Sub SIIx_AppendItemValue(pnd As NotesDocument, p_NomItem As String, p_Valeur As Variant) On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim a_ValeurAjouter As Variant Dim a_ValeurActuelle As Variant
' Formatter la valeur à ajouter If Isarray(p_Valeur) Then a_ValeurAjouter = Fulltrim(p_Valeur) If a_ValeurAjouter(0) = "" Then Exit Sub ' Valeur nulle - ne pas ajouter End If Elseif p_Valeur = "" Then ' Valeur nulle - ne pas ajouter Exit Sub Else a_ValeurAjouter = p_Valeur End If
' Ajouter la valeur à l'item du document a_ValeurActuelle = xVarArray(pnd, p_NomItem) If Isarray(a_ValeurActuelle) Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomItem, Arrayappend(a_ValeurActuelle, a_ValeurAjouter)) Else Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomItem, a_ValeurAjouter) End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIIx, gc_Element_SIIx, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function SIIx_AssignerDate(pnd As Notesdocument, Byval p_NomItem As String, Byval p_Date As Variant) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndt As New Notesdatetime("") Dim ni As Notesitem
If pnd Is Nothing Or p_NomItem = "" Then Exit Function End If
If Datatype(p_Date) <> 7 Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomItem, "") Exit Function End If
' Initialiser le notesdatetime ndt.LSLocalTime = p_Date Call ndt.Setanytime
' Supprimer les items ayant déjà une valeur Call pnd.Removeitem(p_NomItem)
' Assigner la nouvelle valeur Set ni = New Notesitem(pnd, p_NomItem, "") ni.IsSummary = True Set ni.DateTimeValue = ndt
SIIx_AssignerDate = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIIx, gc_Element_SIIx, Getthreadinfo(1), p_NomItem, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIIx_MajItem(pnd As NotesDocument, p_NomItem As String, p_Valeur As Variant, Byval p_Date As Boolean) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
SIIx_MajItem = False
If SIND_ValeurItemEgale(pnd, p_NomItem, p_Valeur, p_Date) = False Then If IsArray(p_Valeur) Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomItem, p_Valeur) ElseIf p_Date Then Call SIIx_AssignerDate(pnd, p_NomItem, p_Valeur) Else Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomItem, p_Valeur) End If
SIIx_MajItem = True End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIIx, gc_Element_SIIx, Getthreadinfo(1), p_NomItem, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIIx_AssignerHeure(pnd As Notesdocument, Byval p_NomItem As String, Byval p_Heure As Variant) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndt As New Notesdatetime("") Dim ni As Notesitem
If pnd Is Nothing Or p_NomItem = "" Then Exit Function End If
If Datatype(p_Heure) <> 7 Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomItem, "") Exit Function End If
' Initialiser le notesdatetime If Isdate(p_Heure) Then ndt.LSLocalTime = p_Heure Call ndt.SetAnyDate
' Supprimer les items ayant déjà une valeur Call pnd.Removeitem(p_NomItem)
' Assigner la nouvelle valeur Set ni = New Notesitem(pnd, p_NomItem, "") ni.IsSummary = True Set ni.DateTimeValue = ndt
SIIx_AssignerHeure = True End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIIx, gc_Element_SIIx, Getthreadinfo(1), p_NomItem, False) Exit Function End Function
Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_GestionErreurs" Use "x_GDK"

Dim gns_VAdmS As notesSession Dim gndb_VAdmS As NotesDatabase
Dim gnuiws_VAdmS As notesuiworkspace Dim gnuiv_VAdmS As notesuiview
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_VAdmS = "SL" Const gc_Element_VAdmS = "V_AdmS"

Sub VAdmS_acRestaurer '=============================================================== ' Restaurer des documents par l'administrateur '=============================================================== On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As Notesdocument Dim v_NbMaj As Long Dim v_Restaurer As Boolean Dim v_HistoNS As String Dim nd_Parent As NotesDocument
' Initialisations Call VAdmS_Initialisations
Set ndc = gndb_VAdmS.UnprocessedDocuments If ndc.Count = 0 Then ' Aucun document sélectionné. Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 2, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub End If
'Valider avec l'usager If Messagebox(xGDK_xMessage("SI", 112, "", ""), 36, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 98, "", Cstr(ndc.Count))) <> 6 Then Exit Sub End If
Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
v_Restaurer = False If nd.HasItem("HistoRS") Then Set nd_Parent = nd.ParentDatabase.GetDocumentByUNID(xvar(nd, "HistoRS", "")) If Not (nd_Parent Is Nothing) Then v_Restaurer = True End If Else v_Restaurer = True End If
If v_Restaurer Then v_HistoNS = xVar(nd,"HistoNS","")
' Restaurer le document nd.form = xVar(nd, "FormOriginal", "") Call nd.RemoveItem( "FormOriginal" ) Call nd.RemoveItem( "HistoNS" ) Call nd.RemoveItem( "HistoDS" ) Call nd.RemoveItem( "HistoDS100" ) Call nd.RemoveItem( "HistoUS" ) Call nd.RemoveItem( "HistoPS" ) If nd.HasItem("HistoRS") Then Call nd.MakeResponse(nd_Parent) Call nd.RemoveItem( "HistoRS" ) End If nd.HistoDM = Now nd.HistoUM = gns_VAdmS.UserName Call nd.Save(True,False) v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1
' Restaurer les sous-documents If v_HistoNS <> "" Then Call VAdmS_RestaurerReponses(nd, v_HistoNS) End If End If Loop
Call gnuiws_VAdmS.CurrentView.Deselectall Call gnuiws_VAdmS.ViewRefresh Print xGDK_xMessage("SI", 114, "", Cstr(v_NbMaj)) Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VAdmS, gc_Element_VAdmS, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub VAdmS_RestaurerReponses(pnd As Notesdocument, p_NoAdmS As Variant) On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd As Notesdocument
' Supprimer les documents réponses-de-réponses Set ndc = pnd.Responses If Not (ndc Is Nothing) Then If ndc.Count > 0 Then Set nd = ndc.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd Is Nothing If xVar(nd, "Form", "") <> "F_AdmS" Then ' Restaurer le document nd.form = xVar(nd, "FormOriginal", "") Call nd.RemoveItem( "FormOriginal" ) Call nd.RemoveItem( "HistoNS" ) Call nd.RemoveItem( "HistoDS" ) Call nd.RemoveItem( "HistoDS100" ) Call nd.RemoveItem( "HistoUS" ) Call nd.RemoveItem( "HistoPS" ) nd.HistoDM = Now nd.HistoUM = gns_VAdmS.UserName Call nd.Save(True,False)
' Restaurer les sous-documents Call VAdmS_RestaurerReponses(nd, p_NoAdmS) End If
Set nd = ndc.GetNextDocument(nd) Loop End If
End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VAdmS, gc_Element_VAdmS, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub VAdmS_Initialisations If gns_VAdmS Is Nothing Then Set gns_VAdmS = New notesSession Set gndb_VAdmS = gns_VAdmS.CurrentDatabase
Set gnuiws_VAdmS = New notesuiworkspace Set gnuiv_VAdmS = gnuiws_VAdmS.CurrentView End If End Sub

Sub VAdmS_acViderCorbeille '=============================================================== ' Restaurer des documents par l'administrateur '=============================================================== On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nv As NotesView Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim v_NbMaj As Long
' Initialisations Call VAdmS_Initialisations
'Valider avec l'usager If Messagebox(xGDK_xMessage("SI", 211, "", ""), 36, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 10, "", "")) <> 6 Then Exit Sub End If
Set nv = gndb_VAdmS.GetView("V_AdmS") Set nd_Suivant = nv.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = nv.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
' Supprimer le document Call nd.Remove(True) v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 Loop
Call gnuiws_VAdmS.ViewRefresh Print xGDK_xMessage("SI", 113, "", Cstr(v_NbMaj)) Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VAdmS, gc_Element_VAdmS, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub VAdmS_acSupprimerSelection '=============================================================== ' Restaurer des documents par l'administrateur '=============================================================== On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim v_NbMaj As Long
' Initialisations Call VAdmS_Initialisations
Set ndc = gndb_VAdmS.UnprocessedDocuments If ndc.Count = 0 Then ' Aucun document sélectionné. Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 2, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub End If
'Valider avec l'usager If Messagebox(xGDK_xMessage("SI", 111, "", ""), 36, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 98, "", Cstr(ndc.Count))) <> 6 Then Exit Sub End If

Function FCSCo_xndPropositionValide(p_NoProposition As String, p_NbProposition As String ) As NotesDocument On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim v_ValeurValid As String Dim v_ValidMessage As String
Call FCSCo_Initialisations Set FCSCo_xndPropositionValide = Nothing
v_ValeurValid = FCSCo_ValiderProposition(p_NoProposition , p_NbProposition , nd )
If v_ValeurValid <> "1" Then
Select Case v_ValeurValid Case "96" : v_ValidMessage="Le numéro de proposition " + p_NoProposition + " n'appartient pas au numéro du client."
Case "97" : v_ValidMessage=xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 69, "", p_NoProposition)
Case "98" : v_ValidMessage=xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 70, "", p_NoProposition)
Case "99" : v_ValidMessage=xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 71, "", p_NoProposition)
Case Else : v_ValidMessage="Erreur" End Select
MessageBox v_ValidMessage , 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Function End If
If Not nd Is Nothing Then Set FCSCo_xndPropositionValide = nd End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FCSCo, gc_Element_FCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function FCSCo_acReviser As Boolean On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_StatutContrat As String Dim v_NoRevision As String Dim v_RevisionCourante As Double Dim v_NoEnRevision As Double Dim v_NoDernRevision As Double Dim v_NoContrat As String Dim nd_CSCoRev As NotesDocument Dim nd_CSCoNouveauRev As NotesDocument Dim v_newUIDoc As NotesUIDocument Dim nv_CSCoRev As NotesView Dim nv_CSCoRen As NotesView Dim v_NoContratFmt As String Dim v_histoText As String Dim nd_CSCoRen As NotesDocument
FCSCo_acReviser=False
Call FCSCo_Initialisations
v_histoText="Révision"
v_NoContrat = xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_NoContrat" , "") v_NoContratFmt = xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_NoContratFmt" , "")
v_StatutContrat = xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_StatutContrat" , "")
If v_StatutContrat = "10" Then Call SDSCSCo_AssignerStatutContrat(gnd_FCSCo,Nothing, "05" , "") Call FCSCo_MajContratUI(v_NoContratFmt , "" )
Else
If v_StatutContrat = "50" Or v_StatutContrat = "30" Then 'Validation Une seul revision permise en tout temp If SDSCSCo_ValidRevision( v_NoContrat ) Then
v_NoDernRevision = xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_DerniereRevision" , 0)
If v_NoDernRevision > 0 Then v_RevisionCourante = v_NoDernRevision Else v_RevisionCourante = xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_NoRevision" , 0) End If
v_NoRevision = SDSCSCo_CreerNoRevision(v_RevisionCourante)
Set nd_CSCoNouveauRev = SDSCSCo_CreerRevision(v_NoRevision , gnd_FCSCo) If Not nd_CSCoNouveauRev Is Nothing Then
Call gnuid_FCSCo.close gnd_FCSCo.CSCo_DerniereRevision = v_NoRevision
gnd_FCSCo.CSCo_StatutTemporaire="1" Call gnd_FCSCo.Save(True,False) Call nd_CSCoNouveauRev.Save( True, True )
Call FCSCo_MajContratUI(xVar(nd_CSCoNouveauRev, "CSCo_NoContratFmt" , "") , "" )
Call gnuiws_FCSCo.ViewRefresh FCSCo_acReviser=True End If
End If
End If End If
Exit Function GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FCSCo, gc_Element_FCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function
End Function

Function FCSCo_acRenouveler As Boolean On Error GoTo GererErreur FCSCo_acRenouveler=False
Call FCSCo_Initialisations Dim v_StatutContrat As String
Dim v_NoContrat As String
Dim nd_CSCoRev As NotesDocument Dim nd_CSCoRen As NotesDocument Dim v_newUIDoc As NotesUIDocument
Dim nv_CSCoRev As NotesView Dim v_NoContratFmt As String Dim v_histoText As String Dim v_MessageConfirmer As String Dim v_MessageAviser As String
v_MessageConfirmer = xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 15, "", "") v_StatutContrat = xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_StatutContrat" , "")
v_NoContrat = xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_NoContrat" , "") v_NoContratFmt = xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_NoContratFmt" , "")
'Verification si contrat peut être renouvellé If xvar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_NePasRenouveler", "") <> "" Then MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 103, "", v_NoContratFmt), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Function End If
'Verification si contrat en Revisio Call xnd("CSCo_NoContrat", v_NoContrat, True, gndb_FCSCo, "V_CSCo22", nv_CSCoRev, nd_CSCoRev) If Not nd_CSCoRev Is Nothing Then If MessageBox(xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 33, "", v_NoContratFmt), 36, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 185, "", "")) <> 6 Then Exit Function End If End If
'Verification si contrat en Renouvellement Call xnd("CSCo_NoContratParent", v_NoContrat, True, gndb_FCSCo, "V_CSCo26", nv_CSCoRev, nd_CSCoRen) If Not nd_CSCoRen Is Nothing Then If xVar(nd_CSCoRen,"CSCo_NoContrat","") <> v_NoContrat Then MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 35, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Function End If End If
If MessageBox(v_MessageConfirmer, 36, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 185, "", "")) = 6 Then Call SDSCSCo_EnleverProduitsHtml(gnd_FCSCo) Set nd_CSCoRen = SDSCSCo_Renouvellement(gnd_FCSCo)
Call gnuid_FCSCo.close Set v_newUIDoc = gnuiws_FCSCo.EditDocument(True, nd_CSCoRen) Call gnuiws_FCSCo.ViewRefresh End If
FCSCo_acRenouveler = True
Exit Function GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FCSCo, gc_Element_FCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function
End Function

Sub FCSCo_acPPARecu()

v_NoContratFmt = xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_NoContratFmt" , "")
If SDSCSCo_FormulairePPArecu(gnd_FCSCo) Then
If Not (gnuid_FCSCo Is Nothing) Then v_StatutGnuid=gnuid_FCSCo.editMode
gnd_FCSCo.SaveOptions = "0" Call gnuid_FCSCo.Close Delete gnuid_FCSCo
Set nd = xSDSCS_xndCSCo(v_NoContratFmt , True )

End If
Call gnuiws_FCSCo.ViewRefresh
End If

Sub FCSCo_acAssignerParametresAugmentation ' ---------------------------------- ' Modification de la date d'echeance ' ---------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur

If xVar(nd_DB, "DB_AugmentationPlafond", "") <> xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_AugmentationPlafond", "") Then gnd_FCSCo.CSCo_AugmentationPlafond = xVar(nd_DB, "DB_AugmentationPlafond", "") v_Changements = True End If
If xVar(nd_DB, "DB_AugmentationArrondi", "") <> xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_AugmentationArrondi", "") Then gnd_FCSCo.CSCo_AugmentationArrondi = xVar(nd_DB, "DB_AugmentationArrondi", "") v_Changements = True End If

Sub FCSCo_NbMoisGratuit( p_Refresh As Boolean)
On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_DateDebut As Variant Dim v_DateMoiGratuit As Variant Dim v_NbMoisGratuits As String Dim v_MaxNbMoisGratuits As Long Dim ndt_DateMoiGratuit As NotesDateTime Dim v_DateFactureJusquau As Variant Dim v_DateDebutFacturation As Variant
Call FCSCo_Initialisations
v_NbMoisGratuits = xVar(gnd_FCSCo,"CSCo_NbMoisGratuits","") v_DateDebut = xVar(gnd_FCSCo,"CSCo_DateDebut","") v_MaxNbMoisGratuits = xSDSCS_xVarProf("Prof_MaxNbMoisGratuits" , 24) v_DateFactureJusquau = xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_DateFactureJusquau_1", "") v_DateDebutFacturation = xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_DateDebutFacturation", "")
If v_NbMoisGratuits = "" And v_DateDebutFacturation <> "" Then
gl_FCSCoItemsValeurOriginal("CSCo_DateDebutFacturation") = xVar(gnd_FCSCo,"CSCo_DateDebutFacturation","") gl_FCSCoItemsValeurOriginal("CSCo_NbMoisGratuits") = ""
'Call gnd_FCSCo.replaceItemValue("CSCo_NbMoisGratuits", "") If p_Refresh Then On Error 4412 GoTo FinSub Call gnuid_FCSCo.Refresh On Error 4412 GoTo GererErreur End If
Else If v_NbMoisGratuits <> "" Then 'Calcul de date debut facturation avec mois gratuits If v_NbMoisGratuits > 0 And v_NbMoisGratuits <= v_MaxNbMoisGratuits Then
If v_DateDebut <> "" Then
Set ndt_DateMoiGratuit = New NotesDateTime(v_DateDebut) Call ndt_DateMoiGratuit.AdjustMonth( v_NbMoisGratuits )
v_DateMoiGratuit = ndt_DateMoiGratuit.lslocaltime
If v_DateFactureJusquau <> "" And ( v_DateFactureJusquau > v_DateMoiGratuit ) Then MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 143, "", "" ), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") gnd_FCSCo.CSCo_NbMoisGratuits = gl_FCSCoItemsValeurOriginal("CSCo_NbMoisGratuits") Exit Sub End If
Call xAssignerDate(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_DateDebutFacturation", v_DateMoiGratuit)
gl_FCSCoItemsValeurOriginal("CSCo_DateDebutFacturation") = xVar(gnd_FCSCo,"CSCo_DateDebutFacturation","") gl_FCSCoItemsValeurOriginal("CSCo_NbMoisGratuits") = xVar(gnd_FCSCo,"CSCo_NbMoisGratuits","")
If p_Refresh Then On Error 4412 GoTo FinSub Call gnuid_FCSCo.Refresh On Error 4412 GoTo GererErreur End If End If Else MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 132, "", v_MaxNbMoisGratuits ), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Call gnd_FCSCo.replaceItemValue("CSCo_NbMoisGratuits", "") If p_Refresh Then On Error 4412 GoTo FinSub Call gnuid_FCSCo.Refresh On Error 4412 GoTo GererErreur End If End If
Else gnd_FCSCo.CSCo_DateDebutFacturation = "" If p_Refresh Then On Error 4412 GoTo FinSub Call gnuid_FCSCo.Refresh On Error 4412 GoTo GererErreur End If End If End If
FinSub: Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FCSCo, gc_Element_FCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub FCSCo_MajMoisGratuits( p_Refresh As Boolean)
On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_NbMoisGratuits As String Dim v_DateFactureJusquau As Variant Dim v_DateDebutFacturation As Variant
Dim vgl_NbMoisGratuits As String Dim vgl_DateDebutFacturation As Variant
Call FCSCo_Initialisations
v_NbMoisGratuits = xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_NbMoisGratuits", "") v_DateFactureJusquau = xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_DateFactureJusquau_1", "") v_DateDebutFacturation = xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_DateDebutFacturation", "")
vgl_NbMoisGratuits = gl_FCSCoItemsValeurOriginal("CSCo_NbMoisGratuits") vgl_DateDebutFacturation = gl_FCSCoItemsValeurOriginal("CSCo_DateDebutFacturation")
If v_DateDebutFacturation = "" Then Call FCSCo_NbMoisGratuit( p_Refresh ) Else
If v_NbMoisGratuits = gl_FCSCoItemsValeurOriginal("CSCo_NbMoisGratuits") Then If gl_FCSCoItemsValeurOriginal("CSCo_DateDebutFacturation") <> v_DateDebutFacturation Then gl_FCSCoItemsValeurOriginal("CSCo_NbMoisGratuits") = "" gnd_FCSCo.CSCo_NbMoisGratuits = "" End If End If
If v_DateFactureJusquau <> "" Then If v_DateFactureJusquau < v_DateDebutFacturation Then Call FCSCo_NbMoisGratuit( p_Refresh ) Else MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 143, "", "" ), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") End If End If
End If
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FCSCo, gc_Element_FCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function FCSCo_ExtraireSitePropo ( p_NbProposition As String, p_typeProposition As String, pnd_Proposition As NotesDocument ) As String
On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nd_Proposition As NotesDocument Dim v_ClientNoFmt As String Dim v_NoClientPropo As String Dim a_PropNoSites As Variant Dim v_PropoTrouve As Boolean
FCSCo_ExtraireSitePropo = ""
Call FCSCo_Initialisations
v_ClientNoFmt = xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_ClientNoFmt", "")
If v_ClientNoFmt = "" Then Exit Function End If
Set nd_Proposition = xSDSP3_xndProp22( p_NbProposition , True)
If nd_Proposition Is Nothing Then p_typeProposition = "SDSPP" Set nd_Proposition = xSDSPP_xndProp22( p_NbProposition , True) End If
If Not nd_Proposition Is Nothing Then
a_PropNoSites = xVARArray(nd_Proposition, "Prop_NoSites")
ForAll v_NoSite In a_PropNoSites
If p_typeProposition = "SDSP3" Then v_NoClientPropo = xSDSP3_xVarSite(v_NoSite, "Site_ClientNoFmt", "" , False) Else v_NoClientPropo = xSDSPP_xVarSite(v_NoSite, "Site_ClientNoFmt", "" , False) End If
If v_NoClientPropo <> "" Then If v_NoClientPropo = v_ClientNoFmt Then If p_typeProposition = "SDSP3" Then FCSCo_ExtraireSitePropo = "1" Else FCSCo_ExtraireSitePropo = xVar(nd_Proposition,"Prop_Hebergement","0") End If Set pnd_Proposition = nd_Proposition gnd_FCSCo.CSCo_PropositionOrigine = p_typeProposition Exit ForAll End If End If
End ForAll
'If pnd_Proposition Is Nothing Then ' FCSCo_ExtraireSitePropo = "99" 'End If

Sub FCSCo_acModifierDateFin ' ---------------------------------- ' Modification de la date d'echeance ' ---------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_DatePrecedente As Variant Dim nd_DB As NotesDocument Dim v_NouvelleDate As Variant Dim v_NbPasRenouveler As String Dim v_histoText As String
' Initialisations Call FCSCo_Initialisations
Set nd_DB = New NotesDocument(gndb_FCSCo)
v_DatePrecedente = xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_DateFin", "") nd_DB.DB_DateMin = xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_DateDebut", "") nd_DB.DB_Date = v_DatePrecedente nd_DB.DB_NePasRenouveler = xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_NePasRenouveler", "")
If gnuiws_FCSCo.DialogBox("DB_DateFin", True, True, False, False, False, False, xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 45, "", ""), nd_DB, True, False, True) = False Then Exit Sub End If
v_NouvelleDate = xVar(nd_DB, "DB_Date", "") If v_NouvelleDate <> v_DatePrecedente Then v_HistoText = "Action : Modification de la date d'échéance" & Chr(13) & "Date précédente : " & Format(v_DatePrecedente, "Long Date") v_NbPasRenouveler = xVar(nd_DB, "DB_NePasRenouveler", "") If v_NbPasRenouveler <> xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_NePasRenouveler", "") Then If v_NbPasRenouveler = "1" Then v_HistoText = v_HistoText & Chr(13) & "Ne pas renouveler le contrat" Else v_HistoText = v_HistoText & Chr(13) & "Contrat a renouveler " End If End If
Call xAssignerDate(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_DateFin", v_NouvelleDate) gnd_FCSCo.CSCo_NePasRenouveler = v_NbPasRenouveler Call SDSCSPr_MAJStatutProduitsRevision(gnd_FCSCo)
Call FCSCo_MAJHistorique(gnd_FCSCo, gnuid_FCSCo,"", v_HistoText) If xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_StatutContrat", "")="00" Then Call SDSCSCo_MAJFacture(gnd_FCSCo)
End If Call gnuiws_FCSCo.ViewRefresh End If Exit Sub
FinSub: Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FCSCo, gc_Element_FCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub FCSCo_PropositionValidation( )
On Error GoTo GererErreur Dim nd_Proposition As NotesDocument Dim v_NoProposition As String Dim v_NbProposition As String Dim v_CleProposition As String Dim v_PropStatut As String Dim v_PropType As String Dim v_CSType As String Dim v_ValeurValid As String Dim v_ValidMessage As String Dim v_ClientNoFmt As String
Call FCSCo_Initialisations
v_ValeurValid=""
v_ClientNoFmt = xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_ClientNoFmt", "")
If v_ClientNoFmt = "" Then Exit Sub End If
v_NoProposition = xVar(gnd_FCSCo,"CSCo_NoProposition","") v_NbProposition = xVar(gnd_FCSCo,"CSCo_NbProposition","") v_CleProposition = ""
If v_NoProposition = "" Then Exit Sub End If
v_ValeurValid = FCSCo_ValiderProposition(v_NoProposition , v_NbProposition , nd_Proposition )
If Not nd_Proposition Is Nothing Then v_CleProposition = xVar(nd_Proposition,"Prop_NoProposition","") End If
Call gnd_FCSCo.replaceItemValue("CSCo_NbProposition", v_NbProposition) Call gnd_FCSCo.replaceItemValue("CSCo_ValidProposition", v_ValeurValid) Call gnd_FCSCo.replaceItemValue("CSCo_CleProposition", v_CleProposition)
If v_ValeurValid <> "" Then
Select Case v_ValeurValid
Case "96" : v_ValidMessage="Le numéro de proposition " & v_NoProposition & " n'appartient pas à " & xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_ClientNoFmt", "") Case "97" : v_ValidMessage=xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 69, "", v_NoProposition) Case "98" : v_ValidMessage=xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 70, "", v_NoProposition) Case "99" : v_ValidMessage=xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 71, "", v_NoProposition) Case "1" : v_ValidMessage="" End Select
Call gnd_FCSCo.replaceItemValue("CSCo_Msg_1", v_ValidMessage) 'gnd_FCSCo.CSCo_Msg_1 = v_ValidMessage End If
Call gnuid_FCSCo.RefreshHideFormulas
Exit Sub

If v_StatutContrat >= 10 Then 'Empecher l'edition Call gns_FCSCo.SetEnvironmentVar(v_EnvVarNom,"") Exit Function Else Call gns_FCSCo.SetEnvironmentVar(v_EnvVarNom,"1") If p_Reload Then Call FCSCo_OuvrirEnEdition( ) End If
End If Else Call gns_FCSCo.SetEnvironmentVar(v_EnvVarNom,"")
End If
FCSCo_ModeChange = True
Exit Function GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FCSCo, gc_Element_FCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function FCSCo_AdditionnerMontantPasEnVigueur( pnd_FCSCo As NotesDocument ) As Double On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ndc_Produits As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim v_Cumul As Double Dim v_NoContratFmt As String Dim v_StatutContrat As String
Dim v_CSCoDateDebut As Variant Dim v_CSCoDateFin As Variant Dim v_CSPrDateDebut As Variant Dim v_CSPrDateFin As Variant Dim v_StatutProduit As String Dim v_TypeProduit As String Dim v_DateCondition As Variant
Call FCSCo_Initialisations v_Cumul = 0
If gnv_CSPr41_FCSCo Is Nothing then Set gnv_CSPr41_FCSCo = gndb_FCSCo.GetView("V_CSPr41") End If Call gnv_CSPr41_FCSCo.Refresh
v_NoContratFmt=xVar(pnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_NoContratFmt", "") v_CSCoDateDebut = xVar(pnd_FCSCo,"CSCo_DateDebut","") v_CSCoDateFin = xVar(pnd_FCSCo,"CSCo_DateFin","") v_StatutContrat = xVar(pnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_StatutContrat" , "")
If v_StatutContrat = "01" Then v_DateCondition = v_CSCoDateDebut Else v_DateCondition = Today End If
Set ndc_Produits = gnv_CSPr41_FCSCo.GetAllDocumentsByKey(v_NoContratFmt, True)
Set nd_Suivant = ndc_Produits.Getfirstdocument
Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc_Produits.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
v_CSPrDateDebut = xVar(nd,"CSPr_DateDebut", v_CSCoDateDebut) v_CSPrDateFin = xVar(nd,"CSPr_DateFin", v_CSCoDateFin) v_StatutProduit = xVar(nd, "CSPr_StatutProduit" , "") v_TypeProduit = xVar(nd, "CSPr_TypeProduit" , "")
If v_StatutProduit = "00" Then If v_TypeProduit < "10" Then If v_CSPrDateDebut > v_DateCondition Or v_CSPrDateFin < v_DateCondition Then v_Cumul = v_Cumul + xVar(nd, "CSPr_PrixTotal" , 0 ) End If End If End If Loop
FCSCo_AdditionnerMontantPasenVigueur = Round(v_Cumul,2) Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FCSCo, gc_Element_FCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub FCSCo_acChangerStatutProduit
On Error GoTo GererErreur Dim nd_DB As NotesDocument Dim nd_CSPr As NotesDocument Dim v_NumeroSeqProduit As String Dim v_Cle As String Dim v_nomTableStatut As String Dim v_StatutIcone As Integer Dim v_StatutDesc As String Dim nuid As NotesUIDocument
' Initialisations Call FCSCo_Initialisations
v_Cle=xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_NoContratFmt", "") Set nd_DB = New NotesDocument(gndb_FCSCo)
If gnuiws_FCSCo.DialogBox("DB_Prod", True, True, False, False, False, False, xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 61, "", ""), nd_DB, True, False, True) = False Then Exit Sub End If
v_NumeroSeqProduit = xVar(nd_DB, "DB_Num", "") If v_NumeroSeqProduit <> "" Then If gnv_CSPr32_FCSCo is Nothing then Set gnv_CSPr32_FCSCo = gndb_FCSCo.Getview("V_CSPr32") Call gnv_CSPr32_FCSCo.Refresh End If
v_Cle=v_Cle+"-"+v_NumeroSeqProduit Set nd_CSPr = gnv_CSPr32_FCSCo.Getdocumentbykey(v_Cle, True) If nd_CSPr Is Nothing Then ' Le produit n'existe pas MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCs", 62, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub Else
v_nomTableStatut = "CSPr_StatutProduit" v_StatutDesc = xDescTabl("00", v_nomTableStatut, True) v_StatutIcone = xIcnTabl("00", v_nomTableStatut, True)
nd_CSPr.CSPr_StatutProduit = "00" nd_CSPr.CSPr_StatutDescFR=v_StatutDesc nd_CSPr.CSPr_StatutIcone=v_StatutIcone
Call nd_CSPr.Save(True, False)
gnd_FCSCo.SaveOptions = "0" Call gnuid_FCSCo.Close
' Rouvrir le document en édition Set nuid = gnuiws_FCSCo.EditDocument(True, gnd_FCSCo) Delete gnuid_FCSCo Set gnuid_FCSCo = nuid Set gnd_FCSCo = gnuid_FCSCo.Document Call gnd_FCSCo.RemoveItem("SaveOptions")
End If End If
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FCSCo, gc_Element_FCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function FCSCo_CalcDateEngagementInitial(p_DateDebut As Variant, p_NbMoisDateEngagement As Integer) As Variant
On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ndt_DateEngagementInitial As New NotesDateTime("")
Call FCSCo_Initialisations FCSCo_CalcDateEngagementInitial = ""
If p_DateDebut = "" Or p_NbMoisDateEngagement = 0 Then Exit Function End If
ndt_DateEngagementInitial.LSLocalTime = p_DateDebut Call ndt_DateEngagementInitial.SetAnyTime Call ndt_DateEngagementInitial.AdjustMonth(p_NbMoisDateEngagement) Call ndt_DateEngagementInitial.AdjustDay(-1)
FCSCo_CalcDateEngagementInitial = ndt_DateEngagementInitial.LSLocalTime Exit Function

Function FCSCo_ChoisirProduit(p_TypeProduit As String) As Boolean On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nuid As NotesUIDocument Dim ndb_Base As NotesDatabase Dim nd_FCSPr As NotesDocument Dim ndc_Base As NotesDocumentCollection Dim ndc_Produits As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_Base As NotesDocument Dim v_NomVue As String Dim v_TypeInstall As String Dim v_NbUtilisateursObligatoire As String Dim v_NbUtilisateurs As Variant Dim v_NbUtilisateursLong As Long Dim v_TypeProduit As String Dim nv As NotesView
FCSCo_ChoisirProduit = False Call FCSCo_Initialisations Set ndb_Base = xGDK_xndbNDB("SDSBB")
v_TypeInstall = xVar(gnd_FCSCo,"CSCo_TypeInstallation","0")
If p_TypeProduit = "02" Then v_NomVue = "V_Prod40" Else If v_TypeInstall="0" Then v_NomVue = "V_Prod38" ElseIf v_TypeInstall="2" Then ' Rapid - Mensuel v_NomVue = "V_Prod41" ElseIf v_TypeInstall="3" Then ' Rapid - Annuel v_NomVue = "V_Prod42" Else v_NomVue = "V_Prod39" End If End If
Set nv = ndb_Base.GetView(v_NomVue)
Set ndc_Base = SISe_ndcSelectionnerDocuments("", "", SISe_PROMPT, nv, |Prod_DescProduit| & xLangue & _ | + " (" + Prod_CodeProduit + ")"|, "Sélection de produits", "", "1", 10, True)
' Si aucune sélection de produit, fin de la routine If ndc_Base.Count = 0 Then Exit Function End If
Set nd_Base = ndc_Base.getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Base Is Nothing
Set nd_FCSPr = SDSCSPr_NouveauProduit(gnd_FCSCo , p_TypeProduit , gndb_FCSCo) v_NbUtilisateursObligatoire= xVar(nd_Base,"Prod_NbUtilisateursObligatoire","0")
If v_NbUtilisateursObligatoire = "1" Then 'Prompt pour le nbr d'utilisateurs v_NbUtilisateurs = gnuiws_FCSCo.Prompt(PROMPT_OKCANCELEDIT, _ "Un nombre d'utilisateurs est requis pour le produit sélectionner", _ "Veuillez saisir le nombre d'utilisateurs.")
If Not IsEmpty(v_NbUtilisateurs) Then If IsNumeric(v_NbUtilisateurs) Then v_NbUtilisateursLong = CLng(v_NbUtilisateurs) If v_NbUtilisateursLong >= 0 Then nd_FCSPr.CSPr_NbUtilisateurs=v_NbUtilisateursLong Else MessageBox "La valeur saisie est invalide.", 16, "Opération annulée" Exit Function End If Else MessageBox "La valeur saisie est invalide.", 16, "Opération annulée" Exit Function End If End If
End If
Call SDSCSPr_BatirProduit(nd_FCSPr , nd_Base) Call SDSCSPr_AjouterProduit(gnd_FCSCo, nd_FCSPr , gnuiws_FCSCo, p_TypeProduit, "" ) Set nd_Base = ndc_Base.GetNextDocument(nd_Base) Loop
FCSCo_ChoisirProduit = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FCSCo, gc_Element_FCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function FCSCo_Querysave(pnuid_Source As NotesUIDocument) As Boolean On Error GoTo GererErreur FCSCo_Querysave=False
Dim v_NoContratSeq As String Dim v_ActionContrat As String Dim v_StatutContrat As String Dim v_NoRevision As String Dim v_AnneeEntVig As String Dim v_NoContrat As String Dim v_DateDebutFacturation As Variant Dim v_DateFactureJusquau As Variant
Dim nd_CSCo As NotesDocument
Set nd_CSCO = pnuid_Source.document
' Rafraîchir le document pour effectuer les validations On Error 4412 GoTo FinSub Call pnuid_Source.Refresh On Error 4412 GoTo GererErreur
v_ActionContrat="00" v_NoRevision = "000"
v_DateDebutFacturation = xVar(nd_CSCo,"CSCo_DateDebutFacturation","") v_DateFactureJusquau = xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_DateFactureJusquau_1", "")
If SDSCSCo_Validation(nd_CSCO) Then Call FCSCo_PropositionValidation() If pnuid_Source.isnewdoc Then
' date Entre en vigeur v_AnneeEntVig = Year(xVar(nd_CSCo,"CSCo_DateDebut",Today)) v_NoContrat = xVar(nd_CSCo,"CSCo_NoContrat","")
If v_NoContrat ="" Then v_NoContratSeq = SDSCSCo_CreerNoContrat(v_AnneeEntVig)
'Ecrire la composition du numéro de contrat Call pnuid_Source.FieldSetText( "CSCo_NoContrat", v_NoContratSeq ) Call pnuid_Source.FieldSetText( "CSCo_NoRevision", v_NoRevision ) Call pnuid_Source.FieldSetText( "CSCo_NoContratFmt", v_NoContratSeq + "-" + v_NoRevision ) Call pnuid_Source.FieldSetText( "CSCo_NoContratInit", v_NoContratSeq + "-" + v_NoRevision )
End If FCSCo_Querysave=True Else Call SDSCSCo_EnleverProduitsHtml(nd_CSCO) Call pnuid_Source.FieldSetText("CSCo_NbRenouvellementDe", "") Call pnuid_Source.FieldSetText("CSCo_NbRenouvellementA", "") Call pnuid_Source.FieldSetText("CSCo_TauxAugmentation", "") Call pnuid_Source.FieldSetText("CSCo_PlafondAugmentation", "")
If v_DateDebutFacturation > v_DateFactureJusquau Then Call FCSCo_MajMoisGratuits( False ) v_DateDebutFacturation = xVar(nd_CSCo,"CSCo_DateDebutFacturation","")
If gl_FCSCoItemsValeurOriginal("CSCo_DateDebutFacturation_depart") <> v_DateDebutFacturation Then Call SDSCSCo_MAJProduitsMoisGratuit( nd_CSCo ) gl_FCSCoItemsValeurOriginal("CSCo_DateDebutFacturation") = xVar(nd_CSCo,"CSCo_DateDebutFacturation","") gl_FCSCoItemsValeurOriginal("CSCo_NbMoisGratuits") = xVar(nd_CSCo,"CSCo_NbMoisGratuits","") End If End If FCSCo_Querysave=True End If End If FinSub: Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FCSCo, gc_Element_FCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function FCSCo_validImportationProposition( pnd_Proposition As NotesDocument, p_NoProposition As String, p_NbProposition As String, a_NoPropositions As Variant, p_TypeImportation As String, p_typeProduit As String) As Boolean On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_TypeProposition As String Dim v_StatutContrat As String Dim i As Long
Call FCSCo_Initialisations FCSCo_validImportationProposition = False
If IsArray(a_NoPropositions) Then For i = LBound(a_NoPropositions) To UBound(a_NoPropositions) If a_NoPropositions(i) = p_NbProposition Then MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 72, "", p_NoProposition), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Function End If Next End If
v_TypeProposition = xVar(pnd_Proposition,"Prop_TypeProposition","") v_StatutContrat = xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_StatutContrat", "")
' Type proposition : '0 - Nouveau client SDS '1 - Site additionnel '2 - Client existant '3 - Conversion à logiciel-service
Select Case v_StatutContrat
Case "00" : 'Si le statut du CC est 00, il est possible d'importer des PP de tous les types FCSCo_validImportationProposition = True
Case "01" : 'Si le statut du CC est 01, il est possible d'importer des PP de type 2 ou 3 If v_TypeProposition = "2" Or v_TypeProposition = "3" Then FCSCo_validImportationProposition = True Else MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 67, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") End If
Case Else : 'Si le statut du CC est 02 à 09, il est possible d'importer des PP de type 2 seulement If v_TypeProposition = "2" Then ' Client existant FCSCo_validImportationProposition = True Else MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 73, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") End If
End Select
%REM If p_TypeImportation = "ADD" Then If v_TypeProposition < "2" Then ' Client existant Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 73, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Function End If Else If v_TypeProposition > "1" And v_TypeProposition <> "3" Then ' Nouveau client ou Site Add Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 67, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Function End If End If %END REM
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FCSCo, gc_Element_FCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

v_classStatut = "errone" v_Message = "** Nb Usagers ** " Else v_NbUtilisateurs = xVar(pnd, "CSPr_NbUtilisateurs" , "") End If Else v_NbUtilisateurs = "X" End If End If End If End If End If If Function FCSCo_acImporterProposition(p_TypeImportation As String) As Boolean On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim ndc_Produits As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_Proposition As NotesDocument Dim v_NoProposition As String Dim v_NbProposition As String Dim v_ProduitsTraites(3) As Variant Dim a_NoPropositions As Variant Dim v_NoContratFmt As String Dim v_typeProduit As String Dim v_ParamPropo List As Variant Dim l_Produits List As Long Dim v_NoClientPropo As String Dim v_NoClientCS As String Dim v_TypeInstallation As String Dim v_DateDebutFacturation As Variant Dim i As Integer
Call FCSCo_Initialisations
FCSCo_acImporterProposition=False
If Not FCSCo_validationDateDebutFacturation( gnd_FCSCo ) Then MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 142, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Function End If
v_NoContratFmt = xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_NoContratFmt", "") a_NoPropositions = xVarArray(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_NoPropositions") v_TypeInstallation = xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_TypeInstallation", "") v_typeProduit = FCSCo_TypeProduit(v_TypeInstallation) v_DateDebutFacturation = ""
l_Produits("Importes") = 0 l_Produits("Ignores") = 0 l_Produits("ImportesCS") = 0 l_Produits("IgnoresCS") = 0
If p_TypeImportation = "ADD" Then v_NoProposition = gnuiws_FCSCo.Prompt(PROMPT_OKCANCELEDIT, "Importation d'une proposition","Veuillez saisir le numéro de la proposition à importer.") If v_NoProposition = "" Then Exit Function End If Else v_DateDebutFacturation = xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_DateDebutFacturation", "") v_NoProposition = xVar(gnd_FCSCo,"CSCo_NbProposition","") End If
Set nd_Proposition = FCSCo_xndPropositionValide(v_NoProposition , v_NbProposition) If nd_Proposition Is Nothing Then ' Message erreur proposition invalide MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 68, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Function End If
If Not FCSCo_validImportationProposition( nd_Proposition , v_NoProposition, v_NbProposition, a_NoPropositions, p_TypeImportation, v_typeProduit ) Then Exit Function End If
If Not FCSCo_getParamProposition (v_NoProposition , v_NbProposition , nd_Proposition, v_ParamPropo ) Then Exit Function End If
'Aussi, si la PP (site) a un no de client, il ne peut être possible d'importer si ce n'est pas le même client que sur le CC. Req 42710
v_NoClientPropo = xSDSP3_xVarSite(v_ParamPropo("NoSite"), "Site_ClientNoFmt", "" , False) v_NoClientCS = xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_ClientNoFmt", "") If v_NoClientPropo <> "" Then If v_NoClientPropo <> v_NoClientCS Then MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 131, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Function End If End If
If v_ParamPropo("NoSite") <> "" Then
If v_TypeInstallation = "1" Then Set ndc_Produits = xSDSP3_xndcProduits(v_ParamPropo("NoSite")) Else Set ndc_Produits = xSDSPP_xndcProduits(v_ParamPropo("NoSite")) End If
If ndc_Produits.Count = 0 Then MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 74, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Function End If
Set nd_Suivant = ndc_Produits.Getfirstdocument
Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc_Produits.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant) If p_TypeImportation <> "ADD" Or xVar(nd, "Prod_NoContratFmt_CS", "") = "" Then ' Ajouter tous les produits sur un nouveau contrat If FCSCo_PropositionAjoutProduit(nd , v_typeProduit, v_NoProposition, v_ParamPropo("DateDebut"), v_ParamPropo("DateFin"), v_DateDebutFacturation ) Then l_Produits("Importes")=l_Produits("Importes") + 1 Else l_Produits("Ignores")=l_Produits("Ignores") + 1 End If Else l_Produits("Ignores")=l_Produits("Ignores") + 1 End If Loop
Call FCSCo_ImporterCSSurSite(v_NoContratFmt, nd_Proposition , v_NoProposition, l_Produits )
If l_Produits("Importes") >= 1 Then If IsArray(a_NoPropositions) Then i = 0 ForAll proposition In a_NoPropositions ReDim Preserve a_NoPropositionsNouv(i) a_NoPropositionsNouv(i) = proposition i = i+1 End ForAll
ReDim Preserve a_NoPropositionsNouv(i) a_NoPropositionsNouv(i) = v_NbProposition gnd_FCSCo.CSCo_NoPropositions = a_NoPropositionsNouv Else gnd_FCSCo.CSCo_NoPropositions = v_NbProposition End If Call gnd_FCSCo.save(True,False) End If %REM
v_ProduitsTraites(0)=CStr(l_Produits("Importes") ) v_ProduitsTraites(1)=CStr(l_Produits("Ignores") ) v_ProduitsTraites(2)=CStr(l_Produits("ImportesCS")) v_ProduitsTraites(3)=CStr(l_Produits("IgnoresCS")) %END REM
v_ProduitsTraites(0)=CStr(l_Produits("Importes") +l_Produits("ImportesCS") ) MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 66, "", v_ProduitsTraites) , 64, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 10, "", "")
If Not SDSCSCo_ValidProduitsActif(gnd_FCSCo) Then MsgBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 77, "" , "" ),16, xGDK_xMessage("SI",8 , xLangue, "") End If ' ---------------- ** **--------------- Call SDSCSCo_EnleverProduitsHtml(gnd_FCSCo) Call FCSCo_MAJHistorique(gnd_FCSCo, gnuid_FCSCo,"", "Action : Importation de la proposition" & v_NoProposition) Call SDSCSCo_rafraichirContratUI(gnd_FCSCo, gnuid_FCSCo , "Produits")
Call gnuiws_FCSCo.ViewRefresh End If 'v_NoSite not null
FCSCo_acImporterProposition=True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FCSCo, gc_Element_FCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function FCSCo_ImporterCSSurSite(p_NoContratFmt As String, pnd_Proposition As NotesDocument, p_NoProposition As String, l_Produits As Variant ) As Boolean On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_ListNoContratFmt As Variant Dim v_PropNoContrat As String Dim v_NoContrat As String Dim v_NoContratParent As String Dim v_ReferenceClient As String Dim v_NoBonCommande As String Dim nd_CS As NotesDocument Dim nd_Site As NotesDocument Dim v_DateFinCSSource As Variant Dim v_DateDebutCSDestination As Variant
Dim v_NoContratTraite As String Dim v_NoContratCle As String Dim v_ListNoContratTraite List As String
FCSCo_ImporterCSSurSite=False Call FCSCo_Initialisations
v_NoContrat = xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_NoContrat", "") v_NoContratParent = xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCO_NOCONTRATPARENT", "")
Set nd_Site = xSDSP3_xndSite(xVarElem(pnd_Proposition, "Prop_NoSites", 0 , ""), True) If Not nd_Site Is Nothing Then
v_ListNoContratFmt = xVarArray(nd_Site, "Site_NoContratFmt_CS")
If IsArray( v_ListNoContratFmt ) Then ForAll v_ProNoContratFmt In v_ListNoContratFmt
If v_ProNoContratFmt <> "" Then v_PropNoContrat = StrLeftBack( v_ProNoContratFmt, "-" )
If v_NoContrat <> v_PropNoContrat Then If v_NoContratParent <> v_PropNoContrat Then Set nd_CS = FCSCo_xndCSSurSiteValide( v_PropNoContrat )
If Not nd_CS Is Nothing Then v_DateFinCSSource = xVar(nd_CS,"CSCo_DateFin","") v_DateDebutCSDestination = xVar(gnd_FCSCo,"CSCo_DateDebut","")
If v_DateDebutCSDestination > v_DateFinCSSource + 1 Then Set nd_CS = FCSCo_xndCSSurSiteValide( xVar(nd_CS,"CSCo_NoRenouvellement","") )
If nd_CS Is Nothing Then ' message d'erreur 'Le CS ne peut pas être importé car il n'a pas été renouvelé. MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 118, "", v_ProNoContratFmt), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Function End If End If Else Exit Function End If
v_NoContratCle = xVar(nd_CS, "CSCo_NoContrat", "") If Not IsElement(v_ListNoContratTraite(v_NoContratCle)) Then If SDSCSCo_ImporterCSSurSite(gnd_FCSCo, nd_CS , p_NoProposition, p_NoProposition, l_Produits ) Then v_NoContratTraite = xVar(nd_CS, "CSCo_NoContrat", "") v_ListNoContratTraite(v_NoContratTraite) = v_ProNoContratFmt FCSCo_ImporterCSSurSite = True End If End If
End If End If End If End ForAll End If End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FCSCo, gc_Element_FCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function FCSCo_ValiderProposition(p_NoProposition As String, p_NbProposition As String , pnd_Proposition As NotesDocument )As String
On Error GoTo GererErreur Dim nd_Proposition As NotesDocument
Dim v_NbProposition As String Dim v_PropStatut As String Dim v_PropType As String Dim v_CSType As String Dim v_ValeurValid As String
Call FCSCo_Initialisations
FCSCo_ValiderProposition = "" v_ValeurValid = ""
If p_NoProposition = "" Then Exit Function End If
v_NbProposition = p_NoProposition
If InStr(v_NbProposition , "-" ) > 0 Then v_NbProposition=StrRightBack ( v_NbProposition , "-" ) End If
If InStr( v_NbProposition, "." ) > 0 Then v_NbProposition = StrLeftBack ( v_NbProposition , "." ) End If p_NbProposition = v_NbProposition
If Not IsNumeric(v_NbProposition) Then v_ValeurValid = "99" Else
v_PropType = FCSCo_ExtraireSitePropo ( v_NbProposition , "SDSP3" , nd_Proposition)
If v_PropType = "" Then v_PropType = FCSCo_ExtraireSitePropo ( v_NbProposition , "SDSPP", nd_Proposition ) End If
If v_PropType = "" Then v_ValeurValid = "96" Else If nd_Proposition Is Nothing Then v_ValeurValid = "99" Else Set pnd_Proposition = nd_Proposition v_ValeurValid = "1"
v_CSType = xVar(gnd_FCSCo,"CSCo_TypeInstallation","")
If v_CSType <> v_PropType Then v_ValeurValid = "98" Else v_PropStatut = xVar(nd_Proposition,"PROP_STATUT","") If v_PropStatut < "60" Or v_PropStatut > "95" Then v_ValeurValid = "97" End If End If End If End If End If
FCSCo_ValiderProposition = v_ValeurValid Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FCSCo, gc_Element_FCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub FCSCo_Queryrecalc(pnuid_Source As NotesUIDocument ) On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_TypeInstallation As String Dim v_TypePeriodeOrig As String Dim v_ModePaiementOrig As String Dim v_TypePeriode As String Dim v_ModePaiement As String Dim v_ModePaiementTable As String Dim v_NoProposition As String Dim v_CleProposition As String Dim v_ClientNo1 As String Dim v_ClientNo2 As String Dim v_ClientNoFmt As String Dim v_AutreCSenVigueur As Variant Dim v_Options As String Dim nd_CSCo As NotesDocument
Call FCSCo_Initialisations
Set nd_CSCo = pnuid_Source.Document
v_Options = "" v_TypeInstallation = xVar(nd_CSCo,"CSCo_TypeInstallation","") v_TypePeriodeOrig = xVar(nd_CSCo,"CSCo_TypePeriode","") v_ModePaiementOrig = xVar(nd_CSCo,"CSCo_ModePaiement","")
v_ClientNo1 = xVar(nd_CSCo, "CSCo_ClientNo1", "") v_ClientNo2 = xVar(nd_CSCo, "CSCo_ClientNo2", "") If v_ClientNo1 <> "" Then v_ClientNo2 = "-" & Right("000" & v_ClientNo2, 3) End If
v_ClientNoFmt = v_ClientNo1 + v_ClientNo2
v_TypePeriode =xComplTabl(v_TypeInstallation, "CSCo_TypeInstallation", "1", True) v_ModePaiement =xComplTabl(v_TypeInstallation, "CSCo_TypeInstallation", "2", True)
Call nd_CSCo.replaceItemValue("CSCo_OptionsCSEnVigeur_1", "")
If pnuid_Source.isnewdoc Then If v_ClientNoFmt <> "" Then
'si client a un autre contrat valid 30 ou 50 then CSCo_PremierContrat = 0 v_AutreCSenVigueur = Evaluate(|@Trim(@Replace(@IfError(@DbLookup("":"NoCache";""; "V_CSCO12" ; "| & v_ClientNoFmt & |" ; 2);"");CSCo_NoContrat; "")) |,nd_CSCo) If IsArray(v_AutreCSenVigueur) Then v_Options = v_AutreCSenVigueur(0) End If
If v_Options <> "" Then Call nd_CSCo.replaceItemValue("CSCo_PremierContrat", "") Call nd_CSCo.replaceItemValue("CSCo_OptionsCSEnVigeur_1", "1") Call nd_CSCo.replaceItemValue("CSCo_AutreCSEnVigeur_1", "1") Call pnuid_Source.RefreshHideFormulas End If
End If End If
If xVar(nd_CSCo, "CSCo_DateFin" , "") <> "" Then If Not SDSCSCo_ValidationDateFin( nd_CSCo ) Then MessageBox "La date d'échéance n'est pas valide" , 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Call nd_CSCo.replaceItemValue("CSCo_DateFin", "") End If End If
' Mode de paiement et période de facturation If v_TypePeriode <> "99" Then Call nd_CSCo.replaceItemValue("CSCo_TypePeriode", v_TypePeriode) If v_ModePaiement <> "99" Then Call nd_CSCo.replaceItemValue("CSCo_ModePaiement", v_ModePaiement) End If Else v_TypePeriode=v_TypePeriodeOrig v_ModePaiement =xComplTabl(v_TypePeriode, "CSFa_PeriodeFacturation", "1", True) End If
If v_TypePeriode <> "" Then If v_ModePaiement <> "99" Then v_ModePaiementOrig=v_ModePaiement Call nd_CSCo.replaceItemValue("CSCo_ModePaiement", v_ModePaiement) End If End If
If xVar(nd_CSCo, "CSCo_ClientFact", "") = "1" Then nd_CSCo.CSCo_ClientFactNo1 = "" nd_CSCo.CSCo_ClientFactNo2 = "" nd_CSCo.CSCo_ClientFactNoFmt = "" nd_CSCo.CSCo_ClientFactNom1 = "" nd_CSCo.CSCo_ClientFactNom2 = "" End If
Call FCSCo_PropositionValidation
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FCSCo, gc_Element_FCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub FCSCo_OuvrirEnLecture(pnuid As NotesUIDocument ) On Error GoTo GererErreur Dim nuid As NotesUIDocument Dim nd As NotesDocument

Sub FCSCo_acModifierDateEngagement ' ---------------------------------- ' Modification de la date d'echeance ' ---------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_NbMoisPrecedent As Integer Dim v_DateEngagementPrecedent As Variant Dim nd_DB As NotesDocument Dim v_NbMoisDateEngagement As Integer Dim v_DateEngagementInitial As Variant Dim v_HistoText As String
' Initialisations Call FCSCo_Initialisations
v_NbMoisPrecedent = xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_NbMoisDateEngagement", 0) v_DateEngagementPrecedent = xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_DateEngagementInitial", "")
Set nd_DB = New NotesDocument(gndb_FCSCo)
If gnuiws_FCSCo.DialogBox("DB_NbMDE", True, True, False, False, False, False, "Modification de la date d'engagement", nd_DB, True, False, True) = False Then Exit Sub End If
v_NbMoisDateEngagement = xVar(nd_DB, "DB_NbMoisDateEngagement", 0) v_DateEngagementInitial = FCSCo_CalcDateEngagementInitial(xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_DateDebut", ""), v_NbMoisDateEngagement) If v_NbMoisDateEngagement <> v_NbMoisPrecedent Or v_DateEngagementInitial <> v_DateEngagementPrecedent Then v_HistoText = "Action : Modification de la date d'engagement" & Chr(13) & "Date précédente : " & Format(v_DateEngagementPrecedent, "Short Date") & _ " (" & CStr(v_NbMoisPrecedent) & " mois)"
Call gnd_FCSCo.ReplaceItemValue("CSCo_NbMoisDateEngagement", v_NbMoisDateEngagement) Call xAssignerDate(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_DateEngagementInitial", v_DateEngagementInitial)
Call FCSCo_MAJHistorique(gnd_FCSCo, gnuid_FCSCo,"", v_histoText) Call gnuiws_FCSCo.ViewRefresh End If Exit Sub
FinSub: Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FCSCo, gc_Element_FCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function FCSCo_xndCSSurSiteValide( p_NoContrat As String ) As NotesDocument ' Cette fonction retourne la version dùn contrat valid. On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_EnVigueur As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim v_StatutCS As String Dim v_formule As String Dim v_PropNoContrat As String
' Initialisation des variables globales Call FCSCo_Initialisations
Set nd_EnVigueur = Nothing
v_Formule = {Form = "F_CSCo" & CSCo_NoContrat="} & p_NoContrat & {" } Set ndc = gndb_FCSCo.Search(v_Formule, Nothing, 0) If ndc.Count >= 1 Then
Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant) If Not nd Is Nothing Then v_StatutCS = xVar(nd,"CSCo_StatutContrat","")
Select Case v_StatutCS Case "30", "50" : Set nd_EnVigueur = nd Exit Do
Case "90" : v_PropNoContrat = xVar(nd,"CSCo_NoRenouvellement","") Set nd = FCSCo_xndCSSurSiteValide( v_PropNoContrat ) Set nd_EnVigueur = nd Exit Do
Case Else : 'v_ValidMessage="Erreur" End Select
End If Loop End If
Set FCSCo_xndCSSurSiteValide = nd_EnVigueur Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FCSCo, gc_Element_FCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function FCSCo_PropositionConfirmation(p_NoProposition As String , p_NbProposition As String, pnd_Proposition As NotesDocument) As NotesDocument On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim v_NomDB As String Dim v_TypeInstallation As String Dim v_StatutContrat As String Dim v_PropositionOrigine As String
v_StatutContrat = xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_StatutContrat", "") v_PropositionOrigine = xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_PropositionOrigine", "")
Set nd = New NotesDocument(gndb_FCSCo) v_TypeInstallation = xVar(gnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_TypeInstallation", "")
'Lors de l'importation d'une proposition, il faut demander la date de début seulement lorsque le statut du CC est 02 à 09 'et utiliser cette date comme date de début de tous les produits ajoutés.
If v_StatutContrat > "01" And v_StatutContrat < "10"Then nd.DB_CacheDates = "1" Else nd.DB_CacheDates = "0" End If
nd.DB_NoProposition = xVar(pnd_Proposition,"Prop_NoProposition","")
' Afficher le no de la proposition nd.DB_NbProposition = xVar(pnd_Proposition,"Prop_NbPropositionTXT","")
' le type de client nd.DB_TypePropositionDescFR = pnd_Proposition.Prop_TypePropositionDescFR
nd.Db_Hebergement = xGDK_xDescTabl(v_TypeInstallation, "SDS_TypeInstallation", True)
' la description nd.DB_Description = pnd_Proposition.Prop_DescProposition
' le nom du client nd.DB_Prop_ClientNoFmt = pnd_Proposition.Prop_ClientNoFmt nd.DB_ClientNomInterne = xVar(pnd_Proposition,"Prop_ClientNomInterne",xVar(pnd_Proposition,"Prop_ClientNom","")) nd.DB_PropositionOrigine = v_PropositionOrigine If v_TypeInstallation = "1" Then v_NomDB="SDSP3" Else v_NomDB="SDSPP" End If
nd.DB_Serveur = xGDK_xVarNDB(v_NomDB, "NDB_Serveur", "", True) nd.DB_Fichier = xGDK_xVarNDB(v_NomDB, "NDB_Fichier", "", True)
Set FCSCo_PropositionConfirmation = nd Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FCSCo, gc_Element_FCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function
End Function

Function FCSCo_PropositionAjoutProduit(pnd_Produit As NotesDocument , p_ClasseProduit As String, p_NoProposition As String , p_DateDebut As Variant , p_DateFin As Variant, p_DateDebutFacturation As Variant ) As Boolean On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nd_CSPr As NotesDocument Dim v_TypeProduit As String Dim v_ClasseProduit As String Dim v_CleProduit As String Dim v_PrixUnitaire As Double Dim v_FraisEntretienAnnuels As Double Dim v_Quantite As Long Dim v_FraisEntretienMensuels As Double Dim nd_ProdSDSBB As NotesDocument Dim v_NbUtilisateursObligatoire As String
FCSCo_PropositionAjoutProduit=False
If xVar(pnd_Produit,"Prod_Quantite",0) = 0 Then Exit Function End If
Call FCSCo_Initialisations
v_TypeProduit = "01" v_CleProduit = xVar(pnd_Produit,"Prod_CleProduitAH",xVar(pnd_Produit,"Prod_CleProduitCS",""))
If v_CleProduit <> "" Then
Set nd_ProdSDSBB = xSDSBB_xndProd(v_CleProduit, True) v_ClasseProduit = xVar(nd_ProdSDSBB,"Prod_ClasseProduit",0)
If p_ClasseProduit = v_ClasseProduit Then v_FraisEntretienAnnuels = xVar(pnd_Produit,"Prod_FraisEntretienAnnuels",0) v_FraisEntretienMensuels = xVar(pnd_Produit,"Prod_FraisEntretienMensuels",0)
'v_FraisEntretienMensuels=SItN_ArrondirHaut(Round(v_FraisEntretienAnnuels / 12, 2), 1)
v_Quantite = xVar(pnd_Produit,"Prod_Quantite",0) If v_ClasseProduit = "AH" Then v_PrixUnitaire=v_FraisEntretienMensuels Else v_PrixUnitaire=v_FraisEntretienAnnuels End If
Set nd_CSPr = SDSCSPr_NouveauProduit(gnd_FCSCo , v_TypeProduit , gndb_FCSCo)
nd_CSPr.Form = "F_CSPr" nd_CSPr.CSPr_NoProduitSeq = SDSCSPr_ValeurSuivante(gnd_FCSCo) nd_CSPr.CSPr_CleProduit = v_CleProduit nd_CSPr.CSPr_CodeProduit = xVar(nd_ProdSDSBB,"Prod_CodeProduit","") nd_CSPr.CSPr_DescProduitFR = xVar(nd_ProdSDSBB,"Prod_DescProduitFR","") nd_CSPr.CSPr_DescProduitEN = xVar(nd_ProdSDSBB,"Prod_DescProduitEN","") nd_CSPr.CSPr_ClasseProduit = v_ClasseProduit nd_CSPr.CSPr_Quantite = v_Quantite nd_CSPr.CSPr_PrixUnitaire = v_PrixUnitaire
nd_CSPr.CSPr_PrixMensuel=v_FraisEntretienMensuels nd_CSPr.CSPr_PrixAnnuel=v_FraisEntretienAnnuels
nd_CSPr.CSPr_NoBonCommande=p_NoProposition nd_CSPr.CSPr_ReferenceClient=p_NoProposition
nd_CSPr.CSPr_NoProduitSeqContratPrec = 0
If p_DateDebutFacturation <> "" Then nd_CSPr.CSPr_InclureMoisGratuits = "1" Call xAssignerDate(nd_CSPr , "CSPr_DateDebutFacturation", p_DateDebutFacturation) End If
Call xAssignerDate(nd_CSPr, "CSPr_DateDebutOriginale", p_DateDebut) Call xAssignerDate(nd_CSPr, "CSPr_DateDebut", p_DateDebut) Call xAssignerDate(nd_CSPr, "CSPr_DateFin", p_DateFin)
v_NbUtilisateursObligatoire = xSDSBB_xVarProd(v_CleProduit, "Prod_NbUtilisateursObligatoire", "0", True) nd_CSPr.CSPr_NbUtilisateursObligatoire = v_NbUtilisateursObligatoire If v_NbUtilisateursObligatoire = "1" Then 'Req : 44023 If SDSCSCo_VerifierSiProfilNbUtil(v_CleProduit) Then nd_CSPr.CSPr_NbUtilisateurs = "" Else nd_CSPr.CSPr_NbUtilisateurs = xVar(pnd_Produit, "Prod_NbUtilisateursCalcule", 0) End If ElseIf v_NbUtilisateursObligatoire = "2" Then nd_CSPr.CSPr_NbUtilisateursInclus = xVar(pnd_Produit, "Prod_NbUtilisateursInclus", 0) nd_CSPr.CSPr_PrixParUtilisateur = xVar(pnd_Produit, "Prod_PrixParUtilisateur", 0) End If
nd_CSPr.CSPr_PrixTotal = SDSCSPr_CalculPrixTotal( xVar(gnd_FCSCo,"CSCo_NoContratFmt",""), nd_CSPr )
' Call nd_CSPr.MakeResponse(gnd_FCSCo) Call nd_CSPr.Save(True,False) FCSCo_PropositionAjoutProduit=True End If End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FCSCo, gc_Element_FCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub FCSCo_MAJHistorique(pnd As NotesDocument, pnuid As NotesUIDocument,p_Statut As String, p_Commentaire As String ) On Error GoTo GererErreur
