Sub FCSPr_QueryOpen(pnuid_Source As NotesUIDocument, p_Mode As Integer, p_Isnewdoc As Variant, p_Continue As Variant) '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script ouvre le produit dans un Dialogue Box pour modification '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_codeProduit As String Dim v_EditMode As Boolean Dim v_ProduitValid As Boolean Dim v_NoContrat As String Dim v_NoContratFmt As String Dim v_TypeProduit As String Dim v_ChampErreur As String Dim v_StatutProduit As String Dim nd_CSCo As NotesDocument Dim v_DateFactureJusquau As Variant Dim v_DateFinProduit As Variant Dim v_DateFinCSPr As Variant Dim v_DateDebutCSCo As Variant Dim v_TypeLigneConversion As String Dim v_NomChampJusquau As String
Dim v_NbMoisGratuits As Long Dim v_DateDebutFacturation As Variant
Dim nd_CreditDependant As NotesDocument Dim v_DateFactureJusquauCredit As Variant Dim v_NomChampJusquauCredit As String
v_editMode = True
'Initialisations '------------------- Call FCSPr_Initialisations Set gnuid_FCSPr = pnuid_Source Set gnd_FCSPr = pnuid_Source.Document
' Extraire champs du produit v_codeProduit = xVar(gnd_FCSPr, "CSPr_CodeProduit", "") v_TypeProduit = xVar(gnd_FCSPr, "CSPr_TypeProduit", "") v_StatutProduit = xVar(gnd_FCSPr, "CSPr_StatutProduit", "") v_TypeLigneConversion = xVar(gnd_FCSPr , "CSPr_TypeLigneConversion" , "" )
gl_ItemsValeurOriginal("CSPr_CodeProduit") = v_codeProduit gl_ItemsValeurOriginal("CSPr_CleProduit") = xVar(gnd_FCSPr, "CSPr_CleProduit", "") gl_ItemsValeurOriginal("CSPr_DescProduitFR") = xVar(gnd_FCSPr, "CSPr_DescProduitFR", "") gl_ItemsValeurOriginal("CSPr_DescProduitEN") = xVar(gnd_FCSPr, "CSPr_DescProduitEN", "") gl_ItemsValeurOriginal("CSPr_PrixUnitaire") = xVar(gnd_FCSPr, "CSPr_PrixUnitaire", "0") gl_ItemsValeurOriginal("CSPr_PrixTotal") = xVar(gnd_FCSPr, "CSPr_PrixTotal", "0") gl_ItemsValeurOriginal("CSPr_DateDebut") = xVar(gnd_FCSPr, "CSPr_DateDebut", "") gl_ItemsValeurOriginal("CSPr_DateFin") = xVar(gnd_FCSPr, "CSPr_DateFin", "") gl_ItemsValeurOriginal("CSPr_Commentaire") = xVar(gnd_FCSPr, "CSPr_Commentaire", "") gl_ItemsValeurOriginal("CSPr_Notes") = xVar(gnd_FCSPr, "CSPr_Notes", "") gl_ItemsValeurOriginal("CSPr_NoBonCommande") = xVar(gnd_FCSPr, "CSPr_NoBonCommande", "")
gl_ItemsValeurOriginal("CSPr_ReferenceClient") = xVar(gnd_FCSPr, "CSPr_ReferenceClient", "") gl_ItemsValeurOriginal("CSPr_InclureMoisGratuits") = xVar(gnd_FCSPr, "CSPr_InclureMoisGratuits", "") gl_ItemsValeurOriginal("CSPr_NbMoisGratuits") = xVar(gnd_FCSPr, "CSPr_NbMoisGratuits", "") gl_ItemsValeurOriginal("CSPr_InstallationReportee") = xVar(gnd_FCSPr, "CSPr_InstallationReportee", "")
If v_TypeProduit = "10" Then
gl_ItemsValeurOriginal("CSPr_MontantFinancement") = xVar(gnd_FCSPr, "CSPr_MontantFinancement", 0) gl_ItemsValeurOriginal("CSPr_JourPaiement") = xVar(gnd_FCSPr, "CSPr_JourPaiement", 0) gl_ItemsValeurOriginal("CSPr_TypeFinancement") = xVar(gnd_FCSPr, "CSPr_TypeFinancement", "") gl_ItemsValeurOriginal("CSPr_NbPaiements") = xVar(gnd_FCSPr, "CSPr_NbPaiements", 0)
End If
If SDSCSPr_ValiderNbUtilisateursObligatoire(gnd_FCSPr) Then gnd_FCSPr.CSPr_NbUtilisateursObligatoire="1" gl_ItemsValeurOriginal("CSPr_NbUtilisateurs") = xVar(gnd_FCSPr, "CSPr_NbUtilisateurs", "0") Else gnd_FCSPr.CSPr_NbUtilisateursObligatoire="" End If
If SDSCSPr_ValiderQtyProduitModifiable(gnd_FCSPr) Then gnd_FCSPr.CSPr_QtyProduitModifiable="1" gl_ItemsValeurOriginal("CSPr_Quantite") = xVar(gnd_FCSPr, "CSPr_Quantite", "0") Else gnd_FCSPr.CSPr_QtyProduitModifiable="" End If
v_NoContratFmt = xVar(gnd_FCSPr, "CSPr_NoContratFmt" , "") Set nd_CSCo=xSDSCS_xndCSCo(v_NoContratFmt, True) v_DateDebutCSCo = xVar(nd_CSCo, "CSCo_DateDebut", "")
v_NoContrat=xVar(nd_CSCo,"CSCo_NoContrat","") v_NomChampJusquau = "CSFa_DateFactureJusquauLigne" & FCSPr_CreerNoSeq(xVar(gnd_FCSPr,"CSPr_NoProduitSeq","")) v_DateFactureJusquau=xSDSCS_xVarCSFa(v_NoContrat, v_NomChampJusquau,"" , True)
If gns_FCSPr.GetEnvironmentValue( "SDSCS_" + v_NoContratFmt ) Then If v_StatutProduit <= "50" Then v_EditMode = False End If
'Il n'est pas permis de modifier un service si la date facturé jusqu'au du service est = date de fin du service (ou du contrat) v_DateFinProduit= xVar(gnd_FCSPr, "CSPr_Datefin", xVar(nd_CSCo, "CSCo_DateFin", "" ) )
If v_DateFactureJusquau = "" Then v_EditMode = False End If
If v_DateFactureJusquau <> "" Then If v_DateFactureJusquau >= v_DateFinProduit Then gnd_FCSPr.CSPr_PrixNonEditable_1 ="1" End If End If
If v_TypeLigneConversion = "1" Or v_TypeLigneConversion = "2" Then gnd_FCSPr.CSPr_PrixNonEditable_1 ="1" End If
If v_TypeProduit = "10" And xVar(gnd_FCSPr,"CSPr_NoFinancement","") <> "" Then v_EditMode = True End If
End If
If gl_ItemsValeurOriginal("CSPr_DateFin") <> "" Then Set nd_CreditDependant = FCSPr_xndCreditDependants(v_NoContratFmt , gnd_FCSPr) If Not nd_CreditDependant Is Nothing Then v_NomChampJusquauCredit = "CSFa_DateFactureJusquauLigne" & FCSPr_CreerNoSeq(xVar(nd_CreditDependant,"CSPr_NoProduitSeq","")) v_DateFactureJusquauCredit=xSDSCS_xVarCSFa(v_NoContrat, v_NomChampJusquauCredit,"" , True) If v_DateFactureJusquauCredit <> "" Then v_EditMode = True End If End If End If
v_ProduitValid = False 'gnd_FCSPr.CSPr_DateFactureJusquau_1 = v_DateFactureJusquau Call xAssignerDate(gnd_FCSPr, "CSPr_DateFactureJusquau_1", v_DateFactureJusquau) gnd_FCSPr.CSPr_StatutContrat_1 = xSDSCS_xVarCSCo(xVar(nd_CSCo,"CSCo_NoContratOrig",""), "CSCo_StatutContrat","" , True)
Do
' Afficher le dialogbox Call FCSPr_AssignerNomItems() If gnuiws_FCSPr.Dialogbox("DB_CSPr", True, True, False, False, False, v_EditMode, "Produit - " + v_codeProduit ,gnd_FCSPr, True ,False,False) Then
If v_EditMode Then v_ProduitValid=True Else
If FCSPr_ProduitModifier(gnd_FCSPr) Then
If SDSCSPr_ValiderProduit(gnd_FCSPr , nd_CSCo, v_TypeProduit, "", v_ChampErreur) Then
If IsElement(gl_NomItems("CSPr_InstallationReportee")) Then
If v_DateFactureJusquau = "" Then If xVar(gnd_FCSPr, "CSPr_InstallationReportee", "") = "1" Then Call SDSCSPr_AssignerStatut(gnd_FCSPr, "40" , False) Else Call SDSCSPr_AssignerStatut(gnd_FCSPr, "00" , False) End If End If
End If
If IsElement(gl_NomItems("CSPr_DateDebut")) Then Call FCSPr_MajDateDebutFacturaion(gnuid_FCSPr) End If
If IsElement(gl_NomItems("CSPr_NbMoisGratuits")) Then
If xVar(gnd_FCSPr, "CSPr_InclureMoisGratuits", "") = "" Then v_NbMoisGratuits = xVar(gnd_FCSPr, "CSPr_NbMoisGratuits", 0)
If v_NbMoisGratuits > 0 Then v_DateDebutFacturation = Evaluate(|@If( CSPr_DateDebut != "" ; @Adjust(CSPr_DateDebut ;0;CSPr_NbMoisGratuits;0;0;0;0) ;@Adjust(CSCo_DateDebut_1 ;0;CSPr_NbMoisGratuits;0;0;0;0) );| , gnd_FCSPr) Call xAssignerDate(gnd_FCSPr, "CSPr_DateDebutFacturation", v_DateDebutFacturation(0)) Else gnd_FCSPr.CSPr_DateDebutFacturation = "" End If
End If
End If
If IsElement(gl_NomItems("CSPr_PrixUnitaire")) Then gnd_FCSPr.CSPr_PrixModification = "1" End If
If xVar(gnd_FCSPr, "CSPR_TypeLigneConversion", "") <> "" Then If IsElement(gl_NomItems("CSPr_NbUtilisateurs")) Then 'CSPR_TYPELIGNECONVERSION Call FCSPr_MajNbUtilisateursDependents( )
End If End If
' Historique gnd_FCSPr.HistoDM = Now gnd_FCSPr.HistoUM = gns_FCSPr.CommonUsername Call SIHi_Ajouter(gnd_FCSPr , "", "Produit modifié", "", True)
If IsElement(gl_NomItems("CSPr_DateFin")) Then v_DateFinCSPr = xVar(gnd_FCSPr, "CSPr_Datefin", "") If v_DateFinCSPr <> "" Then 'Requetes 47928 If v_DateFinCSPr < xVar(nd_CSCo, "CSCo_DateFin", "") Then If v_DateFinCSPr < v_DateFactureJusquau Then 'Requetes 49838 If v_DateFactureJusquau <> "" Then Call FCSPr_TraiterCredit( nd_CSCo, gnd_FCSPr ) End If End If End If End If End If
gnd_FCSPr.CSPr_PrixTotal = SDSCSPr_CalculPrixTotal( xVar(nd_CSCo,"CSCo_NoContratFmt",""), gnd_FCSPr )
Call gnd_FCSPr.RemoveItem("ChampErreur") Call gnd_FCSPr.RemoveItem("CSPr_PrixNonEditable_1") Call gnd_FCSPr.Save (True, False) Call FCSPr_MajContratUI(v_NoContratFmt) Call gnuiws_FCSPr.ViewRefresh v_ProduitValid=True Else gnd_FCSPr.ChampErreur = v_ChampErreur End If
Else v_ProduitValid=True End If End If Else v_ProduitValid=True
End If Loop Until v_ProduitValid
p_Continue = False Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FCSPr, gc_Element_FCSPr, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub FCSPr_Crediter(pnd_CSCo As NotesDocument, pnd_CSPr As NotesDocument, p_MontantFacture As Double , p_ActionParent As String, p_DateDebut As Variant,p_DateFin As Variant, v_Qte As Double ) '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script ouvre le produit en Dialogue Box pour supprimer le produit '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nd_Credit As NotesDocument Dim v_NoContrat As String Dim v_NoContratFmt As String Dim v_ChampErreur As String Dim v_TitreDialog As String Dim v_TitreConfirm As String Dim v_CSPrValide As Boolean Dim v_CSPrConfirmDialog As Boolean Dim v_MontantFacture As Double Dim v_NbUtilisateursObligatoire As String Dim v_TypeProduit As String
Call FCSPr_Initialisations
v_NoContratFmt = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoContratFmt" , "") v_NoContrat = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoContrat" , "") v_TypeProduit = xVar(pnd_CSPr , "CSPr_TypeProduit" , "")
If v_TypeProduit = "80" Then v_TypeProduit = "70" Else v_TypeProduit = "60" End If
Set nd_Credit = New NotesDocument(pnd_CSCo.ParentDatabase) Call SDSCSPr_AssignerStatut(pnd_CSCo, "00" , True)
nd_Credit.Form = "F_CSPr" nd_Credit.CSPr_CodeProduit = xVar(pnd_CSPr , "CSPr_CodeProduit" , "") nd_Credit.CSPr_TypeInstallation = xVar(pnd_CSPr , "CSPr_TypeInstallation" , "") nd_Credit.CSPr_ClientNom1 = xVar(pnd_CSPr,"CSPr_ClientNom1","") nd_Credit.CSPr_ClientNom2 = xVar(pnd_CSPr,"CSPr_ClientNom2","") nd_Credit.CSPr_ClientNomInterne = xVar(pnd_CSPr,"CSPr_ClientNomInterne","") nd_Credit.CSPr_CodeProduit = xVar(pnd_CSPr,"CSPr_CodeProduit","") nd_Credit.CSPr_TypeInstallation = xVar(pnd_CSPr,"CSPr_TypeInstallation","") nd_Credit.CSPr_DescProduitFR = xVar(pnd_CSPr,"CSPr_DescProduitFR","") nd_Credit.CSPr_DescProduitEN = xVar(pnd_CSPr,"CSPr_DescProduitEN","") nd_Credit.CSPr_TypeProduit = v_TypeProduit nd_Credit.CSPr_Quantite = v_Qte nd_Credit.CSPr_QtyProduitModifiable =""
If p_DateDebut = "" Then p_DateDebut = xVar(pnd_CSPr,"CSPr_DateDebut","") End If Call SIIx_AssignerDate(nd_Credit, "CSPr_DateDebut", p_DateDebut) Call SIIx_AssignerDate(nd_Credit, "CSPr_DateFin", p_DateFin) Call SIIx_AssignerDate(nd_Credit, "CSPr_DateInstallation", xVar(pnd_CSPr,"CSPr_DateInstallation","")) nd_Credit.CSPr_NoContratFmt = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoContratFmt" , "") nd_Credit.CSPr_Devise = xVar(pnd_CSPr,"CSPr_Devise","") nd_Credit.CSPr_CleProduit = xVar(pnd_CSPr,"CSPr_CleProduit","") nd_Credit.CSPr_TypeModification = "1" nd_Credit.HistoDC = Now nd_Credit.HistoUC = gns_FCSPr.commonusername
v_NbUtilisateursObligatoire = xVar(pnd_CSPr,"CSPr_NbUtilisateursObligatoire","") nd_Credit.CSPr_NbUtilisateursObligatoire = v_NbUtilisateursObligatoire If v_NbUtilisateursObligatoire = "1" Then nd_Credit.CSPr_NbUtilisateurs = xVar(pnd_CSPr,"CSPr_NbUtilisateurs",0) End If
Call SDSCSPr_AssignerStatut(nd_Credit, "00" , False)
nd_Credit.Description = xVar(pnd_CSPr,"Description","") nd_Credit.CSPr_StatutContrat_1 = xSDSCS_xVarCSCo(xVar(pnd_CSCo,"CSCo_NoContratOrig",""), "CSCo_StatutContrat","" , True)
If p_MontantFacture > 0 Then nd_Credit.CSPr_PrixUnitaire = p_MontantFacture nd_Credit.CSPr_MontantCreditCalcule = p_MontantFacture Else v_MontantFacture=SDSCSPr_CalculMontantFacture(pnd_CSPr) If v_MontantFacture = 0 Then nd_Credit.CSPr_PrixUnitaire = "" Else nd_Credit.CSPr_PrixUnitaire = v_MontantFacture nd_Credit.CSPr_MontantCreditCalcule = v_MontantFacture End If End If
nd_Credit.CSPr_PrixTotal = xVar(nd_Credit, "CSPr_PrixUnitaire" , 0) nd_Credit.CSPr_MaxCredit=xVar(pnd_CSPr, "CSPr_PrixUnitaire" , 0) nd_Credit.CSPr_StatutContrat_1 = xSDSCS_xVarCSCo(xVar(pnd_CSCo,"CSCo_NoContratOrig",""), "CSCo_StatutContrat","" , True)
Do v_CSPrValide = False If gnuiws_FCSPr.dialogbox("DB_CSPr" , True, True, False, False, False, False, v_TitreDialog, nd_Credit, True ,False,False) Then
nd_Credit.CSPr_PrixTotal = xVar(nd_Credit, "CSPr_PrixUnitaire" , 0) * v_Qte ' Si les champs obligatoires sont invalides...On ré-édite le document v_CSPrValide = SDSCSPr_ValiderProduit(nd_Credit , pnd_CSCo, "60" ,"" , v_ChampErreur)
If v_CSPrValide Then
Call SDSCSPr_AssignerTypeModification(nd_Credit, p_ActionParent, False )
nd_Credit.CSPr_NoProduitParent = xVar(pnd_CSPr,"CSPr_NoProduitSeq","") nd_Credit.CSPr_NoProduitSeq = SDSCSPr_ValeurSuivante(pnd_CSCo)
Call nd_Credit.RemoveItem("ChampErreur") Call SDSCSPr_AssignerStatut(nd_Credit, "00",True) Call nd_Credit.MakeResponse(pnd_CSCo) Call nd_Credit.Save(True,False)
Else pnd_CSPr.ChampErreur = v_ChampErreur End If Else
Exit Sub End If
Loop Until v_CSPrValide
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FCSPr, gc_Element_FCSPr, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub FCSPr_Supprimer(pnd_CSCo As NotesDocument ,pnd_CSPr As NotesDocument) '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script ouvre le produit en Dialogue Box pour supprimer le produit '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_NoContrat As String Dim v_NoContratFmt As String Dim v_codeProduit As String Dim nd_CSFa As NotesDocument Dim v_PremiereFacture As Variant Dim v_Commentaire As String Dim v_StatutContrat As String Dim v_Statut As String Dim v_StatutDesc As String Dim v_MontantFacture As Double Dim v_TotalProduitsFacture As String Dim v_DateFinCredit As Variant Dim v_DateDebutContrat As Variant
Call FCSPr_Initialisations
v_Statut = "99" v_StatutContrat = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_StatutContrat" , "") v_NoContratFmt = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoContratFmt" , "") v_NoContrat = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoContrat" , "") v_Commentaire = xVar(pnd_CSPr, "DB_Commentaire","") v_codeProduit = xVar(pnd_CSPr, "CSPr_CodeProduit","") v_StatutDesc = xDescTabl(v_Statut, "CSPr_StatutProduit", True) v_DateDebutContrat = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_DateDebut" , "")
Set nd_CSFa = xSDSCS_xndCSFa(v_NoContrat, True) If Not nd_CSFa Is Nothing Then v_PremiereFacture = xVar(nd_CSFa, "CSFa_DatePremiereFacture", "")
If Today < v_DateDebutContrat Then v_DateFinCredit=v_DateDebutContrat Else v_DateFinCredit=xVar(nd_CSFa, "CSFa_DateFactureJusquauLigne" & FCSPr_CreerNoSeq(xVar(pnd_CSPr,"CSPr_NoProduitSeq","")), "") End If End If
v_StatutDesc = xDescTabl(v_Statut, "CSPr_StatutProduit", True)
If v_PremiereFacture = "" Then 'Aussi les Escomptes dependantes Call SDSCSPr_SupprimerProduit(v_NoContratFmt, pnd_CSCo, xVar(pnd_CSPr, "CSPr_NoProduitSeq", 0)) v_StatutDesc = "Supprimer" Else v_MontantFacture=SDSCSPr_CalculMontantFacture(pnd_CSPr) v_TotalProduitsFacture = Format(Round(v_MontantFacture,2), "standard") If v_MontantFacture > 0 Then If gnuiws_FCSPr.Prompt(PROMPT_YESNO, "Créditer le produit." , xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 88, "", "")) = 1 Then 'pnuid_Source Call FCSPr_Crediter(pnd_CSCo, pnd_CSPr, v_MontantFacture, "99", "" , v_DateFinCredit, -1) End If End If
Call pnd_CSPr.RemoveItem("DB_Commentaire")
' Historique pnd_CSPr.HistoDM = Now pnd_CSPr.HistoUM = gns_FCSPr.CommonUsername ' Àussi les Escomptes dependantes
Call FCSPr_SupprimerDependants( v_NoContratFmt , pnd_CSPr ) Call SDSCSPr_AssignerStatut(pnd_CSPr, v_Statut , True)
Call SIHi_Ajouter(pnd_CSCo , v_Statut + " - " + v_StatutDesc + " : " + v_codeProduit, v_commentaire , "", True)
End If
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FCSPr, gc_Element_FCSPr, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub FCSPr_TraiterCredit( pnd_CSCo As NotesDocument, pnd_CSPr As NotesDocument) On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nd_CSFa As NotesDocument Dim nd_escompte As NotesDocument Dim v_NoContrat As String Dim v_NoContratFmt As String Dim v_FacturationView As NotesView Dim v_MontantCredit As Double Dim v_EscompteCredit As Double Dim v_DateDebutCredit As Variant Dim v_DateFinCredit As Variant Dim v_DateDebutEscompte As Variant Dim v_NomChampDFJ As String Dim v_CleRechEscompte( 1 To 2 ) As Variant
Dim v_DateDebutFacturation As Variant Dim v_MontantCreditMoisGratuit As Double Dim v_DateDebutContrat As Variant
v_MontantCredit=0 v_EscompteCredit=0 v_NoContrat=xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoContrat", "") v_NoContratFmt=xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoContratFmt", "") v_DateDebutContrat = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_DateDebut", "")
Set nd_CSFa = xSDSCS_xndCSFa(v_NoContrat,True)
v_NomChampDFJ = "CSFa_DateFactureJusquauLigne" & SDSCSPr_CreerNoChamp(xVar(pnd_CSPr,"CSPr_NoProduitSeq","")) v_DateDebutFacturation = xVar(pnd_CSPr, "CSPr_DateDebutFacturation", "") v_DateDebutCredit=xVar(pnd_CSPr, "CSPr_Datefin", "") +1 v_MontantCredit = SDSCSPr_CalculCredit( v_NoContratFmt, pnd_CSPr, v_DateDebutCredit )
v_DateFinCredit=xVar(nd_CSFa, v_NomChampDFJ, "")
If gnuiws_FCSPr.Prompt(PROMPT_YESNO, "Créditer le produit." , xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 94, "", Format(v_MontantCredit, "standard"))) = 1 Then
Call FCSPr_Crediter(pnd_CSCo , pnd_CSPr, v_MontantCredit,"90", v_DateDebutCredit,v_DateFinCredit , -1) 'Si on crédite un mois qui avait une escompte pour mois gratuit, il faut renverser l'escompte pour que le total des crédits soit à 0. 'Requetes : 50431
If v_DateDebutFacturation <> "" Then If v_DateFinCredit > v_DateDebutFacturation Then v_DateFinCredit = v_DateDebutFacturation End If
If v_DateDebutCredit < v_DateFinCredit Then v_MontantCreditMoisGratuit = SDSCSPr_CalculCreditMoisGratuit( pnd_CSPr, v_DateDebutCredit, v_DateFinCredit ) Call FCSPr_CrediterMoisGratuits(pnd_CSCo , pnd_CSPr, v_MontantCreditMoisGratuit,"90", v_DateDebutCredit,v_DateFinCredit , 1) End If End If
' Call xAssignerDate(nd_CSFa , v_NomChampDFJ, v_DateDebutCredit) Call nd_CSFa.Save (True, False) End If
Set nd_escompte = SDSCSPr_xndEscompte(xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCO_NOCONTRATORIG" , "") , pnd_CSPr ) If Not (nd_escompte Is Nothing) Then ' Si document est pas null escompte sur le produit
Set v_FacturationView = gndb_SDSCSPr.GetView( "V_CSPr26" ) v_CleRechEscompte( 1 ) = v_NoContratFmt v_CleRechEscompte( 2 ) = xVar(nd_escompte, "CSPr_NoProduitSeq" , 0)
Call v_FacturationView.Refresh Set nd_escompte = v_FacturationView.GetDocumentByKey( v_CleRechEscompte )
If v_DateDebutFacturation <> "" Then ' If v_DateDebutCredit > v_DateDebutFacturation Then v_DateDebutCredit = v_DateDebutFacturation ' End If End If
v_EscompteCredit=SDSCSPr_CalculCredit( v_NoContratFmt, nd_escompte, v_DateDebutCredit) If v_EscompteCredit > 0 Then If gnuiws_FCSPr.Prompt(PROMPT_YESNO, "Créditer le produit." , xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 95, "", Format(v_EscompteCredit, "standard"))) = 1 Then
Call FCSPr_Crediter(pnd_CSCo , nd_escompte, v_EscompteCredit,"90", v_DateDebutCredit,v_DateDebutCredit, 1 )
v_DateDebutEscompte=xVar(nd_escompte, "CSPr_DateDebut", "") If v_DateDebutCredit < v_DateDebutEscompte Then v_DateDebutCredit = v_DateDebutEscompte End If
' v_NomChampDFJ= "CSFa_DateFactureJusquauLigne" & SDSCSPr_CreerNoChamp(xVar(nd_escompte,"CSPr_NoProduitSeq","")) ' Call xAssignerDate(nd_CSFa , v_NomChampDFJ, xVar(pnd_CSPr, "CSPr_Datefin", "")) Call nd_CSFa.Save (True, False)
End If
End If
Call xAssignerDate(nd_escompte, "CSPr_DateFin", xVar(pnd_CSPr, "CSPr_Datefin", "")) Call nd_escompte.Save (True, False) End If
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FCSPr, gc_Element_FCSPr, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub FCSPr_Remplacer(pnuid_Source As NotesUIDocument, p_Mode As Integer, p_Isnewdoc As Variant, p_Continue As Variant) '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script ouvre le produit en Dialogue Box pour remplacer le produit '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ndb_Base As NotesDatabase Dim nd_CSPr As NotesDocument Dim nd_Base As NotesDocument Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_CSCo As NotesDocument Dim nd_Box As NotesDocument Dim nuid_CSCo As NotesUIDocument
Dim v_NoContratFmt As String Dim v_TitreDialog As String Dim v_TitreConfirm As String Dim v_CleRemplacement As String Dim v_boxValide As Boolean Dim v_CodeProduitOrig As String
Call FCSPr_Initialisations p_Continue = False
Set nd_CSPr=pnuid_Source.document v_NoContratFmt = xVar(nd_CSPr, "CSPr_NoContratFmt" , "") v_CodeProduitOrig = xVar(nd_CSPr, "CSPr_CodeProduit" , "") Set nd = xSDSCS_xndCSCo(v_NoContratFmt , True ) Set nd_CSCo = gndb_FCSPr.GetDocumentByID( nd.noteid )
v_TitreDialog = xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 2, "", "") 'Ajout d'un produit v_TitreConfirm = xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 1, "", "") 'Confirmez l'ajout du produit S.V.P.
Set nd_Box = New NotesDocument(gndb_FCSPr) nd_Box.Db_CodeProduit=xVar(nd_CSPr, "CSPr_CodeProduit" , "") nd_Box.Db_DescProduitFR=xVar(nd_CSPr, "CSPr_DescProduitFR" , "") nd_Box.CSPr_TypeInstallation=xVar(nd_CSCo, "CSCo_TypeInstallation" , "") nd_Box.CSPr_TypeProduit = xVar(nd_CSPr, "CSPr_TypeProduit" , "")
Do v_boxValide = False ' Afficher le dialogbox If Not gnuiws_FCSPr.Dialogbox("DB_CSPr03", True, True, False, False, False, False, "Remplacer le produit." ,nd_Box, True, False, False) Then Exit Sub Else v_CleRemplacement = xVar(nd_Box,"Db_CleProduitRempl","") If v_CleRemplacement <> "" Then v_boxValide = True Else MsgBox "Veuillez choisir un produit de remplacement.", 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 0, "", "") End If End If Loop Until v_boxValide
'Db_CleProduitRempl Set nd_Base = xSDSBB_xndProd_Code(v_CleRemplacement,True) Set nd_Base = xSDSBB_xndProd(v_CleRemplacement,True)
nd_CSPr.CSPr_CleProduit = xVar(nd_Base,"Prod_CleProduit","") nd_CSPr.CSPr_CodeProduit = xVar(nd_Base,"Prod_CodeProduit","") nd_CSPr.CSPr_DescProduitFR = xVar(nd_Base,"Prod_DescProduitFR","") nd_CSPr.CSPr_DescProduitEN = xVar(nd_Base,"Prod_DescProduitEN","") nd_CSPr.CSPr_ClasseProduit = xVar(nd_Base,"Prod_ClasseProduit","") nd_CSPr.CSPr_CategorieCode = xVar(nd_Base,"Prod_CategorieCode","") nd_CSPr.CSPr_CategorieProduit = xVar(nd_Base,"Prod_CategorieProduit","")
nd_CSPr.CSPr_Commentaire = "Remplacement du produit " + v_CodeProduitOrig + " " + Date
Call nd_CSPr.save(True,False)
If xVar(nd_CSCo, "CSCo_ProduitInactif" , "")="1" Then Call SDSCSCo_ValidProduitsActif(nd_CSCo) End If Call FCSPr_MajContratUI(v_NoContratFmt ) Call gnuiws_FCSPr.ViewRefresh
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FCSPr, gc_Element_FCSPr, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function FCSPr_ProduitModifier(pnd_DBProduit As NotesDocument) As Boolean '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de valider si il faut maj le produit '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_NomItem As String FCSPr_ProduitModifier = False
' Batir la liste des items à modfier ForAll ValeurItem In gl_NomItems
If CStr(xVarImplode(pnd_DBProduit, ListTag(ValeurItem), " ")) = CStr(ValeurItem) Then If IsElement(gl_NomItems(ListTag(ValeurItem))) Then ' effacer si même valeur Erase gl_NomItems(ListTag(ValeurItem)) End If Else ' remplacer valeur gl_NomItems(ListTag(ValeurItem)) = xVar(pnd_DBProduit, ListTag(ValeurItem), "") End If
End ForAll
' Valider si il y a des items à modifier (si liste n'est pas vide) ForAll ValeurItem In gl_NomItems FCSPr_ProduitModifier = True Exit Function End ForAll
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FCSPr, gc_Element_FCSPr, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub FCSPr_MajDateDebutFacturaion(pnuid As NotesUIDocument )
On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nd_FCSPr As NotesDocument Dim v_CSCoDateDebutFacturation As Variant Dim v_NouvelleDate As Variant Dim v_DateDebut As Variant Dim v_InstallationReportee As String Dim v_Continue As Variant Dim v_NomChamp As String Dim v_InclureMoisGratuits As String Dim v_NbMoisGratuits As Long Dim v_CSCoNbMoisGratuits As Long
Set nd_FCSPr = pnuid.Document Call FCSPr_Initialisations
v_NomChamp = pnuid.CurrentField
v_DateDebut = xVar(nd_FCSPr, "CSPr_DateDebut", "") v_InstallationReportee = xVar(nd_FCSPr, "CSPr_InstallationReportee", "") v_CSCoDateDebutFacturation = xVar(nd_FCSPr, "CSCo_DateDebutFacturation_1", "") v_CSCoNbMoisGratuits = xVar(nd_FCSPr, "CSCo_NbMoisGratuits_1", 0) v_InclureMoisGratuits = xVar(nd_FCSPr, "CSPr_InclureMoisGratuits", "")
v_Continue = Evaluate(|@IsMember("|& v_NomChamp &|"; "CSPr_DateDebut":"CSPr_InstallationReportee":"CSPr_InclureMoisGratuits":"CSPr_NbMoisGratuits")|)
If v_Continue(0) = 1 Then If v_NomChamp = "CSPr_InstallationReportee" Then If v_InstallationReportee = "" Then If v_DateDebut = "" Then MessageBox "La date d'entrée en vigueur du produit n'est pas définie." , 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 8, "", "") End If End If End If
If v_InclureMoisGratuits = "" Then v_NbMoisGratuits = xVar(nd_FCSPr, "CSPr_NbMoisGratuits", 0)
If v_NbMoisGratuits > 0 Then v_NouvelleDate = Evaluate(|@If( CSPr_DateDebut != "" ; @Adjust(CSPr_DateDebut ;0;CSPr_NbMoisGratuits;0;0;0;0) ;@Adjust(CSCo_DateDebut_1 ;0;CSPr_NbMoisGratuits;0;0;0;0) );| , nd_FCSPr) Call xAssignerDate(nd_FCSPr, "CSPr_DateDebutFacturation", v_NouvelleDate(0)) Else nd_FCSPr.CSPr_DateDebutFacturation = "" End If Call pnuid .RefreshHideFormulas
Else
nd_FCSPr.CSPr_NbMoisGratuits = "" If v_CSCoNbMoisGratuits > 0 Then v_NouvelleDate = Evaluate(|@If( CSPr_DateDebut != "" ; @Adjust(CSPr_DateDebut ;0;CSCo_NbMoisGratuits_1;0;0;0;0) ; CSCo_DateDebutFacturation_1 );| , nd_FCSPr) Call xAssignerDate(nd_FCSPr, "CSPr_DateDebutFacturation", v_NouvelleDate(0))
Call pnuid .RefreshHideFormulas Else If v_CSCoDateDebutFacturation <> "" Then Call xAssignerDate(nd_FCSPr, "CSPr_DateDebutFacturation", v_CSCoDateDebutFacturation) Call pnuid .RefreshHideFormulas End If End If
End If
End If
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FCSPr, gc_Element_FCSPr, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Option Public Option Declare
Use "SDSCS_Contrat" Use "SL_SalesforceAPI_v2"

Dim gns_VCSCo As NotesSession Dim gndb_VCSCo As NotesDatabase Dim gnuiws_VCSCo As NotesUIWorkspace
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_VCSCo = "SL" Const gc_Element_VCSCo = "V_CSCo"

Sub VCSCo_acAnnuler( ) On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Box As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim v_Commentaire As String Dim v_Titre As String
Dim v_NbSel As Long Dim v_NbLus As Long Dim v_NbMaj As Long
Call VCSCo_Initialisations Set ndb = gns_VCSCo.Currentdatabase
Set ndc = ndb.UnprocessedDocuments v_NbSel = ndc.Count If v_NbSel = 0 Then ' Aucun document sélectionné. MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 2, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub Else Set nd_Box = New NotesDocument(gndb_VCSCo) v_Titre = xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 36, "", "") + " " + xGDK_xMessage("SI", 98, "" , v_NbSel) nd_Box.DB_CommentaireRequis="" If gnuiws_VCSCo.DialogBox("DB_Comm", True,True,False,False,False,False,v_Titre, nd_Box, True,False,False) = True Then v_Commentaire = xVar(nd_Box, "DB_Commentaire","") Else Call gnuiws_VCSCo.CurrentView.DeselectAll Exit Sub End If End If
Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getfirstdocument
Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant) v_NbLus = v_NbLus + 1
If SDSCSCo_Annuler( nd , v_Commentaire ) Then v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 End If
If (v_NbLus Mod 100) = 0 Then Print "Annulation en cours... " & CStr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & CStr(v_NbLus) & "/" & CStr(v_NbSel) End If Loop
Call gnuiws_VCSCo.CurrentView.DeselectAll Call gnuiws_VCSCo.ViewRefresh Print "Annulation terminée. " & CStr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & CStr(v_NbLus) Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VCSCo, gc_Element_VCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub VCSCo_acAugmenter On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument
Dim gv_TauxAug As Double Dim gv_PlafondAug As Double Dim gv_Arrondi As Double
Dim v_PlafondAug As String Dim v_ArrondiM As String Dim v_ArrondiA As String Dim gv_MinimaleAug As Double Dim v_CSAAug As String Dim V_TauxPersonnel As String Dim V_OkAugmenter As Boolean
Dim v_NbSel As Long Dim v_NbLus As Long Dim v_NbMaj As Long
' Initialisations Call VCSCo_Initialisations Set ndb = gns_VCSCo.Currentdatabase
Set ndc = ndb.UnprocessedDocuments v_NbSel = ndc.Count If v_NbSel = 0 Then ' Aucun document sélectionné. MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 2, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub End If
Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getfirstdocument
gv_TauxAug = xSDSCS_xVarProf("Prof_TauxAugmetation" , 0)
If gv_TauxAug < 1 Then MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 90, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub End If
v_PlafondAug = xSDSCS_xVarProf("Prof_PlafondAugmetation" , "")
v_ArrondiM = xComplTabl("1", "CSCo_TypeInstallation", "3", True) v_ArrondiA = xComplTabl("0", "CSCo_TypeInstallation", "3", True)
' Demander une confirmation If gnuiws_VCSCo.Prompt(PROMPT_YESNO, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 98, "", CStr(v_NbSel)), _ xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 83, "", "")& Chr(13)_ & Chr(13) & "Taux d'augmentation : " + CStr(gv_TauxAug)_ & Chr(13) & "Plafond d'augmentation : " & v_PlafondAug _ & Chr(13) & "Montant d'arrondi contrat type Application Hébergée : " & v_ArrondiM _ & Chr(13) & "Montant d'arrondi contrat type Sur Site : " & v_ArrondiA ) <> 1 Then Call gnuiws_VCSCo.CurrentView.DeselectAll Exit Sub End If
Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
V_OkAugmenter = True v_NbLus = v_NbLus + 1
v_CSAAug = xVar(nd, "CS_ProduitsAug", 0) ' ++++++ 'Req : 50432 Taux d'augmentation en fonction de l'inflation V_TauxPersonnel = xVar(nd, "CSCo_TauxPersonnel", "")
If V_TauxPersonnel = "1" Then If Not SDSCSAug_ValidationAugmentationPersonnel( nd ) Then
V_OkAugmenter = False MessageBox "CS - " & xVar(nd, "CSCo_NoContratFmt" , "") &" ne contient pas de taux personnalisés. ", 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "")
End If End If
If V_OkAugmenter Then If SDSCSCo_ValidProduitsActif(nd) Then Call SDSCSAug_Augmenter(nd) v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 Else MessageBox "CS - " & xVar(nd, "CSCo_NoContratFmt" , "") &" Contient des produits inactif. ", 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") End If End If If (v_NbLus Mod 100) = 0 Then Print "Augmentation en cours... " & CStr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & CStr(v_NbLus) & "/" & CStr(v_NbSel) End If Loop
Call gnuiws_VCSCo.CurrentView.DeselectAll Call gnuiws_VCSCo.ViewRefresh Print "Augmentation terminée. " & CStr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & CStr(v_NbLus) Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VCSCo, gc_Element_VCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub
End Sub

Sub VCSCo_acRenouveler On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim v_MessageConfirmer As String Dim v_MessageAviser As String Dim v_NoContratFmt As String Dim v_NoContrat As String Dim nv_CSCoRev As NotesView Dim nd_CSCoRev As NotesDocument Dim nd_CSCoRen As NotesDocument Dim v_Continue As Boolean Dim v_Parametres As Variant Dim v_DateEcheanceContrat As Variant Dim v_DateMaxRevisionTermine As Variant Dim v_NbSel As Long Dim v_NbLus As Long Dim v_NbMaj As Long Dim v_StatutContrat As String
' Initialisations Call VCSCo_Initialisations Set ndb = gns_VCSCo.Currentdatabase
Set ndc = ndb.UnprocessedDocuments v_NbSel = ndc.Count If v_NbSel = 0 Then ' Aucun document sélectionné. MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 2, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub End If
' Demander une confirmation If gnuiws_VCSCo.Prompt(PROMPT_YESNO, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 98, "", CStr(v_NbSel)), xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 15, "", "")) <> 1 Then Call gnuiws_VCSCo.CurrentView.DeselectAll Exit Sub End If
Call gnuiws_VCSCo.CurrentView.DeselectAll
Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant) v_NbLus = v_NbLus + 1 v_Continue = True
v_NoContrat = xVar(nd, "CSCo_NoContrat" , "") v_NoContratFmt = xVar(nd, "CSCo_NoContratFmt" , "") v_StatutContrat = xVar(nd, "CSCo_StatutContrat" , "")
If v_StatutContrat > "90" Then v_Parametres = Evaluate(|"| & v_NoContratFmt & |":"| & xVar(nd, "CSCo_StatutDescFR" , "") & |"|) MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 130, "", v_Parametres) , 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") v_Continue = False Else
'Verification si contrat peut être renouvellé If xvar(nd, "CSCo_NePasRenouveler", "") <> "" Then MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 103, "", v_NoContratFmt), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") v_Continue = False Else
'Verification si contrat en Revision Call xnd("CSCo_NoContrat", v_NoContrat, True, ndb, "V_CSCo22", nv_CSCoRev, nd_CSCoRev) If Not nd_CSCoRev Is Nothing Then If MessageBox(xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 33, "", v_NoContratFmt) + Chr(13) + xGDK_xMessage("SI", 185, "", "") , 36, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 8, "", "")) <> 6 Then v_Continue = False End If End If
If v_Continue Then If v_StatutContrat = "90" Then If xVar(nd, "CSCo_NoRenouvellement" , "") <> "" Then MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 35, "", v_NoContratFmt) , 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") v_Continue = False End If
If v_Continue Then v_DateEcheanceContrat = xVar(nd,"CSCo_DateFin","") v_DateMaxRevisionTermine = Today - xSDSCS_xVarProf("Prof_NbJoursModifCSTermine" , 10) If v_DateEcheanceContrat < v_DateMaxRevisionTermine Then v_Parametres = Evaluate(|"| & v_NoContratFmt & |":"| & "renouvelé" & |"|) MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 129, "", v_Parametres) , 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") v_Continue = False End If End If
Else
If v_Continue Then 'Verification si contrat en Renouvellement Call xnd("CSCo_NoContratParent", v_NoContrat, True, ndb, "V_CSCo26", nv_CSCoRev, nd_CSCoRen) If Not nd_CSCoRen Is Nothing Then If xVar(nd_CSCoRen,"CSCo_NoContrat","") <> v_NoContrat Then MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 35, "", v_NoContratFmt) , 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") v_Continue = False End If End If End If
End If End If End If End If
If v_Continue Then Call SDSCSCo_Renouvellement(nd) v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 End If
If (v_NbLus Mod 100) = 0 Then Print "Renouvellement en cours... " & CStr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & CStr(v_NbLus) & "/" & CStr(v_NbSel) End If Loop
Call gnuiws_VCSCo.ViewRefresh Print "Renouvellement terminé. " & CStr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & CStr(v_NbLus) Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VCSCo, gc_Element_VCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub
End Sub

Sub VCSCo_acTransferer On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_Tran As NotesDocument Dim nd_CSCoRen As NotesDocument Dim nd_CSCo As NotesDocument Dim v_MessageUsager As String Dim v_Titre As String Dim v_TranValide As Boolean Dim v_NoContrat As String Dim v_NoContratFmt As String Dim nv_CSCoRev As NotesView
Dim v_NbSel As Long
v_MessageUsager = "Action Transfert" v_Titre = "Action Transfert"
' Initialisations Call VCSCo_Initialisations Set ndb = gns_VCSCo.Currentdatabase
Set ndc = ndb.UnprocessedDocuments v_NbSel = ndc.Count If v_NbSel = 0 Then ' Aucun document sélectionné. MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 2, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub ElseIf v_NbSel > 1 Then MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 18, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub End If
Set nd_CSCo = ndc.Getfirstdocument
v_NoContrat = xVar(nd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoContrat" , "") v_NoContratFmt = xVar(nd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoContratFmt" , "")
If Not nd_CSCo Is Nothing Then
Call xnd("CSCo_NoContrat", v_NoContrat, True, ndb, "V_CSCo22", nv_CSCoRev, nd_Tran) If nd_Tran Is Nothing Then
Call xnd("CSCo_NoContratParent", v_NoContrat, True, ndb, "V_CSCo26", nv_CSCoRev, nd_CSCoRen)
If Not nd_CSCoRen Is Nothing Then
'Valider avec l'usager If MessageBox(xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 34, "", v_NoContratFmt), 36, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 185, "", "")) <> 6 Then Exit Sub End If End If Set nd_Tran = New NotesDocument(ndb) nd_Tran.CSCo_DateFin=xVar(nd_CSCo, "CSCo_DateFin" , "")
If gnuiws_VCSCo.DialogBox("DB_Tran",True,True,False,False,False,False,v_Titre,nd_Tran,True,False,False) Then If VCSCo_ValideDBTransfert(nd_Tran) Then
If SDSCSCo_Transfert( nd_CSCo, nd_Tran ) Then v_TranValide = True End If Else 'message erreur End If
Call gnuiws_VCSCo.ViewRefresh
End If Else MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 17, "", v_NoContratFmt) , 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") End If
Call gnuiws_VCSCo.CurrentView.DeselectAll Call gnuiws_VCSCo.ViewRefresh Print "Transfert terminé." End If
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VCSCo, gc_Element_VCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub
End Sub

Sub VCSCo_acAnnulerRevision( ) On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Box As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim v_Commentaire As String Dim v_Titre As String
Dim v_NbSel As Long Dim v_NbLus As Long Dim v_NbMaj As Long
Call VCSCo_Initialisations Set ndb = gns_VCSCo.Currentdatabase
Set ndc = ndb.UnprocessedDocuments v_NbSel = ndc.Count If v_NbSel = 0 Then ' Aucun document sélectionné. MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 2, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub Else Set nd_Box = New NotesDocument(gndb_VCSCo) v_Titre = xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 139, "", "") + " " + xGDK_xMessage("SI", 98, "" , v_NbSel) nd_Box.DB_CommentaireRequis="" If gnuiws_VCSCo.DialogBox("DB_Comm", True,True,False,False,False,False,v_Titre, nd_Box, True,False,False) = True Then v_Commentaire = xVar(nd_Box, "DB_Commentaire","") Else Call gnuiws_VCSCo.CurrentView.DeselectAll Exit Sub End If End If
Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getfirstdocument
Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant) v_NbLus = v_NbLus + 1
If SDSCSCo_AnnulerLaRevision( nd , v_Commentaire ) Then v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 End If
If (v_NbLus Mod 100) = 0 Then Print "Annulation en cours... " & CStr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & CStr(v_NbLus) & "/" & CStr(v_NbSel) End If Loop
Call gnuiws_VCSCo.CurrentView.DeselectAll Call gnuiws_VCSCo.ViewRefresh Print "Annulation terminée. " & CStr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & CStr(v_NbLus) Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VCSCo, gc_Element_VCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function VCSCo_ValideDBTransfert(pnd_Tran As NotesDocument) As Boolean On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nuid_CSCo As NotesUIDocument Dim v_ClientNo1 As String Dim v_ClientNo2 As String Dim v_DateTran As String Dim v_Titre As String Dim ndt_Fin As NotesDateTime Dim ndt_Tran As NotesDateTime
VCSCo_ValideDBTransfert = False v_Titre = xGDK_xMessage("SI",8 , xLangue, "")
Call VCSCo_Initialisations v_DateTran = xVar(pnd_Tran,"CSTran_DateTran", "") v_ClientNo1 = xVar(pnd_Tran,"CSCo_ClientNo1","") v_ClientNo2 = xVar(pnd_Tran,"CSCo_ClientNo2","")
If v_DateTran = "" Then MsgBox "Date du transfert est obligatoire",16, v_Titre Exit Function End If
Set ndt_Fin = New NotesDateTime(xVar(pnd_Tran,"CSCo_DateFin","")) Set ndt_Tran = New NotesDateTime(v_DateTran) If ndt_Tran.Lslocaltime > ndt_Fin.Lslocaltime Then MsgBox "Date du transfert ne peut etre supérieur a la date d'échéance",16, v_Titre Exit Function End If
If v_ClientNo1 = "" Then MsgBox "Numéro de client est obligatoire",16, v_Titre Exit Function End If
If v_ClientNo2 = "" Then MsgBox "Numéro de client est obligatoire",16, v_Titre Exit Function End If
VCSCo_ValideDBTransfert = True
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VCSCo, gc_Element_VCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function
End Function

Sub VCSCo_acReviser On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_FCSCo As NotesDocument
Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd_CSCoRev As NotesDocument Dim nd_CSCoRen As NotesDocument Dim nd_CSCoNouveauRev As NotesDocument Dim nv_CSCoRev As NotesView Dim v_RevisionCourante As Double Dim v_NoRevision As String Dim v_MessageUsager As String Dim v_StatutContrat As String Dim v_NoContrat As String Dim v_NoContratFmt As String Dim v_histoText As String Dim v_NoDernRevision As Double Dim v_DateEcheanceContrat As Variant Dim v_DateMaxRevisionTermine As Variant Dim v_Parametres As Variant Dim v_Continue As Boolean Dim v_NbSel As Long Dim v_NbLus As Long Dim v_NbMaj As Long
' Initialisations Call VCSCo_Initialisations Set ndb = gns_VCSCo.Currentdatabase
v_histoText="Révision" v_MessageUsager = xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 16, "", "") 'v_Titre = xGDK_xMessage("SI",8 , xLangue, "")
Set ndc = ndb.UnprocessedDocuments v_NbSel = ndc.Count If v_NbSel = 0 Then ' Aucun document sélectionné. MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 2, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub Else ' Demander une confirmation If gnuiws_VCSCo.Prompt(PROMPT_YESNO, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 98, "", CStr(v_NbSel)), xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 56, "", "")) <> 1 Then Call gnuiws_VCSCo.CurrentView.DeselectAll Exit Sub End If End If
Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd_FCSCo = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant) v_NbLus = v_NbLus + 1
v_NoContrat = xVar(nd_FCSCo, "CSCo_NoContrat" , "") v_NoContratFmt = xVar(nd_FCSCo, "CSCo_NoContratFmt" , "") v_StatutContrat = xVar(nd_FCSCo, "CSCo_StatutContrat" , "") %REM Fonctionne comme pour les CS en vigueur, sauf qu'il n'est permis de mettre un CS en révision seulement si le statut du CS est 50 Ou (90 et que la date de fin du CS est dans les derniers 10 jours et que le CS n'a pas été renouvelé) Le but est de changer la date de fin %END REM Select Case v_StatutContrat
Case "10" : Call SDSCSCo_AssignerStatutContrat(nd_FCSCo, Nothing, "05" , "")
Case "30" , "50" : 'Validation Une seul revision permise en tout temp If SDSCSCo_ValidRevision( v_NoContrat ) Then
v_NoDernRevision = xVar(nd_FCSCo, "CSCo_DerniereRevision" , 0)
If v_NoDernRevision > 0 Then v_RevisionCourante = v_NoDernRevision Else v_RevisionCourante = xVar(nd_FCSCo, "CSCo_NoRevision" , 0) End If
v_NoRevision = SDSCSCo_CreerNoRevision(v_RevisionCourante)
Set nd_CSCoNouveauRev = SDSCSCo_CreerRevision(v_NoRevision , nd_FCSCo) If Not nd_CSCoNouveauRev Is Nothing Then nd_FCSCo.CSCo_DerniereRevision = v_NoRevision nd_FCSCo.CSCo_StatutTemporaire="1" Call nd_FCSCo.Save(True,False)
'Call SIHi_Ajouter(nd_CSCoNouveauRev , "", v_histoText, "", True)
If nd_CSCoNouveauRev.ComputeWithForm( False, False ) Then Call nd_CSCoNouveauRev.Save( True, True ) End If v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 End If End If
Case "90" : If xVar(nd_FCSCo, "CSCo_NoRenouvellement" , "") = "" Then v_Continue = True Else v_Parametres = Evaluate(|"| & v_NoContratFmt & |":"| & "réviser" & |"|) If MessageBox(xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 138, "", v_Parametres) , 36, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "")) = 6 Then v_Continue = True Else v_Continue = False End If End If
If v_Continue Then v_DateEcheanceContrat = xVar(nd_FCSCo,"CSCo_DateFin","") v_DateMaxRevisionTermine = Today - xSDSCS_xVarProf("Prof_NbJoursModifCSTermine" , 10) If v_DateEcheanceContrat >= v_DateMaxRevisionTermine Then If SDSCSCo_ValidRevision( v_NoContrat ) Then v_NoDernRevision = xVar(nd_FCSCo, "CSCo_DerniereRevision" , 0) If v_NoDernRevision > 0 Then v_RevisionCourante = v_NoDernRevision Else v_RevisionCourante = xVar(nd_FCSCo, "CSCo_NoRevision" , 0) End If
v_NoRevision = SDSCSCo_CreerNoRevision(v_RevisionCourante)
Set nd_CSCoNouveauRev = SDSCSCo_CreerRevision(v_NoRevision , nd_FCSCo) If Not nd_CSCoNouveauRev Is Nothing Then nd_FCSCo.CSCo_DerniereRevision = v_NoRevision nd_FCSCo.CSCo_StatutTemporaire="1" Call nd_FCSCo.Save(True,False)
If nd_CSCoNouveauRev.ComputeWithForm( False, False ) Then Call nd_CSCoNouveauRev.Save( True, True )
End If v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 End If End If Else v_Parametres = Evaluate(|"| & v_NoContratFmt & |":"| & "révisé" & |"|) MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 129, "", v_Parametres) , 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") End If End If End Select
If (v_NbLus Mod 100) = 0 Then Print "Révision en cours... " & CStr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & CStr(v_NbLus) & "/" & CStr(v_NbSel) End If Loop
Call gnuiws_VCSCo.CurrentView.DeselectAll Call gnuiws_VCSCo.ViewRefresh Print "Révision terminé. " & CStr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & CStr(v_NbLus) Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VCSCo, gc_Element_VCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub VCSCo_acSoumettre(p_SoumissionImmediate As Boolean) On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim v_NoContratFmt As String
Dim v_NbSel As Long Dim v_NbLus As Long Dim v_NbMaj As Long
Call VCSCo_Initialisations
If SLSf_VersionNotesValide = False Then ' 272 - Votre client Notes est trop vieux pour effectuer cette action. MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 272, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub End If
Set ndb = gns_VCSCo.Currentdatabase
Set ndc = ndb.UnprocessedDocuments v_NbSel = ndc.Count If v_NbSel = 0 Then ' Aucun document sélectionné. MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 2, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub Else ' Demander une confirmation If gnuiws_VCSCo.Prompt(PROMPT_YESNO, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 98, "", CStr(v_NbSel)), xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 59, "", "")) <> 1 Then Call gnuiws_VCSCo.CurrentView.DeselectAll Exit Sub End If End If
Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant) v_NbLus = v_NbLus + 1
v_NoContratFmt = xVar(nd, "CSCo_NoContratFmt" , "")
If SDSCSCo_SoumettreContrat(nd, Nothing, p_SoumissionImmediate, False) Then v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 Else MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 79, "", v_NoContratFmt), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") End If
If (v_NbLus Mod 100) = 0 Then Print "Soumission en cours... " & CStr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & CStr(v_NbLus) & "/" & CStr(v_NbSel) End If Loop
Call gnuiws_VCSCo.CurrentView.DeselectAll Call gnuiws_VCSCo.ViewRefresh Print "Soumission terminée. " & CStr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & CStr(v_NbLus) Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VCSCo, gc_Element_VCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function SDSCSFa_Activation(pnd_CSFa As NotesDocument, p_Action As Boolean , p_TextCommentaire As String, p_TextHistorique As String ) On Error GoTo GererErreur

v_StatutInactif = xVar(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_FacturationInactive" , "0") If p_Action Then ' If v_StatutInactif="0" Then ' v_StatutInactif="1" ' v_histoText="Facturation desactivé" & " " & p_TextMessage ' pnd_CSFa.CSFa_CommentairesDesactivation=p_TextMessage ' Else v_StatutInactif="0" v_histoText="Facturation activé" & " " & p_TextHistorique pnd_CSFa.CSFa_CommentairesDesactivation="" Call SDSCSFa_MajDatesProchaine(pnd_CSFa , False) ' End If
Else If v_StatutInactif="0" Then v_StatutInactif="1" v_histoText="Facturation desactivé" & " " & p_TextHistorique pnd_CSFa.CSFa_CommentairesDesactivation = p_TextCommentaire Else Exit Function End If
End If
pnd_CSFa.CSFa_FacturationInactive=v_StatutInactif

Sub SDSCSFa_ValiderDateProchaineCommandePPA( ) On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nd_suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_CSCo As NotesDocument
Dim v_DateProchaineCommande As Variant Dim v_CSFa_ProchaineFacture As Variant Dim v_CSFa_ProchaineCommande As Variant Dim v_ModePaiement As String Dim v_NoContratFmt As String Dim v_EstRenouvellement As Boolean
Call SDSCSFa_Initialisations
If gnv_CSFa25_SDSCSFa Is Nothing then Set gnv_CSFa25_SDSCSFa = gndb_SDSCSFa.getview("V_CSFa25") End If Call gnv_CSFa25_SDSCSFa.Refresh
Set nd_Suivant = gnv_CSFa25_SDSCSFa.Getfirstdocument
Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = gnv_CSFa25_SDSCSFa.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
v_EstRenouvellement = False
If xVar(nd, "CSFa_StatutFacturation" , "") <> "90" Then
v_NoContratFmt = xVar(nd, "CSFa_NoContratFmt" , "") v_CSFa_ProchaineFacture = xVar(nd, "CSFa_DateProchaineFacture" , "") v_ModePaiement = xVar(nd, "CSFa_ModePaiement", "00") ' 01 = Autre, 02 = PPA v_CSFa_ProchaineCommande = xVar(nd, "CSFa_DateProchaineCommande" , "")
If v_ModePaiement = "02" Then
Set nd_CSCo = xSDSCS_xndCSCo(v_NoContratFmt , True )
If Not nd_CSCo Is Nothing Then If xVar(nd_CSCo,"CSCo_EstUnRenouvellement","") = "1" And xVar(nd_CSCo,"CSCo_StatutContrat","") < "50" Then v_EstRenouvellement = True End If End If
v_DateProchaineCommande = SDSCSFa_ProchaineCommande( v_CSFa_ProchaineFacture , v_ModePaiement)
If v_CSFa_ProchaineCommande <> v_DateProchaineCommande Then
Call SDSCSFa_MajDatesProchaine( nd , v_EstRenouvellement ) Call nd.Save(True,False) End If
End If
End If
Loop
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSFa, gc_Element_SDSCSFa, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub SDSCSFa_FormulairePPArecu( pnd_CSFa As NotesDocument ) On Error GoTo GererErreur Dim v_statutPPArecu As String Dim v_DatePPARecu As variant
Call SDSCSFa_Initialisations
If xVar(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_ModePaiement" , "") = "02" Then v_statutPPArecu = xVar(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_FormulairePPArecu" , "")
If v_statutPPArecu = "" Then If SDSCSFa_DateFormulairePPArecu(v_DatePPARecu, xVar(pnd_CSFa, "CSFA_CLIENTNOFMT" , "") ) Then pnd_CSFa.CSFa_FormulairePPArecu = "1" If xVar(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_FacturationInactive" , "") = "1" Then Call SDSCSFa_Activation(pnd_CSFa, True , "", " - formulaire PPA reçu." ) Else Call SIHi_Ajouter(pnd_CSFa , "", "Action : Formulaire PPA reçu." , "", True) End If Call xAssignerDate(pnd_CSFa , "CSFa_DatePPARecu", v_DatePPARecu) End If Else pnd_CSFa.CSFa_FormulairePPArecu = "" pnd_CSFa.CSFa_DatePPARecu = ""
If xVar(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_FacturationInactive" , "") = "1" Then Call SIHi_Ajouter(pnd_CSFa , "", "Action : Formulaire PPA non reçu." , "", True) Else Call SDSCSFa_Activation(pnd_CSFa, False ,"", " - formulaire PPA non reçu." ) End If
End If Call pnd_CSFa.Save(True,False) End If
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSFa, gc_Element_SDSCSFa, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function SDSCSFa_Renverser( pnd_CSFa As NotesDocument , p_commentaire As String , p_FactDesactive As String) As Boolean
On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ws_SIFcCo As New Cl_Commande Dim nd_CSFa As NotesDocument Dim v_NoContratFmt As String Dim v_NoCommande As String Dim v_Resultat As String Dim v_ChampRenv As NotesItem Dim v_ListCS As Variant Dim i As Integer Dim v_OkRenverser As Boolean
v_OkRenverser=False
Set v_ChampRenv = pnd_CSFa.GetFirstItem("Renv_NoCommande") If Not v_ChampRenv Is Nothing Then
Call SDSCSFa_Initialisations v_NoContratFmt = xVar(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_NoContratFmt" , "") v_NoCommande=xVar(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_NoCommande", "")
If Not v_NoCommande="" Then
v_Resultat = ws_SIFcCo.ListContratCommande(v_NoCommande) v_ListCS = Split(v_Resultat, ";")
If SDSCSFa_ValideListReversement(v_ListCS , v_NoCommande) Then If ws_SIFcCo.AnnulerCommande(v_NoCommande , p_commentaire ) Then v_OkRenverser =True
For i = 0 To UBound(v_ListCS) Set nd_CSFa = xSDSCS_xndCSFa( v_ListCS(i), True) If Not nd_CSFa Is Nothing Then
Call SDSCSFa_RenverserFacturation( nd_CSFa , p_FactDesactive, p_commentaire ) End If Next
Call SDSCSFa_RenverserFinancement( v_NoCommande )
End If End If End If End If
If Not v_OkRenverser Then 'Message d'erreur Renversement a échoué MsgBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 58, "" , v_NoContratFmt),16, xGDK_xMessage("SI",8 , xLangue, "") End If
SDSCSFa_Renverser = v_OkRenverser
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSFa, gc_Element_SDSCSFa, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function
End Function

Sub SDSCSFa_MAJChampsFactureJusquau(pcl_Facture As SDSCS_clFacture , pnd_CSFa As NotesDocument )
On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim l_ListeProduits As Variant Dim v_ValeurJusquau As Variant Dim v_FacturerJusquau As Variant Dim v_NomChamp As String
v_FacturerJusquau = pcl_Facture.DateFacturerJusquau
Forall ligne In pcl_Facture.ligne v_NomChamp="CSFa_DateFactureJusquauLigne"+SDSCSFa_CreerNoChamp(CInt(ligne("NoLigne"))) v_ValeurJusquau=xVar(pnd_CSFa, v_NomChamp, v_FacturerJusquau)
If v_FacturerJusquau > v_ValeurJusquau Then v_ValeurJusquau = v_FacturerJusquau End If

End ForAll
Exit sub

End Sub

Function SDSCSFa_CreerNoChamp(pv_NoChamp As Integer) As String On Error GoTo GererErreur Dim v_NoChamp As String Dim v_maxLength As Integer Dim v_NouvNumChamp As String Dim i As Integer
v_NouvNumChamp = CStr(pv_NoChamp) v_maxLength = 3 v_maxLength = v_maxLength-Len(v_NouvNumChamp)
For i=1 To v_maxLength v_NoChamp = "0" + v_NoChamp Next
SDSCSFa_CreerNoChamp=v_NoChamp+v_NouvNumChamp Exit Function

Sub SDSCSFa_MajTraitementCommande( pcl_Commande As SDSCS_clCommande , p_NoCommande As String) On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nd_Fact As NotesDocument Dim nd_CSCo As NotesDocument Dim l_Facture As SDSCS_clFacture Dim ws_SIFcCo As New Cl_Commande Dim v_MontantCommande As Double Dim v_MontantEnTraitement As Double Dim v_NoContratFmt As String Dim v_NoContratRenouvellement As String Dim v_ContratRenouvellement As Variant Dim v_FacturerJusquau As Variant Dim v_PeriodeFacturation As Long Dim v_ModePaiement As String
ForAll v_Facture In pcl_Commande.facture
Set l_Facture = v_Facture Set nd_Fact = xSDSCS_xndCSFa(l_Facture.NoContrat , True )
v_NoContratFmt = xVar(nd_Fact, "CSFa_NoContratFmt" , "") Set nd_CSCo = xSDSCS_xndCSCo(v_NoContratFmt , True )
If Not nd_Fact Is Nothing Then If p_NoCommande <> "" Then
Call SDSCSFa_MAJChampsRenversement( nd_Fact )
Call SDSCSFa_MAJChampsFactureJusquau( l_Facture , nd_Fact ) If xVar(nd_Fact, "CSFa_DatePremiereFacture", "") = "" Then Call xAssignerDate(nd_Fact, "CSFa_DatePremiereFacture", Today) End If
'v_MontantEnTraitement = xVar(nd_Fact, "CSFa_MontantEnTraitement", 0) 'v_MontantCommande = ws_SIFcCo.montantCommande(p_NoCommande) 'nd_Fact.CSFa_MontantEnTraitement = v_MontantEnTraitement + v_MontantCommande
nd_Fact.CSFa_NoCommande = p_NoCommande Call xAssignerDate(nd_Fact, "CSFa_DateDerniereFacture", l_Facture.DateFacturation) Call xAssignerDate(nd_Fact, "CSFa_DateDerniereCommande", l_Facture.DateCommande )
End If
v_FacturerJusquau = l_Facture.DateFacturerJusquau
'Dans le cas d'un renouvellement, Prendre la date FacturerJusquau du renouvellement sur la commande. If Not nd_CSCo Is Nothing Then
v_ModePaiement = xVar(nd_Fact, "CSFa_ModePaiement" , "") v_PeriodeFacturation = CInt(xVar(nd_Fact, "CSFa_PeriodeFacturation", 0))
If v_ModePaiement = "02" Or v_PeriodeFacturation = 1 Then 'juste pour PPA ou facturation mensuel... v_NoContratRenouvellement = xVar(nd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoRenouvellement" , "") If v_NoContratRenouvellement <> "" Then If IsElement(pcl_Commande.facture(v_NoContratRenouvellement)) Then Set v_ContratRenouvellement = pcl_Commande.facture(v_NoContratRenouvellement) v_FacturerJusquau = v_ContratRenouvellement.DateFacturerJusquau End If End If End If End If
Call xAssignerDate(nd_Fact, "CSFa_DateFactureJusquau", v_FacturerJusquau ) Call SDSCSFa_MajDatesProchaine( nd_Fact , False ) Call SDSCSFa_ValidationFacturationTerminee( nd_Fact )
Set nd_CSCo = xSDSCS_xndCSCo(v_NoContratFmt , True ) If Not nd_CSCo Is Nothing Then Call xAssignerDate(nd_CSCo, "CSCo_DateDerniereCommande", Now ) Call nd_CSCo.Save(True,False) End If
Call nd_Fact.Save(True,False) Call SDSCSFa_MajFinancement(l_Facture, p_NoCommande) End If End ForAll Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSFa, gc_Element_SDSCSFa, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function SDSCSFa_AssignerStatutFacturation(pnd_CSFa As NotesDocument, pv_StatutNouveau As String, p_commentaire As String) As Boolean On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_StatutFacture As String Dim v_nomTableStatut As String Dim v_StatutIcone As Integer Dim v_StatutDesc As String Dim v_ModePaiement As String Dim v_TypeInstallation As String Dim v_PeriodeFacturation As String
SDSCSFa_AssignerStatutFacturation = False Call SDSCSFa_Initialisations
v_nomTableStatut = "CSFa_StatutFacturation" v_StatutFacture = xVar(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_StatutFacturation" , "")
If pv_StatutNouveau <> v_StatutFacture Then v_ModePaiement = xVar(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_ModePaiement" , "") v_TypeInstallation = xVar(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_TypeInstallation" , "") v_PeriodeFacturation = xVar(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_PeriodeFacturation" , "")
If v_StatutFacture = "90" And pv_StatutNouveau = "50" Then 'If v_ModePaiement = "01" And v_TypeInstallation <> "1" Then 'Si mode paiement cheque est pas Installation Heberge If v_ModePaiement = "01" And v_PeriodeFacturation <> "01" Then 'Si mode paiement cheque est pas Installation Heberge Call xAssignerDate(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_DateProchaineFacture", Today) Call xAssignerDate(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_DateProchaineCommande", Today) Call xAssignerDate(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_DateFactureJusquau", Today) End If
Call SDSCSFa_MajDatesProchaine( pnd_CSFa , False )
End If
v_StatutDesc = xDescTabl(pv_StatutNouveau, v_nomTableStatut, True) v_StatutIcone = xIcnTabl(pv_StatutNouveau, v_nomTableStatut, True)
pnd_CSFa.CSFa_StatutFacturation = pv_StatutNouveau pnd_CSFa.CSFa_StatutDescFR=v_StatutDesc pnd_CSFa.CSFa_StatutIcone =v_StatutIcone
Call SIHi_Ajouter(pnd_CSFa , pv_StatutNouveau + " - " + v_StatutDesc , p_commentaire , "", True)
SDSCSFa_AssignerStatutFacturation = True End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSFa, gc_Element_SDSCSFa, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSCSFa_ndFacturation(pnd_CSCo As NotesDocument) As NotesDocument On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nd_CSFa As NotesDocument
Dim nd_CSCo As NotesDocument Dim nd_CSFaParent As NotesDocument Dim v_NoContrat As String Dim v_StatutContrat As String Dim v_StatutFacture As String Dim v_NoContratFmt As String Dim v_NbPmnts As Long Dim v_ModePaiement As String
Call SDSCSFa_Initialisations
Set nd_CSCo = gndb_SDSCSFa.GetDocumentByID( pnd_CSCo.noteid )
Set SDSCSFa_ndFacturation = Nothing v_NoContrat=xVar(nd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoContrat", "") v_NoContratFmt=xVar(nd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoContratFmt", "") v_ModePaiement=xVar(nd_CSCo,"CSCo_ModePaiement","01") '"02" : PPA, "01" : Autre v_StatutContrat = xVar(nd_CSCo, "CSCo_StatutContrat" , "")
Set nd_CSFa = xSDSCS_xndCSFa(v_NoContrat,True)
'Est-ce que les paramètres de facturation existe pour le contrat ? If nd_CSFa Is Nothing Then
Set nd_CSFa = New NotesDocument(gndb_SDSCSFa) nd_CSFa.Form = "F_CSFa"
nd_CSFa.CSFa_PeriodeFacturation = xVar(nd_CSCo,"CSCo_TypePeriode","01") nd_CSFa.CSFa_ModePaiement = xVar(nd_CSCo,"CSCo_ModePaiement","01") nd_CSFa.CSFa_FacturationInactive="0"
If v_StatutContrat = "00" Then v_StatutFacture="10" Else v_StatutFacture="50" End If
nd_CSFa.CSFa_StatutFacturation = v_StatutFacture
' If PPa Desactiver jusqua optention de formulaire PPA If v_ModePaiement = "02" Then nd_CSFa.CSFa_FacturationInactive="1" Else nd_CSFa.CSFa_FacturationInactive="0" End If
nd_CSFa.CSFa_StatutIcone=xIcnTabl(v_StatutFacture, "CSFa_StatutFacturation", True) nd_CSFa.CSFa_StatutDescFR=xDescTabl(v_StatutFacture, "CSFa_StatutFacturation", True) nd_CSFa.CSFa_NoUnique = xUnique("") nd_CSFa.CSFa_NoContrat = v_NoContrat nd_CSFa.CSFa_NoContratFmt = v_NoContratFmt nd_CSFa.CSFa_NoProposition = xVar(nd_CSCo,"CSCo_NoProposition", "") nd_CSFa.CSFa_TypeInstallation = xVar(nd_CSCo,"CSCo_TypeInstallation","1") nd_CSFa.CSFa_ClientNoFmt = xVar(nd_CSCo,"CSCo_ClientNoFmt","") nd_CSFa.CSFa_ClientNomInterne = xVar(nd_CSCo,"CSCo_ClientNomInterne","") nd_CSFa.CSFa_FormulairePPArecu = ""
If xVar(pnd_CSCo,"CSCo_EstUnRenouvellement","") = "1" Then Set nd_CSFaParent = xSDSCS_xndCSFa(xVar(nd_CSCo,"CSCo_NoContratParent",""),True) If nd_CSFaParent Is Nothing Then nd_CSFa.CSFa_FormulairePPArecu = "1" nd_CSFa.CSFa_FacturationInactive="" Else If v_ModePaiement = xVar(nd_CSFaParent,"CSFa_ModePaiement","") Then nd_CSFa.CSFa_FormulairePPArecu = xVar(nd_CSFaParent,"CSFa_FormulairePPArecu","") nd_CSFa.CSFa_FacturationInactive=xVar(nd_CSFaParent,"CSFa_FacturationInactive","") Else If v_ModePaiement = "02" Then nd_CSFa.CSFa_FormulairePPArecu = "" nd_CSFa.CSFa_FacturationInactive="1" End If End If End If End If
nd_CSFa.CSFa_DateDebut = xVar(nd_CSCo,"CSCo_DateDebut","") nd_CSFa.CSFa_DateFin = xVar(nd_CSCo,"CSCo_DateFin","") nd_CSFa.CSFa_Devise = xVar(nd_CSCo,"CSCo_Devise","") nd_CSFa.CSFa_DerniereLigneFacturee=0 nd_CSFa.CSFa_DatePremiereFacture= "" nd_CSFa.CSFa_DateDerniereFacture= "" nd_CSFa.HistoDC = Now nd_CSFa.HistoUC = gns_SDSCSFa.UserName
Call nd_CSFa.MakeResponse(nd_CSCo) Call nd_CSFa.Save(True,False) Call SDSCSFa_MAJDatePPARecu( nd_CSFa ) End If
Set SDSCSFa_ndFacturation = nd_CSFa Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSFa, gc_Element_SDSCSFa, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub SDSCSFa_RenverserFacturation( pnd_CSFa As NotesDocument , p_FactDesactive As String, p_commentaire As String ) On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim i As Integer Dim v_NomChamp As Variant Dim v_NomChampRenv As String Dim v_NomChampCSFa As String Dim v_ValeurJusquau As Variant Dim v_item As NotesItem Dim v_ChampRenv As NotesItem Dim v_Commentaire As String Dim v_StatutFacture As String Dim v_PPARecu As String Dim v_ModePaiement As String Dim v_NoContratFmt As String Dim nd_CSCo As NotesDocument
Call SDSCSFa_Initialisations
v_ModePaiement=xVar(pnd_CSFa,"CSFa_ModePaiement","") '"02" : PPA, "01" : Autre v_PPARecu = xVar(pnd_CSFa,"CSFa_FormulairePPArecu","") v_NoContratFmt = xVar(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_NoContratFmt" , "") Set nd_CSCo = xSDSCS_xndCSCo(v_NoContratFmt , True )
v_Commentaire = "" ' Set v_ChampRenv = pnd_CSFa.GetFirstItem("Renv_NoCommande") Set v_ChampRenv = pnd_CSFa.GetFirstItem("Renv_DateFactureJusquau")
If Not v_ChampRenv Is Nothing Then
For i = 0 To 999 v_NomChamp="DateFactureJusquauLigne"+SDSCSFa_CreerNoChamp(i)
v_NomChampCSFa = "CSFa_" + v_NomChamp v_NomChampRenv = "Renv_" + v_NomChamp
v_ValeurJusquau=xVar(pnd_CSFa, v_NomChampRenv, "") If v_ValeurJusquau <> "" Then Call xAssignerDate(pnd_CSFa, v_NomChampCSFa, v_ValeurJusquau) Else Call pnd_CSFa.RemoveItem( v_NomChampCSFa ) End If Call pnd_CSFa.RemoveItem( v_NomChampRenv ) Next
For i = 0 To UBound(gv_ChampRenversement_SDSCSFa) v_NomChampCSFa = "CSFa_" + gv_ChampRenversement_SDSCSFa(i) v_NomChampRenv = "Renv_" + gv_ChampRenversement_SDSCSFa(i) Set v_item = pnd_CSFa.ReplaceItemValue ( v_NomChampCSFa, xVar(pnd_CSFa, v_NomChampRenv, "") ) Call pnd_CSFa.RemoveItem( v_NomChampRenv ) Next
v_StatutFacture=xVar(pnd_CSFa,"CSFa_StatutFacturation", "") pnd_CSFa.CSFa_StatutIcone=xIcnTabl(v_StatutFacture, "CSFa_StatutFacturation", True) pnd_CSFa.CSFa_StatutDescFR=xDescTabl(v_StatutFacture, "CSFa_StatutFacturation", True)
If v_ModePaiement="02" And Not v_PPARecu = "1" Then pnd_CSFa.CSFa_FacturationInactive="1" Else pnd_CSFa.CSFa_FacturationInactive=p_FactDesactive If p_FactDesactive Then v_Commentaire = "Facturation desactivé" End If End If
Call SIHi_Ajouter(pnd_CSFa , "", "Action : Renversement" & Chr(13) & v_Commentaire & " " & p_commentaire, "", True)
nd_CSCo.CSCo_CompteurFacturation = xVar(nd_CSCo, "CSCo_CompteurFacturation" , 0) - 1 Call nd_CSCo.Save(True,False) Call pnd_CSFa.Save(True,False) End If
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSFa, gc_Element_SDSCSFa, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub
End Sub

function SDSCSFa_DesactiveRenversement( pnd_CSFa As NotesDocument )As boolean
On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim i As Integer Dim v_NomChamp As Variant Dim v_NomChampRenv As String
SDSCSFa_DesactiveRenversement = false Call SDSCSFa_Initialisations
For i = 0 To 999 v_NomChamp="DateFactureJusquauLigne"+SDSCSFa_CreerNoChamp(i) v_NomChampRenv = "Renv_" + v_NomChamp Call pnd_CSFa.RemoveItem( v_NomChampRenv ) Next
For i = 0 To UBound(gv_ChampRenversement_SDSCSFa) v_NomChampRenv = "Renv_" + gv_ChampRenversement_SDSCSFa(i) Call pnd_CSFa.RemoveItem( v_NomChampRenv ) Next
Call pnd_CSFa.Save(True,False) SDSCSFa_DesactiveRenversement = true Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSFa, gc_Element_SDSCSFa, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function
End Function

Sub SDSCSFa_MajDatesProchaine( pnd_CSFa As NotesDocument , p_Renouvellement As Boolean ) On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_ProchaineCommande As Variant Dim v_DateProchaineCommande As Variant Dim v_ModePaiement As String Dim v_DateFacturation As Variant Dim v_DateFactureJusquau As Variant Dim v_DateFinContrat As Variant Dim v_PeriodeFacturation As Long Dim v_renouvellement As String Dim ndt_DateProchaineFacturation As New NotesDateTime("") Dim ndt_DateProchaineFacturationTest As New NotesDateTime("") Dim ndt_DateFacturerJusquau As New NotesDateTime("") Dim ndt_1erDuMoisSuivant As New NotesDateTime("") Dim ndt_FinDuMoisCourant As New NotesDateTime("") Dim ndt_DateDebutRenouvellement As New NotesDateTime("") Dim v_ContratRenouvellement As String Dim nd_CSFaRenouvellement As NotesDocument Dim nd_CSCo As NotesDocument Dim v_NoContratCSCo As String Dim v_NoContratFmt As String Dim v_NoContratRenouvellement As String Dim v_renouvellementParent As String Dim v_DateFactureJusquauRenouvellement As Variant Dim v_DateDebutRenouvellement As Variant Dim v_TypeInstallation As String
v_TypeInstallation = xVar(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_TypeInstallation" , "") ' 1 = Heberger , 0 = Sur Site v_ModePaiement = xVar(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_ModePaiement" , "") v_PeriodeFacturation = CInt(xVar(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_PeriodeFacturation", 0)) v_NoContratFmt = xVar(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_NoContratFmt" , "") v_DateFactureJusquau = xVar(pnd_CSFa,"CSFa_DateFactureJusquau","") v_renouvellementParent = ""
'Si le contrat a un renouvellement, Si la date de facturer jusquau du renouvellement est superieur prendre elle Set nd_CSCo = xSDSCS_xndCSCo(v_NoContratFmt , True ) If Not nd_CSCo Is Nothing Then v_NoContratRenouvellement = xVar(nd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoRenouvellement" , "") If v_NoContratRenouvellement <> "" Then Set nd_CSFaRenouvellement = xSDSCS_xndCSFa(v_NoContratRenouvellement , True ) If Not nd_CSFaRenouvellement Is Nothing Then v_DateFactureJusquauRenouvellement= xVar(nd_CSFaRenouvellement,"CSFa_DateFactureJusquau","")
v_DateDebutRenouvellement = v_DateFactureJusquauRenouvellement + 1 ndt_DateDebutRenouvellement.lslocaltime = DateNumber(Year(v_DateDebutRenouvellement), Month(v_DateDebutRenouvellement), 1) If v_DateDebutRenouvellement <> ndt_DateDebutRenouvellement.lslocaltime Then
If v_DateFactureJusquauRenouvellement > v_DateFactureJusquau Then v_DateFactureJusquau = v_DateFactureJusquauRenouvellement v_renouvellementParent = "1" End If
End If End If End If End If
v_DateFacturation = v_DateFactureJusquau + 1
' 12 = 1 ans, 03 = periodique, 01 = mensuel, 99 = Échéance
'ndt_DateProchaineFacturationTest.lslocaltime = SDSCSFa_ProchaineFacturation(xVar(pnd_CSFa,"CSFa_DateFactureJusquau",""), v_PeriodeFacturation)
%REM Req:38182 Calcul de la date de la facture suivante Pour un PPA, la date de la prochaine facture devrait toujours être le 1er du mois suivant la Date facturé jusqu'au ou le 1er du mois suivant la date du jour (la valeur la plus élevée des deux) %END REM
If v_ModePaiement = "02" Or v_PeriodeFacturation = 1 Then 'juste pour PPA ou facturation mensuel... If v_renouvellementParent = "1" Then v_renouvellement = "1" Else v_renouvellement = xSDSCS_xVarCSCo(xVar(pnd_CSFa,"CSFa_NoContratFmt",""), "CSCo_EstUnRenouvellement","" , True) End If
If v_renouvellement <> "1" Then
'Si date de de facturer jusquau = date de fin contrat... 'Mettre v_DateFactureJusquau = dernier jour du mois v_DateFinContrat = xSDSCS_xVarCSCo(xVar(pnd_CSFa,"CSFa_NoContratFmt",""), "CSCo_DateFin","" , True)
If v_DateFactureJusquau = v_DateFinContrat Then ndt_FinDuMoisCourant.lslocaltime = DateNumber(Year(v_DateFactureJusquau), Month(v_DateFactureJusquau), 1) Call ndt_FinDuMoisCourant.SetAnyTime Call ndt_FinDuMoisCourant.AdjustMonth(1) Call ndt_FinDuMoisCourant.AdjustDay(-1) v_DateFactureJusquau = ndt_FinDuMoisCourant.lslocaltime End If
ndt_1erDuMoisSuivant.lslocaltime = DateNumber(Year(v_DateFactureJusquau), Month(v_DateFactureJusquau), 1) Call ndt_1erDuMoisSuivant.SetAnyTime Call ndt_1erDuMoisSuivant.AdjustMonth(1)
If v_DateFacturation < ndt_1erDuMoisSuivant.lslocaltime Then Call ndt_1erDuMoisSuivant.AdjustDay(-1) v_DateFactureJusquau = ndt_1erDuMoisSuivant.lslocaltime End If
End If End If
' Calculer la date de facturation ndt_DateProchaineFacturation.lslocaltime = SDSCSFa_ProchaineFacturation(v_DateFactureJusquau , v_PeriodeFacturation)
' Calculer la date de la prochaine commande v_ProchaineCommande = SDSCSFa_ProchaineCommande(ndt_DateProchaineFacturation.lslocaltime , xVar(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_ModePaiement", "00"))
Call xAssignerDate(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_DateProchaineFacture", ndt_DateProchaineFacturation.lslocaltime) Call xAssignerDate(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_DateProchaineCommande", v_ProchaineCommande )
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSFa, gc_Element_SDSCSFa, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub SDSCSFa_Initialisations On Error Goto GererErreur
If gns_SDSCSFa Is Nothing Then Set gns_SDSCSFa = New NotesSession Set gndb_SDSCSFa = gns_SDSCSFa.Currentdatabase Set gnd_Prof_SDSCSFa = gndb_SDSCSFa.GetProfileDocument("F_Prof") 'Set gnv_CSFa20_SDSCSFa = gndb_SDSCSFa.GetView("V_CSFa20") End If
gv_ChampRenversement_SDSCSFa(0)="DatePremiereFacture" gv_ChampRenversement_SDSCSFa(1)="DateDerniereFacture" gv_ChampRenversement_SDSCSFa(2)="DateFactureJusquau" gv_ChampRenversement_SDSCSFa(3)="DateDerniereCommande" gv_ChampRenversement_SDSCSFa(4)="DateProchaineFacture" gv_ChampRenversement_SDSCSFa(5)="DateProchaineCommande" gv_ChampRenversement_SDSCSFa(6)="StatutFacturation" gv_ChampRenversement_SDSCSFa(7)="NoCommande"
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSFa, gc_Element_SDSCSFa, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub SDSCSFa_MAJTransfertFactureJusquau( pnd_CSFa As NotesDocument )
On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ndc_Produits As NotesDocumentCollection
Dim nd_Prod As NotesDocument Dim nd_ProdSuivant As NotesDocument Dim v_NoContratFmt As String
Dim v_FacturerJusquau As Variant Dim v_NomChamp As String Dim v_NoLigne As Integer
Dim v_DateFin As Variant Dim v_ValeurJusquau As Variant
Call SDSCSFa_Initialisations
v_NoContratFmt=xVar(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_NoContratFmt", "")
If gnv_CSPr23_SDSCSFa Is Nothing Then Set gnv_CSPr23_SDSCSFa = gndb_SDSCSFa.getview("V_CSPr23") End If Call gnv_CSPr23_SDSCSFa.refresh
Set ndc_Produits = gnv_CSPr23_SDSCSFa.GetAllDocumentsByKey(v_NoContratFmt,True)
If ndc_Produits.Count = 0 Then Exit Sub End If
v_FacturerJusquau = xVar(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_DateFactureJusquau", "")
Set nd_ProdSuivant = ndc_Produits.Getfirstdocument
Do Until nd_ProdSuivant Is Nothing Set nd_Prod = nd_ProdSuivant Set nd_ProdSuivant = ndc_Produits.Getnextdocument(nd_ProdSuivant)
v_NoLigne = xVar(nd_Prod, "CSPr_NoProduitSeq", 0)
v_NomChamp="CSFa_DateFactureJusquauLigne"+SDSCSFa_CreerNoChamp(V_NoLigne) v_DateFin = xVar(nd_Prod, "CSPR_DATEFIN", v_FacturerJusquau ) v_ValeurJusquau = v_FacturerJusquau
If v_DateFin < v_FacturerJusquau Then v_ValeurJusquau = v_DateFin End If
Call xAssignerDate(pnd_CSFa, v_NomChamp, v_ValeurJusquau)
Loop
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSfa, gc_Element_SDSCSfa, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub
End Sub

Sub SDSCSFa_RafraichirFacturationUI(pnd As NotesDocument, pnuid As NotesUIDocument ) On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nuiws As New NotesUIWorkspace Dim nuid As NotesUIDocument Dim v_StatutGnuid As Boolean Dim v_NoContrat As String Dim nd As NotesDocument
If Not (pnuid Is Nothing) Then
Set pnd = pnuid.Document
v_NoContrat = xVar(pnd, "CSFa_NoContrat" , "") v_StatutGnuid=pnuid.editMode
Call pnuid.Close
Set nd = xSDSCS_xndCSFa(v_NoContrat , True )
' Rouvrir le document en édition Set nuid = nuiws.EditDocument(v_StatutGnuid, nd) Delete pnuid
End If
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSFa, gc_Element_SDSCSFa, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub SDSCSFa_RenverserFinancement( p_NoCommande As String )
On Error GoTo GererErreur Dim nd_suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd As NotesDocument
Dim v_Formule As String Dim v_NoFinancement As String Dim v_MontantCommande As Double Dim ndc_Transaction As NotesDocumentCollection
Call SDSCSFa_Initialisations
v_Formule = {Form = "F_CSFt" & CSFt_NoCommande = "} & p_NoCommande & {"} Set ndc_Transaction = gndb_SDSCSFa.Search(v_Formule, Nothing, 0) If ndc_Transaction.Count >= 1 Then

GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSFa, gc_Element_SDSCSFa, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub
End Sub

Sub SDSCSFa_ReinitialiserFacturation( pnd_CSFa As NotesDocument , p_FactDesactive As String, p_commentaire As String ) On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim i As Integer Dim v_NomChamp As Variant Dim v_NomChampRenv As String Dim v_NomChampCSFa As String Dim v_ValeurJusquau As Variant Dim v_item As NotesItem Dim v_ChampRenv As NotesItem Dim v_Commentaire As String Dim v_StatutFacture As String Dim v_PPARecu As String Dim v_ModePaiement As String Dim v_NoContratFmt As String Dim nd_CSCo As NotesDocument Dim ndt_DateJusquAu As NotesDateTime
Call SDSCSFa_Initialisations
v_ModePaiement=xVar(pnd_CSFa,"CSFa_ModePaiement","") '"02" : PPA, "01" : Autre v_PPARecu = xVar(pnd_CSFa,"CSFa_FormulairePPArecu","") v_NoContratFmt = xVar(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_NoContratFmt" , "") Set nd_CSCo = xSDSCS_xndCSCo(v_NoContratFmt , True )
v_Commentaire = ""
For i = 0 To 999 v_NomChamp="DateFactureJusquauLigne"+SDSCSFa_CreerNoChamp(i) v_NomChampCSFa = "CSFa_" + v_NomChamp v_NomChampRenv = "Renv_" + v_NomChamp
Call pnd_CSFa.RemoveItem( v_NomChampCSFa ) Call pnd_CSFa.RemoveItem( v_NomChampRenv ) Next
For i = 0 To UBound(gv_ChampRenversement_SDSCSFa) v_NomChampCSFa = "CSFa_" + gv_ChampRenversement_SDSCSFa(i) v_NomChampRenv = "Renv_" + gv_ChampRenversement_SDSCSFa(i) Set v_item = pnd_CSFa.ReplaceItemValue ( v_NomChampCSFa, "" ) Call pnd_CSFa.RemoveItem( v_NomChampRenv ) Next
v_StatutFacture="50" pnd_CSFa.CSFa_StatutFacturation=v_StatutFacture pnd_CSFa.CSFa_StatutIcone=xIcnTabl(v_StatutFacture, "CSFa_StatutFacturation", True) pnd_CSFa.CSFa_StatutDescFR=xDescTabl(v_StatutFacture, "CSFa_StatutFacturation", True)
If v_ModePaiement="02" And Not v_PPARecu = "1" Then pnd_CSFa.CSFa_FacturationInactive="1" Else pnd_CSFa.CSFa_FacturationInactive=p_FactDesactive If p_FactDesactive Then v_Commentaire = "Facturation desactivé" End If End If Stop Set ndt_DateJusquAu = New NotesDateTime(xVar(nd_CSCo,"CSCo_DateDebut","")) Call ndt_DateJusquAu.AdjustDay(-1) Call pnd_CSFa.ReplaceItemValue("CSFa_DateFactureJusquau", ndt_DateJusquAu)
Call SDSCSFa_MajDatesProchaine(pnd_CSFa , False) Call SIHi_Ajouter(pnd_CSFa , "", "Action : Réinitialiser la facturation" & Chr(13) & p_commentaire, "", True) Call pnd_CSFa.Save(True,False)
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSFa, gc_Element_SDSCSFa, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub
End Sub

Function SDSCSFa_ProchaineFacturation(p_DateFactureJusquau As Variant, p_PeriodeFacturation As long) As Variant On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_DateProchaineFacturation As variant
Dim ndt_DateProchaineFacturation As New NotesDateTime("") Call SDSCSFa_Initialisations SDSCSFa_ProchaineFacturation=""
v_DateProchaineFacturation = p_DateFactureJusquau + 1
If p_PeriodeFacturation >= 12 then If v_DateProchaineFacturation > Today Then SDSCSFa_ProchaineFacturation = v_DateProchaineFacturation Else SDSCSFa_ProchaineFacturation = Today End If Else ndt_DateProchaineFacturation.lslocaltime = DateNumber(Year(v_DateProchaineFacturation), Month(v_DateProchaineFacturation), xVarProf("Prof_JourFacturation", 1)) Call ndt_DateProchaineFacturation.SetAnyTime Do Until ndt_DateProchaineFacturation.Lslocaltime > Today Call ndt_DateProchaineFacturation.AdjustMonth(p_PeriodeFacturation) Loop SDSCSFa_ProchaineFacturation = ndt_DateProchaineFacturation.Lslocaltime End if Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSFa, gc_Element_SDSCSFa, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSCSFa_MAJDatePPARecu(pnd_CSFA As NotesDocument ) As Boolean
On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_NoClientFmt As String Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_CSFA As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim v_NoClient As String
Dim v_DateReceptionPPA As Variant Dim v_NoContrat As String Dim v_DateReceptionPPA_Courant As Variant Dim v_NoContrat_Courant As String Dim v_DateReceptionPPA_Suivant As Variant Dim v_NoContrat_Suivant As String
SDSCSFa_MAJDatePPARecu = False v_NoClient = xVar(pnd_CSFA, "CSFA_CLIENTNOFMT" , "") v_NoContrat = xVar(pnd_CSFA, "CSFa_NoContrat", "") v_DateReceptionPPA = "" v_NoClientFmt = xVar(pnd_CSFA, "CSFA_ClientNoFmt" , "")
Call SDSCSFa_Initialisations If gnv_CSFa23_SDSCSFa Is Nothing Then Set gnv_CSFa23_SDSCSFa = gndb_SDSCSFa.getview("V_CSFa23") End If Call gnv_CSFa23_SDSCSFa.refresh
Set ndc = gnv_CSFa23_SDSCSFa.GetAllDocumentsByKey(v_NoClientFmt, False)
If ndc.Count = 0 Then Exit Function Else Set nd_Suivant= ndc.GetFirstDocument
Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd_CSFA = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.GetNextDocument(nd_Suivant)
v_NoContrat_Courant = xVar(nd_CSFA, "CSFa_NoContrat", "") v_DateReceptionPPA_Courant = xVar(nd_CSFA, "CSFa_DatePPARecu", "")
If v_NoContrat_Courant <> v_NoContrat Then
v_NoContrat_Suivant = xVar(nd_Suivant, "CSFa_NoContrat", "")
If v_NoContrat_Suivant = v_NoContrat Then v_NoContrat_Suivant = "" End If
v_DateReceptionPPA_Suivant = xVar(nd_Suivant, "CSFa_DatePPARecu", "")
If v_DateReceptionPPA_Suivant = "" Then v_NoContrat_Suivant = "" End If
If v_NoContrat_Courant > v_NoContrat_Suivant And v_DateReceptionPPA_Courant <> "" Then v_DateReceptionPPA = v_DateReceptionPPA_Courant End If End If Loop
End If
If v_DateReceptionPPA <> "" Then
Call xAssignerDate(pnd_CSFa , "CSFa_DatePPARecu", v_DateReceptionPPA ) Call pnd_CSFa.Save(True,False) SDSCSFa_MAJDatePPARecu = True
End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSFa, gc_Element_SDSCSFa, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function
