Option Public Option Explicit
Use "SDSCS_clCommande" Use "SI_CourrielsTypes" Use "SDSCS_Facturation" Use "SDSCS_Contrat"

' Traitement des erreurs Dim gns_A As NotesSession Dim gndb_A As NotesDatabase
Const gc_TypeElement_A = "A" Const gc_Element_A = "A_Fact" ' Inscrire l'alias de l'agent

Sub Initialize On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nv As NotesView Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd_CSCo As NotesDocument
Dim v_PeriodeFacturation As long Dim v_ModePaiement As String Dim v_NoContratFmt As String Dim v_NoCommande As String
Dim v_FacturerAPartirDe As Variant Dim v_FacturerJusqau As Variant Dim v_FactureEcheance As Variant Dim v_DateFactureJusqua As Variant Dim v_DateProchaineCommande As variant
Dim cl_facture As SDSCS_clFacture Dim cl_factureSuivante As SDSCS_clFacture Dim cl_Commande As SDSCS_clCommande
Dim ndc_ParNoClient As NotesDocumentCollection Dim ndc_Erreurs As NotesDocumentCollection Dim ndc_FacturationInactive As NotesDocumentCollection Dim ndc_PPAaviser As NotesDocumentCollection Dim v_Resultat As String Dim v_NoClient as String Dim v_NoClientFact As String Dim v_NoClientFactSuivant As String
Dim v_NomClient as string Dim v_ProchaineCommande As Variant Dim v_ProchaineFacture As Variant Dim v_EstUnRenouvellement As Boolean Dim v_DateInfoBanque As Variant Dim v_DateReceptionPPA As Variant Dim v_FormulairePPArecu As String
Call A_Initialisations
Call A_MAJExecutionCommande("1")
Set nv = gndb_A.Getview("V_CSFa25") Call nv.Refresh
Set ndc_Erreurs = gndb_A.CreateDocumentCollection Set ndc_FacturationInactive = gndb_A.CreateDocumentCollection Set ndc_PPAaviser = gndb_A.CreateDocumentCollection
v_NoClientFact=""
Set nd_Suivant = nv.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant
v_EstUnRenouvellement=False
Set nd_Suivant = nv.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant) v_NoClientFact = xVar(nd,"CSFa_ClientNoFmt","") v_NoClientFactSuivant = xVar(nd_Suivant,"CSFa_ClientNoFmt","")
If cl_Commande Is Nothing Then Set cl_Commande = New SDSCS_clCommande(v_NoClientFact) End If
If xVar(nd, "CSFa_StatutFacturation" , "") <> "90" Then
Call SIGE_OuvrirLog(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A)
v_NoContratFmt = xVar(nd, "CSFa_NoContratFmt" , "") v_DateFactureJusqua = xVar(nd, "CSFa_DateFactureJusquau" , "") v_DateProchaineCommande = xVar(nd, "CSFa_DateProchaineCommande" , Today) v_PeriodeFacturation = xVar(nd, "CSFa_PeriodeFacturation", 0) v_ProchaineFacture = xVar(nd, "CSFa_DateProchaineFacture" , "") v_ModePaiement = xVar(nd, "CSFa_ModePaiement", "00") ' 01 = Autre, 02 = PPA
Set nd_CSCo = xSDSCS_xndCSCo(v_NoContratFmt , True ) Set nd_CSCo = gndb_A.Getdocumentbyunid(nd_CSCo.Universalid)
If xVar(nd_CSCo, "CSCo_EstUnRenouvellement" , "0") = "1" Then v_EstUnRenouvellement = True End If
v_ProchaineCommande = SDSCSFa_ProchaineCommande( v_ProchaineFacture , v_ModePaiement)
If v_ProchaineCommande < v_DateProchaineCommande Then v_DateProchaineCommande = v_ProchaineCommande End If
If v_DateProchaineCommande <= Today Or v_PeriodeFacturation > 12 Then '-------- Validation Pour facturation
If Not nd_CSCo Is Nothing Then
If xVar(nd_CSCo, "CSCo_StatutContrat" , "") > "20" Then '-------- Validation Contrat ne peut etres Nouveau ou en Renouvellement
'Requete 47525 Batir une collection validation PPA recus If v_ModePaiement="02" Then v_FormulairePPArecu = xVar(nd, "CSFa_FormulairePPArecu", "")
If v_FormulairePPArecu <> "1" Then 'Call ndc_PPAaviser.AddDocument(nd) Else
v_DateInfoBanque = xVar(nd, "CSFa_DateInfoBanque", "") v_DateReceptionPPA = xVar(nd, "CSFa_DatePPARecu", "")
If v_DateReceptionPPA <> "" and (v_DateReceptionPPA < v_DateInfoBanque) Then Call ndc_PPAaviser.AddDocument(nd) End If End If End If 'Requete 47525 Fin
If xVar(nd, "CSFa_FacturationInactive" , "0") = "1" Then If xVar(nd_CSCo, "CSCo_StatutContrat" , "") = "90" And v_DateFactureJusqua >= xVar(nd_CSCo, "CSCo_DateFin" , "") Then
'Verification que tout a ete facturé... If validationFacturationTermine(nd , xVar(nd_CSCo, "CSCo_DateFin" , "")) Then 'Mettre la facturation a terminée. Call SDSCSFa_AssignerStatutFacturation(nd, "90" , "") Else Call ndc_FacturationInactive.AddDocument(nd_CSCo) End If Else Call ndc_FacturationInactive.AddDocument(nd_CSCo) End If
Else If Not SDSCSCo_ValidProduitsActif(nd_CSCo ) Then Call ndc_Erreurs.AddDocument(nd_CSCo) Call A_ChampsErreur(nd_CSCo, "Produit inactif.")
Else If Not SDSCSCo_ValidProduitsNbUtilisateurs(nd_CSCo ) Then Call ndc_Erreurs.AddDocument(nd_CSCo)
Call A_ChampsErreur(nd_CSCo, "Le nb d'usager est obligatoire (ne peut pas être 0).") Else If Not SDSCSCo_ClientActif(nd_CSCo) Then Call ndc_Erreurs.AddDocument(nd_CSCo) Call A_ChampsErreur(nd_CSCo,"Client inactif." ) Else
v_NoClient = xVar(nd_CSCo,"CSCo_ClientNoFmt","") v_NomClient = xVar(nd_CSCo,"CSCo_ClientNomInterne","") v_FactureEcheance=xVar(nd_CSCo,"CSCo_DateFin","") v_FacturerAPartirDe=xVar(nd,"CSFa_DateFactureJusquau","")+1 v_FacturerJusqau=SDSCSFa_ProchainePeriode(v_ProchaineFacture , v_PeriodeFacturation )
If v_FactureEcheance < v_FacturerJusqau Then v_FacturerJusqau=v_FactureEcheance End If
' Si c'est un CSA ... If v_ModePaiement="01" And v_PeriodeFacturation = 12 Then v_FacturerJusqau=v_FactureEcheance End If
v_Resultat="Échec" v_NoCommande=""
Set cl_facture = New SDSCS_clFacture(nd, nd_CSCo , v_FacturerAPartirDe , v_FacturerJusqau , False , v_ModePaiement, "")
If cl_facture.Valide Then Call cl_Commande.ajouterFacture(cl_facture) v_Resultat="Succès" Else Call ndc_Erreurs.AddDocument(nd_CSCo) Call A_ChampsErreur(nd_CSCo, "La création de la commande a échoué." )
v_Resultat="Échec" Delete cl_facture End If ' Facture.valide
'Call SIGe_AjouterLog(v_Resultat & " facturation de : " & v_NoContratFmt & " pour : " & v_NoClient & " " & v_NomClient & " commande : " & v_NoCommande ) End If 'End ClientActif End If 'End ValidProduitsNbUtilisateurs End If 'End ValidProduitsActif End If ' ---- CSFa_FacturationInactive = "1" End If ' CSCo_StatutContrat > "01" ( 00 : Nouvelle, 01 : Renouvellement ) End If 'End nd_CSCo is nothing
Else If v_ProchaineCommande <> xVar(nd, "CSFa_DateProchaineCommande" , "") Then Call SDSCSFa_MajDatesProchaine(nd , v_EstUnRenouvellement) Call nd.Save(True,False) End If End If '------------ Validation Pour facturation End If ' Statut facturation terminé 90
If cl_Commande.NbFactures=0 Then Delete cl_commande Else
If v_NoClientFactSuivant <> cl_Commande.NoClient Or Not validationAjoutProchaine(cl_Commande,nd_Suivant ) Then
'Faire la facturation If cl_facture.NbLignes > 0 Then
If SDSCSCom_FacturerContrat(cl_Commande , v_NoCommande) Then '--- Envoi de la facture
'Mise a jour du document Facturation avec succès Call SDSCSFa_MajTraitementCommande(cl_Commande , v_NoCommande)
Call enlenverIndicateurProduits(nd) v_Resultat="Succès" Else Call ndc_Erreurs.AddDocument(nd_CSCo) Call A_ChampsErreur(nd_CSCo, "La création de la commande a échoué.") v_Resultat="Échec" End If '--- Envoi de la facture
Else 'Lignes de facture = 0 Call SDSCSFa_MajTraitementCommande(cl_Commande , "") v_Resultat="Succès" End If '--- cl_facture.NbLignes
ForAll l_Facture In cl_Commande.facture If v_NoCommande <> "" Then Call SIGe_AjouterLog(v_Resultat & " facturation de : " & l_Facture.NoContrat & " pour : " & v_NoClient & " " & v_NomClient & " commande : " & v_NoCommande, 0, 0, False ) End If End ForAll
Delete cl_commande End If End If Loop
If ndc_Erreurs.count > 0 Then Call A_EnvoyerErreursDetailles(ndc_Erreurs ) Call A_EnleverChampsErreur(ndc_Erreurs) End If
If ndc_FacturationInactive.count > 0 Then Call EnvoyErreurs(ndc_FacturationInactive , "A_FactInact") End If
If ndc_PPAaviser.count > 0 Then Call SDSCSFa_AviserErreurs(ndc_PPAaviser, "A_ValidDatePPA") End If
Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Fin", 0 , 0, False) Call SIGE_EnregistrerLog
Call A_MAJExecutionCommande("0")
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

End If End Sub

Function validationAjoutProchaine(cl_commande, pnd As NotesDocument) As Boolean validationAjoutProchaine=False
Dim nd_CS As NotesDocument Dim v_NoContratFmt As String
'Si il ne faut pas regrouper es facturations de meme clients If xVarProf("Prof_FactRegroupee", "0") = "0" Then Exit Function End If
v_NoContratFmt= xVar(pnd,"CSFa_NoContratFmt","") Set nd_CS = xSDSCS_xndCSCo(v_NoContratFmt , True )
If cl_commande.NoClientLivraison = "" Then Exit Function End If
If cl_commande.NoClientLivraison <> xVar(nd_CS, "CSCo_ClientNoFmt", "") Then Exit Function End If
If cl_commande.NoClientFacturation <> xVar(nd_CS, "CSCo_ClientFactNoFmt", "") Then Exit Function End If
If cl_commande.PeriodeFacturation<> xVar(pnd, "CSFa_PeriodeFacturation", 0) Then Exit Function End If
If cl_commande.ModePaiement <> xVar(pnd, "CSFa_ModePaiement", "") Then Exit Function End If
validationAjoutProchaine=True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSclCommande, gc_Element_SDSCSclCommande, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function validationFacturationTermine(pnd As NotesDocument, v_DateFinContrat As variant) As Boolean
validationFacturationTermine=False
'Dim nd_CS As NotesDocument Dim v_NoContratFmt As String Dim nv_CSPr As NotesView Dim ndc_CSPr As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim v_Statut As String Dim v_DateFin As Variant Dim v_DateFactureJusquau As String
v_NoContratFmt= xVar(pnd,"CSFa_NoContratFmt","")
Set nv_CSPr = gndb_A.GetView("V_CSPr23") Set ndc_CSPr = nv_CSPr.GetAllDocumentsByKey(v_NoContratFmt, True)
Set nd_Suivant = ndc_CSPr.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc_CSPr.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
v_Statut = xVar(nd,"CSPr_StatutProduit","") v_DateFin = xVar(nd,"CSPR_DATEFIN","")
v_DateFactureJusquau=xVar(pnd, "CSFa_DateFactureJusquauLigne" & CreerNoChamp(xVar(nd,"CSPr_NoProduitSeq","")),"")
If v_Statut <= "90" Then If v_DateFin = "" Then If v_DateFactureJusquau < v_DateFinContrat Then Exit function End If End If End If
Loop
validationFacturationTermine=True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSclCommande, gc_Element_SDSCSclCommande, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function CreerNoChamp(pv_NoChamp As Integer) As String On Error GoTo GererErreur Dim v_NoChamp As String Dim v_maxLength As Integer Dim v_NouvNumChamp As String Dim i As Integer
v_NouvNumChamp = CStr(pv_NoChamp) v_maxLength = 3 v_maxLength = v_maxLength-Len(v_NouvNumChamp)
For i=1 To v_maxLength v_NoChamp = "0" + v_NoChamp Next
CreerNoChamp=v_NoChamp+v_NouvNumChamp Exit Function

Function xSDSCS_xDescTabl(Byval p_Cle As String, Byval p_Table As String, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As String ' Cette fonction retourne la description d'un élément d'une table.
Dim v_Valeurs As Variant Dim v_Descriptions As Variant Dim i As Long
xSDSCS_xDescTabl = ""
' Extraire les valeurs et les descriptions v_Valeurs = xSDSCS_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Valeurs", "", True) v_Descriptions = xSDSCS_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Descriptions", "", True)
' S'il n'y a plusieurs valeurs, rechercher la valeur recherchée If Isarray(v_Valeurs) Then For i = Lbound(v_Valeurs) To Ubound(v_Valeurs) If v_Valeurs(i) = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Descriptions) Then If i >= Lbound(v_Descriptions) And i <= Ubound(v_Descriptions) Then xSDSCS_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions(i) End If End If
Exit For End If Next
' S'il n'y a qu'une valeur, et qu'elle correspond à la valeur recherchée, retourner la description Else If v_Valeurs = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Descriptions) Then xSDSCS_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions(0) Else xSDSCS_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions End If End If End If End Function

Sub VCSFa_acReiniExecutionCommande( ) On Error GoTo GererErreur Dim nd As NotesDocument
' Initialisations Call VCSFa_Initialisations
On Error GoTo GererErreur
Set nd = SDSCSCom_xndExecutionCommande()
If Not (nd Is Nothing) Then Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("aFact_Execution", "0") Call nd.Save(False, False) End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VCSFa, gc_Element_VCSFa, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub VCSFa_acFacturer()
On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_CSCo As NotesDocument Dim nd_CSFa As NotesDocument
Call VCSFa_Initialisations
Set gndb_VCSFa = gns_VCSFa.Currentdatabase Set ndc = gndb_VCSFa.UnprocessedDocuments
If ndc.Count = 0 Then ' Aucun document sélectionné. MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 2, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub End If
If ndc.Count > 1 Then MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 38, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub End If
Set nd_CSFa = ndc.Getfirstdocument Set nd_CSCo = xSDSCS_xndCSCo(xVar(nd_CSFa, "CSFa_NoContratFmt" , ""), True) If SDSCSCo_FacturerManuellement(nd_CSCo) Then nd_CSCo.CSCo_CompteurFacturation = xVar(nd_CSCo, "CSCo_CompteurFacturation" , 0) + 1 Call nd_CSCo.Save(True,False) End If
Call gnuiws_VCSFa.CurrentView.DeselectAll Call gnuiws_VCSFa.ViewRefresh Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VCSFa, gc_Element_VCSFa, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub VCSFa_acRenverser( p_RenvCSSeulement As Boolean ) On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument
Dim nd_Box As NotesDocument Dim v_Commentaire As String Dim v_Titre As String Dim v_FactDesactive As String Dim v_NoCommande As String Dim a_AutreCS As Variant
' Initialisations Call VCSFa_Initialisations v_Commentaire=""
Set ndc = gndb_VCSFa.UnprocessedDocuments If ndc.Count = 0 Then ' Aucun document sélectionné. MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 2, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub End If
Set nd_Box = New NotesDocument(gndb_VCSFa) v_Titre = xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 54, "", "") 'nd_Box.DB_CommentaireRequis=""
If gnuiws_VCSFa.DialogBox("DB_Renv", True, True, False, False, False, False, v_Titre, nd_Box,True, False, False) = True Then v_Commentaire = xVar(nd_Box, "DB_Commentaire","") v_FactDesactive=xVar(nd_Box, "DB_FactDesactive","") Else Exit Sub End If
Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
If xVar(nd, "CSFa_StatutFacturation", "") = "99" Then MsgBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 112, "", ""),16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Else
If p_RenvCSSeulement Then v_NoCommande=xVar(nd, "CSFa_NoCommande", "") If v_NoCommande <> "" Then a_AutreCS = Evaluate(|@IfError(@count(@DBLookup("" : "NoCache"; ""; "V_CSFa22"; "| & v_NoCommande & |"; 2)); 0)|) If a_AutreCS(0) > 1 Then If gnuiws_VCSFa.Prompt(PROMPT_YESNO, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 185, "", ""), xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 93, "", v_NoCommande)) = 1 Then Call SDSCSFa_RenverserFacturation(nd , v_FactDesactive, v_Commentaire) End If Else Call SDSCSFa_RenverserFacturation(nd , v_FactDesactive, v_Commentaire) End If Else Call SDSCSFa_RenverserFacturation(nd , v_FactDesactive, v_Commentaire) End If Else
Call SDSCSFa_Renverser(nd , v_Commentaire , v_FactDesactive) End If End If Loop
Call gnuiws_VCSFa.CurrentView.DeselectAll Call gnuiws_VCSFa.ViewRefresh Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VCSFa, gc_Element_VCSFa, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub VCSFa_acReinitialiser( ) On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd_Box As NotesDocument Dim v_Commentaire As String Dim v_Titre As String Dim v_FactDesactive As String
' Initialisations Call VCSFa_Initialisations v_Commentaire=""
Set ndc = gndb_VCSFa.UnprocessedDocuments If ndc.Count = 0 Then ' Aucun document sélectionné. MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 2, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub End If
Set nd_Box = New NotesDocument(gndb_VCSFa) v_Titre = xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 107, "", "")
If gnuiws_VCSFa.DialogBox("DB_Renv", True, True, False, False, False, False, v_Titre, nd_Box,True, False, False) = True Then v_Commentaire = xVar(nd_Box, "DB_Commentaire","") v_FactDesactive=xVar(nd_Box, "DB_FactDesactive","") Else Exit Sub End If
Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
If xVar(nd, "CSFa_StatutFacturation", "") = "99" Then MsgBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 112, "", ""),16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Else Call SDSCSFa_ReinitialiserFacturation(nd , v_FactDesactive, v_Commentaire) End If Loop
Call gnuiws_VCSFa.CurrentView.DeselectAll Call gnuiws_VCSFa.ViewRefresh Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VCSFa, gc_Element_VCSFa, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub VCSFa_acFacturerLot()
On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_nd_FactValide As Boolean Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim v_DateFacture As Variant Dim nd_Fact As NotesDocument
Call VCSFa_Initialisations 'Reinitialiser la bd pour eviter l'erreur suivante :"Can't get left-to-do list, <server, database> is not the agent's database" Set gndb_VCSFa = gns_VCSFa.currentdatabase
v_nd_FactValide = False
Set ndc = gndb_VCSFa.UnprocessedDocuments
If ndc.Count = 0 Then ' Aucun document sélectionné. MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 2, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub End If
Set nd_Fact = New NotesDocument(gndb_VCSFa)
Do If gnuiws_VCSFa.DialogBox("DB_FactLot",True,True,False,False,False,False,xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS",39 , xLangue, ""),nd_Fact,True,False,True) Then v_DateFacture=xVar(nd_Fact,"DBFa_DateFacture","") v_nd_FactValide = True Else Exit Sub End If Loop Until v_nd_FactValide
Call SDSCSCo_FacturerAnnuelleEnLot(ndc, v_DateFacture )
Call gnuiws_VCSFa.CurrentView.DeselectAll Call gnuiws_VCSFa.ViewRefresh
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VCSFa, gc_Element_VCSFa, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub VCSFa_acActiver(p_Action As Boolean) On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd_Box As NotesDocument Dim v_Commentaire As String Dim v_textHistorique As String Dim v_Titre As String
' Initialisations Call VCSFa_Initialisations Set ndb = gns_VCSFa.CurrentDatabase
Set ndc = ndb.UnprocessedDocuments If ndc.Count = 0 Then ' Aucun document sélectionné. MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 2, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub End If v_textHistorique = ""
Set nd_Box = New NotesDocument(gndb_VCSFa) v_Titre = xGDK_xMessage("SI", 185, "", "") nd_Box.DB_CommentaireRequis="" If gnuiws_vCSFa.DialogBox("DB_Comm", True,True,False,False,False,False,v_Titre, nd_Box, True,False,False) = True Then If p_Action Then If xVar(nd_Box, "DB_Commentaire","") <> "" Then v_textHistorique = Chr(13) + xVar(nd_Box, "DB_Commentaire","") End If
v_Commentaire = "" Else v_Commentaire = xVar(nd_Box, "DB_Commentaire","") End If
Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
If Not (xVar(nd, "CSFa_FormulairePPArecu" , "") <> "1" And xVar(nd, "CSFa_ModePaiement" , "") = "02") Then Call SDSCSFa_Activation(nd , p_Action, v_Commentaire, v_textHistorique )
End If
Loop
Call gnuiws_VCSFa.CurrentView.DeselectAll Call gnuiws_VCSFa.ViewRefresh End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VCSFa, gc_Element_VCSFa, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function SDSCSCom_EnvoyerCommande(p_NoCommande As String) As Boolean
On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_XML As String Dim v_Resultat As String
If gns_Commande_SDSCSCom Is Nothing Then Exit Function End If
gns_Commande_SDSCSCom.Position = 0 v_XML = gns_Commande_SDSCSCom.Readtext
Dim ws_SIFcCo As New Cl_Commande v_Resultat = ws_SIFcCo.CreerCommandeXML(v_XML) If Strleft(v_Resultat, ";") = "OK" Then SDSCSCom_EnvoyerCommande = True End If p_NoCommande = Strright(v_Resultat, ";")
Set gns_Commande_SDSCSCom = Nothing Exit Function

Function SDSCSCom_XML_FormaterBalise(p_Balise As String, p_Valeur As String, p_NbBlancs As Integer, p_CR As Boolean) As String On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Valeur As String
v_Valeur = p_Valeur If v_Valeur <> "" Then v_Valeur = Replace(p_Valeur, "<", "{") v_Valeur = Replace(p_Valeur, ">", "}") SDSCSCom_XML_FormaterBalise = Ustring$(p_NbBlancs, " ") & |<| & p_Balise & |>| & v_Valeur & |</| & p_Balise & |>| If p_CR Then SDSCSCom_XML_FormaterBalise = SDSCSCom_XML_FormaterBalise & g_CR_SDSCSCom End If End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSCom, gc_Element_SDSCSCom, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSCSCom_AjouterLignes(pcl_Facture) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_NoLigne As String Dim v_TypeLigne As String Dim v_LigneXML As String Dim v_Quantite As Variant Dim v_PrixUnitaire As Variant Dim v_DateDebut As Variant Dim v_DateFin As Variant Dim v_DateDebutPrec As Variant Dim v_DateFinPrec As Variant Dim v_LigneEntete As String Dim a_Dates(1) As String Dim s As String Dim v_EspacementCommentaire As String
v_EspacementCommentaire = xVarProf("Prof_EspacementFacture", "")
%REM <Ligne NoLigne="001" TypeLigne="1"> <CodeProduit>SESDSWIN</CodeProduit> <Quantite>1</Quantite> <PrixUnitaire>100.00</PrixUnitaire> <Commentaire>Ceci est un commentaire.</Commentaire> </Ligne> %END REM
SDSCSCom_AjouterLignes = False
' Ouvrir la commande au besoin If gns_Commande_SDSCSCom Is Nothing Then ' If Not SDSCSCom_OuvrirCommande(pcl_Facture) Then ' Exit function ' End If End If
' Boucler sur les lignes du contrat Forall l_Ligne In pcl_Facture.Ligne v_LigneXML = "" v_Quantite = 0 v_PrixUnitaire = 0
' Si changement de dates, insérer un commentaire v_DateDebut = SDSCSCom_Element(l_Ligne, "DateDebut") v_DateFin = SDSCSCom_Element(l_Ligne, "DateFin") If v_DateDebut <> v_DateDebutPrec Or v_DateFin <> v_DateFinPrec Then
If gl_Commentaire > 0 Then Call SDSCSCom_AjouterCommentaire(v_EspacementCommentaire) End If ' Ligne entête a_Dates(0) = SItD_DateLongue(v_DateDebut, pcl_Facture.Langue) a_Dates(1) = SItD_DateLongue(v_DateFin, pcl_Facture.Langue) v_LigneEntete = xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 40, pcl_Facture.Langue, a_Dates)
Call SDSCSCom_AjouterCommentaire(v_LigneEntete) Call SDSCSCom_AjouterCommentaire(v_EspacementCommentaire) gl_Commentaire=gl_Commentaire+1
v_DateDebutPrec = v_DateDebut v_DateFinPrec = v_DateFin End If
' Ouvrir la ligne v_NoLigne = SDSCSCom_Element(l_Ligne, "NoLigne") v_TypeLigne = SDSCSCom_Element(l_Ligne, "TypeLigne") v_LigneXML = v_LigneXML & SDSCSCom_XML_FormaterTexte(|<Ligne ReferenceSerti="| & Cstr(pcl_Facture.NoContrat) & _ |" NoLigne="| & Cstr(v_NoLigne) & |" TypeLigne="| & v_TypeLigne & |">|, g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom) & g_CR_SDSCSCom g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom = g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom + g_Espacement_SDSCSCom
' Ajouter les éléments Call SDSCSCom_XML_AjouterBalise("CodeProduit", Cstr(SDSCSCom_Element(l_Ligne, "CodeProduit")), g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom, True, v_LigneXML) If v_TypeLigne <> "4" Then Call SDSCSCom_XML_AjouterBalise("DateDebut",Cstr(Format(v_DateDebut, "yyyymmdd")) , g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom, True, v_LigneXML) Call SDSCSCom_XML_AjouterBalise("DateFin",Cstr(Format(v_DateFin, "yyyymmdd")) , g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom, True, v_LigneXML)
Call SDSCSCom_XML_AjouterBalise("NbUtilisateurs", Cstr(SDSCSCom_Element(l_Ligne, "NbUtilisateurs")), g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom, True, v_LigneXML) v_Quantite = SDSCSCom_Element(l_Ligne, "Quantite") Call SDSCSCom_XML_AjouterBalise("Quantite", Cstr(v_Quantite), g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom, True, v_LigneXML) Call SDSCSCom_XML_AjouterBalise("NbJours", Cstr(SDSCSCom_Element(l_Ligne, "NbJours")), g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom, True, v_LigneXML) v_PrixUnitaire = SDSCSCom_Element(l_Ligne, "PrixUnitaire") If v_PrixUnitaire <> "" Then Call SDSCSCom_XML_AjouterBalise("PrixUnitaire", xEvaluate(|@Text(|& v_PrixUnitaire & |; "F2")|, Nothing), g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom, True, v_LigneXML) End If
Call SDSCSCom_XML_AjouterBalise("NoBonCommande", SDSCSCom_Element(l_Ligne, "NoBonCommande"), g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom, True, v_LigneXML) Call SDSCSCom_XML_AjouterBalise("ReferenceClient", SDSCSCom_Element(l_Ligne, "ReferenceClient"), g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom, True, v_LigneXML) Call SDSCSCom_XML_AjouterBalise("TypeModification", SDSCSCom_Element(l_Ligne, "TypeModification"), g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom, True, v_LigneXML) Call SDSCSCom_XML_AjouterBalise("FacturationInitiale", SDSCSCom_Element(l_Ligne, "FacturationInitiale"), g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom, True, v_LigneXML) Call SDSCSCom_XML_AjouterBalise("TypeReferenceSerti", SDSCSCom_Element(l_Ligne, "TypeReferenceSerti"), g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom, True, v_LigneXML) Call SDSCSCom_XML_AjouterBalise("NoFactureFinancement", SDSCSCom_Element(l_Ligne, "NoFactureFinancement"), g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom, True, v_LigneXML)
End If
Call SDSCSCom_XML_AjouterBalise("Commentaire", SDSCSCom_Element(l_Ligne, "Commentaire"), g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom, True, v_LigneXML)
' Fermer la ligne g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom = g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom - g_Espacement_SDSCSCom v_LigneXML = v_LigneXML & SDSCSCom_XML_FormaterTexte(|</Ligne>|, g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom)
' Ajouter la ligne au XML Call gns_Commande_SDSCSCom.Writetext(v_LigneXML, EOL_CR)
' Mettre à jour les totaux gl_Totaux_SDSCSCom("NbLignes") = gl_Totaux_SDSCSCom("NbLignes") + 1 If v_Quantite <> "" Then gl_Totaux_SDSCSCom("SommeQuantites") = gl_Totaux_SDSCSCom("SommeQuantites") + v_Quantite End If If v_PrixUnitaire <> "" Then gl_Totaux_SDSCSCom("SommePrixUnitaires") = gl_Totaux_SDSCSCom("SommePrixUnitaires") + v_PrixUnitaire End If End Forall
SDSCSCom_AjouterLignes = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSCom, gc_Element_SDSCSCom, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSCSCom_XML_FormaterTexte(p_Texte As String, p_NbBlancs As Integer) As String On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_Texte As String
v_Texte = FullTrim(p_Texte) If v_Texte <> "" Then SDSCSCom_XML_FormaterTexte = UString$(p_NbBlancs, " ") & v_Texte End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSCom, gc_Element_SDSCSCom, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSCSCom_OuvrirCommande(pcl_Commande As SDSCS_clCommande) As Boolean
On Error Goto GererErreur
SDSCSCom_OuvrirCommande = False
Set gns_Commande_SDSCSCom = gns_SDSCSCom.CreateStream
gl_Totaux_SDSCSCom("NbLignes") = 0 gl_Totaux_SDSCSCom("SommeQuantites") = 0 gl_Totaux_SDSCSCom("SommePrixUnitaires") = 0 g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom = 0
' Créer l'entête de la commande Call gns_Commande_SDSCSCom.Writetext(SDSCSCom_XML_FormaterTexte(|<?xml version="1.0"?>|, g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom), EOL_CR) Call gns_Commande_SDSCSCom.Writetext(SDSCSCom_XML_FormaterTexte(|<Commande Origine="| & xVarProf("Prof_IdBaseGDK", "SDSCS") & |">|, g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom), EOL_CR) g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom = g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom + g_Espacement_SDSCSCom
' Ajouter les clients If pcl_Commande.NoClientFacturation <> "" Then Call gns_Commande_SDSCSCom.Writetext(SDSCSCom_XML_FormaterTexte(|<Adresse TypeAdresse="Facturation" NoClient="| & pcl_Commande.NoClientFacturation & |"></Adresse>|, g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom), EOL_CR) End If If pcl_Commande.NoClientLivraison <> "" Then Call gns_Commande_SDSCSCom.Writetext(SDSCSCom_XML_FormaterTexte(|<Adresse TypeAdresse="Livraison" NoClient="| & pcl_Commande.NoClientLivraison & |"></Adresse>|, g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom), EOL_CR) End If
' Ajouter les éléments de la commande Call gns_Commande_SDSCSCom.Writetext(SDSCSCom_XML_FormaterBalise("ReferenceClient", pcl_Commande.NoProposition, g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom, False), EOL_CR) Call gns_Commande_SDSCSCom.Writetext(SDSCSCom_XML_FormaterBalise("DateCommande", Format(pcl_Commande.DateCommande, "yyyymmdd"), g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom, False), EOL_CR) Call gns_Commande_SDSCSCom.Writetext(SDSCSCom_XML_FormaterBalise("TypeCommande", xVarProf("Prof_TypeCommande", "08"), g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom, False), EOL_CR) Call gns_Commande_SDSCSCom.Writetext(SDSCSCom_XML_FormaterBalise("SousTypeCde", xVarProf("Prof_SousTypeCommande", "02"), g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom, False), EOL_CR) Call gns_Commande_SDSCSCom.Writetext(SDSCSCom_XML_FormaterBalise("TypeContratService", pcl_Commande.TypeContratService, g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom, False), EOL_CR)
'If pcl_Commande.DateFacturation < Today then ' Call gns_Commande_SDSCSCom.Writetext(SDSCSCom_XML_FormaterBalise("DateFacturation", Format(Today, "yyyymmdd"), g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom, False), EOL_CR) 'else Call gns_Commande_SDSCSCom.Writetext(SDSCSCom_XML_FormaterBalise("DateFacturation", Format(pcl_Commande.DateFacturation, "yyyymmdd"), g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom, False), EOL_CR) 'End if Call gns_Commande_SDSCSCom.Writetext(SDSCSCom_XML_FormaterBalise("ModePaiement", pcl_Commande.ModePaiement, g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom, False), EOL_CR) Call gns_Commande_SDSCSCom.Writetext(SDSCSCom_XML_FormaterBalise("PeriodeFacturation", pcl_Commande.PeriodeFacturation, g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom, False), EOL_CR) Call gns_Commande_SDSCSCom.Writetext(SDSCSCom_XML_FormaterBalise("Devise", pcl_Commande.Devise, g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom, False), EOL_CR) Call gns_Commande_SDSCSCom.Writetext(SDSCSCom_XML_FormaterBalise("IndicateurOrigine", pcl_Commande.Indicateur, g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom, False), EOL_CR)
If pcl_Commande.TypeTransfert = "1" Then Call gns_Commande_SDSCSCom.Writetext(SDSCSCom_XML_FormaterBalise("TypeTransfert", pcl_Commande.TypeTransfert, g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom, False), EOL_CR) Call gns_Commande_SDSCSCom.Writetext(SDSCSCom_XML_FormaterBalise("DateTransfert", Format(pcl_Commande.DateTransfert, "yyyymmdd"), g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom, False), EOL_CR) End If
' Ouvrir la section des lignes Call gns_Commande_SDSCSCom.Writetext(SDSCSCom_XML_FormaterTexte(|<Lignes>|, g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom), EOL_CR) g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom = g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom + g_Espacement_SDSCSCom
' Ajouter un commentaire si commande PPA If pcl_Commande.ModePaiement = "02" Then Call SDSCSCom_AjouterCommentaire(xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 57, pcl_Commande.Langue, "")) End If
SDSCSCom_OuvrirCommande = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSCom, gc_Element_SDSCSCom, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSCSCom_Element(p_Liste As Variant, p_NomElement As String) As Variant On Error Goto GererErreur
SDSCSCom_Element = ""
If Iselement(p_Liste(p_NomElement)) Then SDSCSCom_Element = p_Liste(p_NomElement) End If
Exit Function

Function SDSCSCom_FermerCommande(p_NoCommande As String) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
SDSCSCom_FermerCommande = False p_NoCommande = ""
If gns_Commande_SDSCSCom Is Nothing Then Exit Function End If
' Fermer la section des lignes g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom = g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom - g_Espacement_SDSCSCom Call gns_Commande_SDSCSCom.Writetext(SDSCSCom_XML_FormaterTexte(|</Lignes>|, g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom), EOL_CR)
' Ajouter les totaux Call gns_Commande_SDSCSCom.Writetext(SDSCSCom_XML_FormaterTexte(|<Totaux>|, g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom), EOL_CR) g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom = g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom + g_Espacement_SDSCSCom Call gns_Commande_SDSCSCom.Writetext(SDSCSCom_XML_FormaterBalise("NbLignes", Cstr(gl_Totaux_SDSCSCom("NbLignes")), g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom, False), EOL_CR) Call gns_Commande_SDSCSCom.Writetext(SDSCSCom_XML_FormaterBalise("SommeQuantites", Cstr(gl_Totaux_SDSCSCom("SommeQuantites")), g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom, False), EOL_CR) 'Call gns_Commande_SDSCSCom.Writetext(SDSCSCom_XML_FormaterBalise("SommePrixUnitaires", CStr(Format(gl_Totaux_SDSCSCom("SommePrixUnitaires"), "Fixed")), g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom, False), EOL_CR) Call gns_Commande_SDSCSCom.Writetext(SDSCSCom_XML_FormaterBalise("SommePrixUnitaires", xEvaluate(|@Text(|& gl_Totaux_SDSCSCom("SommePrixUnitaires") & |; "F2")|, Nothing), g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom, False), EOL_CR) g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom = g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom - g_Espacement_SDSCSCom Call gns_Commande_SDSCSCom.Writetext(SDSCSCom_XML_FormaterTexte(|</Totaux>|, g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom), EOL_CR)
' Fermer la commande g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom = g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom - g_Espacement_SDSCSCom Call gns_Commande_SDSCSCom.Writetext(SDSCSCom_XML_FormaterTexte(|</Commande>|, g_NbBlancs_SDSCSCom))
' Envoyer la commande à SI Facturation SDSCSCom_FermerCommande = SDSCSCom_EnvoyerCommande(p_NoCommande) Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSCom, gc_Element_SDSCSCom, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSCSCom_FacturerContrat(pcl_Commande As SDSCS_clCommande, p_NoCommande As String) As Boolean ' Point d'entrée - Permet de créer une commande XML et de l'envoyer à SI Commandes ' p_NoCommande - Le numéro de la commande qui a été créée dans SI Commandes ' La fonction retourne TRUE si la commande a été créée avec succès. ' Si la fonction retourne FALSE et qu'il n'y a pas de no de commande, il y a eu une erreur de traitement dans ce SL. ' Si la fonction retourne FALSE et qu'il y a un no de commande, le XML a été rejeté par SI Commandes. il est ' possible de voir les erreurs dans la commande de SI Commandes. On Error Goto GererErreur
' Initialisations
SDSCSCom_FacturerContrat = False p_NoCommande = ""
Call SDSCSCom_Initialisations
' Ouvrir la commande XML If SDSCSCom_OuvrirCommande(pcl_Commande) Then ' Ajouter les lignes à la commande XML Forall l_Facture In pcl_Commande.facture If Not SDSCSCom_AjouterLignes(l_Facture) Then Exit Function End If End Forall
If SDSCSCom_FermerCommande(p_NoCommande) Then ' Fermer la commande XML SDSCSCom_FacturerContrat = True End If
End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSCom, gc_Element_SDSCSCom, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub SDSCSCom_XML_AjouterBalise(p_Balise As String, p_Valeur As String, p_NbBlancs As Integer, p_CR As Boolean, p_LigneXML As String) On Error Goto GererErreur
If p_Valeur <> "" Then p_LigneXML = p_LigneXML & SDSCSCom_XML_FormaterBalise(p_Balise, p_Valeur, p_NbBlancs, p_CR) End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSCom, gc_Element_SDSCSCom, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub SDSCSCom_AjouterCommentaire(p_Commentaire As String) On Error GoTo GererErreur

function SDSCSCom_xndExecutionCommande( ) As notesdocument '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet d'obtenir le document qui contient les compteurs séquentiels. '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim v_Formule As String
Set SDSCSCom_xndExecutionCommande = nothing Call SDSCSCom_Initialisations
v_Formule = |Form = "F_aFact"| Set ndc = gndb_SDSCSCom.Search(v_Formule, Nothing, 0) Set nd = ndc.GetFirstDocument
If (nd Is Nothing) Then Set nd = New NotesDocument(gndb_SDSCSCom) nd.Form = "F_aFact" Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("$PublicAccess", "1") Call nd.Save(False, False)
End If
If Not (nd Is Nothing) Then If Not nd.Hasitem("Form") Then nd.Form = "F_aFact" Call nd.Save(False, False) End If
If Not nd.Hasitem("$PublicAccess") Then Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("$PublicAccess", "1") Call nd.Save(False, False) End If
If Not nd.Hasitem("aFact_Execution") Then Call nd.ReplaceItemValue("aFact_Execution", "0") Call nd.Save(False, False) End If
Set SDSCSCom_xndExecutionCommande = nd
End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSCom, gc_Element_SDSCSCom, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Option Public Option Declare
Use "SDSCS_Financement" Use "SDSCS_Messages"

' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_SDSCSclFacture = "SL" Const gc_Element_SDSCSclFacture = "SDSCS_clFacture"
Class SDSCS_clFacture
Public NoContrat As String Public NoContratFmt As String Public NoContratInitial As String Public DateDebut As Variant Public DateFin As Variant Public NbLignes As Long Public NoProposition As String Public NoClientLivraison As String Public NoClientFacturation As String Public DateCommande As Variant Public DateFacturation As Variant Public DateProchaineFacture As Variant Public DateFacturerAPartirDe As Variant Public DateFacturerJusquau As Variant Public ModePaiement As String Public TypePaiement As String Public TypeInstallation As String Public Langue As String Public Ligne List As Variant Public Devise As String Public DateFactureJusquauLigne000 List As Variant Public PeriodeFacturation As Long Public PeriodeFacturationStr As String Public FacturationManuelle As Boolean Public Valide As Boolean Public Facture List As Variant Public Indicateur As String Public DateDerniereCommande As Variant Public DateEnVigueur As Variant Public TypeTransfert As Variant Public DateTransfert As Variant Public Nd_CSFi As NotesDocument Public ListFinancement List As Variant Public CompteurFinancement As Integer Public BalanceFinancement As Double Public LangueClient As String Public DateDebutFacturation As Variant Public messages List As Variant Public estUnRenouvellement As string
Public Sub New( pnd_CSFa As NotesDocument , pnd_CSCo As NotesDocument , pv_DateFacturerAPartirDe As Variant, pv_DateFacturerJusquau As Variant , p_FactManuelle As Boolean , p_ModePaiement As String, pv_DateFacturation)
Call xSDSCS_Initialisations
Me.Valide=True
Me.FacturationManuelle=p_FactManuelle Me.NoContrat= xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoContrat", "") Me.NoContratFmt= xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoContratFmt", "") Me.NoProposition = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoProposition", "") Me.NoClientLivraison = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_ClientNoFmt", "") Me.NoClientFacturation = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_ClientFactNoFmt", "") Me.DateCommande = Today Me.DateProchaineFacture = xVar(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_DateProchaineFacture" , "") If pv_DateFacturation = "" Then Me.DateFacturation = pv_DateFacturerAPartirDe Else Me.DateFacturation = pv_DateFacturation End If Me.DateFacturerAPartirDe = pv_DateFacturerAPartirDe Me.DateFacturerJusquau = pv_DateFacturerJusquau Me.TypePaiement = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_ModePaiement", "") Me.Devise = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_Devise", "") Me.DateDebut = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_DateDebut", "") Me.DateFin = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_DateFin", "") Me.Langue = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_Langue", "") Me.PeriodeFacturationStr = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_TypePeriode", "") Me.TypeInstallation = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_TypeInstallation", "") Me.LangueClient = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_Langue", "FR") Me.NbLignes = 0 Me.Indicateur = "" Me.CompteurFinancement = 0 Me.BalanceFinancement = 0 Me.estUnRenouvellement = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_EstUnRenouvellement" , "")
'*** Correction pour crayon modification Me.DateDerniereCommande = xVar(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_DateDerniereCommande", "") Me.DateEnVigueur = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_DateEnVigueur", "")
Me.TypeTransfert = "0" Me.DateTransfert = ""
Set Me.Nd_CSFi = Nothing
If xVar(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_DatePremiereFacture" , "") = "" Then Me.DateTransfert = Me.DateDebut End If
If Me.DateEnVigueur <> "" And Me.DateDerniereCommande <> "" Then If Me.DateEnVigueur >= Me.DateDerniereCommande Then If xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoRevision" , "") <> "000" Then Me.Indicateur = "12" End If End If End If
If FacturationManuelle Then Me.ModePaiement = p_ModePaiement Else Me.ModePaiement = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_ModePaiement", "") End If
If Me.TypeInstallation = "0" Or Me.TypeInstallation = "3" Then ' Sur site Me.PeriodeFacturation = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_TypePeriode", 0) Else Me.PeriodeFacturation = 1 End If
Call ajouterLignesFacturation(pnd_CSFa) If listIsEmpty( Me.Ligne ) Then Me.NbLignes=0 End If
End Sub
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Public Function ajouterLignesFacturation(pnd_CSFa As NotesDocument ) As Boolean '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ndc_CSPr As NotesDocumentCollection ajouterLignesFacturation = False Set ndc_CSPr = genererCollectionProduits()
If ndc_CSPr.count > 0 Then Call listeFactureJusquau(pnd_CSFa) Call AjoutLignes(ndc_CSPr) End If
ajouterLignesFacturation = True
Exit Function GererErreur: Me.Valide=False Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSclFacture, gc_Element_SDSCSclFacture, GetThreadInfo(1), Me.NoContratFmt, False) Exit Function End Function
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Public Sub listeFactureJusquau(pnd_Facturation As NotesDocument) '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim i As Integer Dim v_ValeurJusquau As Variant Dim v_NoChamp As String
For i = 0 To 999 v_NoChamp=CreerNoChamp(i) v_ValeurJusquau=xVar(pnd_Facturation, "CSFa_DateFactureJusquauLigne"+v_NoChamp, "") If v_ValeurJusquau <> "" Then Me.DateFactureJusquauLigne000(CStr(i)) = v_ValeurJusquau End If Next
Exit Sub GererErreur: Me.Valide=False Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSclFacture, gc_Element_SDSCSclFacture, GetThreadInfo(1), Me.NoContratFmt, False) Exit Sub End Sub
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Private Function SauterFacturation (pnd_Produit As NotesDocument, p_DateLigneFacturation As variant) As boolean '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nd_parent As NotesDocument Dim nv As NotesView Dim v_CleRech( 1 To 2 ) As Variant
Dim v_DateDebutFacturation As Variant Dim v_TypeProduit As String Dim v_NoLigneParent As long
SauterFacturation = False v_TypeProduit = xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_TypeProduit", "") v_NoLigneParent = xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_NoProduitParent" , 0)
'Ajouter FacturerJusquau ?! If v_TypeProduit = "80" And v_NoLigneParent > 0 Then 'Aller chercher le produit parent Set nv = gndb_xSDSCS.GetView( "V_CSPr26" ) v_CleRech( 1 ) = Me.NoContratFmt v_CleRech( 2 ) = v_NoLigneParent
Call nv.Refresh Set nd_parent = nv.GetDocumentByKey( v_CleRech )
If Not (nd_parent Is Nothing) Then v_DateDebutFacturation = xVar(nd_parent, "CSPr_DateDebutFacturation" , "") If v_DateDebutFacturation = "" Then Exit function Else If v_DateDebutFacturation > p_DateLigneFacturation("debut") Then SauterFacturation = True End If End If
End If
End If
Exit Function GererErreur: Me.Valide=False Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSclFacture, gc_Element_SDSCSclFacture, GetThreadInfo(1), Me.NoContratFmt, False) Exit Function End Function
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Public Sub AjoutLignes(pndc_Produits As NotesDocumentCollection ) '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim v_DateDebutProduitFacturation As Variant Dim v_DateFinProduitFacturation As Variant Dim v_DateLigneFacturation As Variant Dim v_PerioderCompteur As Long Dim v_TypeProduit As String
v_DateLigneFacturation = AjusteDatePeriodeFacturation( 0, 0 )
Set nd_Suivant = pndc_Produits.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = pndc_Produits.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
v_TypeProduit = xVar(nd, "CSPr_TypeProduit", "")
If v_TypeProduit = "10" Then Set me.Nd_CSFi = xSDSCS_xndCSFi(xVar(nd, "CSPr_NoFinancement", ""),True) Me.BalanceFinancement = xVar(me.Nd_CSFi, "CSFi_MontantFinancement", 0) - xVar(me.Nd_CSFi, "CSFi_MontantCommande", 0) End if
If xVar(nd, "CSPr_InstallationReportee", "") = "" Then
If xVar(nd, "CSPr_Quantite", 0) <> 0 Then '********************************************** PBE v_DateDebutProduitFacturation = CalculDateProduitDebut( nd ) v_DateFinProduitFacturation = CalculDateProduitFin( nd )
If Not v_DateDebutProduitFacturation = "" Then
If v_TypeProduit = "60" Or v_TypeProduit = "70" Or Me.PeriodeFacturation = 12 Then ' Le Produit est un Crédit ou c'est une facturation annuelle v_DateLigneFacturation("debut")=v_DateDebutProduitFacturation v_DateLigneFacturation("fin")=v_DateFinProduitFacturation
Call EcrireLigneFacturation(nd, v_DateDebutProduitFacturation , v_DateFinProduitFacturation , v_DateLigneFacturation ) Else v_DateLigneFacturation = AjusteDatePeriodeFacturation( Me.DateFacturerAPartirDe, 0 )
'Si le produits doit etre facturé avant la date de facturation courante If v_DateDebutProduitFacturation < Me.DateFacturerAPartirDe Then Do 'Recul d'une periode de facturation... v_DateLigneFacturation = AjusteDatePeriodeFacturation( v_DateLigneFacturation("debut") , -1 ) If v_TypeProduit = "10" And Me.BalanceFinancement <= 0 Then Exit Do Else Call EcrireLigneFacturation(nd, v_DateDebutProduitFacturation , v_DateFinProduitFacturation , v_DateLigneFacturation ) End If Loop Until v_DateLigneFacturation("debut") = v_DateDebutProduitFacturation End If
v_DateLigneFacturation = AjusteDatePeriodeFacturation( Me.DateFacturerAPartirDe, 0 ) v_PerioderCompteur = 0
Do
If v_PerioderCompteur > 0 Then v_DateLigneFacturation = AjusteDatePeriodeFacturation( v_DateLigneFacturation("fin") , 1 ) End If
If v_TypeProduit = "10" And Me.BalanceFinancement <= 0 Then Exit Do Else Call EcrireLigneFacturation(nd, v_DateDebutProduitFacturation , v_DateFinProduitFacturation , v_DateLigneFacturation ) v_PerioderCompteur = v_PerioderCompteur +1 End If
Loop Until v_DateLigneFacturation("fin") = v_DateFinProduitFacturation
End If 'Fin validation "CSPr_TypeProduit" = "60" Crédit End If ' Fin Not v_DateDebutProduitFacturation = "" End If ' xVar(nd, "CSPr_Quantite", 0) <> 0 End If 'CSPr_InstallationReportee Loop
If Not listIsEmpty( Me.Ligne ) Then Call TrieProduits(Me.Ligne) Call TrieLigneProduits(Me.Ligne) End If
Exit Sub GererErreur: Me.Valide=False Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSclFacture, gc_Element_SDSCSclFacture, GetThreadInfo(1), Me.NoContratFmt, False) Exit Sub End Sub
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Private Sub EcrireLigneFacturation(pnd As NotesDocument, p_DateDebutProduitFacturation As Variant, p_DateFinProduitFacturation As Variant , p_DateLigneFacturation As Variant) '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur Dim v_LigneProduit As Variant
Dim v_JourPaiementFinancement As Integer Dim v_JourfacturationDebut As Integer Dim v_JourfacturationFin As Integer Dim v_TypeProduit As String Dim v_InclureMoisGratuits As String Dim v_TypeProduitS As String Dim v_DateDebutFacturationProduit As Variant Dim nd_TC As NotesDocument
Dim v_datePeriodeFacturation As Variant v_datePeriodeFacturation = p_DateLigneFacturation
v_InclureMoisGratuits = xVar(pnd, "CSPr_InclureMoisGratuits", "") If xVar(pnd, "CSPr_NbMoisGratuits", 0) > 0 Then v_InclureMoisGratuits = "1" End If v_DateDebutFacturationProduit = xVar(pnd, "CSPr_DateDebutFacturation", me.DateDebut ) -1 v_LigneProduit="" v_TypeProduit = xVar(pnd, "CSPr_TypeProduit", "")
If p_DateLigneFacturation("debut") < p_DateDebutProduitFacturation Then p_DateLigneFacturation("debut")= p_DateDebutProduitFacturation End If
If p_DateLigneFacturation("fin") > p_DateFinProduitFacturation Then p_DateLigneFacturation("fin") = p_DateFinProduitFacturation End If
If p_DateLigneFacturation("fin") >= p_DateDebutProduitFacturation Then If p_DateLigneFacturation("fin") >= p_DateLigneFacturation("debut") Then
If (v_TypeProduit > "20" And v_TypeProduit < "90") Then v_TypeProduitS = Left(v_TypeProduit , 1) If v_TypeProduitS = "8" Then If SauterFacturation( pnd, p_DateLigneFacturation ) Then 'Si escomptes lieé et durant période gratuite sauter la ligne Exit Sub End If
End If End If
If v_TypeProduit = "10" Then If Not me.Nd_CSFi Is Nothing Then
v_JourfacturationDebut = Day( p_DateLigneFacturation("debut") ) v_JourfacturationFin = Day( p_DateLigneFacturation("fin") ) v_JourPaiementFinancement = xVar( me.Nd_CSFi, "CSFi_JourPaiement", 0)
If Not (v_JourPaiementFinancement >= v_JourfacturationDebut And v_JourPaiementFinancement <= v_JourfacturationFin) Then Exit Sub End If End If End If
v_LigneProduit = composeProduit(pnd, p_DateLigneFacturation("debut") , p_DateLigneFacturation("fin"), v_datePeriodeFacturation ) me.Ligne(produitCle(v_LigneProduit)) = v_LigneProduit
If v_LigneProduit ("TypeProduit") = "10" Then Call ajoutLigneFinancement( v_LigneProduit ) End If
If v_LigneProduit ("TypeProduit") = "01" Or v_LigneProduit ("TypeProduit") = "02" then 'If v_DateFactureJusquauLigne000 = "" Then 'Premiere facturation 'Verifier si un produit lié pour les tierces compagnies est défini
%REM
Set nd_TC = SDSCSPr_xNdProduitTierce( pnd ) If Not nd_TC Is Nothing Then Call EcrireMessage( pnd ) End If %END REM End If
'Facturation des mois gratuits req :46867 If v_InclureMoisGratuits = "1" Then If p_DateLigneFacturation("debut") <= v_DateDebutFacturationProduit then If ( v_TypeProduit < "10" ) Then
If p_DateLigneFacturation("fin") > v_DateDebutFacturationProduit Then p_DateLigneFacturation("fin") = v_DateDebutFacturationProduit End If
v_LigneProduit = composeProduitGratuit(pnd, p_DateLigneFacturation("debut") , p_DateLigneFacturation("fin") , v_datePeriodeFacturation) Me.Ligne(produitCle(v_LigneProduit)& "02") = v_LigneProduit End If End If End If
End If
End If
Exit Sub GererErreur: Me.Valide=False Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSclFacture, gc_Element_SDSCSclFacture, GetThreadInfo(1), Me.NoContratFmt, False) Exit Sub End Sub
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Private Function listIsEmpty( pv_list As Variant ) As Boolean '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- listIsEmpty = True
ForAll item In pv_list listIsEmpty = False Exit Function End ForAll
End Function
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Private Function CreerNoChamp(pv_NoChamp As Integer) As String '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur Dim v_NoChamp As String Dim v_maxLength As Integer Dim v_NouvNumChamp As String Dim i As Integer
v_NouvNumChamp = CStr(pv_NoChamp) v_maxLength = 3 v_maxLength = v_maxLength-Len(v_NouvNumChamp)
For i=1 To v_maxLength v_NoChamp = "0" + v_NoChamp Next
CreerNoChamp=v_NoChamp+v_NouvNumChamp
Exit Function GererErreur: Me.Valide=False Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSclFacture, gc_Element_SDSCSclFacture, GetThreadInfo(1), Me.NoContratFmt, False) Exit Function End Function
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Private Function AjusteDatePeriodeFacturation( v_Date As Variant , v_PeriodeAjustement As Integer ) As Variant '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur Dim ndt_Date As New NotesDateTime(v_Date) Dim v_DatePeriodeFacturation List As Variant Dim v_Ajustement As Long
v_DatePeriodeFacturation("debut")="" v_DatePeriodeFacturation("fin")=""
If v_Date <> 0 Then If Me.PeriodeFacturation=12 Then
ndt_Date.LocalTime = DateNumber(Year(v_Date), Month(v_Date), Day(v_Date)) Else ndt_Date.LocalTime = DateNumber(Year(v_Date), Month(v_Date), 1) End if
v_Ajustement = v_PeriodeAjustement * Me.PeriodeFacturation Call ndt_Date.AdjustMonth(v_Ajustement) v_DatePeriodeFacturation("debut")= ndt_Date.lsLocalTime If Me.PeriodeFacturation=12 Then 'PJ -> Correction pour facturation manuelle, Pour un Annuelle v_DatePeriodeFacturation("fin")=Me.DateFacturerJusquau Else
Call ndt_Date.AdjustMonth(Me.PeriodeFacturation) Call ndt_Date.AdjustDay(-1) v_DatePeriodeFacturation("fin")=ndt_Date.lsLocalTime End If End If
AjusteDatePeriodeFacturation = v_DatePeriodeFacturation
Exit Function GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSclFacture, gc_Element_SDSCSclFacture, GetThreadInfo(1), Me.NoContratFmt, False) Exit Function End Function
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Private Function CalculDateProduitDebut(pnd_Produit As NotesDocument) As Variant '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur Dim v_dateDebutProduit As Variant Dim v_dateFinProduit As Variant Dim v_DateFactureJusquauLigne000 As Variant Dim v_NoLigne As String
Dim v_TypeProduit As String Dim v_NoLigneParent As String
CalculDateProduitDebut=""
v_TypeProduit = xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_TypeProduit", "") v_NoLigneParent = xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_NoProduitParent" , "")
' FacturerJusqau ' E = Date Facturer jusqu'au ou date de fin v_NoLigne= xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_NoProduitSeq" , "")
'Si escompte Global sur contrat avec mois gratuit, date debut = Me.DateDebutFacturation v_dateDebutProduit= xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_DateDebut", Me.DateDebut) 'EV
v_dateFinProduit= xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_Datefin", Me.DateFacturerJusquau ) 'ECH
If IsElement( DateFactureJusquauLigne000( v_NoLigne ) ) Then v_DateFactureJusquauLigne000 = DateFactureJusquauLigne000( v_NoLigne ) End If
If v_DateFactureJusquauLigne000 = "" Then If v_dateDebutProduit > DateFacturerJusquau Then v_dateDebutProduit="" End If Else v_dateDebutProduit = v_DateFactureJusquauLigne000 +1 If v_dateDebutProduit > v_dateFinProduit Then v_dateDebutProduit="" End If End If
CalculDateProduitDebut=v_dateDebutProduit
Exit Function GererErreur: Me.Valide=False Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSclFacture, gc_Element_SDSCSclFacture, GetThreadInfo(1), Me.NoContratFmt, False) Exit Function End Function
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Private Function FacturationInitial(pnd_Produit As NotesDocument) As string '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_DateFactureJusquauLigne000 As Variant Dim v_NoLigne As String Dim v_RENOUV_AJOUTPRODUIT As String
FacturationInitial = "0"
v_NoLigne= xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_NoProduitSeq" , "")
If IsElement( DateFactureJusquauLigne000( v_NoLigne ) ) Then v_DateFactureJusquauLigne000 = DateFactureJusquauLigne000( v_NoLigne ) End If
If v_DateFactureJusquauLigne000 = "" Then 'Premiere facturation FacturationInitial = "1" If Me.estUnRenouvellement = "1" Then v_RENOUV_AJOUTPRODUIT = xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPR_RENOUV_AJOUTPRODUIT" , "") If v_RENOUV_AJOUTPRODUIT = "" Then FacturationInitial = "2" End If End If End If
Exit Function GererErreur: Me.Valide=False Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSclFacture, gc_Element_SDSCSclFacture, GetThreadInfo(1), Me.NoContratFmt, False) Exit Function End Function
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Private Function EcrireMessage(pnd_Produit As NotesDocument) As Variant '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_DateFactureJusquauLigne000 As Variant Dim v_NoLigne As String Dim v_message As string Dim v_cleMessages As string
v_NoLigne= xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_NoProduitSeq" , "") v_cleMessages = xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_CleProduit" , "") & "-" & v_NoLigne
If Not IsElement(Me.Messages(v_cleMessages)) Then
If IsElement( DateFactureJusquauLigne000( v_NoLigne ) ) Then v_DateFactureJusquauLigne000 = DateFactureJusquauLigne000( v_NoLigne ) End If
If v_DateFactureJusquauLigne000 = "" Then 'Premiere facturation v_message = xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 134, "", "") Call SDSCSMsgF_creerMessage(pnd_Produit, v_message) Me.Messages( v_cleMessages ) = True End If End If
Exit Function GererErreur: Me.Valide=False Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSclFacture, gc_Element_SDSCSclFacture, GetThreadInfo(1), Me.NoContratFmt, False) Exit Function End Function
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Private Function CalculDateProduitFin(pnd_Produit As NotesDocument) As Variant '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur Dim v_dateFinProduit As Variant Dim v_TypeProduit As string
CalculDateProduitFin="" ' FacturerJusqau ' E = DateDe fin facturation ou date de fin v_dateFinProduit= xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_Datefin", Me.DateFacturerJusquau ) 'ECH v_TypeProduit = xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_TypeProduit", "")
If v_TypeProduit = "60" Or v_TypeProduit = "70" Then CalculDateProduitFin = v_dateFinProduit Else If v_dateFinProduit < DateFacturerJusquau Then CalculDateProduitFin = v_dateFinProduit Else CalculDateProduitFin = DateFacturerJusquau End If End If
Exit Function GererErreur: Me.Valide=False Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSclFacture, gc_Element_SDSCSclFacture, GetThreadInfo(1), Me.NoContratFmt, False) Exit Function End Function
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Public Function produitCle(v_listProduit As Variant) As String '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_NoNouv As String Dim v_maxLength As Integer Dim v_NoLigne As String Dim v_DateDebut As variant Dim i As Integer Dim ndt_DateDebut As New NotesDateTime("")
v_NoLigne = v_listProduit("NoLigne")
v_maxLength = 5 v_maxLength = v_maxLength-Len(v_NoLigne)
For i=1 To v_maxLength v_NoNouv = "0" + v_NoNouv Next
produitCle = Format(v_listProduit("DateDebut"),"yyyymmdd")+Format(v_listProduit("DateFin"),"yyyymmdd") +"-"+ v_NoNouv+v_NoLigne
Exit Function GererErreur: Me.Valide=False Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSclFacture, gc_Element_SDSCSclFacture, GetThreadInfo(1), Me.NoContratFmt, False) Exit Function End Function
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Private Function CalculPrixFacturation(p_PrixUnitaire As Double, p_NbJrsDansPeriode As Double, p_DateDebut As Variant, p_DateFin As Variant, p_datePeriodeFacturation As variant) As Double '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Dim v_JoursDansPeriodeTypeInstallation As Double Dim v_Prix As Double Dim ndt_Date As New NotesDateTime("") Dim v_PeriodeFacturationDebut As Variant Dim v_PeriodeFacturationFin As Variant
On Error GoTo GererErreur CalculPrixFacturation=p_PrixUnitaire
' Si TypeInstallation = 0 : Sur Site alor un CSA prix du produit est anuel ' Sinon TypeInstallation = 1 : prix du produit est mensuel If Me.TypeInstallation = "0"Or Me.TypeInstallation = "3" Then ndt_Date.LsLocalTime = me.DateFacturerAPartirDe v_PeriodeFacturationDebut = ndt_Date.LsLocalTime
Call ndt_Date.AdjustYear(1) Call ndt_Date.AdjustDay(-1)
v_PeriodeFacturationFin = ndt_Date.LsLocalTime
CalculPrixFacturation = SItN_Round(p_PrixUnitaire * SItD_FacteurProrata(v_PeriodeFacturationDebut, v_PeriodeFacturationFin, p_DateDebut ,p_DateFin),2)
Else
v_JoursDansPeriodeTypeInstallation = JoursDansMoi(p_DateDebut)
If p_NbJrsDansPeriode <> v_JoursDansPeriodeTypeInstallation Then CalculPrixFacturation = SItN_Round(p_PrixUnitaire * SItD_FacteurProrata(p_datePeriodeFacturation("debut"), p_datePeriodeFacturation("fin"), p_DateDebut ,p_DateFin),2) End If
End If
Exit Function GererErreur: Me.Valide=False Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSclFacture, gc_Element_SDSCSclFacture, GetThreadInfo(1), Me.NoContratFmt, False) Exit Function End Function
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Public sub ajoutLigneFinancement( p_LigneProduit As Variant ) '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim LigneFinancement List As Variant Dim v_NbPmnts As Long Dim v_NoFinancement As String
Me.CompteurFinancement = Me.CompteurFinancement + 1 v_NoFinancement = xVar(me.nd_CSFi, "CSFi_NoFinancement" , "")
v_NbPmnts = xVar(me.nd_CSFi, "CSFi_NbPaiementsRecus" , 0) + Me.CompteurFinancement
LigneFinancement("NoFinancement")= v_NoFinancement LigneFinancement("MontantCommande")=p_LigneProduit("PrixUnitaire")
ListFinancement(v_NoFinancement + "-" + CStr(v_NbPmnts)) = LigneFinancement
Me.BalanceFinancement = Me.BalanceFinancement - LigneFinancement("MontantCommande")
Exit sub GererErreur: Me.Valide=False Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSclFacture, gc_Element_SDSCSclFacture, GetThreadInfo(1), Me.NoContratFmt, False) Exit sub End sub '------------ ********************************* ----------------
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Public Function composeProduit(pnd_Produit As NotesDocument, pv_DateDebut As Variant, pv_DateFin As Variant , p_datePeriodeFacturation As variant ) As Variant '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur Dim v_PrixUnitaire As Double Dim v_NbJrsDansPeriode As Double Dim v_JoursDansMois As Double Dim v_Quantite As Double Dim v_NbUtilisateurs As String Dim v_TypeLigne As long Dim v_CleProduit As String ' PBE Dim v_CodeProduit As String Dim v_CodeDisgen As String ' PBE Dim v_NoLigne As String Dim v_NoLigneParent As string Dim v_ListLigne List As Variant Dim v_PrixUnitaireAjust As Double Dim v_PrixTotal As Double Dim v_Reste As Variant Dim v_NombreJrs As Long Dim v_NombreMois As Long Dim v_MoisCourant As Variant Dim v_TypeProduit As String Dim v_TypeReferenceSerti As String Dim v_TypeModification As String Dim v_resteapayer As Double Dim v_FinancementMontantPaiement As Double Dim v_NoFactureFinancement As String Dim v_Commentaire As String Dim v_MontantCommande As Double Dim v_NbPaiementRecus As Long
composeProduit=""
v_NoLigne = xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_NoProduitSeq" , "") v_CleProduit= xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_CleProduit" , "") ' PBE v_CodeProduit= xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_CodeProduit" , "") v_CodeDisgen= xSDSBB_xVarProd(v_CleProduit, "Prod_CodeDisgen", v_CodeProduit, True) ' PBE v_TypeReferenceSerti = xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_TypeProduit" , "") v_PrixUnitaire = xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_PrixUnitaire" , 0) v_Quantite = xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_Quantite" , 0) v_NoLigneParent = xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPR_NOPRODUITPARENT" , "")
If v_TypeReferenceSerti = "80" And v_CleProduit <> "0008138" and v_CleProduit <> "0005588" Then ' *********************** TEMPORAIRE PBE 2019-04-17 v_TypeModification = "3" else v_TypeModification = xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_TypeModification" , "0") End If
v_NbUtilisateurs = xSDSBB_xVarProd(v_CleProduit, "Prod_NbUtilisateursObligatoire", "0", True) ' PBE v_NoFactureFinancement = "" v_NbPaiementRecus = 0
If v_NbUtilisateurs = "1" Then If xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_PasDeNbUtilisateurs", "") <> "1" Then ' Req 47293 v_NbUtilisateurs = xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_NbUtilisateurs" , "0") Else v_NbUtilisateurs = "X" End if
End If
v_TypeProduit = xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_TypeProduit" , "01") v_NbJrsDansPeriode= (pv_DateFin-pv_DateDebut)+1
If Not(v_TypeProduit = "60" Or v_TypeProduit = "70") Then ' Type Crédit v_PrixUnitaire=CalculPrixFacturation(v_PrixUnitaire, v_NbJrsDansPeriode, pv_DateDebut, pv_DateFin, p_datePeriodeFacturation) End If
If v_TypeProduit = "10" Then ' Type Financement
Dim xnextPmnt As Double
v_FinancementMontantPaiement = xVar(me.Nd_CSFi, "CSFi_MontantPaiement" , 0) xnextPmnt = me.BalanceFinancement - v_FinancementMontantPaiement Stop if me.BalanceFinancement < v_FinancementMontantPaiement Then v_PrixUnitaire = me.BalanceFinancement Else If me.BalanceFinancement - v_FinancementMontantPaiement < v_FinancementMontantPaiement Then v_PrixUnitaire = me.BalanceFinancement Else v_PrixUnitaire = v_FinancementMontantPaiement End If End If
v_NbPaiementRecus = xVar(nd_CSFi, "CSFi_NbPaiementsRecus" , 0) + me.CompteurFinancement + 1 v_Commentaire = SDSCSFi_FacturationCommentaire( xVar(me.Nd_CSFi, "CSFi_NoFinancement" , 0) , v_NbPaiementRecus, me.BalanceFinancement - v_PrixUnitaire, me.LangueClient ) v_TypeLigne = xComplTabl( xVar(me.Nd_CSFi, "CSFi_TypeFinancement" , "") , "CSFi_TypeFinancement", "2", True) v_CleProduit = xComplTabl( xVar(me.Nd_CSFi, "CSFi_TypeFinancement" , "") , "CSFi_TypeFinancement", "1", True)
If v_TypeLigne = "9" Then v_NoFactureFinancement = xVar(me.Nd_CSFi, "CSFi_NoFacture" , "") End If
Else v_Commentaire = xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_Commentaire" , "") v_TypeLigne = xComplTabl( v_TypeProduit , "CSPr_TypeProduit", "1", True) End If
v_ListLigne("TypeLigne")= v_TypeLigne v_ListLigne("TypeProduit") = v_TypeProduit v_ListLigne("CodeProduit")= v_CodeDisgen ' PBE v_ListLigne("Quantite")= v_Quantite v_ListLigne("PrixUnitaire")= v_PrixUnitaire v_ListLigne("NoLigne")= v_NoLigne v_ListLigne("NoLigneParent")= v_NoLigneParent v_ListLigne("DateDebut")= pv_DateDebut v_ListLigne("DateFin")= pv_DateFin v_ListLigne("NbJours")= v_NbJrsDansPeriode v_ListLigne("NbUtilisateurs")= v_NbUtilisateurs v_ListLigne("NoBonCommande")= xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_NoBonCommande" , Me.NoProposition) v_ListLigne("ReferenceClient")= xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_ReferenceClient" , Me.NoProposition) v_ListLigne("Commentaire") = v_Commentaire v_ListLigne("TypeModification") = v_TypeModification v_ListLigne("TypeLigneConversion") = xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_TypeLigneConversion" , "") v_ListLigne("NoFactureFinancement") = v_NoFactureFinancement
v_ListLigne("FacturationInitiale") = FacturationInitial(pnd_Produit)
If v_TypeReferenceSerti = "81" Then If Not Me.DateTransfert = "" Then Me.TypeTransfert = "1" End If v_ListLigne("TypeReferenceSerti") = "1" Else v_ListLigne("TypeReferenceSerti") = "0" End If
composeProduit=v_ListLigne
Exit Function GererErreur: Me.Valide=False Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSclFacture, gc_Element_SDSCSclFacture, GetThreadInfo(1), Me.NoContratFmt, False) Exit Function End Function

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Public Function composeProduitGratuit(pnd_Produit As NotesDocument, pv_DateDebut As Variant, pv_DateFin As Variant , p_datePeriodeFacturation As variant ) As Variant '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur Dim v_PrixUnitaire As Double Dim v_NbJrsDansPeriode As Double Dim v_JoursDansMois As Double
Dim v_Quantite As Double Dim v_NbUtilisateurs As String Dim v_TypeLigne As Long Dim v_CleProduit As String ' PBE Dim v_CodeProduit As String Dim v_CodeDisgen As String ' PBE Dim v_NoLigne As String Dim v_NoLigneParent As String Dim v_ListLigne List As Variant
Dim v_PrixUnitaireAjust As Double Dim v_PrixTotal As Double Dim v_Reste As Variant
Dim v_NombreJrs As Long Dim v_NombreMois As Long Dim v_MoisCourant As Variant Dim v_TypeProduit As String Dim v_TypeReferenceSerti As String Dim v_TypeModification As String Dim v_resteapayer As Double Dim v_FinancementMontantPaiement As Double Dim v_NoFactureFinancement As String Dim v_Commentaire As String Dim v_MontantCommande As Double Dim v_NbPaiementRecus As Long
composeProduitGratuit = ""
v_NoLigne = xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_NoProduitSeq" , "") v_CleProduit= xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_CleProduit" , "") ' PBE v_CodeProduit= xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_CodeProduit" , "") v_CodeDisgen= xSDSBB_xVarProd(v_CleProduit, "Prod_CodeDisgen", v_CodeProduit, True) ' PBE v_TypeReferenceSerti = xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_TypeProduit" , "") v_PrixUnitaire = xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_PrixUnitaire" , 0)
v_TypeProduit = "60" v_Quantite = xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_Quantite" , 0)
If v_Quantite > 0 Then v_Quantite = v_Quantite * -1 End If
v_NoLigneParent = xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_NoProduitSeq" , "")
v_TypeModification = "3"
v_NbUtilisateurs = xSDSBB_xVarProd(v_CleProduit, "Prod_NbUtilisateursObligatoire", 0, True) ' PBE v_NoFactureFinancement = "" v_NbPaiementRecus = 0
If v_NbUtilisateurs = "1" Then If xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_PasDeNbUtilisateurs", "") <> "1" Then ' Req 47293 v_NbUtilisateurs = xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_NbUtilisateurs" , "0") Else v_NbUtilisateurs = "X" End If End If
v_NbJrsDansPeriode= (pv_DateFin-pv_DateDebut)+1 v_PrixUnitaire=CalculPrixFacturation(v_PrixUnitaire, v_NbJrsDansPeriode, pv_DateDebut, pv_DateFin, p_datePeriodeFacturation)
v_Commentaire = xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_Commentaire" , "") v_TypeLigne = xComplTabl( v_TypeProduit , "CSPr_TypeProduit", "1", True)
v_ListLigne("TypeLigne")= v_TypeLigne v_ListLigne("TypeProduit") = v_TypeProduit v_ListLigne("CodeProduit")= v_CodeDisgen ' PBE v_ListLigne("Quantite")= v_Quantite v_ListLigne("PrixUnitaire")= v_PrixUnitaire v_ListLigne("NoLigne")= v_NoLigne v_ListLigne("NoLigneParent")= v_NoLigneParent v_ListLigne("DateDebut")= pv_DateDebut v_ListLigne("DateFin")= pv_DateFin v_ListLigne("NbJours")= v_NbJrsDansPeriode v_ListLigne("NbUtilisateurs")= v_NbUtilisateurs v_ListLigne("NoBonCommande")= xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_NoBonCommande" , Me.NoProposition) v_ListLigne("ReferenceClient")= xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_ReferenceClient" , Me.NoProposition) v_ListLigne("Commentaire") = v_Commentaire v_ListLigne("TypeModification") = v_TypeModification v_ListLigne("TypeLigneConversion") = xVar(pnd_Produit, "CSPr_TypeLigneConversion" , "") v_ListLigne("NoFactureFinancement") = v_NoFactureFinancement v_ListLigne("TypeReferenceSerti") = "0" v_ListLigne("FacturationInitiale") = FacturationInitial(pnd_Produit) composeProduitGratuit = v_ListLigne
Exit Function GererErreur: Me.Valide=False Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSclFacture, gc_Element_SDSCSclFacture, GetThreadInfo(1), Me.NoContratFmt, False) Exit Function End Function
'++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Public Function TrieLigneProduits(pl_ListeProduitsOriginalList List As Variant) '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur Dim l_ListeTemporaire List As Variant Dim l_ListeProduitsConversion List As Variant Dim l_ListeEscompte List As Variant Dim l_ListeCredit List As Variant Dim v_dateFacturation As String Dim v_dateFacturationAvant As String Dim v_dateElement As String Dim v_cleAjoutEnfant As String
Call isolerLesPoduits(l_ListeCredit, l_ListeEscompte, pl_ListeProduitsOriginalList)
If Not (me.ModePaiement = "01" And (me.TypeInstallation <> "0" And me.TypeInstallation <> "3")) Then Call isolerLesPoduitsConversion( l_ListeProduitsConversion, pl_ListeProduitsOriginalList) End If
ForAll elem In pl_ListeProduitsOriginalList
v_dateFacturation = Format(elem("DateDebut"),"yyyymmdd")+Format(elem("DateFin"),"yyyymmdd")
If v_dateFacturationAvant <> "" And v_dateFacturationAvant < v_dateFacturation Then
' Ajouter Toute les lignes de conversion de la periode precedente ForAll elemProduitsConversion In l_ListeProduitsConversion v_dateElement = Format(elemProduitsConversion("DateDebut"),"yyyymmdd")+ Format(elemProduitsConversion("DateFin"),"yyyymmdd") If v_dateElement = v_dateFacturationAvant Then l_ListeTemporaire(ListTag(elemProduitsConversion)) = l_ListeProduitsConversion(ListTag(elemProduitsConversion)) v_cleAjoutEnfant = ajoutLigneEnfant(ListTag(elemProduitsConversion), l_ListeCredit, l_ListeTemporaire) Erase l_ListeProduitsConversion (ListTag(elemProduitsConversion))
While v_cleAjoutEnfant <> "" v_cleAjoutEnfant = ajoutLigneEnfant(v_cleAjoutEnfant, l_ListeCredit, l_ListeTemporaire) Wend
End If End ForAll
' inserer Escompte si il y en a un pour cet periode ForAll elemEscompte In l_ListeEscompte If Format(elemEscompte("DateDebut"),"yyyymmdd")+ Format(elemEscompte("DateFin"),"yyyymmdd") = v_dateFacturationAvant Then l_ListeTemporaire(ListTag(elemEscompte)) = l_ListeEscompte(ListTag(elemEscompte)) v_cleAjoutEnfant = ajoutLigneEnfant(ListTag(elemEscompte), l_ListeCredit, l_ListeTemporaire) Erase l_ListeEscompte (ListTag(elemEscompte))
While v_cleAjoutEnfant <> "" v_cleAjoutEnfant = ajoutLigneEnfant(v_cleAjoutEnfant, l_ListeCredit, l_ListeTemporaire) Wend End If End ForAll End If
l_ListeTemporaire(ListTag(elem)) = pl_ListeProduitsOriginalList (ListTag(elem)) v_cleAjoutEnfant = ajoutLigneEnfant(ListTag(elem), l_ListeCredit, l_ListeTemporaire) Erase pl_ListeProduitsOriginalList (ListTag(elem))
While v_cleAjoutEnfant <> "" v_cleAjoutEnfant = ajoutLigneEnfant(v_cleAjoutEnfant, l_ListeCredit, l_ListeTemporaire) Wend
v_dateFacturationAvant = v_dateFacturation
End ForAll
'Le restant des Produits Conversion
ForAll elemProduitsConversion In l_ListeProduitsConversion l_ListeTemporaire(ListTag(elemProduitsConversion)) = l_ListeProduitsConversion(ListTag(elemProduitsConversion)) v_cleAjoutEnfant = ajoutLigneEnfant(ListTag(elemProduitsConversion), l_ListeCredit, l_ListeTemporaire) Erase l_ListeProduitsConversion (ListTag(elemProduitsConversion))
While v_cleAjoutEnfant <> "" v_cleAjoutEnfant = ajoutLigneEnfant(v_cleAjoutEnfant, l_ListeCredit, l_ListeTemporaire) Wend
End ForAll
'Le restant des escomptes ForAll elemEscompte In l_ListeEscompte l_ListeTemporaire(ListTag(elemEscompte)) = l_ListeEscompte(ListTag(elemEscompte)) Erase l_ListeEscompte (ListTag(elemEscompte)) End ForAll
'Le restant des Credits ForAll elemCredit In l_ListeCredit l_ListeTemporaire(ListTag(elemCredit)) = l_ListeCredit(ListTag(elemCredit)) Erase l_ListeCredit(ListTag(elemCredit)) End ForAll
Erase pl_ListeProduitsOriginalList
ForAll elem In l_ListeTemporaire pl_ListeProduitsOriginalList(ListTag(elem)) = l_ListeTemporaire(ListTag(elem)) End ForAll
Erase l_ListeTemporaire
Exit Function GererErreur: Me.Valide=False Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSclFacture, gc_Element_SDSCSclFacture, GetThreadInfo(1), Me.NoContratFmt, False) Exit Function End Function
