Sub SDSCSCo_MAJFacture(pnd_FCSCo As NotesDocument)
On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_TypePeriodeCo As String Dim v_TypePeriodeFa As String Dim v_ModePaiementCo As String Dim v_ModePaiementFa As String Dim nd_CSFa As NotesDocument Dim v_ModePmntDesc As String Dim v_TypePeriodeDesc As String Dim v_NoContrat As String Dim v_NoContratFmt As String Dim v_PPArecu As String Dim v_StatutFacturation As String Dim v_DatePremiereFacturation As Variant Dim ndt_DateJusquAu As NotesDateTime Dim v_EstRenouvellement As Boolean Dim v_StatutFacturationOrig As String Dim v_DateProchaineCommande As Variant Dim v_ClientNoFmtCo As String Dim v_ClientNoFmtFa As String 'Dim v_TypeInstallation As String
Call SDSCSCo_Initialisations
v_EstRenouvellement=False v_NoContrat = xVar(pnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_NoContrat" , "") v_NoContratFmt = xVar(pnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_NoContratFmt" , "") 'v_TypeInstallation = xVar(pnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_TypeInstallation" , "")
Call pnd_FCSCo.Save(True,False)
Set nd_CSFa = SDSCSFa_ndFacturation(pnd_FCSCo)
nd_CSFa.CSFa_NoProposition = xVar(pnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_NoProposition", "") v_DateProchaineCommande = xVar(nd_CSFa, "CSFa_DateProchaineCommande" , Today) v_StatutFacturation = xVar(nd_CSFa, "CSFa_StatutFacturation" , "")
If v_StatutFacturation >= "90" Then Exit Sub End If
v_ClientNoFmtCo = xVar(pnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_ClientNoFmt" , "") v_ClientNoFmtFa = xVar(nd_CSFa, "CSFa_ClientNoFmt" , "")
v_TypePeriodeCo=xVar(pnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_TypePeriode" , "") v_TypePeriodeFa=xVar(nd_CSFa, "CSFa_PeriodeFacturation" , "")
v_ModePaiementCo=xVar(pnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_ModePaiement" , "") v_ModePaiementFa=xVar(nd_CSFa, "CSFa_ModePaiement" , "")
nd_CSFa.CSFa_PeriodeFacturation=v_TypePeriodeCo
v_ModePmntDesc = xDescTabl(v_ModePaiementCo , "CSFa_ModePaiement", True) v_TypePeriodeDesc = xDescTabl(v_TypePeriodeCo , "CSFa_PeriodeFacturation", True)
v_PPArecu = xVar(nd_CSFa,"CSFa_FormulairePPArecu","")
If v_ModePaiementFa <> v_ModePaiementCo Then If v_ModePaiementCo = "02" And v_PPArecu = "" Then nd_CSFa.CSFa_FacturationInactive="1" Else nd_CSFa.CSFa_FacturationInactive="" End If 'Modification Req : 43848 If v_ModePaiementCo = "01" And v_PPArecu <> "" Then nd_CSFa.CSFa_FormulairePPArecu = "" End If End If
nd_CSFa.CSFa_ModePaiement=v_ModePaiementCo nd_CSFa.CSFa_PeriodeFacturationDescFR=v_TypePeriodeDesc nd_CSFa.CSFa_ModePaiementDescFR=v_ModePmntDesc nd_CSFa.CSFa_NoContratFmt = v_NoContratFmt
'Si les dates change il faut recalucler... Call xAssignerDate(nd_CSFa, "CSFa_DateDebut", xVar(pnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_DateDebut" , "") ) Call xAssignerDate(nd_CSFa, "CSFa_DateFin", xVar(pnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_DateFin" , "") )
' Si la date de premiere facture est nulle, initialiser la date facturé jusqu'au v_DatePremiereFacturation = xVar(nd_CSFa, "CSFa_DatePremiereFacture", "")
If v_DatePremiereFacturation = "" Or v_TypePeriodeCo >= "12" Then If xVar(pnd_FCSCo,"CSCo_EstUnRenouvellement","")="1" Then '---Si c'est un renouvellement v_EstRenouvellement=True End If
'If Not (v_TypeInstallation = "1" And v_ModePaiementCo = "01" )Then Set ndt_DateJusquAu = New NotesDateTime(xVar(pnd_FCSCo,"CSCo_DateDebut","")) Call ndt_DateJusquAu.AdjustDay(-1) Call nd_CSFa.ReplaceItemValue("CSFa_DateFactureJusquau", ndt_DateJusquAu) v_DateProchaineCommande=SDSCSFa_ProchaineCommande( xVar(pnd_FCSCo,"CSCo_DateDebut","") , v_ModePaiementCo) 'End If
End If
'Modification Req : 34186
If v_DateProchaineCommande <= Today And v_ModePaiementCo = "01" Then Call xAssignerDate(nd_CSFa, "CSFa_DateProchaineFacture", Today) Call xAssignerDate(nd_CSFa, "CSFa_DateProchaineCommande", Today) Else
Call SDSCSFa_MajDatesProchaine( nd_CSFa , v_EstRenouvellement ) End If
Call nd_CSFa.Save(True, False)
If xVar(pnd_FCSCo, "CSCo_FacturationId", "")="" Then pnd_FCSCo.CSCo_FacturationId = xVar(nd_CSFa,"CSFa_NoUnique","") Call SDSCSCo_EnleverProduitsHtml(pnd_FCSCo) Call pnd_FCSCo.Save(True,False) End If
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSCo, gc_Element_SDSCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub SDSCSCo_ActiverContrats() On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nd_suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim ndc_Erreurs As NotesDocumentCollection
Call SDSCSCo_Initialisations
If gnv_CSCo25_SDSCSCo Is Nothing Then Set gnv_CSCo25_SDSCSCo = gndb_SDSCSCo.getview("V_CSCo25") End If Call gnv_CSCo25_SDSCSCo.Refresh
Set ndc_Erreurs = gnv_CSCo25_SDSCSCo.Getalldocumentsbykey("*BiDoN*", True) Set nd_Suivant = gnv_CSCo25_SDSCSCo.Getfirstdocument
Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = gnv_CSCo25_SDSCSCo.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
If Not SDSCSCo_ValidProduitsActif(nd) Then Call ndc_Erreurs.AddDocument(nd) Else If Not SDSCSCo_ValidProduitsNbUtilisateurs(nd ) Then Call ndc_Erreurs.AddDocument(nd) Else Call SDSCSCo_Activer(nd, True) End If End If Loop
If ndc_Erreurs.count > 0 Then Call SDSCSCo_EnvoyErreurs(ndc_Erreurs) End If
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSCo, gc_Element_SDSCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function SDSCSCo_FacturerManuellement(pnd_CSCo As NotesDocument ) As Boolean On Error GoTo GererErreur On Error 9999 Resume Next
Dim nd_ExecCommande As NotesDocument Dim nd_CSFa As NotesDocument Dim nd_DB As NotesDocument Dim v_NoContratFmt As String Dim v_NoContrat As String Dim v_NoCommande As String Dim v_StatutFacturation As String Dim v_DateFacturerAPartirDe As Variant Dim v_DateFacturerJusqau As Variant Dim v_DateFactureJusquau As Variant Dim v_DateFacturation As Variant Dim v_DateDebutCSCo As Variant Dim v_StatutPrecedentCSCo As String
Dim v_DatePremiereFacture As Variant Dim cl_facture As SDSCS_clFacture Dim cl_Commande As SDSCS_clCommande Dim v_Titre As String Dim v_FactParam(1) As String Dim v_ModePaiement As String Dim v_NoClientFact As String Dim v_datesFacturation As Variant Dim v_PeriodeFacturation As Long
v_Titre = xGDK_xMessage("SI",8 , xLangue, "")
Call SDSCSCo_Initialisations
Set nd_ExecCommande = SDSCSCom_xndExecutionCommande()
If xVar(nd_ExecCommande, "aFact_Execution" , "") = "1" Then MsgBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 137, "" , v_NoCommande),16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Function End If
v_NoClientFact = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_ClientNoFmt" , "") v_NoContrat = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoContrat" , "") v_NoContratFmt = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoContratFmt" , "") v_StatutPrecedentCSCo=xVar(pnd_CSCo,"CSCo_StatutPrecedent","") v_DateDebutCSCo=xVar(pnd_CSCo,"CSCo_DateDebut","") v_PeriodeFacturation = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_TypePeriode", "")
v_FactParam(0)=v_NoContratFmt
SDSCSCo_FacturerManuellement=False
If SDSCSCo_ValidFacturationManuelle(pnd_CSCo, v_Titre) > 0 Then Exit Function End If
Set nd_CSFa = xSDSCS_xndCSFa(v_NoContrat, True) If Not nd_CSFa Is Nothing Then
v_StatutFacturation = xVar(nd_CSFa, "CSFa_StatutFacturation" , "") If v_StatutFacturation = "90" Then MsgBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 43, "" , v_NoCommande),16, v_Titre Exit Function End If
'------ Recueillir la date de facturer jusqu'au ------ v_DateFactureJusquau=xVar(nd_CSFa,"CSFa_DateFactureJusquau","") + 1 v_DatePremiereFacture = xVar(nd_CSFa,"CSFa_DatePremiereFacture","")
v_DateFacturation = SDSCSCo_CalculDateFacturation(xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_ModePaiement", "01"), v_DateFactureJusquau, v_DateDebutCSCo, v_DatePremiereFacture , v_StatutPrecedentCSCo ) Set nd_DB = SDSCSCo_ndFacturationManuelle(pnd_CSCo , nd_CSFa, v_DateFacturation) If nd_DB Is Nothing Then Exit Function End If
v_ModePaiement = xVar(nd_DB, "DBFa_ModePaiement", "") If v_ModePaiement = "01" Then 'Cheque v_DateFacturation = xVar(nd_DB, "DBFa_DateFacture", "") Else ' "02" PPA v_DateFacturation = xVar(nd_DB, "DBFa_DateFacturePPA", "") End If 'Si c'est un CSA facturer a partir du debut du contrat. If v_ModePaiement = "01" And v_PeriodeFacturation = "12" Then v_DateFacturerAPartirDe = v_DateDebutCSCo Else v_DateFacturerAPartirDe = xVar(nd_DB, "DBFa_DateDebut", "") End If v_DateFacturerJusqau = xVar(nd_DB, "DBFa_DateFin", "")
Set cl_Commande = New SDSCS_clCommande(v_NoClientFact) Set cl_facture = New SDSCS_clFacture(nd_CSFa, pnd_CSCo , v_DateFacturerAPartirDe , v_DateFacturerJusqau , True , v_ModePaiement, v_DateFacturation)
If Not cl_facture Is Nothing Then If cl_facture.NbLignes > 0 Then
Call cl_Commande.ajouterFacture(cl_facture)
If SDSCSCom_FacturerContrat(cl_Commande , v_NoCommande) Then 'Mise a jour du document Facturation avec succès Call SDSCSFa_MajTraitementCommande(cl_Commande, v_NoCommande) v_FactParam(1)=v_NoCommande MsgBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 42, "" , v_FactParam),64, v_Titre
If v_ModePaiement = "02" Then v_DateFacturation = xVar(nd_DB, "DBFa_DateFacturePPA", "") End If
Call SIHi_Ajouter(nd_CSFa , "" , "Action : Facturation manuelle " + Chr(13) +xDescTabl(v_ModePaiement, "CSFa_ModePaiement", True) _ + " Pour le " + Cstr(v_DateFacturation) +" du " + CStr(v_DateFactureJusquau) + " au "+ CStr(v_DateFacturerJusqau) , "", True)
SDSCSCo_FacturerManuellement=True Else If v_NoCommande <> "" Then MsgBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 41, "" , v_NoCommande),16, v_Titre Else MsgBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 47, "" , ""),16, v_Titre End If End If Else MsgBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 44, "" , ""),16, v_Titre End If Else MsgBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 44, "" , ""),16, v_Titre End If
Delete cl_Commande
End If 'End nd_CSFa Is Nothing
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSCo, gc_Element_SDSCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSCSCo_ValidRevision( p_NoContrat As String ) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_CSCoRev As NotesDocument Dim nd_CSCoRen As NotesDocument Dim v_StatutContrat As String
SDSCSCo_ValidRevision = False
Call SDSCSCo_Initialisations
Call xnd("CSCo_NoContrat", p_NoContrat, True, gndb_SDSCSCo, "V_CSCo22", gnv_CSCo22_SDSCSCo, nd_CSCoRev) v_StatutContrat = xVar(nd_CSCoRev,"CSCo_StatutContrat","") 'CSCo_StatutContrat ; "05" = En revision , "06" = Transfert en cours , "10" = Soumis
Select Case v_StatutContrat Case "05" : 'CS deja en revision Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 104, "", p_NoContrat) , 16, "Attention" Exit Function
Case "06" : 'CS en statut Soumis Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 105, "", p_NoContrat) , 16, "Attention" Exit Function
Case "10" : 'CS en statut Soumis Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 106, "", p_NoContrat) , 16, "Attention" Exit Function
Case Else : Call xnd("CSCo_NoContratParent", p_NoContrat, True, gndb_SDSCSCo, "V_CSCo26", gnv_CSCo26_SDSCSCo, nd_CSCoRen)
If Not nd_CSCoRen Is Nothing Then If xVar(nd_CSCoRen,"CSCo_NoContrat","") <> p_NoContrat Then 'Valider avec l'usager If Messagebox(xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 34, "", p_NoContrat) + Chr(13) + xGDK_xMessage("SI", 185, "", ""), 36, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 8, "", "")) <> 6 Then Exit Function End If End If Else
End If
End Select
SDSCSCo_ValidRevision = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSCo, gc_Element_SDSCSCo, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSCSCo_ValidationFacturationTermine(pnd_CSFa As NotesDocument, pnd_CSCo As NotesDocument) As Boolean
SDSCSCo_validationFacturationTermine=False
Dim v_NoContratFmt As String Dim ndc_CSPr As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd As NotesDocument
Dim v_Statut As String Dim v_DateFin As Variant Dim v_DateFactureJusquau As Variant Dim v_DateFinContrat As Variant Dim v_StatutFacturation As String Dim v_CSPrCode As String
v_DateFinContrat = xVar(pnd_CSCo,"CSCo_DateFin","") v_NoContratFmt= xVar(pnd_CSCo,"CSCo_NoContratFmt","") v_StatutFacturation = xVar(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_StatutFacturation" , "")
If v_StatutFacturation < "90" Then Exit Function End If
If v_StatutFacturation = "90" Then
Call SDSCSCo_Initialisations
If gnv_CSPr23_SDSCSCo Is Nothing then Set gnv_CSPr23_SDSCSCo = gndb_SDSCSCo.GetView("V_CSPr23") End If Call gnv_CSPr23_SDSCSCo.Refresh Set ndc_CSPr = gnv_CSPr23_SDSCSCo.GetAllDocumentsByKey(v_NoContratFmt, True)
Set nd_Suivant = ndc_CSPr.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc_CSPr.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
v_Statut = xVar(nd,"CSPr_StatutProduit","") v_DateFin = xVar(nd,"CSPR_DATEFIN","") v_CSPrCode = xVar(nd,"CSPr_CodeProduit","")
If v_Statut <> "40" Then ' 40 - Installation reportée v_DateFactureJusquau=xVar(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_DateFactureJusquauLigne" & SDSCSFa_CreerNoChamp(xVar(nd,"CSPr_NoProduitSeq","")),"")
If v_DateFin = "" Then v_DateFin = v_DateFinContrat End If
If v_Statut <= "90" Then If v_DateFactureJusquau = "" Or v_DateFactureJusquau < v_DateFin Then Exit Function End If End If End If Loop End If
SDSCSCo_validationFacturationTermine=True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSclCommande, gc_Element_SDSCSclCommande, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSCSCo_ValidProduitsActif( pnd_CSCo As NotesDocument ) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim v_statut As Boolean Dim v_StatutProduit As String Dim v_ListInactif List As String Dim v_CodeProduit As String Dim i As Integer
Dim v_NoContratFmt As String
v_NoContratFmt = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoContratFmt" , 0) v_StatutProduit = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_ProduitInactif" , "")
Call SDSCSCo_Initialisations
v_statut=True If gnv_CSPr41_SDSCSCo Is Nothing Then Set gnv_CSPr41_SDSCSCo = gndb_SDSCSCo.GetView("V_CSPr41") End If Call gnv_CSPr41_SDSCSCo.Refresh Set ndc = gnv_CSPr41_SDSCSCo.GetAllDocumentsByKey(v_NoContratFmt, True)
If ndc.count >= 1 Then
Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
If Not SDSCSPr_ValiderStatutProduit(nd) Then i=i+1 v_CodeProduit = Trim(xVar(nd, "CSPr_CodeProduit", "")) v_ListInactif(Cstr(i)) = v_CodeProduit End If Loop
v_statut=SDSCSCo_ListeEtVide(v_ListInactif) '************* Ne pas oublier le document Facturation End If
If v_statut=False And v_StatutProduit="" Then pnd_CSCo.CSCo_ProduitInactif = "1" Call SDSCSCo_EnleverProduitsHtml(pnd_CSCo) Call pnd_CSCo.Save(True,False) Else If v_statut=True And v_StatutProduit = "1" Then pnd_CSCo.CSCo_ProduitInactif = "" Call SDSCSCo_EnleverProduitsHtml(pnd_CSCo) Call pnd_CSCo.Save(True,False) End If End If
SDSCSCo_ValidProduitsActif = v_statut Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSCo, gc_Element_SDSCSCo, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Call gnv_CSPr41_SDSCSCo.Refresh Set ndc = gnv_CSPr41_SDSCSCo.GetAllDocumentsByKey(v_NoContratFmt, True)
If ndc.count >= 1 Then
Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant) v_NoLigneContratPrecedent = xVar(nd, "CSPr_NoProduitSeqContratPrec", 0)
If v_NoLigneContratPrecedent = 0 Then
v_DateDebutCSPr = xVar(nd, "CSPr_DateDebut", v_DateDebutCS) v_DateDebutOriginale = xVar(nd, "CSPr_DateDebutOriginale", "")
If v_DateDebutOriginale <> v_DateDebutCSPr Then
Call xAssignerDate(nd , "CSPr_DateDebutOriginale", v_DateDebutCSPr) Call nd.Save(False, False)
End If End If
Loop
End If
SDSCSCo_MettreDateDebutOriginaleProduits = 1 Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSCo, gc_Element_SDSCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSCSCo_AnnulerLaRevision(pnd_CSCo As NotesDocument, p_Commentaire As String) As Boolean On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ndc_CSCoRemplace As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_CSCoRemplace As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd_CSCoRev As NotesDocument Dim v_NoContratFmtRev As String Dim v_NoContratFmt As String Dim v_NoContrat As String Dim v_Formule As String Dim v_NoRevision As String Dim v_RevisionCourante As Double Dim v_Revision As Double Dim v_NoDernRevision As Double Dim v_StatutContrat As String Dim i As Long
SDSCSCo_AnnulerLaRevision = False Call SDSCSCo_Initialisations
v_NoContrat = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoContrat" , "") v_NoContratFmt = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoContratFmt" , "")
If xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_CompteurFacturation", 0) > 0 Then MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 136, "", v_NoContratFmt), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Function End If
'Verification si contrat en Revision Call xnd("CSCo_NoContrat", v_NoContrat, True, gndb_SDSCSCo, "V_CSCo22", gnv_CSCo22_SDSCSCo, nd_CSCoRev) If Not nd_CSCoRev Is Nothing Then MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 33, "", v_NoContratFmt), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Function End If
v_RevisionCourante = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoRevision" , 0) v_Revision = v_RevisionCourante -1
For i = 0 To v_RevisionCourante v_Revision = v_Revision - 1 v_NoRevision = SDSCSCo_CreerNoRevision(v_Revision) v_NoContratFmtRev = v_NoContrat + "-" + v_NoRevision
Set nd_CSCoRemplace = xSDSCS_xndCSCo(v_NoContratFmtRev , True ) If Not( nd_CSCoRemplace Is Nothing ) Then v_StatutContrat = xVar(nd_CSCoRemplace, "CSCo_StatutContrat" , "") If v_StatutContrat = "95" Then v_NoContratFmt = xVar(nd_CSCoRemplace, "CSCo_NoContratFmt" , "") Exit For Else v_Revision = v_Revision - 1 End If End If Next
If Not( nd_CSCoRemplace Is Nothing ) Then
nd_CSCoRemplace.CSCo_DerniereRevision = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_DerniereRevision" , 0)
Call SDSCSCo_AssignerStatutContrat(nd_CSCoRemplace , Nothing, "50", "") Call nd_CSCoRemplace.Save(True,False)
Call SDSCSpr_AnnulerLaRevision( v_NoContratFmt ) Call SDSCSCo_AssignerStatutContrat(pnd_CSCo , Nothing, "99", "") Call SDSCSCo_MAJFacture( nd_CSCoRemplace )
SDSCSCo_AnnulerLaRevision = True End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSCo, gc_Element_SDSCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

%REM Sub FCSCo_ComposeRevision Description: Copy un contrat de service en etat de revision Editable %END REM Function SDSCSCo_CreerRevision(pv_NoRevision As String, pnd_CSCo As NotesDocument) As NotesDocument On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_NoContrat As String Dim v_NoContratFmt As String Dim v_NoContratFmtNouv As String Dim nd_Revision As NotesDocument
Set SDSCSCo_CreerRevision = Nothing Call SDSCSCo_Initialisations
' Verifier si contrat en renouvellement
Set nd_Revision = New NotesDocument(gndb_SDSCSCo) Call pnd_CSCo.CopyAllItems(nd_Revision)
v_NoContrat=xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoContrat", "") v_NoContratFmt=xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoContratFmt", "")
v_NoContratFmtNouv= v_NoContrat + "-" + pv_NoRevision
nd_Revision.CSCo_NoContrat = v_NoContrat nd_Revision.CSCo_NoRevision = pv_NoRevision nd_Revision.CSCo_DerniereRevision = pv_NoRevision
nd_Revision.CSCo_NoContratFmt = v_NoContratFmtNouv nd_Revision.CSCo_NoContratOrig = v_NoContratFmt nd_Revision.CSCo_NoContratParent = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoContratParent", "") nd_Revision.CSCo_NoContrat = v_NoContrat nd_Revision.CSCo_CompteurFacturation = 0
nd_Revision.HistoDC = Now nd_Revision.HistoUC = gns_SDSCSCo.commonusername nd_Revision.HistoDM = "" nd_Revision.HistoUM = ""
nd_Revision.Description=v_NoContratFmtNouv
Call SDSCSCo_AssignerStatutContrat(nd_Revision , Nothing, "05", "")
Call SDSCSPr_CreerRevision( v_NoContratFmt , v_NoContratFmtNouv , "5" , pnd_CSCo, "") Call SDSCSAug_CreerRevision( v_NoContratFmt , v_NoContratFmtNouv , pnd_CSCo )
Set SDSCSCo_CreerRevision = nd_Revision Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSCo, gc_Element_SDSCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSCSCo_ImporterCSSurSite( pnd_CSCo As NotesDocument , pnd_CSA As NotesDocument, p_ReferenceClient As String, p_NoBonCommande As String, l_Produits As Variant ) As Boolean On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ndc_Produits As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim v_NoContratFmt As String Dim v_TypeProduit As String Dim v_StatutProduit As String Dim v_CSPrFin As Variant Dim v_CSPrDebut As Variant Dim v_CSCoFin As Variant Dim v_CSADebut As Variant Dim v_DateDebutCS_Dest As Variant
Call SDSCSCo_Initialisations
Erase gv_ListProduitsNoSeq SDSCSCo_ImporterCSSurSite=False
v_NoContratFmt = xVar(pnd_CSA, "CSCo_NoContratFmt", "") v_CSADebut = xVar(pnd_CSA,"CSCo_DateDebut", "") v_CSCoFin = xVar(pnd_CSCo,"CSCo_DateFin", "") v_DateDebutCS_Dest = xVar(pnd_CSCo,"CSCo_DateDebut", "")
If gnv_CSPr41_SDSCSCo Is Nothing Then Set gnv_CSPr41_SDSCSCo = gndb_SDSCSCo.GetView("V_CSPr41") End If Call gnv_CSPr41_SDSCSCo.Refresh() Set ndc_Produits = gnv_CSPr41_SDSCSCo.GetAllDocumentsByKey(v_NoContratFmt, True) Set nd_Suivant = ndc_Produits.Getfirstdocument
Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc_Produits.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
v_TypeProduit = xVar(nd, "CSPr_TypeProduit", "") v_StatutProduit = xVar(nd, "CSPr_StatutProduit", "") v_CSPrDebut = xVar(nd,"CSPr_DateDebut","") v_CSPrFin = xVar(nd,"CSPr_DateFin", "")
If v_TypeProduit = "01" Or v_TypeProduit = "02" Or v_TypeProduit = "80" Then ' PBE Ajouter les CE If v_StatutProduit < "90" Then If v_CSPrFin = "" Or v_CSPrFin > v_DateDebutCS_Dest Then If SDSCSCo_ImporterProduitSurSite(pnd_CSCo, pnd_CSA, nd, p_ReferenceClient, p_NoBonCommande ) Then l_Produits("ImportesCS")=l_Produits("ImportesCS") + 1 Else l_Produits("IgnoresCS")=l_Produits("IgnoresCS") + 1 End If End If End If End If Loop
SDSCSCo_ImporterCSSurSite = True
pnd_CSCo.CSCo_NoContratPrecedent = v_NoContratFmt Call pnd_CSCo.Save(True,False)
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSCo, gc_Element_SDSCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSCSCo_ValiderServeurSDSHeberge(pnd_CSCo As NotesDocument, p_msgErreurs As String)As Boolean ' Valider serveur Merlin hébergés 35380 On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_NoContrat As String ' No contrat du pnd_CSCo Dim v_NoClient As String Dim nd_SICf As NotesDocument Dim v_NoConfigurationServeur As String Dim nd_Serv As NotesDocument
Dim v_Formule As String Dim ndc_Serv As NotesDocumentCollection Dim ndc_CSPr As NotesDocumentCollection
Dim nd_CSCo As NotesDocument Dim nd_CSPr As NotesDocument Dim nd_CSPrSuivant As NotesDocument Dim v_NoContratCSPr As String Dim v_StatutProduit As String Dim v_NbCSPr As Long
SDSCSCo_ValiderServeurSDSHeberge = False v_NbCSPr = 0
Call SIGE_OuvrirLog(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSCo, gc_Element_SDSCSCo)
v_NoContrat = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoContratFmt", "")
' Si le CS contient le produit "C-SDSWIN" ou "C-SDSBASE" If Not(SDSCSCo_ndProduit(v_NoContrat, "0008697", "") Is Nothing) _ Or Not(SDSCSCo_ndProduit(v_NoContrat, "0008661", "") Is Nothing) Then
' Extraire le document SDS ou Merlin actif du client du CS (SI CONFIGURATIONS) v_NoClient = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_ClientNoFmt", "") Set nd_SICf = xSICf_xndSDS(v_NoClient, True) ' Si le document n'existe pas If nd_SICf Is Nothing Then ' La configuration SDS du client & est inexistante. Opération annulée. p_msgErreurs = xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 97, "", v_NoClient & " (" & xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_ClientNomInterne", "") & ")") If gns_SDSCSCo.IsOnServer = False Then MessageBox p_msgErreurs, 48, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") End If Exit Function Else ' Extraire le document du serveur déclaré sur le document SDS v_NoConfigurationServeur = xVar(nd_SICf, "SDS_NoConfigurationServeur", "") Set nd_Serv = xSICf_xndServ(v_NoConfigurationServeur, False) ' doc Serveur dans SI_Configuration ' Si le document n'existe pas If xVar(nd_Serv, "Conf_Inactif", "") = "1" Then ' La configuration du serveur SDS ou Merlin du client & est inexistante. Opération annulée. p_msgErreurs = xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 99, "", v_NoClient & " (" & xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_ClientNomInterne", "") & ")") If gns_SDSCSCo.IsOnServer = False Then MessageBox p_msgErreurs, 48, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") End If Exit Function Else ' Si le CS ne contient pas le produit "C-SDSMSERV" If SDSCSCo_ndProduit(v_NoContrat, "0008816", "") Is Nothing Then
' Compter le nombre de serveurs hébergés du client If gnv_Serv40_SDSCSCo Is Nothing Then Set gnv_Serv40_SDSCSCo = gndb_xSICf.GetView("V_Serv40") Call gnv_Serv40_SDSCSCo.Refresh End If Set ndc_Serv = gnv_Serv40_SDSCSCo.GetAllDocumentsByKey(StrLeft(v_NoClient, "-") & ";SDS", True)
' Si le client a des serveurs hébergés If ndc_Serv.Count > 0 Then
' Compter le nombre de licences If gnv_CSPr40_SDSCSCo Is Nothing Then Set gnv_CSPr40_SDSCSCo = gndb_SDSCSCo.GetView("V_CSPr40") Call gnv_CSPr40_SDSCSCo.Refresh End If Set ndc_CSPr = gnv_CSPr40_SDSCSCo.GetAllDocumentsByKey(StrLeft(v_NoClient, "-") & ";0008816", True)
Set nd_CSPrSuivant = ndc_CSPr.Getfirstdocument
Do Until nd_CSPrSuivant Is Nothing v_StatutProduit = "" Set nd_CSPr = nd_CSPrSuivant Set nd_CSPrSuivant = ndc_CSPr.Getnextdocument(nd_CSPrSuivant) v_StatutProduit = xVar(nd_CSPr,"CSPr_StatutProduit","") If v_StatutProduit = "50" Then v_NbCSPr = v_NbCSPr + 1 Call SIGE_AjouterLog("SDSWIN client " & xVar(nd_CSPr,"CSPr_ClientNoFmt","") & " contrat " & xVar(nd_CSPr,"CSPr_NoContratFmt",""), 0, False, False) Else
v_NoContratCSPr = xVar(nd_CSPr,"CSPr_NoContratFmt","")
Set nd_CSCo = xSDSCS_xndCSCo(v_NoContratCSPr , True )
If Not nd_CSCo Is Nothing Then If xVar(nd_CSCo,"CSCO_NOCONTRATPARENT","") = "" Then v_NbCSPr = v_NbCSPr + 1 Call SIGE_AjouterLog("SDSWIN client " & xVar(nd_CSPr,"CSPr_ClientNoFmt","") & " contrat " & xVar(nd_CSPr,"CSPr_NoContratFmt",""), 0, False, False) End If End If
End If Loop
'If ndc_CSPr.Count < ndc_Serv.Count Then If v_NbCSPr < ndc_Serv.Count Then ' 98 - Il n'est pas permis de soumettre ce CS car il y a plus de serveurs hébergés que de licences pour ce groupe (&). p_msgErreurs = xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 98, "", "SDS") If gns_SDSCSCo.IsOnServer = False Then MessageBox p_msgErreurs, 48, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") End If
Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Nb contrats = " & CStr(v_NbCSPr), 0, False, False) Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Nb serveurs = " & CStr(ndc_Serv.Count), 0, False, False) Call SIGE_EnregistrerLog Exit Function End If End If End If End If End If End If
SDSCSCo_ValiderServeurSDSHeberge = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSCo, gc_Element_SDSCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSCSCo_ValidProduitsNbUtilisateurs( pnd_CSCo As NotesDocument ) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim v_statut As Boolean Dim v_StatutProduit As String Dim v_ListProduits List As String Dim v_CodeProduit As String Dim i As Integer Dim v_NoContratFmt As String
v_NoContratFmt = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoContratFmt" , "") v_StatutProduit = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_ProduitInactif" , "")
Call SDSCSCo_Initialisations
v_statut = True If gnv_CSPr41_SDSCSCo Is Nothing Then Set gnv_CSPr41_SDSCSCo = gndb_SDSCSCo.GetView("V_CSPr41") End If Call gnv_CSPr41_SDSCSCo.Refresh Set ndc = gnv_CSPr41_SDSCSCo.GetAllDocumentsByKey(v_NoContratFmt, True)
If ndc.count >= 1 Then
Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
If SDSCSPr_ValiderNbUtilisateursObligatoire(nd) Then 'Si le nombre d'usager est obligatoire If xVar(nd, "CSPr_PasDeNbUtilisateurs", "") <> "1" Then ' Req 47293 If xVar(nd, "CSPr_NbUtilisateurs" , 0) = 0 Then ' ne peut pas etre 0 i = i + 1 v_CodeProduit = Trim(xVar(nd, "CSPr_CodeProduit", "")) v_ListProduits(Cstr(i)) = v_CodeProduit End If End If End If Loop
v_statut = SDSCSCo_ListeEtVide(v_ListProduits)
End If
SDSCSCo_ValidProduitsNbUtilisateurs = v_statut Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSCo, gc_Element_SDSCSCo, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub SDSCSCo_CrediterCompagnieTierce( pnd_CSCo As NotesDocument )

Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_TC As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim i As Integer Dim v_NoContratFmt As String Dim v_dateFinProduit As Variant Dim v_TypeModification As String
If xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_TypePeriode" , "") = "12" Then
v_NoContratFmt = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoContratFmt" , "")
Call SDSCSCo_Initialisations
If gnv_CSPr41_SDSCSCo Is Nothing Then Set gnv_CSPr41_SDSCSCo = gndb_SDSCSCo.GetView("V_CSPr41") End If Call gnv_CSPr41_SDSCSCo.Refresh Set ndc = gnv_CSPr41_SDSCSCo.GetAllDocumentsByKey(v_NoContratFmt, True)
If ndc.count >= 1 Then
Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
'Si c'est un credit... If xVar(nd, "CSPr_TypeProduit" , "") = "60" Then Set nd_TC = SDSCSPr_xNdProduitTierce( nd ) If Not nd_TC Is Nothing Then Call SDSCSMsgF_creerMessage(nd, xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 135, "", "")) v_TypeModification = xSDSCS_xVarProf("Prof_TypeModifTierce" , "") If v_TypeModification <> "" Then nd.CSPr_TypeModification = v_TypeModification Call nd.Save(True, False) End If End If End If Loop End If
End If Exit Sub

%REM Function SICS_StatutContrat Description: Etablir le statut de contrat %END REM
Function SDSCSCo_AssignerStatutContrat(pnd_CSCo As NotesDocument, pnuid_CSCo As NotesUIDocument, pv_StatutNouveau As String, p_commentaire As String)As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_StatutContrat As String Dim v_nomTableStatut As String Dim v_StatutIcone As Integer Dim v_StatutDesc As String Dim v_NoContratFmt As String Dim v_NoContrat As String
SDSCSCo_AssignerStatutContrat=False Call SDSCSCo_Initialisations
v_nomTableStatut="CSCo_StatutContrat" v_NoContratFmt=xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoContratFmt", "") v_StatutContrat = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_StatutContrat" , "")
If pv_StatutNouveau <> v_StatutContrat Then v_StatutDesc = xDescTabl(pv_StatutNouveau, v_nomTableStatut, True) v_StatutIcone = xIcnTabl(pv_StatutNouveau, v_nomTableStatut, True)
If v_StatutContrat < "10" Then pnd_CSCo.CSCo_StatutPrecedent = v_StatutContrat End If
If pv_StatutNouveau = "50" Then Call xAssignerDate(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_DateEnVigueur", Now ) End If
pnd_CSCo.CSCo_StatutContrat = pv_StatutNouveau pnd_CSCo.CSCo_StatutDescFR = v_StatutDesc pnd_CSCo.CSCo_StatutIcone = v_StatutIcone pnd_CSCo.CSCo_StatutDate = Now
Call SIHi_Ajouter(pnd_CSCo , pv_StatutNouveau + " - " + v_StatutDesc , p_commentaire + " "+v_NoContratFmt , "", True)
If pv_StatutNouveau < "10" Then Call SDSCSpr_ProduitsMAJ( v_NoContratFmt, "00" ) Elseif pv_StatutNouveau > "10" Then Call SDSCSpr_ProduitsMAJ( v_NoContratFmt, pv_StatutNouveau ) End If
SDSCSCo_AssignerStatutContrat=True End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSCo, gc_Element_SDSCSCo, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSCSCo_ValidFinancement( pnd_CSCo As NotesDocument ) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim ndc_CSFi As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_CSFi As NotesDocument Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd_CSFiSuivant As NotesDocument Dim v_statut As Boolean Dim v_NoFacture As String Dim v_ListProduits List As String Dim v_CodeProduit As String Dim i As Integer Dim v_NoContratFmt As String
v_NoContratFmt = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoContratFmt" , "")
Call SDSCSCo_Initialisations
v_statut = True If gnv_CSPr41_SDSCSCo Is Nothing Then Set gnv_CSPr41_SDSCSCo = gndb_SDSCSCo.GetView("V_CSPr41") End If Call gnv_CSPr41_SDSCSCo.Refresh
If gnv_CSFi23_SDSCSCo Is Nothing Then Set gnv_CSFi23_SDSCSCo = gndb_SDSCSCo.GetView("V_CSFi23") End If Call gnv_CSFi23_SDSCSCo.Refresh
Set ndc = gnv_CSPr41_SDSCSCo.GetAllDocumentsByKey(v_NoContratFmt, True)
If ndc.count >= 1 Then
Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
If xVar(nd, "CSPr_TypeProduit" , "") = "10" Then
v_NoFacture = xVar(nd, "CSPr_NoBonCommande" , "") Set ndc_CSFi = gnv_CSFi23_SDSCSCo.GetAllDocumentsByKey(v_NoFacture, True)
If ndc_CSFi.count > 0 Then
Set nd_CSFiSuivant = ndc_CSFi.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_CSFiSuivant Is Nothing Set nd_CSFi = nd_CSFiSuivant Set nd_CSFiSuivant = ndc_CSFi.Getnextdocument(nd_CSFiSuivant)
If xVar(nd_CSFi, "CSFi_StatutFinancement" , "") <> "99" Then If xVar(nd_CSFi, "CSFi_NoFinancement" , "") <> xVar(nd, "CSPr_NoFinancement" , "") Then i = i + 1 v_CodeProduit = Trim(xVar(nd, "CSPr_CodeProduit", "")) v_ListProduits(CStr(i)) = v_CodeProduit End If End If
Loop End If End If Loop
v_statut = SDSCSCo_ListeEtVide(v_ListProduits)
End If
SDSCSCo_ValidFinancement = v_statut Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSCo, gc_Element_SDSCSCo, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub SDSCSCo_RenouvellementRapel( ) On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_CSFa As NotesDocument Dim nd_Renouvellement As NotesDocument Dim ndc_Renouvellement As NotesDocumentCollection Dim ndc_Rappel As NotesDocumentCollection
Dim v_DateEcheance As Variant Dim v_JrsRappel As Long
Dim v_NoContrat As String Dim v_ModePaiement As String Dim v_ProchaineFacture As Variant Dim v_ProchaineCommande As Variant Dim v_DateAvertissement As Variant
Dim ndt_DateEcheance As New NotesDateTime("") Dim v_DelaisFacturation As Long Dim v_JourDeLaSemaine As Integer Dim v_JourDeLaSemaineRappel As Integer Dim v_TypePeriode As String
Call SDSCSCo_Initialisations
'v_JourDeLaSemaineRappel=xSDSCS_xVarProf("Prof_JourRenouvellement" , 2)
If gnv_CSCo29_SDSCSCo Is Nothing Then Set gnv_CSCo29_SDSCSCo = gndb_SDSCSCo.GetView("V_CSCo29") End If Call gnv_CSCo29_SDSCSCo.Refresh
Set ndc_Rappel = gnv_CSCo29_SDSCSCo.Getalldocumentsbykey("*BiDoN*", True)
Set nd_Suivant = gnv_CSCo29_SDSCSCo.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = gnv_CSCo29_SDSCSCo.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
v_NoContrat = xVar(nd, "CSCo_NoContrat" , "") v_DateEcheance = xVar(nd, "CSCo_DateFin" , "")
'-- requetes 33622 ndt_DateEcheance.LocalTime = Datenumber(Year(v_DateEcheance), Month(v_DateEcheance), 1)
Set nd_CSFa = xSDSCS_xndCSFa(v_NoContrat, True) If Not nd_CSFa Is Nothing Then v_ProchaineFacture = xVar(nd_CSFa, "CSFa_DateProchaineFacture" , "") v_ModePaiement = xVar(nd_CSFa, "CSFa_ModePaiement", "00") ' 01 = Autre, 02 = PPA v_TypePeriode = xVar(nd, "CSCo_TypePeriode", "")
'-- requetes 38947 v_JrsRappel=xComplTabl(v_TypePeriode, "CSFa_PeriodeFacturation", "3", True)
'-- requetes 33622 If v_ModePaiement = "02" Then v_DelaisFacturation=xComplTabl(v_ModePaiement, "CSFa_ModePaiement", "1", True) Call ndt_DateEcheance.AdjustDay(-v_DelaisFacturation) End If
v_DateEcheance=ndt_DateEcheance.lsLocalTime v_DateAvertissement = v_DateEcheance - v_JrsRappel
If v_DateAvertissement <= Today Then 'Voir si Renouvellement exist dejas, sinon avertir If xVar(nd, "CSCo_NoRenouvellement" , "") = "" Then v_JourDeLaSemaine = Weekday(Today) v_JourDeLaSemaineRappel=xSDSCS_xVarProf("Prof_JourRapelRenou" , 2)
If v_TypePeriode<>"12" Then Call ndc_Rappel.AddDocument(nd) Else If v_JourDeLaSemaine = v_JourDeLaSemaineRappel Then Call ndc_Rappel.AddDocument(nd) End If End If End If End If End If '-- nd_CSFa Is Nothing Loop
If ndc_Rappel.count > 0 Then Call ndc_Rappel.StampAll( "CSCo_aRenouveler" , 1 )'Mettre dans la vue a renouveller V_CSCo08 Call SDSCSCo_EnvoieRappel(ndc_Rappel , "A_Rap") End If Exit Sub GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSCo, gc_Element_SDSCSCo, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function SDSCSCo_ListeEtVide( pv_list As Variant ) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur

' ------------------------------------------------------------------- Function SDSCSCo_CalculProrata( pnd_CSCo As NotesDocument ) As Double ' -------------------------------------------------------------------
Dim v_DateDebutContrat As Variant Dim v_DateFinContrat As Variant Dim v_DateFinAnnee As Variant Dim v_DateDebut As Variant Dim v_PeriodeFacturationDebut As Variant Dim v_PeriodeFacturationFin As Variant Dim v_JoursFactureDansPeriode As Long Dim v_Date As Variant Dim v_NoContrat As String Dim v_Montant As Double Dim v_TotalServices As Double Dim ndt_Date As New NotesDateTime("") Dim v As Variant Dim v_JoursDansPeriode As Double
On Error Goto GererErreur
Call SDSCSPr_Initialisations
v_Montant=0
If Not (pnd_CSCo Is Nothing) Then ' Si document est pas null calcul le prorata
v_NoContrat=xVar(pnd_CSCo,"CSCo_NoContrat","") v_DateDebutContrat = xVar(pnd_CSCo,"CSCo_DateDebut","") v_DateFinContrat = xVar(pnd_CSCo,"CSCo_DateFin","")
v = Evaluate(|@Sum(@DbLookup("":"NoCache";""; "V_CSPr33" ;CSCo_NoContratFmt ; 3))|,pnd_CSCo) v_TotalServices = v(0)
Call ndt_Date.SetAnyTime ndt_Date.LsLocalTime = Datenumber(Year(v_DateDebutContrat), Month(v_DateDebutContrat), Day(v_DateDebutContrat)) v_Date = ndt_Date.LsLocalTime v_JoursDansPeriode = SDSCSPr_JoursDansAnnee(v_Date)
Call ndt_Date.AdjustYear(1) Call ndt_Date.AdjustDay(-1) v_DateFinAnnee = ndt_Date.LsLocalTime
If v_DateFinContrat = v_DateFinAnnee Then SDSCSCo_CalculProrata=v_TotalServices Else
ndt_Date.LsLocalTime = Datenumber(Year(v_DateDebutContrat), Month(v_DateDebutContrat), 1)
Do
v_PeriodeFacturationDebut = ndt_Date.LsLocalTime
Call ndt_Date.SetAnyTime Call ndt_Date.AdjustMonth(1) Call ndt_Date.AdjustDay(-1)
v_PeriodeFacturationFin=ndt_Date.LsLocalTime v_JoursFactureDansPeriode=v_PeriodeFacturationFin-v_Date+1 v_Montant = v_Montant + SItN_Round((v_TotalServices/v_JoursDansPeriode) * v_JoursFactureDansPeriode,2)
Call ndt_Date.AdjustMonth(1) v_DateDebut= ndt_Date.LsLocalTime ndt_Date.LsLocalTime = Datenumber(Year(v_DateDebut), Month(v_DateDebut), 1) v_Date = ndt_Date.LsLocalTime
Loop Until v_PeriodeFacturationFin >= v_DateFinContrat
SDSCSCo_CalculProrata=v_Montant End If
End If
Exit Function GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSCo, gc_Element_SDSCSCo, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

%REM Description: Copy un contrat de service en etat de Transfert en court... %END REM Function SDSCSCo_Transfert( pnd_CSCo As NotesDocument , pnd_Tran As NotesDocument ) As Boolean
On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_NoContrat As String Dim v_NoContratFmt As String Dim v_NoContratFmtTran As String Dim v_DateTran As String Dim v_NoContratSeq As String Dim ndt As NotesDateTime Dim v_ActionContrat As String Dim nd_Tran As NotesDocument Dim v_CSCo_ClientNo1 As String Dim v_CSCo_ClientNo2 As String Dim v_NoRevision As String Dim v_RevisionCourante As Double Dim v_NoEnRevision As Double Dim v_NoDernRevision As Double Dim ndt_Tran As NotesDateTime Dim v_AnneeTran As String Dim nd_Clie As NotesDocument Dim v_ClientNoFmt As String
Call SDSCSCo_Initialisations SDSCSCo_Transfert = False
v_ActionContrat="00" v_NoRevision = "000"
v_NoContratFmt = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoContratFmt" , 0) v_NoContrat = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoContrat" , "")
Set ndt_Tran = New NotesDateTime(xVar(pnd_Tran,"CSTran_DateTran", Today)) v_DateTran = ndt_Tran.LSLocalTime v_AnneeTran = ndt_Tran.dateonly
v_NoContratSeq = SDSCSCo_CreerNoContrat(v_AnneeTran) v_NoContratFmtTran = v_NoContratSeq + "-" + v_NoRevision
v_CSCo_ClientNo1 = xVar(pnd_Tran,"CSCo_ClientNo1","") v_CSCo_ClientNo2 = xVar(pnd_Tran,"CSCo_ClientNo2","") v_ClientNoFmt = v_CSCo_ClientNo1 + "-" + v_CSCo_ClientNo2 Set nd_Clie = xSICl_xndClie(v_ClientNoFmt, True)
If nd_Clie Is Nothing Then MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 78, "", v_ClientNoFmt), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Function End If
Call pnd_CSCo.CopyAllItems(pnd_Tran )
Call xAssignerDate(pnd_Tran, "CSCo_DateDebut", ndt_Tran.LSLocalTime) 'pnd_Tran.CSCo_DateDebut = ndt_Tran.LSLocalTime Call xAssignerDate(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_DateFin", ndt_Tran.LSLocalTime) 'pnd_CSCo.CSCo_DateFin = ndt_Tran.LSLocalTime pnd_CSCo.CSCo_NePasRenouveler = "1" Call SDSCSCo_EnleverProduitsHtml(pnd_CSCo) Call pnd_CSCo.Save(True, False) Call SDSCSCo_MAJFacture(pnd_CSCo)
pnd_Tran.form="F_CSCo" pnd_Tran.CSCo_ClientNo1 = v_CSCo_ClientNo1 pnd_Tran.CSCo_ClientNo2 = v_CSCo_ClientNo2 pnd_Tran.CSCo_ClientNom1 = xVar(nd_Clie,"Clie_ClientNom1","") pnd_Tran.CSCo_ClientNom2 = xVar(nd_Clie,"Clie_ClientNom2","")
pnd_CSCo.CSCo_ClientFactNo1 = v_CSCo_ClientNo1 pnd_CSCo.CSCo_ClientFactNo2 = v_CSCo_ClientNo2 pnd_CSCo.CSCo_ClientFactNoFmt = v_ClientNoFmt pnd_CSCo.CSCo_ClientFactNomInterne= xVar(nd_Clie,"Clie_ClientNomInterne","") pnd_CSCo.CSCo_BannieresDesc = xVar(nd_Clie,"SDS_BANNIERESDESC","") pnd_CSCo.CSCo_ClientFact = "" pnd_CSCo.CSCo_ClientFactNom1 = xVar(nd_Clie,"Clie_ClientNom1","") pnd_CSCo.CSCo_ClientFactNom2 = xVar(nd_Clie,"Clie_ClientNom2","")
pnd_CSCo.CSCo_NoContratTran = v_NoContratFmtTran Call SDSCSCo_EnleverProduitsHtml(pnd_CSCo) Call pnd_CSCo.Save(True, True)
pnd_Tran.CSCo_NoContrat = v_NoContratSeq pnd_Tran.CSCo_NoRevision = v_NoRevision pnd_Tran.CSCo_DerniereRevision = "" pnd_Tran.CSCo_NoContratFmt = v_NoContratFmtTran pnd_Tran.CSCo_NoContratInit = v_NoContratFmtTran pnd_Tran.CSCo_NoContratOrig = xVar(pnd_CSCo,"CSCo_NoContratFmt","") pnd_Tran.CSCo_NoContratPrecedent = xVar(pnd_CSCo,"CSCo_NoContratFmt","") pnd_Tran.CSCo_NoContratParent = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoContrat" , "") pnd_Tran.Description = v_NoContratFmtTran Call SDSCSCo_AssignerStatutContrat(pnd_Tran , Nothing, "06" , "")
Call SDSCSPr_CreerRevision( v_NoContratFmt , v_NoContratFmtTran , "6", pnd_Tran, "") Call SDSCSAug_CreerRevision( v_NoContratFmt , v_NoContratFmtTran , pnd_Tran )
Call SIHi_EffacerHistorique(pnd_Tran) SDSCSCo_Transfert = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSCo, gc_Element_SDSCSCo, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIAi_SelectionnerAide(Byval p_Categorie As String) As String '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet de sélectionner l'Aide à effectuer. '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd As Notesdocument Dim v_SIAi As Variant
SIAi_SelectionnerAide = ""
' Si aucune catégorie n'est spécifiée, sélectionner une Aide parmis toutes les catégorie ' --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- If p_Categorie = "" Then If gnv_SIAi1_SIAi Is Nothing Then Set gnv_SIAi1_SIAi = gndb_SIAi.Getview("V_SIAi20") End If
Set nd = gnv_SIAi1_SIAi.Getfirstdocument If nd Is Nothing Then Messagebox "Il n'y a aucune aide disponible.", 16, "Aide" Exit Function End If

' Si une catégorie est spécifiée, sélectionner une Aide de la catégorie ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Else If gnv_SIAi2_SIAi Is Nothing Then Set gnv_SIAi2_SIAi = gndb_SIAi.Getview("V_SIAi2") End If
Set nd = gnv_SIAi2_SIAi.Getdocumentbykey(p_Categorie) If nd Is Nothing Then Messagebox "Il n'y a aucune aide disponible dans la catégorie " & p_Categorie & ".", 16, "Aide" Exit Function End If
' Sélection de l'Aide v_SIAi = gnuiws_SIAi.Pickliststrings(PICKLIST_CUSTOM, False, gndb_SIAi.Server, gndb_SIAi.Filepath, "V_SIAi2", "Aide de documents", _ "Choisissez la page d'aide que vous voulez consulter.", 3, p_Categorie) End If
If Isarray(v_SIAi) Then SIAi_SelectionnerAide = v_SIAi(Lbound(v_SIAi)) End If Exit Function

Option Public Option Explicit Use "SI_Extractions" ' ' Cette bibliothèque de script permet d'extraire un document ou un item d'un document. Les documents ' à extraire se trouvent dans la base de documents courante. ' ' Instructions ' 1. Renommer le script library. Le nouveau nom devrait être x_SIAi ou SIAi est le type de document. ' 2. Inscrire le nom de l'item qui contient la clé et le nom de la vue de recherche dans la section (Declarations). ' 3. Remplacer toutes les occurences de SIAi par l'identifiant du type de document. Les subs seront ' automatiquement renommés.

' Section 1 - Paramètres de la session - Définis dans le sub Initialisation_xSIAi Dim gns_xSIAi As Notessession Dim gndb_xSIAi As Notesdatabase
' Section 2 - Définition des valeurs conservées dans la cache Dim gnv_xSIAi As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_xSIAi As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées
' Section 3 - Les constantes à définir Const gc_NomItemCle_xSIAi = "SIAi_Nom" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVue_xSIAi = "V_SIAi20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche

Function xndSIAi(Byval p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Notesdocument ' Cette fonction retourne un document du type approprié.
' Initialisation des variables globales Call Initialisation_xSIAi
' Si nécéssaire, extraire le document qui contient la variable recherchée. Call xnd(gc_NomItemCle_xSIAi, p_Cle, p_Cache, gndb_xSIAi, gc_NomVue_xSIAi, gnv_xSIAi, gnd_xSIAi)
' Retourne le document défini en variable globale Set xndSIAi = gnd_xSIAi End Function

Function xVarSIAi(Byval p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_ValeurNulle As Variant, _ Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Variant ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une variable d'un document.
Dim nd As NotesDocument
' Extraire la variable recherchée du document retourné par la fonction xnd) Set nd = xndSIAi(p_Cle, p_Cache) xVarSIAi = xVar(nd, p_NomVar, p_ValeurNulle) End Function

Option Public Option Declare
Use "SI_GestionErreurs" Use "SDSCS_clFacture"

' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_SDSCSclCommande = "SL" Const gc_Element_SDSCSclCommande = "SDSCS_clCommande"
Class SDSCS_clCommande
Public NoClient As String Public DateCommande As Variant Public NbFactures As Long Public Facture List As Variant Public NoClientLivraison As String Public NoClientFacturation As String Public PeriodeFacturation As string Public ModePaiement As String Public DateFacturation As Variant Public Devise As string Public Langue As string Public NoProposition As String Public Indicateur As String Public TypeTransfert As String Public DateTransfert As Variant Public TypeContratService As String
Public Sub New( p_noClient As string )
me.NoClient=p_noClient me.DateCommande = Today me.NbFactures=0 me.NoClientLivraison = "" me.NoClientFacturation = "" me.Indicateur = "" me.ModePaiement="" me.DateFacturation ="" me.DateTransfert ="" me.NoProposition= "" me.PeriodeFacturation = "" me.TypeTransfert = "" me.TypeContratService =""
End Sub
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Public Function ajouterFacture(pObj_Facture As SDSCS_clFacture) As Boolean '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur Dim positionNoProposition As Integer
If me.NbFactures=0 Then me.NoClientLivraison = pObj_Facture.NoClientLivraison me.NoClientFacturation=pObj_Facture.NoClientFacturation me.PeriodeFacturation=pObj_Facture.PeriodeFacturation me.ModePaiement=pObj_Facture.ModePaiement me.PeriodeFacturation = pObj_Facture.PeriodeFacturationStr me.TypeContratService = pObj_Facture.TypeInstallation
If me.PeriodeFacturation=12 Then me.DateFacturation = Today Else If me.ModePaiement = "01" Then me.DateFacturation = pObj_Facture.DateFacturation Else If me.DateFacturation = "" Then If pObj_Facture.DateProchaineFacture > pObj_Facture.DateFacturation Then me.DateFacturation = pObj_Facture.DateProchaineFacture 'Req : 60106 Else me.DateFacturation = pObj_Facture.DateFacturation End If End If
End If End If
me.Devise = pObj_Facture.Devise me.Langue = pObj_Facture.Langue me.NoProposition=pObj_Facture.NoProposition End If
If pObj_Facture.Indicateur <> "" Then me.Indicateur = pObj_Facture.Indicateur End If
If me.TypeTransfert <> "1" Then If pObj_Facture.TypeTransfert = "1" Then me.TypeTransfert = pObj_Facture.TypeTransfert me.DateTransfert = pObj_Facture.DateTransfert End If End If
me.NbFactures=me.NbFactures+1 Set Me.Facture(pObj_Facture.NoContrat)=pObj_Facture
If InStr(pObj_Facture.NoProposition, me.NoProposition ) = 0 Then me.NoProposition= NoProposition+ " ," +pObj_Facture.NoProposition End If
ajouterFacture = True
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSclCommande, gc_Element_SDSCSclCommande, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function
End Class
Option Public Option Explicit Use "SI_GestionErreurs" ' ' Les fonctions définies dans cette bibliothèque permettent de manipuler des nombres (integer, long et double).

Dim g_Randomize_SItN As Boolean
' Traitement des erreurs ' ----------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_SItN = "SL" Const gc_Element_SItN = "SI_tNombre"

Function SItN_cdbl(Byval p_Nombre As String) As Double On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Nombre As String Dim v_Separateur As Integer Dim i As Integer Dim v_Gauche As String Dim v_Droite As String Dim p As Long
SItN_cdbl = 0 v_Nombre = Replace(Fulltrim(p_Nombre), " ", "") If v_Nombre = "" Then Exit Function End If
v_Separateur = Instr(v_Nombre, ".") If v_Separateur > 0 Then i = Instr(v_Nombre, ",") If i > 0 Then v_Nombre = Replace(v_Nombre, ",", "") v_Separateur = Instr(v_Nombre, ".") End If Else v_Separateur = Instr(v_Nombre, ",") End If
If v_Separateur > 0 Then v_Gauche = Left(v_Nombre, v_Separateur - 1) v_Droite = Left(Right(v_Nombre, Len(v_Nombre) - v_Separateur), 8) ' Maximum 8 décimales If v_Gauche = "" Then v_Gauche = "0" Elseif v_Gauche = "-" Then v_Gauche = "-0" End If If v_Droite = "" Then SItN_cdbl = Cdbl(v_Gauche) Else v_Nombre = v_Gauche & v_Droite p = 10 ^ Len(v_Droite) SItN_cdbl = Cdbl(v_Nombre) / p End If Else SItN_cdbl = Cdbl(v_Nombre) End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SItN, gc_Element_SItN, Getthreadinfo(1), Cstr(p_Nombre), False) Exit Function End Function

Function SItN_NombreEnLettresFR(p_Nombre As Long) As String On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_NombreEnChiffres As String Dim v_NombreEnLettres As String Dim v_TrancheNum As Integer Dim v_TrancheEnLettres As String Dim v_Centaines As Integer Dim v_Dizaines As Integer Dim v_Unites As Integer Dim v_DizainesEnLettres As String Dim v_CentainesEnLettres As String Dim t As Integer
Dim a_Tranches As Variant Dim a_Chiffres As Variant Dim a_Dizaines As Variant a_Tranches = Evaluate(|"" : "mille" : "million" : "milliard" : "billion" : "mille billions" : "trillion" : "mille trillions" : "quatrillion" : "mille quatrillions"|) a_Chiffres = Evaluate(|"zéro" : "un" : "deux" : "trois" : "quatre" : "cinq" : "six" : "sept" : "huit" : "neuf" : "dix" : "onze" : "douze" : "treize" : "quatorze" : "quinze" : "seize" : "dix-sept" : "dix-huit" : "dix-neuf"|) a_Dizaines = Evaluate(|"" : "" : "vingt" : "trente" : "quarante" : "cinquante" : "soixante" : "soixante" : "quatre-vingt" : "quatre-vingt"|)
' Si le nombre est inférieur à 20, pas de traitement --> retourner la valeur de la table des chiffres If p_Nombre < 20 Then SItN_NombreEnLettresFR = a_Chiffres(p_Nombre) Exit Function End If
SItN_NombreEnLettresFR = "" v_NombreEnChiffres = Cstr(p_Nombre)
' Boucler sur chaque tranche (bloc de trois chiffres) t = -1 Do If Len(v_NombreEnChiffres) < 3 Then v_NombreEnChiffres = Right("00" & v_NombreEnChiffres, 3) End If t = t + 1 v_TrancheNum = Cint(Right(v_NombreEnChiffres, 3))
' Traduire la tranche en lettres If v_TrancheNum = 1 And t > 0 And t < 2 Then ' Tranche = 001 v_TrancheEnLettres = a_Tranches(t) Elseif v_TrancheNum > 0 Then If v_TrancheNum < 20 Then ' Tranche < 020 v_TrancheEnLettres = a_Chiffres(v_TrancheNum) Else ' Centaines v_Centaines = v_TrancheNum \ 100 ' 123 --> 1 v_CentainesEnLettres = "" If v_Centaines >= 1 Then ' Tranche >= 100 If v_Centaines >= 2 Then ' Tranche >= 200 v_CentainesEnLettres = a_Chiffres(v_Centaines) & " " End If v_CentainesEnLettres = v_CentainesEnLettres & "cent" End If ' Dizaines v_TrancheNum = v_TrancheNum Mod 100 ' 123 --> 23 If v_TrancheNum = 0 Then ' Tranche = x00 If v_Centaines > 1 Then ' Tranche > 1xx v_CentainesEnLettres = v_CentainesEnLettres & "s" v_DizainesEnLettres = "" End If Elseif v_TrancheNum < 20 Then ' Tranche < x20 v_DizainesEnLettres = a_Chiffres(v_TrancheNum) Else v_Dizaines = v_TrancheNum \ 10 ' 23 --> 2 v_DizainesEnLettres = a_Dizaines(v_Dizaines)
' Unités v_Unites = v_TrancheNum Mod 10 ' 23 --> 3 If v_Dizaines = 7 Then ' Tranche = x7x If v_Unites = 1 Then ' Tranche = x71 v_DizainesEnLettres = v_DizainesEnLettres & "-et-" & a_Chiffres(v_TrancheNum - ((v_Dizaines - 1) * 10)) Else v_DizainesEnLettres = v_DizainesEnLettres & "-" & a_Chiffres(v_TrancheNum - ((v_Dizaines - 1) * 10)) End If Elseif v_TrancheNum = 80 Then ' Tranche = x80 v_DizainesEnLettres = v_DizainesEnLettres & "s" Elseif v_Dizaines = 9 Then ' Tranche = x9x v_DizainesEnLettres = v_DizainesEnLettres & "-" & a_Chiffres(v_TrancheNum - ((v_Dizaines - 1) * 10)) Else If v_Unites = 1 And v_Dizaines <> 8 Then ' Tranche = xx1 & Tranche <> x8x v_DizainesEnLettres = v_DizainesEnLettres & "-et-" & a_Chiffres(v_Unites) Elseif v_Unites >= 1 Then ' Tranche >= xx1 v_DizainesEnLettres = v_DizainesEnLettres & "-" & a_Chiffres(v_Unites) End If End If End If
v_TrancheEnLettres = Fulltrim(v_CentainesEnLettres & " " & v_DizainesEnLettres) End If
v_TrancheEnLettres = v_TrancheEnLettres & " " & a_Tranches(t) End If
' Ajouter la tranche au nombre en lettres v_NombreEnLettres = v_TrancheEnLettres & " " & v_NombreEnLettres
v_NombreEnChiffres = Left(v_NombreEnChiffres, Len(v_NombreEnChiffres) - 3) Loop Until v_NombreEnChiffres = ""
SItN_NombreEnLettresFR = Fulltrim(v_NombreEnLettres) Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SItN, gc_Element_SItN, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SItN_cIntRomain(Byval p_Romain As String) As Integer On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_Decimal As Integer Dim i As Integer Dim v_Courant As String Dim v_Suivant As String
Dim l_ChiffresRomains List As Integer l_ChiffresRomains("I") = 1 l_ChiffresRomains("V") = 5 l_ChiffresRomains("X") = 10 l_ChiffresRomains("L") = 50 l_ChiffresRomains("C") = 100 l_ChiffresRomains("D") = 500 l_ChiffresRomains("M") = 1000
SItN_cIntRomain = -1
For i = 1 To Len(p_Romain) v_Courant = Mid(p_Romain, i, 1) v_Suivant = ""
If i < Len(p_Romain) Then v_Suivant = Mid(p_Romain, i + 1, 1) End If
If v_Suivant = "" Then v_Decimal = v_Decimal + l_ChiffresRomains(v_Courant) ElseIf l_ChiffresRomains(v_Courant) < l_ChiffresRomains(v_Suivant) Then v_Decimal = v_Decimal - l_ChiffresRomains(v_Courant) Else v_Decimal = v_Decimal + l_ChiffresRomains(v_Courant) End If Next
SItN_cIntRomain = v_Decimal Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SItN, gc_Element_SItN, GetThreadInfo(1), p_Romain, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SItN_Format(Byval p_Nombre As Double, p_Format As String, p_Langue As string) As String '-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de convertir un nombre en texte ' Formats permis : "Fixed" = -999999999.99 ' "Standard" = -999 999 999.99 ' Langue: Utilise les paramètre du poste si langue est nulle ' Note : Le script Format(Abs(p_Nombre), "Standard") retourn une message d'erreur de overflow ' lorqu'on l'excute sur le serveur. '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nint As NotesInternational Dim ns As New NotesSession Dim v_SeparateurDecimal As String Dim v_SeparateurMille As String Dim v_NombreFix As Double Dim v_Fraction As Double Dim v_NombreStandard As String Dim v_Nombre As String
Select Case p_Langue Case "FR": v_SeparateurDecimal = "," v_SeparateurMille = " " Case "EN": v_SeparateurDecimal = "." v_SeparateurMille = "," Case Else: Set nint = ns.International v_SeparateurDecimal = nint.DecimalSep v_SeparateurMille = nint.ThousandsSep End Select
v_NombreFix = Fix(Abs(p_Nombre)) v_Fraction = Round((Fraction(Abs(p_Nombre)) * 100), 0) v_Nombre = Cstr(v_NombreFix)
If p_Format = "Standard" Then
If v_SeparateurMille = "" Then v_Nombre = v_Nombre & v_SeparateurDecimal & Right("0" & Cstr(v_Fraction), 2) Else Do While Len(v_Nombre) > 3 v_NombreStandard = v_SeparateurMille & Right(v_Nombre, 3) & v_NombreStandard v_Nombre = Left(v_Nombre, Len(v_Nombre) - 3) Loop v_Nombre = v_Nombre & v_NombreStandard & v_SeparateurDecimal & Right("0" & Cstr(v_Fraction), 2) End If
Elseif p_Format = "Fixed" Then v_Nombre = v_Nombre & v_SeparateurDecimal & Right("0" & Cstr(v_Fraction), 2) Else v_Nombre = Cstr(p_Nombre) End If
If p_Nombre < 0 Then SItN_Format = "-" & v_Nombre Else SItN_Format = v_Nombre End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SItN, gc_Element_SItN, Getthreadinfo(1), Cstr(p_Nombre), False) Exit Function
End Function

Function SItN_cRomain(ByVal p_Valeur As Integer) As String On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim a_Nombres(12) As Integer Dim a_Romains(12) As String Dim i As Integer Dim v_Romain As String
a_Nombres(0) = 1000 a_Nombres(1) = 900 a_Nombres(2) = 500 a_Nombres(3) = 400 a_Nombres(4) = 100 a_Nombres(5) = 90 a_Nombres(6) = 50 a_Nombres(7) = 40 a_Nombres(8) = 10 a_Nombres(9) = 9 a_Nombres(10) = 5 a_Nombres(11) = 4 a_Nombres(12) = 1
a_Romains(0) = "M" a_Romains(1) = "CM" a_Romains(2) = "D" a_Romains(3) = "CD" a_Romains(4) = "C" a_Romains(5) = "XC" a_Romains(6) = "L" a_Romains(7) = "XL" a_Romains(8) = "X" a_Romains(9) = "IX" a_Romains(10) = "V" a_Romains(11) = "IV" a_Romains(12) = "I"
For i = 0 To 12 Do While p_Valeur >= a_Nombres(i) v_Romain = v_Romain + a_Romains(i) p_Valeur = p_Valeur - a_Nombres(i) Loop Next i
SItN_cRomain = v_Romain Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SItN, gc_Element_SItN, GetThreadInfo(1), CStr(p_Valeur), False) Exit Function End Function

Function SItN_NombreEnLettresEN(p_Nombre As Long) On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim a_Dizaines As Variant Dim a_Chiffres As Variant Dim a_Tranches As Variant Dim v_NombreEnChiffres As String Dim t As Integer Dim v_NombreEnLettres As String Dim v_TrancheEnLettres As String Dim v_TrancheNum As Integer Dim v_Centaines As Integer Dim v_Dizaines As Integer Dim v_DizainesEnLettres As String Dim v_CentainesEnLettres As String Dim v_Unites As Integer
a_Dizaines = Evaluate(|"":"":"Twenty" : "Thirty" : "Forty" : "Fifty" : "Sixty" : "Seventy" : "Eighty" : "Ninety"|) a_Chiffres = Evaluate(|"": "One":"Two":"Three":"Four":"Five":"Six":"Seven":"Eight": "Nine": "Ten": "Eleven": "Twelve": "Thirteen": "Fourteen": "Fifteen": "Sixteen": "Seventeen": "Eighteen": "Nineteen"|) a_Tranches = Evaluate(|"":"":"Thousand":"Million":"Billion":"Trillion":"":"":"":""|)
' Si le nombre est inférieur à 20, pas de traitement --> retourner la valeur de la table des chiffres If p_Nombre < 20 Then SItN_NombreEnLettresEN = a_Chiffres(p_Nombre) Exit Function End If
SItN_NombreEnLettresEN = "" v_NombreEnChiffres = Cstr(p_Nombre)
t = 0
Do While v_NombreEnChiffres <> ""
v_TrancheEnLettres = ""
v_TrancheNum = Right("000" & v_NombreEnChiffres, 3)
If Len(v_NombreEnChiffres) < 3 Then v_NombreEnChiffres = Right("00" & v_NombreEnChiffres, 3) End If
t = t + 1
v_TrancheNum = Cint(Right(v_NombreEnChiffres, 3))
If v_TrancheNum > 0 And v_TrancheNum < 19 Then
v_TrancheEnLettres = a_Chiffres(v_TrancheNum)
Else v_Centaines = v_TrancheNum \ 100 v_CentainesEnLettres = "" If v_Centaines >= 1 And v_Centaines =< 9 Then v_CentainesEnLettres = a_Chiffres(v_Centaines) & " " & "Hundred" & " " End If
' Dizaines v_TrancheNum = v_TrancheNum Mod 100 ' 123 --> 23
If v_TrancheNum < 20 And v_TrancheNum > 0 Then
v_DizainesEnLettres = a_Chiffres(v_TrancheNum) & " "
Else
v_Dizaines = v_TrancheNum \ 10 ' 23 --> 2 v_DizainesEnLettres = a_Dizaines(v_Dizaines) & " "
' Unités v_Unites = v_TrancheNum Mod 10 ' 23 --> 3 If v_Unites >= 1 And v_Unites =< 9 Then v_DizainesEnLettres = Trim(v_DizainesEnLettres) & "-" & a_Chiffres(v_Unites) End If
End If
v_TrancheEnLettres = Fulltrim(v_CentainesEnLettres & " " & v_DizainesEnLettres)
End If
If v_TrancheEnLettres <> "" Then v_NombreEnLettres = v_TrancheEnLettres & " " & a_Tranches(t) & " " & v_NombreEnLettres End If
If Len(v_NombreEnChiffres) > 3 Then ' Retirer 3 dernier chiffres converti v_NombreEnChiffres = Left(v_NombreEnChiffres, Len(v_NombreEnChiffres) - 3) Else v_NombreEnChiffres = "" End If
Loop
SItN_NombreEnLettresEN = Trim(v_NombreEnLettres)
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SItN, gc_Element_SItN, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SItN_isNumeric(Byval p_Nombre As String) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Nombre As String Dim v_Separateur As Integer Dim i As Integer Dim v_Gauche As String Dim v_Droite As String Dim p As Long
SItN_isNumeric = False v_Nombre = Replace(Fulltrim(p_Nombre), " ", "") If v_Nombre = "" Then Exit Function End If
v_Separateur = Instr(v_Nombre, ".") If v_Separateur > 0 Then i = Instr(v_Nombre, ",") If i > 0 Then v_Nombre = Replace(v_Nombre, ",", "") v_Separateur = Instr(v_Nombre, ".") End If Else v_Separateur = Instr(v_Nombre, ",") End If
If v_Separateur > 0 Then v_Gauche = Left(v_Nombre, v_Separateur - 1) v_Droite = Right(v_Nombre, Len(v_Nombre) - v_Separateur)
' SItN_isNumeric = IsNumeric(v_Gauche) And IsNumeric(v_Droite) SItN_isNumeric = (v_Gauche = "" Or Isnumeric(v_Gauche)) And ( v_Droite = "" Or Isnumeric(v_Droite)) And (v_Gauche <> "" Or v_Droite <> "") Else SItN_isNumeric = Isnumeric(v_Nombre) End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SItN, gc_Element_SItN, Getthreadinfo(1), Cstr(p_Nombre), False) Exit Function End Function

Function SItN_ArrondirBas(Byval p_Nombre As Double, p_Arrondi As Double) As Double ' p_Arrondi : ex.: 1, 0.5, 0.25. 5 On Error Goto GererErreur
SItN_ArrondirBas = Int((p_Nombre / p_Arrondi)) * p_Arrondi ' FIN Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SItN, gc_Element_SItN, Getthreadinfo(1), Cstr(p_Nombre), False) Exit Function End Function

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Public Sub ajoutCoen() '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur Dim nv As NotesView

Dim ndc_CSAD As NotesDocumentCollection Dim v_NomVue As String Dim v_CodeProduit As String Dim v_PrixProd As Double Dim v_DateDebutProd As Variant Dim v_DateFinProd As Variant

v_ElementList("DateDebut")= v_DateDebutProd v_ElementList("DateFin")= v_DateFinProd v_ElementList("TypeProduit")="02"
Me.Produits(xUnique("")) = v_ElementList
If xvar(nd, "CoEn_DateDebut2", "" ) <> "" Then v_ElementList("Prix")= xvar(nd, "CoEn_CoutAnnuel2", 0 ) v_ElementList("DateDebut")=xVar(nd, "CoEn_DateDebut2", "") v_DateFinProd = xVar(nd, "CoEn_DateFin2", "")

'Me.Produits(v_CodeProduit) = v_ElementList Me.Produits(xUnique("")) = v_ElementList End If End If

Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCS_clTransfertt, gc_Element_SDSCS_clTransfert, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Public Sub ajoutEvenement(P_ProdId As String ) '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_EvenementList List As variant
v_EvenementList("Message")="Produit Inactif" Me.Evenements(P_ProdId) = v_EvenementList
Exit Sub GererErreur:
Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCS_clTransfertt, gc_Element_SDSCS_clTransfert, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Public Sub ajoutProduits() '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur Dim nv As notesview
Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd As NotesDocument
Dim ndc_CSAD As NotesDocumentCollection Dim v_NomVue As String Dim v_CodeProduit As string Dim v_PrixProd As Double Dim v_DateDebutProd As Variant Dim v_DateFinProd As Variant
Dim v_ElementList List As variant
Set nv = db_CSA.getview("V_CSAD21") Call nv.refresh
Set ndc_CSAD = nv.GetAllDocumentsByKey(me.cle,True)
If ndc_CSAD.Count = 0 Then Exit Sub End If
Set nd_Suivant = ndc_CSAD.Getfirstdocument
Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc_CSAD.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
v_CodeProduit=xVar(nd, "CSAD_CodeProduit", "")
If v_CodeProduit="" Then me.ContientEscompte=true End If
v_ElementList("CodeProduit")= v_CodeProduit
If xvar(nd, "CSAD_ModePaiement", "" ) = "M" Then v_ElementList("Prix")= xvar(nd, "CSAD_PrixUnitaire", 0 ) Else v_ElementList("Prix")= xvar(nd, "CSAD_CoutAnnuel1", 0 ) End If
v_ElementList("Cle")= xVar(nd, "CSAD_CleProduit", "") v_ElementList("CleProduit")= xVar(nd, "CSAD_CleProduit", "") v_DateDebutProd = xVar(nd, "CSAD_DateDebut1", "") v_DateFinProd = xVar(nd, "CSAD_DateFin1", "")
If v_DateDebutProd = me.DateDebut Then v_DateDebutProd="" End If
If v_DateFinProd = me.DateFin Then If xvar(nd, "CSAD_XRen", "" ) <> "1" Then v_DateFinProd="" End If End If
v_ElementList("DateDebut")= v_DateDebutProd v_ElementList("DateFin")= v_DateFinProd v_ElementList("Expiration")= xVar(nd, "CSAD_Expiration", "") v_ElementList("TypeProduit")="01"
'Me.Produits(v_CodeProduit+ "-1") = v_ElementList Me.Produits(xUnique("")) = v_ElementList
If xvar(nd, "CSAD_DateDebut2", "" ) <> "" Then
v_ElementList("Prix")= xvar(nd, "CSAD_CoutAnnuel2", 0 ) v_ElementList("DateDebut")=xVar(nd, "CSAD_DateDebut2", "") v_DateFinProd = xVar(nd, "CSAD_DateFin2", "")
If v_DateFinProd = me.DateFin Then If xvar(nd, "CSAD_XRen", "" ) <> "1" Then v_DateFinProd="" End If End If
v_ElementList("DateFin")= v_DateFinProd 'Me.Produits(v_CodeProduit + "-2") = v_ElementList Me.Produits(xUnique("")) = v_ElementList End If
Loop
Exit Sub GererErreur:
Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCS_clTransfertt, gc_Element_SDSCS_clTransfert, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Public Function transfererCSA() As boolean '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur transfererCSA=False Dim ns As notessession Dim nd As NotesDocument
If ns Is Nothing Then Set ns = New NotesSession End If
Set nd = New NotesDocument(db_CS) nd.Form = "F_CSCo"
Call xAssignerDate(nd, "CSCo_DateInstallation", me.DateInstallation ) Call xAssignerDate(nd, "CSCo_DateDebut", me.DateDebut ) Call xAssignerDate(nd, "CSCo_DateFin", me.DateFin ) Call me.composeNoContrat(Nd)
'----------------- Contrat nd.CSCo_Devise=me.Devise nd.CSCo_Langue=me.Langue nd.CSCo_NoProduitSeq =0 nd.CSCo_PremierContrat=me.PremierContrat nd.CSCo_NePasRenouveler=me.NePasRenouveler nd.CSCo_SoutienActif = me.SoutienActif nd.CSCo_NoProposition = me.NoProposition
nd.CSCo_CSAidReference = me.Cle
nd.CSCo_TypeInstallation="0" nd.CSCo_TypeInstallationDescFR="Sur Site" nd.CSCo_TypeInstallationIcone = 0
nd.CSCo_ModePaiement="01" nd.CSCo_ModePaiementDescFR = "Chèque"
nd.CSCo_TypePeriode="12" nd.CSCo_TypePeriodeDescFR="Anuelle" nd.CSA_Total=me.CSA_Total
Call ajoutClient(nd, "CSCo_Client") If me.NoClientFactFmt <> "" Then nd.CSCo_ClientFact="" Call ajoutClient(nd, "CSCo_ClientFact") End If
Call SDSCSCo_AssignerStatutContrat(nd , Nothing, "06" , "") Call insererProduits(nd) Call copierNotes(nd)
nd.HistoDC = Now nd.HistoUC = ns.commonusername
Set me.nd_CSCo=nd
transfererCSA=true Exit Function GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCS_clTransfertt, gc_Element_SDSCS_clTransfert, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function
'--------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Private Sub ajoutClient(nd_CSCO As NotesDocument, v_ChampCS As string) '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
dim nd_SICl as notesdocument Dim v_ChampClient As Variant Dim v_ChampBdClient As String
v_ChampBdClient = "Clie_Client"
v_ChampClient = Evaluate({"NomInterne" : "Nom1" : "Nom2" : "Adresse1": "Adresse2" : "Ville" : "Province": "CodePostal": "Pays"}) On Error GoTo GererErreur
If v_ChampCS = "CSCo_ClientFact" Then nd_CSCO.CSCo_ClientFactNoFmt=me.NoClientFactFmt nd_CSCO.CSCo_ClientFactNo1=me.ClientFactNo1 nd_CSCO.CSCo_ClientFactNo2=me.ClientFactNo2 Set nd_SICl = xSICl_xndClie(me.NoClientFactFmt, False) Else nd_CSCO.CSCo_ClientNoFmt=me.NoClientFmt nd_CSCO.CSCo_ClientNo1=me.ClientNo1 nd_CSCO.CSCo_ClientNo2=me.ClientNo2 Set nd_SICl = xSICl_xndClie(me.NoClientFmt, False) End If
' Extraire le document SI Clients
If Not nd_SICl Is Nothing Then
ForAll champ In v_ChampClient 'v_ChampCS+champ Call nd_CSCO.ReplaceItemValue(v_ChampCS+champ, xVar(nd_SICl,v_ChampBdClient+champ,"")) End ForAll
End If
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCS_clTransfertt, gc_Element_SDSCS_clTransfert, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub
'--------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Private Sub insererProduits(nd_CSCO As NotesDocument) '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------- %REM Les different type de produit : "01" : Service "02" : Contrat d'entretien "03" : Frais de récupération "80" : Escompte %END REM On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim listeProduits As Variant Dim nd_CSPr As NotesDocument Dim nd_Base As notesdocument Dim v_TypeProduit As string Dim v_NoContratFmt As String
v_NoContratFmt = xVar(nd_CSCO,"CSCo_NoContratFmt","")
ForAll produits In me.Produits
Set nd_CSPr = SDSCSPr_NouveauProduit(nd_CSCO , CStr(produits("TypeProduit")) , db_CS) nd_CSPr.Form="F_CSPr"
If produits("TypeProduit") ="02" Then
nd_CSPr.CSPr_CodeProduit = produits("CodeProduit")
nd_CSPr.CSPr_Modele=produits("Modele") nd_CSPr.CSPr_NoSerie=produits("NoSerie") nd_CSPr.CSPr_CodeContEnt=produits("CodeContEnt") nd_CSPr.CSPr_DescProduitFR=produits("DescProduit") ElseIf produits("TypeProduit") ="03" Then
nd_CSPr.CSPr_CodeProduit = produits("CodeProduit") nd_CSPr.CSPr_DescProduitFR=produits("DescProduit")
Else
'Batir remplacement a partir du produit de sdsbase. Set nd_Base = xSDSBB_xndProd_Code(produits("CodeProduit"),True) If Not nd_Base Is Nothing Then
Call SDSCSPr_BatirProduit(nd_CSPr , nd_Base) End If End If nd_CSPr.CSPr_PrixUnitaire = produits("Prix")
'si produit 'nd_CSPr.CSPr_PrixMensuel @If(CSPr_ClasseProduit = "AH"; v_PrixUnitaire; @Round(v_PrixUnitaire / 12; 0,01))
Call xAssignerDate(nd_CSPr, "CSPr_DateDebut", produits("DateDebut")) Call xAssignerDate(nd_CSPr, "CSPr_DateFin", produits("DateFin")) nd_CSPr.CSPr_PrixTotal = SDSCSPr_CalculPrixTotal( v_NoContratFmt, nd_CSPr )
nd_CSPr.CSPr_NoProduitSeq = SDSCSPr_ValeurSuivante(nd_CSCo) Call nd_CSPr.MakeResponse(nd_CSCo) Call nd_CSPr.Save(True,False)
End ForAll
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCS_clTransfertt, gc_Element_SDSCS_clTransfert, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub
private sub composeNoContrat(nd_CSCO as notesdocument) On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_NoContratSeq As String Dim v_NoRevision As String Dim v_AnneeEntVig As String Dim v_NoContrat As String
v_NoRevision = "000"
' date Entre en vigeur v_AnneeEntVig = Year(xVar(nd_CSCo,"CSCo_DateDebut",Today)) v_NoContrat = xVar(nd_CSCo,"CSCo_NoContrat","") v_NoContratSeq = SDSCSCo_CreerNoContrat(v_AnneeEntVig)
'Ecrire la composition du numéro de contrat nd_CSCO.CSCo_NoContrat= v_NoContratSeq nd_CSCO.CSCo_NoRevision=v_NoRevision nd_CSCO.CSCo_NoContratFmt= v_NoContratSeq + "-" + v_NoRevision nd_CSCO.CSCo_NoContratInit= v_NoContratSeq + "-" + v_NoRevision nd_CSCO.Cle=v_NoContratSeq + "-" + v_NoRevision nd_CSCO.Description=v_NoContratSeq + "-" + v_NoRevision
Exit sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCS_clTransfertt, gc_Element_SDSCS_clTransfert, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit sub End sub
End Class

Sub SDSCSTran_MajDateFacture( pnd_CSCo As NotesDocument) On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nd_Fact As NotesDocument Dim v_NoContrat As String Dim v_DateFIN As Variant
v_NoContrat = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoContrat" , "") v_DateFIN = xVar(pnd_CSCo,"CSCo_DateFin","") Set nd_Fact = xSDSCS_xndCSFa(v_NoContrat , True )
If Not nd_Fact Is Nothing Then
Call xAssignerDate(nd_Fact, "CSFa_DateFactureJusquau", v_DateFIN ) Call SDSCSFa_MajDatesProchaine( nd_Fact , False )

Call nd_Fact.Save(True,False) End If

SDSCSTran_ValiderClientTransfert=""

Set nv = gndb_SDSCSTran.getview("V_CSCo13") Call nv.refresh

Function SDSCSTran_CreerContrat(p_DocID As String) As boolean Dim cl_transfert As CSA_clTransfert On Error GoTo GererErreur
Call SDSCSTran_Initialisations
Set cl_Transfert = New CSA_clTransfert(p_DocID)
SDSCSTran_CreerContrat = cl_Transfert.transfererCSA()
If SDSCSTran_CreerContrat Then Call SDSCSCo_MAJFacture( cl_Transfert.nd_CSCo ) cl_Transfert.nd_CSCo.CSCo_NoProduitSeq = xVar(cl_Transfert.nd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoProduitSeq", 0) + 1 Call cl_Transfert.nd_CSCo.Save(True, False) End If
Exit Function

Dim ns As New NotesSession Dim nd As NotesDocument
Set SITp_ndTemp = Nothing
Set gndb_Temp_SITp = xGDK_xndbNDB("SITp") If gndb_Temp_SITp Is Nothing Then Exit Function Elseif Not gndb_Temp_SITp.IsOpen Then Exit Function End If
Set SITp_ndTemp = New NotesDocument(gndb_Temp_SITp) SITp_ndTemp.Cle = Evaluate(|@Unique|) SITp_ndTemp.Description = p_Description SITp_ndTemp.HistoDC = Now SITp_ndTemp.HistoUC = ns.UserName Exit Function

Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_Extractions" Use "x_GDK" ' ' Cette bibliothèque de script permet d'extraire un document ou un item d'un document. Les documents ' à extraire ne se trouvent pas dans la base de documents courante. Il faut rechercher la base de documents ' à utiliser dans le GDK. ' ' Instructions ' 1. Renommer le script library. Le nouveau nom devrait être "x_SICf" ou "SICf" est ' l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' 2. Inscrire le nom usuel de la base de documents de recherche, le nom de l'item qui contient ' la clé et le nom de la vue de recherche dans la section (Declarations). ' 3. Remplacer toutes les occurences de "SICf" par l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' Les subs seront automatiquement renommés. ' 4. Remplacer toutes les occurences de "SDS" par l'identifiant du type de document. ' Les subs seront automatiquement renommés.

' Section 1 - Paramètres de la session - Définis dans le sub Initialisation_xELrod Dim gndb_xSICf As Notesdatabase
' Section 2 - Définition des valeurs conservées dans la cache Dim gnd_Prof_SICf As NotesDocument Dim gnvTabl_xSICf As Notesview Dim gndTabl_xSICf As Notesdocument Dim gnv_Equi_xSICf As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_Equi25_xSICf As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_Equi25_xSICf As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_Equi_xSICf As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_Conf_xSICf As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_Conf_xSICf As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_SDS_xSICf As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_SDS_xSICf As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_Merl_xSICf As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_Merl_xSICf As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_VPN_xSICf As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_VPN_xSICf As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_Post_xSICf As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_Post_xSICf As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les infor Dim gnv_Serv_xSICf As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnv_Serv25_xSICf As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document par nom serveur Dim gnv_Serv26_xSICf As NotesView ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document par nom serveur Dim gnd_Serv_xSICf As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_LogMeIn_xSICf As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_LogMeIn_xSICf As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_Prod_xSICf As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_Prod_xSICf As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées
' Section 3 - Les constantes à définir Const gc_NomBD_xSICf = "SICf" ' Inscrire le nom usuel de la base de documents ' de recherche, tel que déclaré dans le GDK. Const gc_NomItemCleEqui_xSICf = "Equi_NoEquipement" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueEqui_xSICf = "V_Equi20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomItemCleConf_xSICf = "Conf_NoConfiguration" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueConf_xSICf = "V_Conf20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche ' Suivants: Clé = no client Const gc_NomItemCleSDS_xSICf = "Conf_ClientNoFmt" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueSDS_xSICf = "V_SDS21" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomItemCleMerl_xSICf = "Conf_ClientNoFmt" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueMerl_xSICf = "V_Merl21" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomItemCleVPN_xSICf = "Conf_ClientNoFmt" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueVPN_xSICf = "V_VPN21" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomItemClePost_xSICf = "Post_NomPoste" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVuePost_xSICf = "V_Post20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomItemCleServ_xSICf = "SDS_NoConfigurationServeur"' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueServ_xSICf ="V_Serv23" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche par no config Const gc_NomItemCleServ25_xSICf = "SDS_NomServeur"' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueServ25_xSICf ="V_Serv25" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche par nom Const gc_NomItemCleServ26_xSICf = "SDS_NomServeurVirtuel"' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueServ26_xSICf ="V_Serv26" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche par nom Const gc_NomItemCleLogMeIn_xSICf = "Conf_ClientNoFmt" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueLogMeIn_xSICf = "V_LgMI20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomItemCleProd_xSICf = "Prod_CodeProduit" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueProd_xSICf = "V_Prod20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche

Function xSICf_xndPost(Byval p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Notesdocument ' Cette fonction retourne un document du type approprié.
' Initialisation des variables globales Call xSICf_Initialisation
' Si nécéssaire, extraire le document qui contient la variable recherchée. Call xnd(gc_NomItemClePost_xSICf, p_Cle, p_Cache, gndb_xSICf, gc_NomVuePost_xSICf, gnv_Post_xSICf, gnd_Post_xSICf)
' Retourne le document défini en variable globale Set xSICf_xndPost = gnd_Post_xSICf End Function

Function xSICf_xIcnTabl(Byval p_Cle As String, Byval p_Table As String, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Integer ' Cette fonction retourne la description d'un élément d'une table.
Dim v_Valeurs As Variant Dim v_Icones As Variant Dim i As Long
xSICf_xIcnTabl = 0
' Extraire les valeurs et les Icones v_Valeurs = xSICf_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Valeurs", "", True) v_Icones = xSICf_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Icones", "", True)
' S'il n'y a plusieurs valeurs, rechercher la valeur recherchée If Isarray(v_Valeurs) Then For i = Lbound(v_Valeurs) To Ubound(v_Valeurs) If v_Valeurs(i) = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Icones) Then If i >= Lbound(v_Icones) And i <= Ubound(v_Icones) Then xSICf_xIcnTabl = v_Icones(i) End If End If
Exit For End If Next
' S'il n'y a qu'une valeur, et qu'elle correspond à la valeur recherchée, retourner la description Else If v_Valeurs = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Icones) Then xSICf_xIcnTabl = v_Icones(0) Else xSICf_xIcnTabl = v_Icones End If End If End If End Function
