GererErreur: SDSCSSf_MajAssetBT = -9 Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSSf, gc_Element_SDSCSSf, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

'=================================================================================================================================================== Function SDSCSSf_DeleteAccountAssets(p_ClientNoFmt As String, pcl_ConnexionAPI As SLSf_clConnexionAPI) As Integer On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim cl_Sync As New SDSCSSf_clSync Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd_CSPr As NotesDocument Dim a_PointeursARetirer As Variant
Dim v_Resultat As Integer Dim v_NbMaj As Integer
SDSCSSf_DeleteAccountAssets = 0 Call SDSCSSf_Initialisations
If Not (pcl_ConnexionAPI Is Nothing) Then Set cl_Sync.ConnexionAPI = pcl_ConnexionAPI End If
' Extraire les assets de Salesforce a_PointeursARetirer = Evaluate(|"OwnerId":"CreatedDate":"CreatedById":"LastModifiedDate":"LastModifiedById":"SystemModstamp":"LastActivityDate":"LastViewedDate":"LastReferencedDate":"IsDeleted":"Name":"CurrencyIsoCode":"Account__c":"Annual_Price__c":"Billing_Start_Date__c":"Client_Reference__c":"Comments__c":"Contract_Number__c":"Customer_Number__c":"End_Date__c":"Include_Months_Free__c":"Monthly_Price__c":"Months_Free__c":"Notes__c":"Original_Start_Date__c":"Product_Code__c":"Product_Key__c":"Product_Name_English__c":"Product_Name_French__c":"Product_Sequence_Number__c":"Quantity__c":"Start_Date__c":"Status_English__c":"Status_French__c":"Total_Price__c":"Unit_Price__c"|)':"Asset_Category__c"|) v_Resultat = SDSCSSf_ExtraireAccountAssets(p_ClientNoFmt, cl_Sync, a_PointeursARetirer) If v_Resultat < 0 Then SDSCSSf_DeleteAccountAssets = -4 Exit Function End If
' Supprimer les assets des produits provenant des contrats de service ForAll v_Element In cl_Sync.Assets_CS v_Resultat = v_Element.SupprimerObjet If v_Resultat > 0 Then v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + v_Resultat End If End ForAll
' Supprimer les assets des produits provenant des bons de travail ForAll v_Element In cl_Sync.Assets_BT v_Resultat = v_Element.SupprimerObjet If v_Resultat > 0 Then v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + v_Resultat End If End ForAll
SDSCSSf_DeleteAccountAssets = v_NbMaj Exit Function
GererErreur: SDSCSSf_DeleteAccountAssets = -9 Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSSf, gc_Element_SDSCSSf, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

'=================================================================================================================================================== Function SDSCSSf_SyncAccountAssets(p_ClientNoFmt As String, pcl_ConnexionAPI As SLSf_clConnexionAPI, p_NbMaj List As Integer) As Integer On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim cl_Sync As New SDSCSSf_clSync Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd_CSPr As NotesDocument Dim a_PointeursARetirer As Variant
Dim v_Resultat As Integer Dim v_NbMaj As Integer
SDSCSSf_SyncAccountAssets = 0 Call SDSCSSf_Initialisations p_NbMaj("CC") = 0 p_NbMaj("MC") = 0 p_NbMaj("DC") = 0 p_NbMaj("CB") = 0 p_NbMaj("MB") = 0 p_NbMaj("DB") = 0 p_NbMaj("DD") = 0
If Not (pcl_ConnexionAPI Is Nothing) Then Set cl_Sync.ConnexionAPI = pcl_ConnexionAPI End If
' Extraire les produits des CS If gnv_CSPr39_SDSCSSf Is Nothing then Set gnv_CSPr39_SDSCSSf = gndb_SDSCSSf.GetView("V_CSPr39") Call gnv_CSPr39_SDSCSSf.Refresh End If Set cl_Sync.ndc_CSPr = gnv_CSPr39_SDSCSSf.GetAllDocumentsByKey(p_ClientNoFmt, True)
' Extraire les assets de Salesforce a_PointeursARetirer = Evaluate(|"OwnerId":"CreatedDate":"CreatedById":"LastModifiedDate":"LastModifiedById":"SystemModstamp":"LastActivityDate":"LastViewedDate":"LastReferencedDate"|) v_Resultat = SDSCSSf_ExtraireAccountAssets(p_ClientNoFmt, cl_Sync, a_PointeursARetirer) If v_Resultat < 0 Then SDSCSSf_SyncAccountAssets = -4 Exit Function End If
' Synchroniser les produits des contrats de service Set nd_Suivant = cl_Sync.ndc_CSPr.GetFirstDocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd_CSPr = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = cl_Sync.ndc_CSPr.GetNextDocument(nd_Suivant)
v_Resultat = SDSCSSf_SyncProduitCS(nd_CSPr, cl_Sync) If v_Resultat > 0 Then If v_Resultat = 1 Then p_NbMaj("CC") = p_NbMaj("CC") + 1 Else p_NbMaj("MC") = p_NbMaj("MC") + 1 End If v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 End If Loop
' Supprimer les assets des produits désactivés - Contrats de service ForAll v_Element In cl_Sync.AssetsByXId_CS v_Resultat = cl_Sync.Assets_CS(v_Element).SupprimerObjet If v_Resultat > 0 Then p_NbMaj("DC") = p_NbMaj("DC") + v_Resultat v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + v_Resultat End If End ForAll
If cl_Sync.SyncAssetsBT Then ' Synchroniser les produits des bons de travail v_Resultat = SDSCSSf_SyncBonsDeTravail(p_ClientNoFmt, cl_Sync) If v_Resultat > 0 Then If v_Resultat = 1 Then p_NbMaj("CB") = p_NbMaj("CB") + 1 Else p_NbMaj("MB") = p_NbMaj("MB") + 1 End If v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 End If
' Supprimer les assets des produits désactivés - Bons de travail ForAll v_Element In cl_Sync.AssetsByXId_BT v_Resultat = cl_Sync.Assets_BT(v_Element).SupprimerObjet If v_Resultat > 0 Then p_NbMaj("DB") = p_NbMaj("DB") + v_Resultat v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + v_Resultat End If End ForAll End If
' Supprimer les assets doublons ForAll v_Asset In cl_Sync.AssetsToDelete v_Resultat = v_Asset.SupprimerObjet If v_Resultat > 0 Then p_NbMaj("DD") = p_NbMaj("DD") + v_Resultat v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + v_Resultat End If End ForAll
SDSCSSf_SyncAccountAssets = v_NbMaj Exit Function
GererErreur: SDSCSSf_SyncAccountAssets = -9 Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSSf, gc_Element_SDSCSSf, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

'=================================================================================================================================================== Function SDSCSSf_CreerAssetCS(pnd_CSPr As NotesDocument, pcl_Sync As SDSCSSf_clSync) As Integer On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim cl_Asset As SLSf_clObject Dim v_Maj As Boolean Dim v_NoContratFmt As String Dim s As String Dim v_Resultat As Integer
SDSCSSf_CreerAssetCS = 0 v_NoContratFmt = xVar(pnd_CSPr, "CSPr_NoContratFmt", "") v_Maj = False
Set cl_Asset = New SLSf_clObject(pcl_Sync.ConnexionAPI, "SERTI_Asset__c", "*", "") v_Maj = cl_Asset.AssignerValeur("Account__c", pcl_Sync.Account.Cle, "") Or v_Maj v_Maj = cl_Asset.AssignerValeur("Asset_Unique_ID__c", pcl_Sync.IdSerti, "") Or v_Maj v_Maj = cl_Asset.AssignerValeur("Contract_Number__c", v_NoContratFmt, "") Or v_Maj s = xSDSCS_xVarCSCo(v_NoContratFmt, "CSCo_ClientNoFmt", "", True) v_Maj = cl_Asset.AssignerValeur("Customer_Number__c", s, "") Or v_Maj v_Maj = cl_Asset.AssignerValeur("Product_Sequence_Number__c", xVar(pnd_CSPr, "CSPr_NoProduitSeq", 0), "N") Or v_Maj
v_Resultat = SDSCSSf_MajItemsAssetCS(pnd_CSPr, cl_Asset) If v_Resultat = 1 Then v_Maj = True ElseIf v_Resultat < 0 Then SDSCSSf_CreerAssetCS = -1 End If
If v_Maj Then v_Resultat = cl_Asset.SauvegarderObjet If v_Resultat > 0 Then Set pcl_Sync.Assets_CS(cl_Asset.Cle) = cl_Asset pcl_Sync.NbAssets_CS = pcl_Sync.NbAssets_CS + 1 SDSCSSf_CreerAssetCS = 1 End If End If Exit Function
GererErreur: SDSCSSf_CreerAssetCS = -9 Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSSf, gc_Element_SDSCSSf, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSCSSf_SyncProduitsBT(pnd_BTra As NotesDocument, pcl_Sync As SDSCSSf_clSync) As Integer On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_BTPr As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim v_CleBonTravail As String Dim v_ClasseProduit As String Dim v_Quantite As Long Dim v_CleProduit As String Dim v_NoBonTravail As String Dim v_AssetId As String Dim v_Resultat As Integer
Dim v_NbLus As Long Dim v_NbMaj As Long
SDSCSSf_SyncProduitsBT = 0
If gnv_BTPr20_SDSCSSf Is Nothing Then Set gnv_BTPr20_SDSCSSf = gndb_xSIBDT.Getview("V_BTPr20") Call gnv_BTPr20_SDSCSSf.Refresh End If v_CleBonTravail = xVar(pnd_BTra, "BTra_CleBonTravail", "") Set ndc = gnv_BTPr20_SDSCSSf.GetAllDocumentsByKey(v_CleBonTravail, True) Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd_BTPr = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant) v_NbLus = v_NbLus + 1
v_ClasseProduit = xVar(nd_BTPr, "BTPr_ClasseProduit", "") If v_ClasseProduit = "LG" Then v_Quantite = xVar(nd_BTPr, "BTPr_Quantite", 0) If v_Quantite > 0 then v_CleProduit = xVar(nd_BTPr, "BTPr_CleProduit", "") If Not IsElement(pcl_Sync.l_CleProduit(v_CleProduit)) Then v_NoBonTravail = xVar(pnd_BTra, "BTra_NoBonTravailFmt", "") pcl_Sync.IdSerti = "SIBT;" & v_NoBonTravail & ";" & v_CleProduit If IsElement(pcl_Sync.AssetsByXId_BT(pcl_Sync.IdSerti)) Then v_AssetId = pcl_Sync.AssetsByXId_BT(pcl_Sync.IdSerti) Else v_AssetId = "*" End If
If v_AssetId = "*" Then v_Resultat = SDSCSSf_CreerAssetBT(nd_BTPr, pcl_Sync) If v_Resultat = 1 Then SDSCSSf_SyncProduitsBT = 1 ElseIf v_Resultat < 0 Then SDSCSSf_SyncProduitsBT = -5 Exit Function End If
Else v_Resultat = SDSCSSf_MajAssetBT(nd_BTPr, v_AssetId, pcl_Sync) If v_Resultat = 1 Then SDSCSSf_SyncProduitsBT = 2 ElseIf v_Resultat < 0 Then SDSCSSf_SyncProduitsBT = -5 Exit Function End If
End If v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + v_Resultat
If v_AssetId <> "*" Then Erase pcl_Sync.AssetsByXId_BT(pcl_Sync.IdSerti) End If
pcl_Sync.l_CleProduit(v_CleProduit) = v_CleProduit End If End If End If Loop
Exit Function
GererErreur: SDSCSSf_SyncProduitsBT = -9 Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSSf, gc_Element_SDSCSSf, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

'=================================================================================================================================================== Function SDSCSSf_ExtraireAccountAssets(p_ClientNoFmt As String, pcl_Sync As SDSCSSf_clSync, pa_PointeursARetirer As Variant) As Integer On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_NomProfilSalesforceAPI As String Dim v_Resultat As Integer Dim v_IdBaseGDK As String Dim v_Unique_Id As String Dim v_NbAssets As Long Dim l_Assets List As SLSf_clObject
SDSCSSf_ExtraireAccountAssets = 0 Call SDSCSSf_Initialisations pcl_Sync.NbAssets_CS = 0 pcl_Sync.NbAssets_BT = 0
If p_ClientNoFmt = "" Then SDSCSSf_ExtraireAccountAssets = -1 Exit Function End If
If pcl_Sync.ConnexionAPI Is Nothing then v_NomProfilSalesforceAPI = xVarProf("Prof_NomProfilSalesforceAPI", "") If v_NomProfilSalesforceAPI = "" Then SDSCSSf_ExtraireAccountAssets = -2 Exit Function End If
Set pcl_Sync.ConnexionAPI = New SLSf_clConnexionAPI(v_NomProfilSalesforceAPI) If pcl_Sync.ConnexionAPI.Resultat < 0 Then SDSCSSf_ExtraireAccountAssets = -2 Exit Function End If End If
Set pcl_Sync.Account = New SLSf_clObject(pcl_Sync.ConnexionAPI, "Account", "SERTI_ID__c/" & p_ClientNoFmt, "") If pcl_Sync.Account.Resultat < 0 Then SDSCSSf_ExtraireAccountAssets = -3 Exit Function ElseIf pcl_Sync.Account.Resultat = 0 Then Exit Function End If
' Extraire les assets de Salesforce v_Resultat = pcl_Sync.Account.ExtraireEnfants("SERTI_Assets__r", pa_PointeursARetirer) If v_Resultat < 0 Then SDSCSSf_ExtraireAccountAssets = -4 Exit Function End If
v_NbAssets = pcl_Sync.Account.NbEnfants("SERTI_Assets__r") If v_NbAssets > 0 then ForAll v_Element In pcl_Sync.Account.Enfants("SERTI_Assets__r") v_Unique_Id = v_Element.Contenu("Asset_Unique_ID__c") If v_Unique_Id = "" Then Set pcl_Sync.AssetsToDelete(ListTag(v_Element)) = v_Element Else v_IdBaseGDK = StrLeft(v_Unique_Id, ";") If pcl_Sync.SyncAssetsBT And v_IdBaseGDK = "SIBT" Then If Not IsElement(pcl_Sync.AssetsByXId_BT(v_Unique_Id)) Then Set pcl_Sync.Assets_BT(ListTag(v_Element)) = v_Element pcl_Sync.NbAssets_BT = pcl_Sync.NbAssets_BT + 1 pcl_Sync.AssetsByXId_BT(v_Unique_Id) = ListTag(v_Element) Else ' Doublon Set pcl_Sync.AssetsToDelete(ListTag(v_Element)) = v_Element End If
ElseIf v_IdBaseGDK = g_IdBaseGDK_SDSCSSf Then If Not IsElement(pcl_Sync.AssetsByXId_CS(v_Unique_Id)) Then Set pcl_Sync.Assets_CS(ListTag(v_Element)) = v_Element pcl_Sync.NbAssets_CS = pcl_Sync.NbAssets_CS + 1 pcl_Sync.AssetsByXId_CS(v_Unique_Id) = ListTag(v_Element) Else ' Doublon Set pcl_Sync.AssetsToDelete(ListTag(v_Element)) = v_Element End If
Else Erase v_Element pcl_Sync.Account.NbEnfants("SERTI_Assets__r") = pcl_Sync.Account.NbEnfants("SERTI_Assets__r") - 1 End If End If End ForAll End If
SDSCSSf_ExtraireAccountAssets = v_Resultat Exit Function
GererErreur: SDSCSSf_ExtraireAccountAssets = -9 Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSSf, gc_Element_SDSCSSf, GetThreadInfo(1), p_ClientNoFmt, False) Exit Function End Function

'=================================================================================================================================================== Function SDSCSSf_DeleteDuplicateAssets(p_ClientNoFmt As String, pcl_ConnexionAPI As SLSf_clConnexionAPI) As Integer On Error GoTo GererErreur

Dim v_Resultat As Integer Dim v_NbMaj As Integer
SDSCSSf_DeleteDuplicateAssets = 0 Call SDSCSSf_Initialisations
If Not (pcl_ConnexionAPI Is Nothing) Then Set cl_Sync.ConnexionAPI = pcl_ConnexionAPI End If
' Extraire les assets de Salesforce a_PointeursARetirer = Evaluate(|"OwnerId":"CreatedDate":"CreatedById":"LastModifiedDate":"LastModifiedById":"SystemModstamp":"LastActivityDate":"LastViewedDate":"LastReferencedDate":"IsDeleted":"Name":"CurrencyIsoCode":"Account__c":"Annual_Price__c":"Billing_Start_Date__c":"Client_Reference__c":"Comments__c":"Contract_Number__c":"Customer_Number__c":"End_Date__c":"Include_Months_Free__c":"Monthly_Price__c":"Months_Free__c":"Notes__c":"Original_Start_Date__c":"Product_Code__c":"Product_Key__c":"Product_Name_English__c":"Product_Name_French__c":"Product_Sequence_Number__c":"Quantity__c":"Start_Date__c":"Status_English__c":"Status_French__c":"Total_Price__c":"Unit_Price__c"|)':"Asset_Category__c"|) v_Resultat = SDSCSSf_ExtraireAccountAssets(p_ClientNoFmt, cl_Sync, a_PointeursARetirer) If v_Resultat < 0 Then SDSCSSf_DeleteDuplicateAssets = -4 Exit Function End If
' Supprimer les assets doublons ForAll v_Asset In cl_Sync.AssetsToDelete v_Resultat = v_Asset.SupprimerObjet If v_Resultat > 0 Then v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + v_Resultat End If End ForAll

'=================================================================================================================================================== Function SDSCSSf_SyncProduitCS(pnd_CSPr As NotesDocument, pcl_Sync As SDSCSSf_clSync) As Integer ' 0 = Pas de changement, 1 = Créé, 2 = Maj On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_TypeProduit As String Dim v_NoContratFmt As String Dim v_NoContrat As String Dim v_NoProduitSeq As String Dim v_AssetId As String Dim v_Resultat As Integer Dim v_CleProduit As String Dim v_NbMaj As Integer
SDSCSSf_SyncProduitCS = 0
v_TypeProduit = xVar(pnd_CSPr, "CSPr_TypeProduit", "") If v_TypeProduit <= "10" Then v_NoContratFmt = xVar(pnd_CSPr, "CSPr_NoContratFmt", "") v_NoContrat = xSDSCS_xVarCSCo(v_NoContratFmt, "CSCo_NoContrat", "", True) v_NoProduitSeq = xVar(pnd_CSPr, "CSPr_NoProduitSeq", 0) pcl_Sync.IdSerti = g_IdBaseGDK_SDSCSSf & ";" & v_NoContrat & ";" & CStr(v_NoProduitSeq) If IsElement(pcl_Sync.AssetsByXId_CS(pcl_Sync.IdSerti)) Then v_AssetId = pcl_Sync.AssetsByXId_CS(pcl_Sync.IdSerti) Else v_AssetId = "*" End If
If v_AssetId = "*" Then v_Resultat = SDSCSSf_CreerAssetCS(pnd_CSPr, pcl_Sync) If v_Resultat = 1 Then SDSCSSf_SyncProduitCS = 1 ElseIf v_Resultat < 0 Then SDSCSSf_SyncProduitCS = -6 Exit Function End If Else v_Resultat = SDSCSSf_MajAssetCS(pnd_CSPr, v_AssetId, pcl_Sync) If v_Resultat = 1 Then SDSCSSf_SyncProduitCS = 2 ElseIf v_Resultat < 0 Then SDSCSSf_SyncProduitCS = -6 Exit Function End If End If

v_CleProduit = xVar(pnd_CSPr, "CSPr_CleProduit", "") If Not IsElement(pcl_Sync.l_CleProduit(v_CleProduit)) Then pcl_Sync.l_CleProduit(v_CleProduit) = v_CleProduit End If End If

GererErreur: SDSCSSf_SyncProduitCS = -9 Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSSf, gc_Element_SDSCSSf, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

' Traitement des erreurs ' ----------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_SLJS = "SL" Const gc_Element_SLJS = "SL_JSON_v2"

'=========================================================================================================================== Function SLJS_RetirerPointeurs(p_JSON As String, pa_Pointeurs As Variant) As long On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim i As Integer
SLJS_RetirerPointeurs = 0 Call SLJS_Initialisations
If Not IsArray(pa_Pointeurs) Then Exit Function End If
For i = LBound(pa_Pointeurs) To UBound(pa_Pointeurs) SLJS_RetirerPointeurs = SLJS_RetirerPointeurs + SLJS_RetirerPointeur(p_JSON, pa_Pointeurs(i)) Next
Exit Function
GererErreur: SLJS_RetirerPointeurs = -1 Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SLJS, gc_Element_SLJS, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

'=========================================================================================================================== Function SLJS_RetirerPointeur(p_JSON As String, p_Pointeur As String) As long On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_JSON As String Dim i As Integer Dim v_Pos As Long Dim v_Debut As Long Dim v_Fin As Long Dim v_Continue As Boolean
SLJS_RetirerPointeur = 0 Call SLJS_Initialisations
If p_JSON = "" Or p_Pointeur = "" Then Exit Function End If v_JSON = p_JSON v_Debut = 1
v_Pos = InStr(v_Debut, v_JSON, p_Pointeur) Do While v_Pos > 0 v_Continue = False v_Debut = v_Pos - 1 v_Fin = v_Pos + 1
' Trouver la fin du pointeur précédent (,) If Mid(v_JSON, v_Debut, 1) = |"| Then v_Debut = v_Debut - 1 Do Until Mid(v_JSON, v_Debut, 1) <> " " v_Debut = v_Debut - 1 Loop If Mid(v_JSON, v_Debut, 1) = |,| Then v_Debut = v_Debut + 1 v_Continue = True End If End If
If v_Continue Then v_Continue = False
' Trouver le séparateur (:) v_Pos = v_Pos + Len(p_Pointeur) If Mid(v_JSON, v_Pos, 1) = |"| Then v_Pos = v_Pos + 1 Do Until Mid(v_JSON, v_Debut, 1) <> " " v_Pos = v_Pos - 1 Loop If Mid(v_JSON, v_Pos, 1) = ":" Then v_Pos = v_Pos + 1
' Trouver le début de la valeur du pointeur Do Until Mid(v_JSON, v_Pos, 1) <> " " v_Pos = v_Pos + 1 Loop
v_Continue = True End If End If End If
If v_Continue Then ' Si une chaîne de caractères, trouver la fin de la chaîne If Mid(v_JSON, v_Pos, 1) = |"| Then v_Pos = InStr(v_Pos + 1, v_JSON, |"|) End If
' Trouver la fin du pointeur (,) v_Fin = InStr(v_Pos + 1, v_JSON, |,|) If v_Fin > 0 Then 'Retirer le pointeur du JSON v_JSON = Left(v_JSON, v_Debut - 1) & Right(v_JSON, Len(v_JSON) - v_Fin) SLJS_RetirerPointeur = SLJS_RetirerPointeur + 1 Else v_Debut = v_Fin End If Else v_Debut = v_Fin End If
If v_Debut > 0 Then v_Pos = InStr(v_Debut, v_JSON, p_Pointeur) Else v_Pos = 0 End if Loop
p_JSON = v_JSON Exit Function
GererErreur: SLJS_RetirerPointeur = -1 Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SLJS, gc_Element_SLJS, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

'=========================================================================================================================== Function SLJS_ExtraireArray(p_JSON As String, pa_Liste As Variant) As Integer On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_JSON As String Dim jsr As JSONReader Dim l_ResultatParse As Variant
Dim i As Integer Dim l_Items As Variant ReDim a_Liste(1000) As Variant Dim l_Liste List As Variant
SLJS_ExtraireArray = 0 v_JSON = Replace(Replace(p_JSON, Chr(13), ""), Chr(10), "") Set jsr = New JSONReader Set l_ResultatParse = jsr.Parse(v_JSON)
i = -1
l_Items = l_ResultatParse.Items If IsArray(l_ResultatParse.Items) Then ForAll v_Element In l_Items Select Case SLJS_ExtraireListe_Element(v_Element, CStr(i + 1), l_Liste) Case 1 : i = i + 1 If i > 0 And (i Mod 1000) = 0 Then ReDim Preserve a_Liste(UBound(a_Liste) + 1000) As Variant End If
a_Liste(i) = l_Liste SLJS_ExtraireArray = 1 Case 0 : Case Else : SLJS_ExtraireArray = -1 Exit Function End Select
End ForAll End If
If i >= 0 Then ReDim Preserve a_Liste(i) As Variant pa_Liste = a_Liste End If SLJS_ExtraireArray = i + 1 Exit Function
GererErreur: SLJS_ExtraireArray = -1 Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SLJS, gc_Element_SLJS, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

'=========================================================================================================================== Function SLJS_ExtraireListe_Element(p_ResultatParse As Variant, p_NomElement As String, pl_Liste List As Variant) As Integer On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_NomElement As string Dim l_Liste List As Variant Dim v_Liste As Variant Dim a_Liste() As Variant
SLJS_ExtraireListe_Element = 0 If p_NomElement <> "" Then v_NomElement = p_NomElement Else v_NomElement = xUnique("") End If
Select Case p_ResultatParse.valueType Case "O": Call SLJS_ExtraireListe_Objet(p_ResultatParse, v_NomElement, l_Liste) 'v_Liste = l_Liste pl_Liste(v_NomElement) = l_Liste Case "A": Call SLJS_ExtraireListe_Array(p_ResultatParse, v_NomElement, v_Liste) pl_Liste(v_NomElement) = v_Liste Case "S": ' String pl_Liste(v_NomElement) = Replace(CStr(p_ResultatParse.Value), |\"|, |"|) Case "#": ' Number pl_Liste(v_NomElement) = CDbl(p_ResultatParse.Value) Case "f": ' False pl_Liste(v_NomElement) = False Case "t": ' True pl_Liste(v_NomElement) = True Case "n": ' Null pl_Liste(v_NomElement) = "" Case "e": ' Error SLJS_ExtraireListe_Element = -2 Exit Function Case Else: pl_Liste(v_NomElement) = CStr(p_ResultatParse.Value) End Select
SLJS_ExtraireListe_Element = 1 Exit Function
GererErreur: SLJS_ExtraireListe_Element = -1 Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SLJS, gc_Element_SLJS, GetThreadInfo(1), p_NomElement, False) Exit Function End Function

'=========================================================================================================================== Function SLJS_ExtraireListe_Array(p_ResultatParse As Variant, p_NomArray As String, pa_Liste As Variant) As Integer On Error GoTo GererErreur

a_Liste(i) = l_Liste SLJS_ExtraireListe_Array = 1 Case 0 : Case Else : SLJS_ExtraireListe_Array = -1 Exit Function End Select
End ForAll End If
If i >= 0 then ReDim Preserve a_Liste(i) As Variant pa_Liste = a_Liste End If SLJS_ExtraireListe_Array = i + 1 Exit Function
GererErreur: SLJS_ExtraireListe_Array = -1 Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SLJS, gc_Element_SLJS, GetThreadInfo(1), p_NomArray, False) Exit Function End Function

'=========================================================================================================================== Function SLJS_ExtraireObjet(p_JSON As String, pl_Liste List As Variant) As Integer On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_JSON As String Dim jsr As JSONReader Dim l_ResultatParse As Variant Dim l_Items As Variant Dim v_NomElement As String
SLJS_ExtraireObjet = 0 v_JSON = Replace(Replace(p_JSON, Chr(13), ""), Chr(10), "") Set jsr = New JSONReader Set l_ResultatParse = jsr.Parse(v_JSON)
l_Items = l_ResultatParse.Items ForAll v_Element In l_Items v_NomElement = ListTag(v_Element) Select Case SLJS_ExtraireListe_Element(v_Element, v_NomElement, pl_Liste) Case 1 : SLJS_ExtraireObjet = 1 Case 0 : Case Else : SLJS_ExtraireObjet = -1 Exit Function End Select End ForAll Exit Function

'=================================================================================================================================================== Function ExtraireEnfants(p_NomObjet As String, pa_PointeursARetirer As Variant) As Integer On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_URL As String Dim v_Resultat As Integer Dim v_ResultatJSON As String Dim v_NbElem As Integer Dim jsr As JSONReader Dim l_JSON List As String Dim i As Integer Dim l_ResultatParse As Variant Dim v_NbEnfants As Integer Dim vcl_Enfant As SLSf_clObject Dim l_Records As Variant Dim lcl_Enfants List As SLSf_clObject

v_ResultatJSON = Replace(Replace(v_ResultatJSON, Chr(13), ""), Chr(10), "") If Len(v_ResultatJSON) > 65533 And IsArray(pa_PointeursARetirer) Then Call SLJS_RetirerPointeurs(v_ResultatJSON, pa_PointeursARetirer) End If
Call SLSf_SeparerListe(v_ResultatJSON, l_JSON) i = 1 Do While IsElement(l_JSON(CStr(i))) ' Extraire le nombre d'enfants Set jsr = New JSONReader Set l_ResultatParse = jsr.Parse(l_JSON(CStr(i)))
If i = 1 Then v_NbElem = l_ResultatParse.GetItem("totalSize").Value If v_NbElem = 0 Then Exit Do End If End If
' Construire la liste des enfants Set l_Records = l_ResultatParse.GetItem("records") ForAll o_Enfant In l_Records.jlist Set vcl_Enfant = New SLSf_clObject(Me.ConnexionAPI, "*", "*", "") Select Case SLJS_ExtraireListe_Objet(o_Enfant, "", vcl_Enfant.Contenu) Case 1 : vcl_Enfant.TypeObjet = o_Enfant.GetItem("attributes").GetItem("type").Value vcl_Enfant.Cle = o_Enfant.GetItem("Id").Value vcl_Enfant.URL = Me.ConnexionAPI.URL_API & "sobjects/" & vcl_Enfant.TypeObjet & "/" & vcl_Enfant.Cle Set lcl_Enfants(vcl_Enfant.Cle) = vcl_Enfant v_NbEnfants = v_NbEnfants + 1 Case 0 : Case Else : Me.Resultat = -279 Exit Function End Select End ForAll
i = i + 1 Loop
Me.NbEnfants(p_NomObjet) = v_NbEnfants Me.Enfants(p_NomObjet) = lcl_Enfants ExtraireEnfants = v_NbEnfants Exit Function
GererErreur: ExtraireEnfants = -24 Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SLSf, gc_Element_SLSf, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function
'=================================================================================================================================================== Function SauvegarderObjet() As Integer ' p_Type: D = Date, N = Nombre, autre = String, B = Boolean On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_URL As String Dim v_Data As String Dim v_Valeur As String Dim v_ResultatJSON As String Dim v_Resultat As Integer Dim l_Liste List As Variant
If Me.Resultat = 99 Then SauvegarderObjet = -278 Exit Function End If SauvegarderObjet = 0
' Construire le JSON de maj v_Data = "{" ForAll v_Element In Me.Maj_Valeur If IsList(v_Element) Then ' Développement futur... Else If v_Element = "" Then v_Valeur = "null" Else Select Case Me.Maj_Type(ListTag(v_Element)) Case "B": If v_Element Then v_Valeur = |true| Else v_Valeur = |false| End If Case "D": v_Valeur = Replace(Format(v_Element, "yyyy-mm-dd"), "/", "-") & "T" & Format(v_Element, "hh:nn:ss") If Right(v_Valeur, 9) = "T00:00:00" Then v_Valeur = StrLeftBack(v_Valeur, "T") End If v_Valeur = |"| & v_Valeur & |"| Case "N": v_Valeur = Replace(Format(v_Element, "Fixed"), ",", ".") Case Else v_Valeur = |"| & Replace(CStr(v_Element), |"|, |\"|) & |"| End Select End If End If
If Len(v_Data) = 1 then v_Data = v_Data & |"| & ListTag(v_Element) & |" : | & v_Valeur Else v_Data = v_Data & |, "| & ListTag(v_Element) & |" : | & v_Valeur End If End ForAll v_Data = v_Data & "}" If g_LogAPI_SLSf = 1 Then Call SIGE_AjouterLog("SauvegardeObjet - Data = " & v_Data, 0, 0, False) End If
' Envoyer le JSON à Salesforce If Me.Cle = "*" Then ' curl https://MyDomainName.my.salesforce.com/services/data/v56.0/sobjects/Account/ -H "Authorization: Bearer token" -H ' "Content-Type: application/json" -d "@newaccount.json" v_URL = Me.ConnexionAPI.URL_API & "sobjects/" & Me.TypeObjet v_Resultat = SLSf_ExecutePOST(v_URL, Me.ConnexionAPI.CleAcces, v_Data, v_ResultatJSON) Else v_Resultat = SLSf_ExecutePATCH(Me.URL, Me.ConnexionAPI.CleAcces, v_Data, v_ResultatJSON) End If If v_Resultat < 0 Then Me.Resultat = v_Resultat Exit Function End If SauvegarderObjet = 1
' Si nouvel objet, maj la clé If Me.Cle = "*" Then v_Resultat = SLJS_ExtraireObjet(v_ResultatJSON, l_Liste) If v_Resultat < 0 Then Me.Resultat = -280 Exit Function End If
If l_Liste("success") <> True Then Me.Resultat = -280 Exit Function End If
Me.Cle = l_Liste("id") Me.URL = Me.ConnexionAPI.URL_API & "sobjects/" & Me.TypeObjet & "/" & Me.Cle End If
' Maj les valeurs courantes ForAll v_Element In Me.Maj_Valeur If IsList(v_Element) Then ' Développement futur... Else Me.Contenu(ListTag(v_Element)) = v_Element End If End ForAll
Erase Me.Maj_Valeur Erase Me.Maj_Type Exit Function
GererErreur: SauvegarderObjet = -24 Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SLSf, gc_Element_SLSf, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

'=========================================================================================================================== Function SLSf_SeparerListe(p_JSON As String, pl_JSON List As String) As Long On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_JSON_Debut As String Dim v_JSON_Fin As String Dim v_Pos As Long Dim v_Pos_Debut As Long Dim v_Pos_Fin As Long Dim v_JSON As String Dim v_Bloc As String Dim i As Integer Dim v_Continue As Boolean
SLSf_SeparerListe = 0 Call SLJS_Initialisations
If p_JSON = "" Then Exit Function End If
v_Pos = InStr(p_JSON, |"records"|) v_Pos_Debut = InStr(v_Pos, p_JSON, |[|) v_Pos_Fin = Len(p_JSON) - Len(StrRightBack(p_JSON, |]|))
' Extraire l'entête du JSON v_JSON_Debut = Left(p_JSON, v_Pos_Debut) v_JSON_Fin = Right(p_JSON, Len(p_JSON) - v_Pos_Fin + 1)
' Extraire les blocs v_JSON = Trim(Mid(p_JSON, v_Pos_Debut + 1, v_Pos_Fin - v_Pos_Debut - 1)) i = 1 Do Until Len(v_JSON) <= 60000 v_Pos = InStr(50000, v_JSON, |},{|) If v_Pos = 0 Then v_Pos = InStr(40000, v_JSON, |},{|) End If v_Bloc = Left(v_JSON, v_Pos) pl_JSON(CStr(i)) = v_JSON_Debut & v_Bloc & v_JSON_Fin i = i + 1
v_JSON = Right(v_JSON, Len(v_JSON) - v_Pos - 1) Loop pl_JSON(CStr(i)) = v_JSON_Debut & v_JSON & v_JSON_Fin
SLSf_SeparerListe = 1 Exit Function
GererErreur: SLSf_SeparerListe = -1 Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SLJS, gc_Element_SLJS, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

' Retrieve the debug enabled setting v = gs(docProf, DEBUG_ON_ITEMNAME) iDebugOn = (v="" Or v="Yes")
' Retrieve the logging enabled setting v = gs(docProf, LOGGING_ON_ITEMNAME) iLoggingOn = (v <> "No")
' Retrieve the maximum log size v = gv(docProf, MAX_LOG_SIZE_NAME) If IsNumeric(v) Then lMaxLogSize = CLng(v) Else lMaxLogSize = DEFAULT_LOG_SIZE End If
' Retrieve the maximum buffered lines v = gv(docProf, BUFFERED_LINES) If IsNumeric(v) Then iMaxBufferedLines = CLng(v) Else iMaxBufferedLines = DEFAULT_BUFFERED_LINES End If
' Retrieve the recipients vRecipients = gvArr(docProf, RECIPIENTS_NAME) If Not IsEmpty(vRecipients) Then If IsArray(vRecipients) Then vRecipients = FullTrim(vRecipients) End If End If If vRecipients(0) = "" Then vRecipients(0) = DEFAULT_RECIPIENTS End If End Sub ' New
%REM Sub setCaller Description: process the calling procedure name. Prepends the agent name if available. %END REM Private Sub setCaller(sCallingProcName As String) Dim myName As String
If agtCurrent Is Nothing Then sLogCaller = sCallingProcName Else myName = Trim$(agtCurrent.Name) If InStr(myName, "|" ) > 0 Then myName = Trim$(StrLeft(myName, "|")) End If If myName = "" Then sLogCaller = sCallingProcName Else sLogCaller = myName & "::" & sCallingProcName End If End If End Sub ' setCaller
%REM Sub CloseLog %END REM Private Sub CloseLog ' Append the agent statistics to the log If Not docLog Is Nothing Then Call si("logInfos" , iInfos) Call si("logWarns" , iWarns) Call si("logErrors" , iErrors) Call si("logDebugs" , iDebugs) Call si("logMails" , iMails) ' Save the log document Call docLog.Save(True, False, True) iBufferedLines = 0 End If If Not nLog Is Nothing Then nLog.Close ' sends mail End If End Sub ' CloseLog
%REM Function CreateNewLogDocument %END REM Private Function CreateNewLogDocument As NotesDocument Dim namUser As NotesName ' Exit immediately if no valid Log db available If Not isLogDBValid Then Exit Function End If ' Initialization Set CreateNewLogDocument = Nothing Set namUser = New NotesName(ses.UserName) ' Create a new log document Set docLog = New NotesDocument(dbAgentLog) ' Set the fields Call si("Form" , FRM_LOG) Call si("CreatedBy" , namUser.Abbreviated) Call si("CreatedOn" , dtStart) Call si("Entity" , iIsEntity) Call si("EventName" , strName) Call si("Server" , namUser.Canonical) Call si("StartTime" , dtStart) Call si("EventList" , "") ' Reset the event counters iInfos = 0 iWarns = 0 iErrors = 0 iDebugs = 0 iMails = 0 iBufferedLines = 0 Call si("logInfos" , iInfos) Call si("logWarns" , iWarns) Call si("logErrors" , iErrors) Call si("logDebugs" , iDebugs) Call si("logMails" , iMails) ' Return the results Set CreateNewLogDocument = docLog End Function ' CreateNewLogDocument
%REM Function isValidDoc Description: returns if passed in NotesDocument is a valid document %END REM Private Function isValidDoc(doc As NotesDocument) As Boolean isValidDoc = False If doc Is Nothing Then Exit Function If doc.Size = 0 Or doc.IsDeleted Or Not doc.IsValid Then Exit Function isValidDoc = True End Function ' isValidDoc

%REM Function GetLogDocument %END REM Private Function GetLogDocument As NotesDocument Dim namUser As NotesName Dim aKeys(0 To 1) As String
' Exit immediately if no valid log db If Not isLogDBValid Then Exit Function End If ' Initialization Set GetLogDocument = Nothing Set namUser = New NotesName(ses.UserName) ' Find the last log document for the current agent in the logs view aKeys(0) = namUser.Abbreviated aKeys( 1) = strName Set docLog = vwLogs.GetDocumentByKey(aKeys, True) ' Create a new log document if none was found If(docLog Is Nothing) Then Set docLog = CreateNewLogDocument Else ' Retrieve the last event counters iInfos = docLog.logInfos(0) iWarns = docLog.logWarns(0) iErrors = docLog.logErrors(0) iDebugs = docLog.logDebugs(0) iMails = docLog.logMails(0) End If ' Return the results Set GetLogDocument = docLog End Function ' GetLogDocument
%REM Sub MailEvent 2021-03-22 Lars: kept for historic purposes. Superseded for now by new development in LogEvent method Commented for runtime space usage %End REM Private Sub MailEvent(strMessage As String) %REM Dim docMemo As NotesDocument Dim rtitmBody As NotesRichTextItem
Set docMemo = dbAgentLog.CreateDocument Call docMemo.ReplaceItemValue("Form", FRM_MEMO) Call docMemo.ReplaceItemValue("SendTo", vRecipients) Call docMemo.ReplaceItemValue("Subject", "Error occured in application " + dbAgentLog.Title) Call docMemo.ReplaceItemValue("Principal", VAL_PRINCIPAL) Call docMemo.ReplaceItemValue("Message", strMessage) 'calculate body of memo Set rtitmBody = New NotesRichTextItem(docMemo, FLD_BODY) Call rtitmBody.AppendText("Dear Sir/Madam," + LF + LF) Call rtitmBody.AppendText("An error occured in application " + dbAgentLog.Title + LF + LF) Call rtitmBody.AppendText(strMessage + LF) 'add database link if not run on local If dbAgentLog.Server <> "" Then Call rtitmBody.AppendText("Link to database ->") Call rtitmBody.AppendDoclink(dbAgentLog, "Open Database") End If 'send Call docMemo.Send(False) %END REM End Sub ' MailEvent

%REM Sub LogEvent %END REM Public Sub LogEvent(iEventType As Integer, sEventMessage As String) Dim itmField As NotesItem Dim lLogSize As Long Dim hasLines As Boolean Dim sPreLog As String Dim sLogText As String Dim sLine As String Dim vEventMessage As Variant Dim strNow As String Dim vNu As New NotesDateTime("") ' Exit immediately if logging is disabled or debugevent and debuglog is off If Not iLoggingOn Then Exit Sub If iEventType = LOG_DEBUG And Not iDebugOn Then Exit Sub
vEventMessage = Split(sEventMessage, CR & LF) hasLines =(Lbound(vEventMessage) <> Ubound(vEventMessage)) Forall s In vEventMessage sLine = Trim$(s) If sLine <> "" Then Call vNu.SetNow ' get Now
If isInValidDoc(docLog) Then ' Check log document Set docLog = GetLogDocument Else ' Check whether the log document size exceeds the maximum size lLogSize = docLog.Size If lLogSize > lMaxLogSize Then Call CloseLog Set docLog = CreateNewLogDocument End If End If ' Put the end time on the log document Call si("FinishTime", vNu) strNow = Format$(vNU.Lslocaltime, "yyyy-mm-dd hh:nn:ss") ' Compose the log text Select Case iEventType Case LOG_INFO iInfos = iInfos + 1 sPreLog = LOG_INFO_PREFIX Case LOG_WARN iWarns = iWarns + 1 sPreLog = LOG_WARN_PREFIX Case LOG_ERROR iErrors = iErrors + 1 sPreLog = LOG_ERROR_PREFIX Case LOG_DEBUG If iDebugOn Then iDebugs = iDebugs + 1 sPreLog = LOG_DEBUG_PREFIX End If Case LOG_MAIL iMails = iMails + 1 sPreLog = LOG_MAIL_PREFIX End Select If hasLines Then sLogText = strNow + " " + sPreLog + " " + TB + Trim$(s) Else sLogText = strNow + " " + sPreLog + " " + Trim$(s) End If If iEventType = LOG_MAIL Then ' a Mail event starts the mail log If nLog Is Nothing Then ' first time? Set nLog = New NotesLog(strName) nlog.OpenMailLog vRecipients, strName End If ' old: Call MailEvent(sLogText) If iEventType = LOG_ERROR Then nlog.Logerror errNum, sLogText Else nLog.LogAction sLogText End If End If
If isLogDBValid Then ' Add the log text to the events field Set itmField = docLog.GetFirstItem("EventList") Call itmField.AppendToTextList(sLogText) ' Save the log document If(iMaxBufferedLines = 0) Then 'no buffering enabled. save log document Call docLog.Save(True, False, True) Elseif(iBufferedLines >= iMaxBufferedLines) Then 'log limit reached, save document and reset buffer Call docLog.Save(True, False, True) iBufferedLines = 0 Else 'buffer message iBufferedLines = iBufferedLines + 1 End If Else Print sLogText ' write to console if no log db End If ' isLogDBValid End If End Forall End Sub ' LogEvent

' Option Public ' deprecated Option Declare %REM Library lsJSONReader Version 3.8
Read JSON into LotusScript objects according to JSON.org https://www.json.org/json-en.html and ECMA 404 standard https://www.ecma-international.org/wp-content/uploads/ECMA-404_2nd_edition_december_2017.pdf and RFC8259 https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8259
please note that RFC8259 has stricter recommendations than ECMA-404, like the recommendation that names in a JSON object with name/value pairs be unique within the same level. Example: {"Names":{"Names":"Jane Doe"}} is OK {"Names":{"Names":"Jane Doe"},"Names":{"Names":"Jane Eyre"}} is not. While the grammar does not mandate uniquene names, different JSON libraries handle this in different ways: use only first, use last, throw an error. So for maximum compatibility, it is best to use unique names.
use the JSONWrapperConverters instead of JSONArray and JSONObject if you need the ability to convert the JSONObject or JSONArray to a JSON string

' Private sEscapes List As String ' a list of escape characters '************************************************* %REM Class JSONReader Version: 1.0.6 Original Author: Troy Reimer (treimer@snapps.com) Author Lars Berntrop-Bos (lars@planet.nl)
Purpose: This class provides a way to parse JSON text into a JSONValue object. It may contain a JSONValue with a simple type, or a more complex combination of JSONValue object, representing JSON Objects or Arrays in any combination. However, it will always return a JSONValue object (if the JSON is valid). The JSONObject and JSONArray subtypes classes have an Items property. You can put the value of the returned object Items property into a variant then step through the results.
according to JSON.org https://www.json.org/json-en.html and ECMA 404 standard https://www.ecma-international.org/wp-content/uploads/ECMA-404_2nd_edition_december_2017.pdf and RFC8259 https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8259
This class uses the ls.class.JSONArray and ls.class.JSONObject classes.
Example: dim sJSON as String dim jsonReader as JSONReader dim vResults as Variant dim vPieces as Variant set jsonReader = New JSONReader sJSON = |{"a":[15,25],"b":"Some text"}| vResults = jsonReader.Parse(sJSON) 'this is a JSONObject vPieces = vResults.Items
Methods: Parse(JSON string)
Version : 1.0.7 Author: Lars Berntrop-Bos moved STATIC objects to globals moved error handler to the base class made all classes subclasses of base class moved error handler variables to private globals in the base class library (where they should be)
Version: 2.0 Changed handling of strings into Unicode codes resulting in a massive speed up.
Version: 3.0 Author: Lars Berntrop-Bos Output was hard to use. Also had parsing bugs. And slow because Variants. Now more strictly implements the standard as published on json.org Using Variants is no longer necessary. You can use the JSONValue object. The old way of using .Items and .Count still works. But re-coding to avoid Variant is faster!
Version 3.9 Author: Lars Berntrop-Bos - updated library lsAgentLog to not have an Sub Initialize - updated lsJSONValue to disable Option Public and enable Option Declare, exposing a couple of bugs - updated refrences to JSON specifications
%END REM Public Class JSONReader 'vToken As Variant ' the current token value vArr As Variant ' receiver for ns.Read ns As NotesStream ' Stream to handle string jToken As JSONValue tail As String ' holder for last couple of characters for debugging iIndex As Long ' the current character index iPrevIndex As Long ' the previous character index iLen As Long ' the current string length uniPrevPrev As Long ' the previous previous char as uni uniPrev As Long ' the previous char as uni uniChar As Long ' the current char as Uni uniNext As Long ' the next char as Uni arrLB As Integer ' receiver Lower Bound arrUB As Integer ' receiver Upper Bound arrUpper As Integer ' receiver Upper bound last position arrUpperNext As Integer ' receiver Upper bound last position next idxArr As Integer ' receiver index justReadBlock As Integer ' just read a Block in GetNext
%REM Sub Parse Purpose: The only public method for this class. It returns a JSONValue object created from parsing the input JSON string. Input: sJSON: The JSON string to parse Output: JSONValue if a JSON string with invalid content was passed, the returned JSONValue object wiil be of typeJSONError, and its Value will hold the error message If a programming error occurs, a LotusScript Error will be thrown Calls: ParseMe %END REM Public Function Parse(sJSON As String) As JSONValue Const proc = cJR + "Parse" If noDebug Then On Error Goto bublUp
Dim lenLeft As Long Dim posPart As Long ' positioon in Dim block As Long ' length of current block to use with WritetText
Const blkSize = 8000&
If Not listsInited Then Call initLists
' trim control characters (e.g. like LF and CR, spaces) from the beginning and end of the string sJSON = myTrim(sJSON)
iLen = Len(sJSON) ' check for empty string If iLen = 0 Then Set Parse = Nothing Error 1000, ERR_1000 End If
' init NotesStream Set ns = ses.CreateStream
' iLen = ns.WriteText(sJSON) ' a Czech consumer of the Turbo classes found that it failed on JSON having long lines of Czech text in May 2022 ' this turns out to be a problem with having lots of UTF-8 multi-byte (UTF-8 can be 1 to 4 bytes long) ' to mitigate ns.WriteText mangling long lines of UTF-8 multi-byte characters, cut up the string in parts, blkSize a guess is 8000 If iLen < blkSize Then ' if not bigger than block ns.WriteText sJSON Else posPart = 1 lenLeft = iLen Do While lenLeft > 0 If lenLeft >= blkSize Then block = blkSize Else block = lenLeft End If If block <> ns.WriteText(Mid$(sJson, posPart, blkSize)) Then Error 1204, ERR_1209 End If posPart = posPart + blkSize lenLeft = lenLeft - blkSize Loop End If ' iLen < blkSize ' Print "Parsing of " + CStr(iLen) + " JSON character string started"
ns.Position = 0 justReadBlock = False readUniArr iIndex = 0 iPrevIndex = -1
' setup uniChar vars uniPrevPrev = 0 ' the previous previous char as uni uniPrev = 0 ' the previous char as uni uniChar = CLng(vArr(idxArr)) + CLng(vArr(idxArr + 1)) * 256& If idxArr + 2 < arrUB Then uniNext = CLng(vArr(idxArr + 2)) + CLng(vArr(idxArr + 3)) * 256& ' the next char as unicode Else uniNext = 0 End If
ParseError ' parse and transform JSON syntax erors in error object If jToken Is Nothing Then Error 1001, ERR_1001 + errTail ' assert that this token is a value Else Set Parse = jToken End If Exit Function
bublUp: Error Err, addBubblEr(proc, Erl, Err) End Function ' Parse
%REM Sub ParseError transform a JSON syntax error into a message %END REM Private Sub ParseError Const proc = cJR + "ParseError" On Error GoTo testErr
Dim msg As String
ParseMe typeJSONNull ' exitSub: Exit Sub testErr: If Err < 1000 Or Err > 1199 Then GoTo bublUp
msg = getErrorMessageAndClear(Error$, proc, Erl, Err) ' JSON syntax error, get message and clear error Err = 0 'it turns out simply setting Err to 0 in getErrorMessageAndClear does not really clear the error Resume createErr ' a Resume is needed createErr: On Error GoTo bublUp Set jToken = New JSONValue(typeJSONError) ' create error value jToken.Value = msg 'save message GoTo exitSub bublUp: Error Err, addBubblEr(proc, Erl, Err) End Sub ' ParseError
%REM Sub readUniArr read block of integers from the unicode string into variant array of integer need to reconstitute the Long values from two integers %END REM Private Sub readUniArr Const proc = cJR + "readUniArr" If noDebug Then On Error GoTo bublUp
vArr = ns.Read(65534) ' read max even number of bytes arrLB = LBound(vArr) arrUB = UBound(vArr) ' Stop arrUpper = arrUB - 1 ' precalc last Position of idxArr If arrLB = -32768 And arrUB = 32765 then arrUpperNext = arrUB - 3 ' precalc last Next Position of idxArr Else arrUpperNext = arrUB - 2 ' precalc last Next Position of idxArr End If idxArr = arrLB Exit Sub
bublUp: Error Err, addBubblEr(proc, Erl, Err) End Sub ' readUniArr
%REM Sub getTail Return tail of last <tailLen> characters (control characters skipped!) up to point of parsing %END REM Private Function getTail As String Const proc = cJR + "getTail" Dim vUniTail As Variant ' Receiver for tail read from NotesStream Dim tailBegin As Long Dim tailEnd As Long Dim uniC As Long Dim lbV As Long Dim ubV As Long Dim i As Integer
tailEnd = iIndex * 2 tailBegin = (iIndex - tailLen) * 2 If tailBegin < 0 Then tailBegin = 0 If tailBegin = tailEnd Or ns Is Nothing Then getTail = "<No tail available>" Exit Function End If uniC = ns.Position ' save ns Position ns.Position = tailBegin ' set begin position for tail vUniTail = ns.Read(tailEnd - tailBegin) 'read tail array ns.Position = uniC ' restore position tail = "" lbV = LBound(vUniTail) ubV = UBound(vUniTail) For i = lbV To ubV Step 2 uniC = CLng(vUniTail(i)) + CLng(vUniTail(i + 1)) * 256& If uniC >= uniSPACE Then tail = tail + UChr$(uniC) End If Next i getTail = tail End Function ' getTail
Function errTail As String errTail = ", tail: " + getTail End Function 'errTail
%REM Function myTrim
Alternative for native trim, which neglects to snip off trailing LF and CR This version strips any control characters found at the beginning or the end of the sinput String
by Matthias Wille 2015-07-11, enhanced by Lars Berntrop-Bos %END REM Private Function myTrim(strSource As String) As String Const proc = cJR + "myTrim" Dim idxL As Long Dim idxR As Long
myTrim = "" uniChar = 0 idxL = 1 idxR = Len(strSource) Do Until idxL >= idxR If Uni(Mid$(strSource, idxL, 1)) > uniSPACE Then Exit Do ' found a non-control char, done idxL = idxL + 1 Loop Do Until idxR <= idxL If Uni(Mid$(strSource, idxR, 1)) > uniSPACE Then Exit Do ' found a non-control char, done idxR = idxR - 1 Loop If idxL <= idxR Then myTrim = Mid$(strSource, idxL, idxR - idxL + 1) End If End Function ' myTrim
%REM Sub ParseMe Purpose: This function tries to get the next token in the remaining string and returns it as a JSONValue object
Output: A JSONValue object in jToken Calls: CreateJSONArray, CreateJSONObject, GetNextNonWSChar, GetNextChar, CreateJSONNumber, GetStringValue %END REM Private Sub ParseMe(parseType As String) Const proc = cJR + "ParseMe" If noDebug Then On Error GoTo bublUp
Dim parsedType As String * 1
If iPrevIndex >= 0 Then GetNextNonWSChar ' get next char If iIndex = iPrevIndex Then Error 1200, ERR_1200 + errTail ' infinite loop
iPrevIndex = iIndex ' parseType switches parsing behaviour. If parseType not typeJSONArrayEnd or typeJSONObject, only a JSON Value Start is allowed. ' If parseType = typeJSONArrayEnd, only arrayEnd or scalar or object start or array start is allowed ' If parseType = typeJSONObject, only a scalar or object start or array start is allowed Select Case uniChar ' parse current char ' first, teast for scalar or Object start of array start
Case uniQuote ' string (scalar) GetNextCharString Set jToken = CreateJSONString(GetStringValue)
Case uniMinus, uni0 To uni9 ' a numeric value (scalar) Set jToken = CreateJSONNumber
Case uniObjOpen ' begin object Set jToken = CreateJSONObject
Case uniArrayOpen ' begin array Set jToken = CreateJSONArray
Case uniFalse, uniNull, uniTrue ' false, null, true are JSON constants (scalar) parsedType = typeJSONError Select Case uniChar Case uniTrue If uniNext = uniTrue2 Then ' assert 'true' GetNextChar If uniNext = uniTrue3 Then GetNextChar If uniNext = uniTrue4 Then parsedType = typeJSONTrue End If End If Case uniFalse If uniNext = uniFalse2 Then ' assert 'false' GetNextChar If uniNext = uniFalse3 Then GetNextChar If uniNext = uniFalse4 Then GetNextChar If uniNext = uniFalse5 Then parsedType = typeJSONFalse End If End If End If Case uniNull If uniNext = uniUnicode Then ' assert 'null' GetNextChar If uniNext = uniNull3 Then GetNextChar If uniNext = uniNull3 Then parsedType = typeJSONNull End If End If End Select If parsedType <> typeJSONError Then ' If a valid seqence was found GetNextNonWSChar ' get next char Select Case uniNext Case uniObjClose, uniArrayClose, uniCOMMA ' valid end? ' no change Case Else parsedType = typeJSONError End Select End If If parsedType = typeJSONError Then Error 1002, ERR_1002 + errTail
Set jToken = New JSONValue(parsedType)
Case Else ' no valid JSON, or extra parsing because of parseType Select Case parseType Case typeJSONArrayEnd ' besides above only AraayEnd allowed If uniChar <> uniArrayClose Then Error 1006, ERR_1006 + errTail ' no value or arrayEnd for array Set jToken = ARRAY_END
Case typeJSONObject ' only a scalar or object startor array start allowed Error 1005, ERR_1005 + errTail ' assert colon is followed by a value
Case Else ' for other parseType values, other uniChars allowed Select Case uniChar Case uniObjClose ' end object Set jToken = OBJECT_END
Case uniArrayClose ' end array Set jToken = ARRAY_END
Case uniCOMMA ' comma Set jToken = COMMA
Case uniColon ' colon Set jToken = COLON
Case Else ' no valid uniChar found Error 1001, ERR_1001 + errTail
End Select ' uniChar End Select ' parseType End Select ' uniChar Exit Sub bublUp: Error Err, addBubblEr(proc, Erl, Err) End Sub ' ParseMe
%REM Sub ParseMeCommaObjectEnd Purpose: This function tries to get the next token in the remaining string and returns it as a JSONValue object The characters the parser will accept is restricted to ',' COMMA and '}' ObjectEnd
If a correct char is not found, throws error 1008
Output: A JSONValue object in jToken Calls: GetNextNonWSChar
%END REM Private Sub ParseMeCommaObjectEnd Const proc = cJR + "ParseMeCommaObjectEnd" If noDebug Then On Error GoTo bublUp
If iPrevIndex >= 0 Then GetNextNonWSChar If iIndex = iPrevIndex Then Error 1200, ERR_1200 ' infinite loop iPrevIndex = iIndex Select Case uniChar ' parse current char Case uniCOMMA ' comma Set jToken = COMMA Case uniObjClose ' end object Set jToken = OBJECT_END Case Else ' not valid Error 1008, ERR_1008 + errTail ' not a valid Object continuation End Select Exit Sub bublUp: Error Err, addBubblEr(proc, Erl, Err) End Sub ' ParseMeMeObjectEnd
%REM Sub ParseMeCommaArrayEnd Purpose: This function tries to get the next token in the remaining string and returns it as a JSONValue object The characters the parser will accept is restricted to ',' COMMA and '}' ArrayEnd
An INCORRECT token will throw error 1010
Output: A JSONValue object in jToken Calls: GetNextNonWSChar
%END REM Private Sub ParseMeCommaArrayEnd Const proc = cJR + "ParseMeCommaArrayEnd" If noDebug Then On Error GoTo bublUp
If iPrevIndex >= 0 Then GetNextNonWSChar If iIndex = iPrevIndex Then Error 1200, ERR_1200 + errTail ' infinite loop iPrevIndex = iIndex Select Case uniChar ' parse current char Case uniCOMMA ' comma Set jToken = COMMA Case uniArrayClose ' end Array Set jToken = Array_END Case Else ' not valid Error 1010, ERR_1010 + errTail End Select Exit Sub bublUp: Error Err, addBubblEr(proc, Erl, Err) End Sub ' ParseMeMeArrayEnd
%REM Sub CreateJSONArray Purpose: This function creates and populates a JSONValue object of type JSONArray with all of its values. Output: A populated JSONArray object Calls: ParseMeValueArrayEnd, %END REM Private Function CreateJSONArray As JSONValue Const proc = cJR + "CreateJSONArray" If noDebug Then On Error Goto bublUp
Dim jsonArray As JSONValue
Set jsonArray = New JSONValue(typeJSONArray) Do ParseMe typeJSONArrayEnd If jToken.isNotTokenArrayEnd Then jsonArray.AddItemValue "", jToken ParseMeCommaArrayEnd ' check for COMMA or ArrayEnd End If Loop Until jToken.isTokenArrayEnd Set CreateJSONArray = jsonArray Exit Function bublUp: Error Err, addBubblEr(proc, Erl, Err) End Function ' CreateJSONArray
%REM Function CreateJSONObject Description: This function creates and populates a JSONValue object of type JSONObject with all of its values. Output: A populated JSONObject object Calls: ParseMe, SkipWhiteSpace %END REM Private Function CreateJSONObject As JSONValue Const proc = cJR + "CreateJSONObject" If noDebug Then On Error GoTo bublUp
Dim jsonObject As JSONValue Dim sKey As String
Set jsonObject = New JSONValue(typeJSONObject)
Do GetNextNonWSChar If uniChar = uniQuote Then GetNextCharString sKey = GetStringValue GetNextNonWSChar If uniChar <> uniCOLON Then Error 1004, ERR_1004 + errTail ' assert key is followed by a colon ParseMe typeJSONObject ' get value token, failure throws error 1005 jsonObject.AddItemValue sKey, jToken ParseMeCommaObjectEnd ' check for COMMA or ObjectEnd Else If uniChar <> uniObjClose Then Error 1003, ERR_1003 + errTail ' no name for object member ' assert token is a string name End If End If Loop Until uniChar = uniObjClose Set CreateJSONObject = jsonObject Exit Function bublUp: Error Err, addBubblEr(proc, Erl, Err) End Function ' CreateJSONObject
%REM Function CreateJSONString Purpose: This function creates and populates a JSONValue object type string with its value. Output: A populated JSONValue object %END REM Private Function CreateJSONString(strValue As String) As JSONValue Const proc = cJR + "CreateJSONString" If noDebug Then On Error GoTo bublUp Set CreateJSONString = New JSONValue(typeJSONString) CreateJSONString.Value = strValue Exit Function bublUp: Error Err, addBubblEr(proc, Erl, Err) End Function ' CreateJSONString
%REM Sub incPointer %END REM Private Sub incPointer Const proc = cJR + "incPointer" iIndex = iIndex + 1 'increment character pointer If iIndex > iLen Then Error 1201, ERR_1201 + errTail ' for some reason we are trying to move past the last character. uniPrevPrev = uniPrev uniPrev = uniChar uniChar = uniNext End Sub ' incPointer
%REM Sub GetNextChar Purpose: moves the "pointer" to the next character in the string. This call should not be used for getting JSON string values, only parts where whitespace is allowed Output: next character in the string (via uniChar) %END REM Private Sub GetNextChar Const proc = cJR + "GetNextChar" If noDebug Then On Error Goto bublUp
incPointer If iIndex = iLen Then uniNext = 0 ' zero terminated string Exit Sub End If If uniChar < uniSPACE Then ' in whitespace certain control characters are allowed Select Case uniChar Case uniTAB, uniLF, uniCR ' We let through TAB, LineFeed, CarriageReturn Case Else Error 1007, ERR_1007 + CStr(unichar) + errTail ' all other control characters are illegal End Select End If handleBlock Exit Sub bublUp: Error Err, addBubblEr(proc, Erl, Err) End Sub ' GetNextChar
%REM Sub GetNextCharString
Purpose: moves the "pointer" to the next character in the string.
Does not allow control characters like TAB, CR and LF
Output: next character in the string (via uniChar) %END REM Private Sub GetNextCharString Const proc = cJR + "GetNextCharString" If noDebug Then On Error GoTo bublUp
incPointer If iIndex = iLen Then uniNext = 0 ' zero terminated string Exit Sub End If If uniChar < uniSPACE Then Error 1007, ERR_1007 + CStr(unichar) + errTail ' all control characters are illegal in a JSON string End If handleBlock Exit Sub bublUp: Error Err, addBubblEr(proc, Erl, Err) End Sub ' GetNextCharString
%REM Sub handleBlock handle reading next block of byte array if needed %END REM Private Sub handleBlock Const proc = cJR + "handleblock" If idxArr >= arrUpperNext Then ' if at upper position roll over to next block of integer readUniArr uniNext = CLng(vArr(idxArr)) + CLng(vArr(idxArr + 1)) * 256& justReadBlock = True Else If justReadBlock Then justReadBlock = False Else idxArr = idxArr + 2 ' byte array, so move by two End If If idxArr < arrUpper Then uniNext = CLng(vArr(idxArr + 2)) + CLng(vArr(idxArr + 3)) * 256& Else uniNext = 0 End If End If End Sub ' handleBlock
%REM Sub GetNextNonWSChar Purpose: moves the "pointer" to the next non-ws character in the string. Output: next character in the string (via uniChar) %END REM Private Sub GetNextNonWSChar Do GetNextChar Loop Until uniChar > uniSPACE End Sub ' GetNextNonWSChar
%REM Function CreateJSONNumber Purpose: returns either a Long or Double value for the numeric string being parsed. looks ahead while parsing using uniNext because unlike a string, a number is not delimited by a quote Output: Long or Double number Calls: GetDigits, GetNextChar %END REM Private Function CreateJSONNumber As JSONValue Const proc = cJR + "CreateJSONNumber" If noDebug Then On Error GoTo bublUp
Dim vEval As Variant Dim sReturn As String Dim isFloatingPoint As Integer
' this is called whith uniChar guaranteed to be a number or a minus sReturn = UChr$(uniChar) ' a minus MUST be followed by a digit in a valid JSON number If uniChar = uniMinus Then If uniNext < uni0 or uniNext > uni9 Then Error 1013, ERR_1013 + CStr(uniNext) + errTail ' non-digit found sReturn = sReturn + UChr$(uniNext) GetNextChar ' error raised when reading a nonws control char End If '' process rest of number ' a zero can be the only number or followed by a period with further 1 or more digits, and may be followed by an exponent (pointless if only a zero before the exponent, but valid) ' a 1-9 can be followed by further digits until a non digit is found If uniChar > uni0 Then ' read further digits Do While uniNext >= uni0 And uniNext <= uni9 sReturn = sReturn + UChr$(uniNext) GetNextChar ' error raised when reading a nonws control char Loop End If ' all digits till end of number or period or Exponent char read ' a period MUST be followed by a digit in a valid JSON number If uniNext = uniPERIOD Then isFloatingPoint = True sReturn = sReturn + UChr$(uniNext) '&&&&&&&&&&&& PBE GetNextChar If uniNext < uni0 Or uniNext > uni9 Then Error 1012, ERR_1012 + CStr(uniNext) + errTail ' non-digit found after period sReturn = sReturn + UChr$(uniNext) ' add found number ' get rest of fraction GetNextChar Do While uniNext >= uni0 And uniNext <= uni9 sReturn = sReturn + UChr$(uniNext) GetNextChar ' error raised when reading a nonws control char Loop End If ' fraction read, test for exponent If uniNext = uniExp Or uniNext = uniExpE Then ' an exponent may be followed by a plus or a minus, and 1 or more digits isFloatingPoint = True sReturn = sReturn + cExpE ' in LotusScript, the exp char is a capital E GetNextChar If uniNext = uniPlus Or uniNext = uniMinus Then sReturn = sReturn + UChr$(uniNext) GetNextChar ' error raised when reading a nonws control char Else ' In LotusScript, an exponentiation char needs to be followed by a Plus or a Minus ' so if no plus or minus is there, a plus is inserted sReturn = sReturn + cPlus End If ' first char after exp after plus or minus has been processed MUST be a digit If uniNext < uni0 Or uniNext > uni9 Then Error 1014, ERR_1014 + CStr(uniNext) + errTail ' non-digit found after exponent char ' add digits to exponent, exponent is gathered in sExponent to guard against overflow Do While uniNext >= uni0 And uniNext <= uni9 sReturn = sReturn + UChr$(uniNext) GetNextChar ' error raised when reading a nonws control char Loop End If
' return either a double or long value Set CreateJSONNumber = New JSONValue(typeJSONNumber) If noDebug Then On Error Resume Next ' protect against overflow ' the overflow error is converted to a more appropiate error message. Unless this tanks performance. If isFloatingPoint Then ' convert to the current locale if possible sReturn = Join(Split(sReturn, cPERIOD), sDecimalSeparator) CreateJSONNumber.Value = CDbl(sReturn) If Err <> 0 Then Err = 0 ' reset error state If noDebug Then On Error GoTo bublUp ' reset error handler to handle raised error message Error 1015, ERR_1015 + sReturn + errTail End If Else CreateJSONNumber.Value = CLng(sReturn) If Err <> 0 Then Err = 0 ' reset error state If noDebug Then On Error GoTo bublUp ' reset error handler to handle raised error message Error 1016, ERR_1016 + sReturn + errTail End If End If Exit Function bublUp: Error Err, addBubblEr(proc, Erl, Err) End Function ' CreateJSONNumber
%REM Function GetStringValue Purpose: This function returns the string value contained within quotes. It also accounts for unicode characters and escape characters. Output: The string value Calls: GetNextCharString %END REM Private Function GetStringValue As String Const proc = cJR + "GetStringValue" If noDebug Then On Error GoTo bublUp
Dim sReturn As String Dim arrUni(5) As String * 1 Dim vEval As Variant Dim x As Integer
Do While uniChar <> uniQuote If uniChar = uniBackslash Then ' escape character found, reverse solidus '\' GetNextCharString ' Error on control char If uniChar = uniUnicode Then ' unicode character 'u' Erase arrUni arrUni(0) = "&" arrUni(1) = "H" For x = 2 To 5 'retrieve the four hex digit unicode Select Case uniNext ' filter uniNext for illigal characters Case uni0 To uni9, uniAlphaA To uniFalse, uniAlphaAA To Uni(UCase$(cFalse)) arrUni(x) = UChr$(uniNext) Case Else Error 1018, ERR_1018 + "\u" + Trim$(Join(arrUni, "")) + " illegal code: " + CStr(uniNext) + errTail End Select GetNextCharString Next sReturn = sReturn + UChr$(CLng(Join(arrUni, ""))) Else ' transform if this is a legal escaped char If IsElement(uniEscapes(uniChar)) Then sReturn = sReturn + uniEscapes(uniChar) Else ' raise error about invalid escape char Error 1017, ERR_1017 + UChr$(uniChar) + errTail End If End If Else sReturn = sReturn + UChr$(uniChar) If uniChar = uniQuote Then Exit Do End If GetNextCharString Loop
' GetNextChar ' advance past Quote GetStringValue = sReturn Exit Function bublUp: Error Err, addBubblEr(proc, Erl, Err) End Function 'GetStringValue
%REM Sub Terminate on end of life of object, explicitly close stream %END REM Sub Terminate Const proc = cJR + "Terminate" If Not ns Is Nothing Then ns.Close Set ns = Nothing End Sub ' Terminate
' JSONReader End Class

%REM Sub initLists Init Globals and constant Objects once %END REM Private Sub initLists Const proc = cJR + "init" If noDebug Then On Error GoTo bublUp
If ses Is Nothing Then initAgentLog
sDecimalSeparator = Left$(CStr(Fraction(0.1)), 1)
Set OBJECT_END = New JSONValue(typeJSONObjectEnd) Set ARRAY_END = New JSONValue(typeJSONArrayEnd) Set COLON = New JSONValue(typeJSONColon) Set COMMA = New JSONValue(typeJSONComma) Set jNull = New JSONValue(typeJSONNull) Set jError = New JSONValue(typeJSONError)
uniEscapes(uniQuote) = cQuote uniEscapes(uniBackSlash) = cBackSlash uniEscapes(uniSlash) = cSlash uniEscapes(Uni(|b|)) = cBACKSPACE uniEscapes(Uni(|f|)) = FF uniEscapes(Uni(|n|)) = LF uniEscapes(Uni(|r|)) = CR uniEscapes(Uni(|t|)) = cTAB
listsInited = True Exit Sub bublUp: Error Err, addBubblEr(proc, Erl, Err) End Sub ' initLists

%REM Library lsJSONValue Created Jun 14, 2021 by Lars Berntrop-Bos/SKG
v 3.9
JSON values, according to JSON.org https://www.json.org/json-en.html and ECMA 404 standard https://www.ecma-international.org/wp-content/uploads/ECMA-404_2nd_edition_december_2017.pdf and RFC8259 https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8259 %END REM ' Option Public Option Declare
Use "SL_JSONAgentLog_T"

Const cJV = "JSONValue::" ' error numbers 1200 and above are reserved for programming errors. These errors are thrown to the caller of JSONReader.Parse Const ERR_1202 = "CR or LF in JSON name" Const ERR_1203 = "Cannot add an object to a scalar value" Const ERR_1204 = "Error on New JSONValue, invalid jsonType specified: '" Const ERR_1205 = "Can only return a count for an Object or an Array" Const ERR_1206 = "Programming error: Object or Array count below zero" ' character constants Const cQuote = |"| ' Public consts for use with JSONValue Public Const typeJSONNull = UChr$(Uni("n" )) ' 110 Public Const typeJSONFalse = UChr$(Uni("f")) ' 70 Public Const typeJSONTrue = UChr$(Uni("t")) ' 84 Public Const typeJSONNumber = UChr$(Uni("#")) ' 35 Public Const typeJSONString = UChr$(Uni("S")) ' 83 Public Const typeJSONArray = UChr$(Uni("A")) ' 65 Public Const typeJSONArrayEnd = UChr$(Uni("Æ")) ' 198 Public Const typeJSONObject = UChr$(Uni("O")) ' 79 Public Const typeJSONObjectEnd = UChr$(Uni("Œ")) ' 338 Public Const typeJSONComma = UChr$(Uni(",")) ' 44 Public Const typeJSONColon = UChr$(Uni(":")) ' 58 Public Const typeJSONError = UChr$(Uni("e")) ' 101
%REM Class JSONValue
Version: 3.9 Purpose: This class is a wrapper for a value in a JSON string
Properties: Count: Returns the number of items in the JSONValue Items: Returns the value as a Variant, which is a list of JSONValue for a JSONObject or JSONArray or a scalar for the other types Value: Returns the value as a Variant, which is a list of JSONValue for a JSONObject or JSONArray or a scalar for the other types
Methods: Init AddItemValue(Name, Value): Adds the value to the JSONValue GetItemValue(ItemName): Returns the value of the requested item RemoveItem(ItemName): Removes the value of the requested item ReplaceItemValue(Index, Value): Replaces the value in the specified array index %END REM Public Class JSONValue Private jNumber As Double ' 8 byte align, also how many items in jList, used for both Array and Object Private jString As String ' 4 byte align holds error message if typeJSONError Public jList List As JSONValue ' 4 byte, holds object and array Private jType As String * 1 ' is it a String, #number, Object, Array, True, False, null, ArrayEnd, ObjectEnd, or Error Private isInited As Integer 'indicates if this JSONValue object has been Inited by calling Init or by some other way
Public Property Get Count As Long If jType = typeJSONArray Or jType = typeJSONObject Then Count = jNumber Else Error 1205, ERR_1205 End If End Property ' Get Count
Public Property Get Items As Variant Items = Me.Value End Property ' Get Items
%REM Property Get valueType
Will be typeJSONNull until inited %END REM Public Property Get valueType As String valueType = jType End Property ' Get valueType
%REM Property Get isError
Return if the value is an error value %END REM Public Property Get isError As Integer isError = (jType = typeJSONError) End Property ' Get isError
%REM Property Get isError
Return the error string %END REM Public Property Get getError As String getError = "" If jType = typeJSONError Then getError = jString End Property ' Get getError
%REM Sub AddItemValue
Expects a name, JSONValue pair Only valid for a JSONValue of typeJSONArray or type JSONObject For a typeJSONArray, sName is ignored
For a JSONValue where Init has not been called, will set the valueType to typeJSONArray if sName is empty ("") Otherwise will set the valueType to typeJSONObject %END REM Public Sub AddItemValue(sName As String, jValue As JSONValue) Const proc = cJV + "AddItemValue" If noDebug Then On Error GoTo bublUp
Dim sKey As String ' because we rely on certain strings to be illegal in JSON strings, we do not unescape ' also saves processing...
' Unescaped Control characters in a JSON string are illegal ' but since that should have been detected by the JSONReader, we do not test for it here ' that will be a job for JSONWriter! ' If InStr(sName, CR) + InStr(sName, LF) > 0 Then Error 1202, ERR_1202
If Not isInited Then ' if we do not have been inited, determine type based on if a name has been supplied If sName = "" Then Init typeJSONArray Else Init typeJSONObject End If End If
Select Case jType Case typeJSONArray Set jList(CLng(jNumber)) = jValue jNumber = jNumber + 1
Case typeJSONObject ' the JSON spec for an object allows a name in a name/value pair to be the empty string ' lucklily, there is a string that is not a string according to the JSON spec: the single doublequote ' we can use that to hold the value for the empty string If sName = "" Then sKey = cQuote Else sKey = sName End If If Not IsElement(jList(sKey)) Then ' if we are not replacing... jNumber = jNumber + 1 ' up the number of members (so this is 1-based) End If %REM JSON.org and ECMA-404 allows names to be used multiple times. But RFC8259 cautions against it. RFC8259 also documents different libraries handle it differently. I follow the most popular implentation: the last name/value pair wins previously, duplicates were kept. Changed to keep last, per RFC8259 old code: If IsElement(jList(sKey)) Then ' ouch this name has been used already ' since the \ is forbidden unless escaped, and \ followed by digits is not legal in JSON names ' and the original object already exists to do housekeeping with: jList(sKey).jNumber = jList(sKey).jNumber + 1 ' count the number of extra values Set jlist(sKey + "\" + CStr(jList(sKey).jNumber)) = jValue ' Store the extra value Else Set jList(sKey) = jValue End If %END REM Set jList(sKey) = jValue
Case Else ' typeJSONNull, typeJSONFalse, typeJSONTrue, typeJSONNumber, typeJSONString Error 1203, ERR_1203 End Select Exit Sub bublUp: Error Err, addBubblEr(proc, Erl, Err) End Sub ' AddItemValue
%REM Function GetItemValue %END REM Public Function GetItemValue(sName As String, jsVal As JSONValue) As Variant Const proc = cJV + "GetItemValue" If noDebug Then On Error GoTo bublUp If IsElement(jList(sName)) Then Set jsVal = jList(sName) Set GetItemValue = jsVal.Value End If Exit Function bublUp: Error Err, addBubblEr(proc, Erl, Err) End Function ' GetItemValue
Public Property Get Value As Variant Const proc = cJV + "PropertyGetValue" If noDebug Then On Error GoTo bublUp
Dim vNull As Variant Select Case jType Case typeJSONNull Value = vNull Case typeJSONFalse Value = False Case typeJSONTrue Value = True Case typeJSONNumber Value = jNumber Case typeJSONString, typeJSONError Value = jString Case typeJSONArray, typeJSONObject Value = jList Case Else Value = jType End Select
Exit Property bublUp: Error Err, addBubblEr(proc, Erl, Err) End Property ' Get Value
Public Property Set Value As Variant Const proc = cJV + "PropertySetValue" If noDebug Then On Error GoTo bublUp
Dim tVal As JSONValue Dim sKey As String Select Case jType Case typeJSONNumber jNumber = Value Case typeJSONString, typeJSONError jString = Value ' strLen = Len(jString) Case typeJSONArray, typeJSONObject If IsObject(Value) Then If Value IsA "JSONValue" Then Set tVal = Value If tVal.ValueType = jType Then Erase jList jNumber = 0 ForAll vElem In tVal.jList sKey = ListTag(vElem) If Not IsElement(jList(sKey)) Then jNumber = jNumber + 1 Set jList(skey) = vElem End ForAll Else Error 1009, "No JSON array or object supplied to set an array or object, cannot set the value" End If End If Else Error 1004, "No object supplied, cannot set JSON array or object" End If Case Else ' typeJSONNull, typeJSONFalse, typeJSONTrue ' value === type, so no action possible Error 1007, "Cannot set the value of a fixed type: true, false or null, ArrayEnd, ObjectEnd, Colon, Comma"
End Select
Exit Property bublUp: Error Err, addBubblEr(proc, Erl, Err) End Property ' Set Value
%REM Function GetItem %END REM Public Function GetItem(sName As Variant) As JSONValue Const proc = cJV + "GetItem" If noDebug Then On Error GoTo bublUp
If IsElement(jList(sName)) Then Set GetItem = jList(sName) End If Exit Function bublUp: Error Err, addBubblEr(proc, Erl, Err) End Function ' GetItem
%REM Sub RemoveItem %END REM Public Sub RemoveItem(sName As String) Const proc = cJV + "RemoveItem" If noDebug Then On Error GoTo bublUp
If IsElement(jList(sName)) Then If jNumber > 0 Then jNumber = jNumber - 1 Else Error 1206, ERR_1206 End If Erase jList(sName) End If
Exit Sub bublUp: Error Err, addBubblEr(proc, Erl, Err) End Sub ' RemoveItem
%REM Sub ReplaceItemValue
In Notes, ReplaceItemValue removes all note items with the same name if multiple exists %END REM Public Sub ReplaceItemValue(sName As String, vValue As JSONValue) AddItemValue sName, vValue ' according to RFC8259, most libraries klet the last win. so simply add the value, which wil replace an existing End Sub ' ReplaceItemValue
%REM ' offer direct asserts for typeJSONNull, typeJSONFalse, typeJSONTrue, typeJSONNumber, typeJSONString, typeJSONArray, typeJSONArrayEnd, typeJSONObject, typeJSONObjectEnd, typeJSONComma. typeJSONColon and the reverse to save nots these are so simple and heavily used, that onerror statements have not been implemented %END REM Public Function isTokenNull As Integer isTokenNull = (jType = typeJSONNull) End Function ' isNullToken

Public Function isNotTokenObjectEnd As Integer isNotTokenObjectEnd = (jType <> typeJSONObjectEnd) End Function ' isNotTokenObjectEnd
Public Function isNotTokenComma As Integer isNotTokenComma = (jType <> typeJSONComma) End Function ' isNotTokenComma

' if the token isNot a value or parsing object Public Function isNotTokenValue As Integer Select Case jType Case typeJSONArrayEnd, typeJSONObjectEnd, typeJSONColon, typeJSONComma isNotTokenValue = True Case Else isNotTokenValue = False End Select End Function ' isNotTokenValue
