'Dim gns_VICS As NotesSession 'Dim gndb_VICS As NotesDatabase Dim gnuiws_VICS As NotesUIWorkspace Dim g_DateInstallation_VICS As Variant
Const c_NomTableStatut_VICS = "ICS_Statut"
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_VICS = "SL" Const gc_Element_VICS = "V_ICS"

Function VICS_OuvrirDocumentImportation(p_Importation As String, p_Fichier As String) As Integer '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet d'ouvrir un document d'importation dans Excel. '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_Entetes As Variant Dim v_ColonneCourante As Long Dim i As Long Dim v_Onglet As String
VICS_OuvrirDocumentImportation = False
' Démarrer Excel '------------------------- If Not SIMX_DemarrerExcel(True) Then Exit Function End If
' Ouvrir le classeur à importer ' -------------------------------------------- If Not SIMX_OuvrirClasseur(False, p_Fichier) Then Exit Function End If
' Ouvrir l'onglet ' -------------------------------------------- v_Onglet = xVarSIIm(p_Importation, "SIIm_Onglet", "", True) If v_Onglet <> "" Then If SIMX_OuvrirFeuille(v_Onglet, False) = False Then Exit Function End If End If
g_DocumentImportationOuvert_SIIm = True VICS_OuvrirDocumentImportation = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIIm, gc_Element_SIIm, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub VICS_Initialisations On Error Goto GererErreur
If gnuiws_VICS Is Nothing Then 'Set gns_VICS = New NotesSession 'Set gndb_VICS = gns_VICS.currentdatabase Set gnuiws_VICS = New NotesUIWorkspace
g_DateInstallation_VICS = DateNumber(2025, 01, 01) End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VICS, gc_Element_VICS, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function VICS_TrimNoClient(p_NoClient As String) As String On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_NoClient As String
v_NoClient = Trim(p_NoClient) If v_NoClient <> "" Then If InStr(v_NoClient, "-") > 0 Then If Left(v_NoClient, 1) = "0" Then v_NoClient = CStr(CLng(StrLeft(v_NoClient, "-"))) & "-" & StrRight(v_NoClient, "-") End If End If End If
VICS_TrimNoClient = v_NoClient Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VICS, gc_Element_VICS, GetThreadInfo(1), p_NoClient, False) Exit Function End Function

Sub VICS_AssignerStatut(pnd As NotesDocument, p_NouveauStatut As String, p_Commentaire As String) On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_Statut As String Dim v_StatutIcone As Integer Dim v_StatutDesc As String
Call VICS_Initialisations
v_Statut = xVar(pnd, "ICS_Statut" , "")
If p_NouveauStatut <> v_Statut Then v_StatutDesc = xDescTabl(p_NouveauStatut, c_NomTableStatut_VICS, True)
pnd.ICS_Statut = p_NouveauStatut pnd.ICS_StatutDescFR = v_StatutDesc pnd.ICS_StatutIcone = xIcnTabl(p_NouveauStatut, c_NomTableStatut_VICS, True) pnd.ICS_StatutDate = Now
Call SIHi_Ajouter(pnd , p_NouveauStatut + " - " + v_StatutDesc , p_Commentaire , "", True) End If
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VICS, gc_Element_VICS, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub VICS_acValiderImportations(p_Selection As String) On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ns As New NotesSession Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim nv As NotesView Dim nd_ICS As NotesDocument Dim v_Statut As String Dim ndc_ICS As NotesDocumentCollection
Call VICS_Initialisations Set ndb = ns.Currentdatabase
If p_Selection = "S" Then Set ndc_ICS = ndb.UnprocessedDocuments Else Set nv = ndb.GetView("V_ICS01") Call nv.Refresh
' Charger les consommations à valider dans une collection Set ndc_ICS = ndb.CreateDocumentCollection Set nd_ICS = nv.GetFirstDocument Do Until nd_ICS Is Nothing v_Statut = xVar(nd_ICS, "ICS_Statut", "") If v_Statut < "10" Or v_Statut = "80" Then Call ndc_ICS.AddDocument(nd_ICS) End If
Set nd_ICS = nv.GetNextDocument(nd_ICS) Loop End If
' Valider les consommations If ndc_ICS.Count = 0 Then Print "Validation - Aucun document à valider." Else Call VICS_ValiderImportations(ndc_ICS) End If
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VICS, gc_Element_VICS, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function VICS_xndClie(p_NoClient As String) As NotesDocument On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_NoClient As String Dim nd_Clie As NotesDocument
v_NoClient = Trim(p_NoClient) If v_NoClient <> "" Then If InStr(v_NoClient, "-") > 0 Then Set nd_Clie = xSICl_xndClie(v_NoClient, False) Else Set nd_Clie = xSICl_xndClie_Rapid(CLng(v_NoClient)) End If End If
Set VICS_xndClie = nd_Clie Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VICS, gc_Element_VICS, GetThreadInfo(1), p_NoClient, False) Exit Function End Function

Function VICS_ValiderImportation(pnd_ICS As NotesDocument) As Integer On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_NoClient_L As String Dim v_NoClient_F As String Dim v_NoClientRAPID As Long Dim v_NoClientSerti As String Dim nd_Clie As NotesDocument Dim v_ClientNoFmt As String Dim v_TypeRevenu As String Dim v_CodeProduit As String Dim nd_Prod As NotesDocument Dim v_Quantite As Integer Dim v_Prix As Double Dim v_NbUtilisateursObligatoire As String Dim v_NbUtilisateurs As Integer Dim v_DescRapid As String Dim v_DescLevel As String Dim s As String Dim v_Niveau As String Dim v_Pos As Integer
Dim v_Statut As String Dim v_Erreur As String
VICS_ValiderImportation = 0 pnd_ICS.ICS_CleICS = xUnique("")
' Prix v_Quantite = xVar(pnd_ICS, "ICS_Import_Quantite", 0) v_Prix = xVar(pnd_ICS, "ICS_Import_PrixUnitaire", 0) If v_Prix < 0 Then If v_Quantite > 0 Then v_Quantite = -v_Quantite End If v_Prix = Abs(v_Prix) End If pnd_ICS.ICS_Quantite = v_Quantite pnd_ICS.ICS_PrixUnitaire = v_Prix
' Client Livraison v_NoClientRAPID = xVar(pnd_ICS, "ICS_NoClientRapidRTC", 0) v_NoClientSerti = VICS_TrimNoClient(xVar(pnd_ICS, "ICS_Import_NoClientSerti", "")) If v_NoClientRAPID > 2 Then Set nd_Clie = VICS_xndClie(CStr(v_NoClientRAPID)) End If If nd_Clie Is Nothing Then Set nd_Clie = VICS_xndClie(v_NoClientSerti) If nd_Clie Is Nothing Then v_Statut = "80" v_Erreur = "Client livraison inexistant" GoTo AssignerStatut End If End If
v_ClientNoFmt = xVar(nd_Clie, "Clie_ClientNoFmt", "") If v_NoClientRAPID > 2 And v_ClientNoFmt <> v_NoClientSerti Then 'v_Statut = "80" ' ******************************** TEMP v_Erreur = "No de client Rapid ne correspond pas au no de client Serti: " & v_ClientNoFmt 'GoTo AssignerStatut End If
pnd_ICS.ICS_ClientNoFmt = v_ClientNoFmt pnd_ICS.ICS_ClientNom1 = xVar(nd_Clie, "Clie_ClientNom1", "") pnd_ICS.ICS_ClientNom2 = xVar(nd_Clie, "Clie_ClientNom2", "") pnd_ICS.ICS_ClientNomInterne = xVar(nd_Clie, "Clie_ClientNomInterne", "") pnd_ICS.ICS_NoClientRapidRTC = v_NoClientRAPID
' Client Facturation %rem v_NoClient_F = CStr(xVar(pnd_ICS, "ICS_NoClientRapidRTC_F", "")) If v_NoClient_F <> "" Then Set nd_Clie = VICS_xndClie(v_NoClient_F) If nd_Clie Is Nothing Then v_Statut = "80" v_Erreur = "Id de client facturation inexistant" GoTo AssignerStatut End If
v_NoClientRAPID = xVar(nd_Clie, "Clie_NoClientRapidRTC", 0) If v_NoClientRAPID = 0 Then v_Statut = "80" v_Erreur = "No de client facturation Rapid manquant" GoTo AssignerStatut End If
pnd_ICS.ICS_ClientFactNoFmt = xVar(nd_Clie, "Clie_ClientNoFmt", "") pnd_ICS.ICS_ClientFactNom1 = xVar(nd_Clie, "Clie_ClientNom1", "") pnd_ICS.ICS_ClientFactNom2 = xVar(nd_Clie, "Clie_ClientNom2", "") pnd_ICS.ICS_ClientFactNomInterne = xVar(nd_Clie, "Clie_ClientNomInterne", "") pnd_ICS.ICS_NoClientFactRapidRTC = v_NoClientRAPID End If %end rem
' Produit v_CodeProduit = UCase(xVar(pnd_ICS, "ICS_CodeProduit", "")) v_TypeRevenu = UCase(xVar(pnd_ICS, "ICS_TypeRevenu", "")) If v_TypeRevenu = "TRANSACTIONAL" Then pnd_ICS.ICS_ConsSeulement = "1" pnd_ICS.ICS_TypeInstallation = "2" ElseIf v_TypeRevenu <> "RECURRING" Then ' OTHER REVENU TYPE v_Statut = "92" GoTo AssignerStatut Else Set nd_Prod = SDSCSPr_ndProduitBanniere(v_ClientNoFmt, v_CodeProduit) If nd_Prod Is Nothing Then v_Statut = "80" v_Erreur = "Produit inexistant" GoTo AssignerStatut End If
pnd_ICS.ICS_CleProduit = xVar(nd_Prod, "Prod_CleProduit", "") pnd_ICS.ICS_CodeProduit = xVar(nd_Prod, "Prod_CodeProduit", "") pnd_ICS.ICS_DescProduitFR = xVar(nd_Prod, "Prod_DescProduitFR", "") pnd_ICS.ICS_DescProduitEN = xVar(nd_Prod, "Prod_DescProduitEN", "")
v_NbUtilisateursObligatoire = xVar(nd_Prod, "Prod_NbUtilisateursObligatoire", "0") pnd_ICS.ICS_NbUtilisateursObligatoire = v_NbUtilisateursObligatoire v_DescRapid = FullTrim(xVar(pnd_ICS, "ICS_CodeProduitRapid", "")) v_Pos = InStr(UCase(v_DescRapid), "LEVEL") If v_Pos > 0 Then v_DescLevel = Right(v_DescRapid, Len(v_DescRapid) - v_Pos + 1) v_Niveau = Mid(v_DescLevel, 7, 2) If IsNumeric(v_Niveau) Then pnd_ICS.ICS_NbUtilisateurs = CInt(v_Niveau) End If pnd_ICS.ICS_Commentaire = v_DescLevel Else v_Pos = InStr(UCase(v_DescRapid), "TIER") If v_Pos > 0 Then v_DescLevel = Replace(Replace(Right(v_DescRapid, Len(v_DescRapid) - v_Pos + 1), ")", ""), "(", "") v_Pos = 6 s = Mid(v_DescLevel, v_Pos, 1) If IsNumeric(s) Then pnd_ICS.ICS_NbUtilisateurs = CInt(s) Else Do While s = "I" Or s = "V" v_Niveau = v_Niveau & s v_Pos = v_Pos + 1 s = Mid(v_DescLevel, v_Pos, 1) If v_Niveau <> "" Then pnd_ICS.ICS_NbUtilisateurs = SItN_cIntRomain(v_Niveau) End If Loop End If pnd_ICS.ICS_Commentaire = v_DescLevel End If End If
%rem v_DescRapid = UCase(xVar(pnd_ICS, "ICS_CodeProduitRapid", "")) v_DescLevel = Trim(StrRightBack(Replace(Replace(v_DescRapid, ")", ""), "(", ""), "LEVEL", 0)) & ">" If v_DescLevel <> ">" Then v_Pos = 2 v_Niveau = Mid(s, v_Pos, 1) pnd_ICS.ICS_NbUtilisateurs = cint(v_Niveau) pnd_ICS.ICS_Commentaire = "Level " & v_Niveau else v_DescLevel = Trim(StrRightBack(Replace(Replace(v_DescRapid, ")", ""), "(", ""), "TIER", 0)) & ">" If v_DescLevel <> ">" Then v_Pos = 1 s = Mid(s, v_Pos, 1) Do Until s = "I" Or s = "V" Or s = ">" v_Pos = v_Pos + 1 s = Mid(s, v_Pos, 1) Loop Do While s = "I" Or s = "V" v_Niveau = v_Niveau & s v_Pos = v_Pos + 1 s = Mid(s, v_Pos, 1) Loop pnd_ICS.ICS_NbUtilisateurs = SItN_cIntRomain(v_Niveau) pnd_ICS.ICS_Commentaire = "Tier " & v_Niveau End If End If %end rem
' Type d'installations Select case Left(v_CodeProduit, 2) Case "RA": pnd_ICS.ICS_TypeInstallation = "3" Case "R-": pnd_ICS.ICS_TypeInstallation = "2" Case Else v_Statut = "80" v_Erreur = "Type d'installation indéterminé." GoTo AssignerStatut End Select
'v_Quantite = xVar(pnd_ICS, "ICS_Quantite", 0) If v_Quantite = 0 Then v_Statut = "80" v_Erreur = "Quantité manquante" GoTo AssignerStatut End If
' Prix ' If Left(v_CodeProduit, 2) = "RA" then 'v_Prix = xVar(pnd_ICS, "ICS_PrixUnitaire", 0) If v_Prix = 0 Then v_Statut = "80" v_Erreur = "Prix manquant" GoTo AssignerStatut End If ' End If
pnd_ICS.ICS_PrixTotal = v_Quantite * v_Prix End If
v_Statut = "10"
AssignerStatut: If v_Statut = "80" Then pnd_ICS.ICS_StatutErreur = v_Statut Else pnd_ICS.ICS_StatutErreur = "" End If pnd_ICS.ICS_Erreur = v_Erreur
Call VICS_AssignerStatut(pnd_ICS, v_Statut, v_Erreur) ' Terminé If v_Statut = "80" Then VICS_ValiderImportation = -1 Else VICS_ValiderImportation = 1 End If Exit Function
GererErreur: VICS_ValiderImportation = -9 Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VICS, gc_Element_VICS, GetThreadInfo(1), CStr(xVar(pnd_ICS, "ICS_NoClientRapidRTC", "")), False) Exit Function End Function

Sub VICS_acChangerStatut(p_Statut As String) On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nuiv As NotesUIView Dim ns As New NotesSession Dim ndb As Notesdatabase Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim V_NouveauStatut As String Dim nd_Box As NotesDocument Dim v_Statut As String Dim v_Continue As Boolean Dim v_Commentaire As String Dim v_NbMaj As Long
Const c_NomTableStatut = "ICS_Statut"
Call VICS_Initialisations Set nuiv = gnuiws_VICS.CurrentView
Set ndb = ns.Currentdatabase Set ndc = ndb.UnprocessedDocuments
If ndc.Count = 0 Then ' Aucun document sélectionné. MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 2, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub End If
' Demander le nouveau statut ' -------------------------- If p_Statut = "" then Set nd_Box = New NotesDocument(ndb) nd_Box.Form = "DB_Stat" nd_Box.DB_TableStatuts = c_NomTableStatut_VICS
If Not gnuiws_VICS.DialogBox("DB_Stat", True, True, False, False, False, False, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 97, xLangue, ""), nd_Box, _ True, False, False) Then Exit Sub End If
V_NouveauStatut = xVar(nd_Box, "DB_Statut", "") v_Commentaire = FullTrim(xVar(nd_Box, "DB_Commentaire", "")) Else ' Demander une confirmation If gnuiws_VICS.Prompt(PROMPT_YESNO, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 98, "", CStr(ndc.Count)), xGDK_xMessage("SDSCS", 133, "", "")) <> 1 Then Exit sub End If V_NouveauStatut = p_Statut End If Call nuiv.DeselectAll
' Assigner le statut aux documents sélectionnés Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant) v_Continue = False
v_Statut = xVar(nd, "ICS_Statut", "") Select Case p_Statut Case "05": v_Continue = (v_Statut = "80") Case "92": v_Continue = (v_Statut < "90") Case Else: v_Continue = (v_NouveauStatut <> v_Statut) End Select
If v_Continue Then Call VICS_AssignerStatut(nd, V_NouveauStatut, v_Commentaire) v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 End If Loop Call gnuiws_VICS.ViewRefresh
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VICS, gc_Element_VICS, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function VICS_AjouterProduitCS(pnd_ICS As NotesDocument, pnd_CSCo As NotesDocument) As Long On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nd_Prod As NotesDocument Dim v_ClientNoFmt As String Dim v_Periode As Variant Dim v_NoBonCommande As String Dim v_CleProduit As String Dim v_CodeProduit As String Dim v_Quantite As Long Dim v_Prix As Double Dim v_TypeProduit As String
Dim nd_CSPr_E As NotesDocument Dim v_NoContratFmt As String Dim v_ChampErreur As String Dim v_TitreDialog As String Dim v_TitreConfirm As String Dim v_CSPrValide As Boolean Dim v_CSPrConfirmDialog As Boolean Dim v_MontantFacture As Double Dim v_NbUtilisateurs As Integer Dim v_NbUtilisateursObligatoire As String Dim v_PrixTotal As Double Dim v_Commentaire As String
VICS_AjouterProduitCS = 0 v_ClientNoFmt = xVar(pnd_ICS, "ICS_ClientNoFmt", "")
' Extraire le produit de SDS Base II v_CleProduit = xVar(pnd_ICS, "ICS_CleProduit", "") Set nd_Prod = xSDSBB_xndProd(v_CleProduit, False) If nd_Prod Is Nothing Then VICS_AjouterProduitCS = -56 Exit Function End If
v_NoBonCommande = xVar(pnd_ICS, "ICS_NoTransaction", "") v_Periode = g_DateInstallation_VICS 'xVar(pnd_ICS, "ICS_Periode", "") v_CodeProduit = xVar(pnd_ICS, "ICS_CodeProduit", "") v_Quantite = xVar(pnd_ICS, "ICS_Quantite", 0) v_Prix = xVar(pnd_ICS, "ICS_PrixUnitaire", 0) If v_Quantite < 0 Then v_TypeProduit = "80" v_Commentaire = xVar(pnd_ICS, "ICS_CodeProduitRapid", "") Else v_TypeProduit = "01" End If
' Créer le service dans la CS v_NoContratFmt = xVar(pnd_CSCo, "CSCo_NoContratFmt" , "") Set nd_CSPr_E = SDSCSPr_NouveauProduit(pnd_CSCo, v_TypeProduit, pnd_CSCo.ParentDatabase) Call SDSCSPr_BatirProduit(nd_CSPr_E, nd_Prod) nd_CSPr_E.CSPr_Source = "ICS" nd_CSPr_E.CSPr_CleSource = xVar(pnd_ICS, "ICS_CleICS", "") nd_CSPr_E.CSPr_CodeProduitRapid = xVar(pnd_ICS, "ICS_CodeProduitRapid", "")
nd_CSPr_E.CSPr_Quantite = v_Quantite nd_CSPr_E.CSPr_QtyProduitModifiable = ""
nd_CSPr_E.CSPr_ReferenceClient = v_NoBonCommande nd_CSPr_E.CSPr_NoBonCommande = v_NoBonCommande
v_NbUtilisateurs = xVar(pnd_ICS, "ICS_NbUtilisateurs", 0) v_NbUtilisateursObligatoire = xVar(pnd_ICS, "ICS_NbUtilisateursObligatoire", "0") v_Commentaire = xVar(pnd_ICS, "ICS_Commentaire", "") If v_NbUtilisateursObligatoire = "1" And v_NbUtilisateurs = 0 Then v_NbUtilisateurs = 99 End If If v_NbUtilisateurs = 0 Then nd_CSPr_E.CSPr_NbUtilisateurs = "" Else nd_CSPr_E.CSPr_NbUtilisateurs = v_NbUtilisateurs If v_Commentaire = "" And v_NbUtilisateurs <> 99 And v_Quantite > 0 Then v_Commentaire = "Level/Tier " & cstr(v_NbUtilisateurs) End If End If
nd_CSPr_E.CSPr_PrixUnitaire = v_Prix nd_CSPr_E.CSPr_PrixTotal = v_Quantite * v_Prix nd_CSPr_E.CSPr_Commentaire = v_Commentaire
Call SDSCSPr_AssignerStatut(nd_CSPr_E, "00" , False)
' Si les champs obligatoires sont invalides...On ré-édite le document 'v_CSPrValide = VICS_ValiderConsommation(nd_CSPr_E , pnd_CSCo, "80" ,"" , v_ChampErreur) 'If v_CSPrValide Then
nd_CSPr_E.CSPr_NoProduitParent = "" nd_CSPr_E.CSPr_NoProduitSeq = SDSCSPr_ValeurSuivante(pnd_CSCo) Call nd_CSPr_E.RemoveItem("ChampErreur") Call SDSCSPr_AssignerStatut(nd_CSPr_E, "00",True) ' Call nd_CSPr_E.MakeResponse(pnd_CSCo) Call nd_CSPr_E.Save(True,False)
'Else ' pnd_CSPr.ChampErreur = v_ChampErreur ' VICS_AjouterProduitCS = -55 'End If
VICS_AjouterProduitCS = 1 Exit Function
GererErreur: VICS_AjouterProduitCS = -1 Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VICS, gc_Element_VICS, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function VICS_CreerContratService(pndc_ICS As NotesDocumentCollection) As Integer On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ns As New NotesSession Dim nd_ICS As NotesDocument Dim v_ClientNoFmt As String Dim v_TypeInstallation As String Dim v_ConsSeulement As String Dim v_ClientFactNoFmt As String Dim v_CodeProduit As String Dim v_Resultat As Integer Dim nd_CSCo As NotesDocument Dim v_NoContratSeq As String Dim v_ActionContrat As String Dim v_StatutContrat As String Dim ndt As New NotesDateTime("") Dim v_NoRevision As String Dim v_AnneeEntVig As String Dim v_NoContrat As String Dim v_DateDebutFacturation As Variant Dim v_DateFactureJusquau As Variant Dim v_StatutICS As String Dim v_Commentaire As String
Dim v_NbMaj As Long
Call VICS_Initialisations VICS_CreerContratService = 0 If pndc_ICS.Count = 0 Then Exit Function End If
Set nd_ICS = pndc_ICS.GetFirstDocument v_ClientNoFmt = xVar(nd_ICS, "ICS_ClientNoFmt", "") v_TypeInstallation = xVar(nd_ICS, "ICS_TypeInstallation", "")
' Créer le contrat de service Set nd_CSCo = New NotesDocument(nd_ICS.ParentDatabase) nd_CSCo.Form = "F_CSCo" nd_CSCo.CSCo_StatutContrat = "00" nd_CSCo.CSCo_SoutienActif = "1" nd_CSCo.CSCo_DerniereRevision = "0"
nd_CSCo.CSCo_ClientNo1 = CLng(StrLeft(v_ClientNoFmt, "-")) nd_CSCo.CSCo_ClientNo2 = StrRight(v_ClientNoFmt, "-") nd_CSCo.CSCo_ClientNoFmt = v_ClientNoFmt nd_CSCo.CSCo_ClientNom1 = xSICl_xVarClie(v_ClientNoFmt, "Clie_ClientNom1", "", True) nd_CSCo.CSCo_ClientNom2 = xSICl_xVarClie(v_ClientNoFmt, "Clie_ClientNom2", "", True) nd_CSCo.CSCo_ClientNomInterne = xSICl_xVarClie(v_ClientNoFmt, "Clie_ClientNomInterne", "", True) nd_CSCo.CSCo_NoClientRapidRTC = xVar(nd_ICS, "ICS_NoClientRapidRTC", "")
v_ClientFactNoFmt = xVar(nd_ICS, "ICS_ClientFactNoFmt", "") If v_ClientFactNoFmt <> "" Then nd_CSCo.CSCo_ClientFact = "" nd_CSCo.CSCo_ClientFactNo1 = CLng(StrLeft(v_ClientFactNoFmt, "-")) nd_CSCo.CSCo_ClientFactNo2 = StrRight(v_ClientFactNoFmt, "-") nd_CSCo.CSCo_ClientFactNoFmt = v_ClientFactNoFmt nd_CSCo.CSCo_ClientFactNom1 = xSICl_xVarClie(v_ClientFactNoFmt, "Clie_ClientNom1", "", True) nd_CSCo.CSCo_ClientFactNom2 = xSICl_xVarClie(v_ClientFactNoFmt, "Clie_ClientNom2", "", True) nd_CSCo.CSCo_ClientFactNomInterne = xSICl_xVarClie(v_ClientFactNoFmt, "Clie_ClientNomInterne", "", True) nd_CSCo.CSCo_NoClientFactRapidRTC = xVar(nd_ICS, "ICS_NoClientFactRapidRTC", "") Else nd_CSCo.CSCo_ClientFact = "1" End If
nd_CSCo.CSCo_Langue = xSICl_xVarClie(v_ClientNoFmt, "Clie_ClientLangue", "", True) nd_CSCo.CSCo_Devise = xSICl_xVarClie(v_ClientNoFmt, "Clie_Devise", "", True) nd_CSCo.CSCo_TypeInstallationSDS = xSICl_xVarClie(v_ClientNoFmt, "Clie_TypeInstallationSDS", 0, True) nd_CSCo.CSCo_TypeInstallationSDSIcone = xSICl_xVarClie(v_ClientNoFmt, "Clie_TypeInstallationSDSIcone", 0, True)
nd_CSCo.CSCo_TypeInstallation = v_TypeInstallation nd_CSCo.CSCo_TypePeriode = xComplTabl(v_TypeInstallation, "CSCo_TypeInstallation", "1", True) nd_CSCo.CSCo_ModePaiement = xComplTabl(v_TypeInstallation, "CSCo_TypeInstallation", "2", True)
Call SIIx_AssignerDate(nd_CSCo, "CSCo_DateInstallation", g_DateInstallation_VICS) Call SIIx_AssignerDate(nd_CSCo, "CSCo_DateDebut", g_DateInstallation_VICS) ndt.LSLocalTime = g_DateInstallation_VICS Call ndt.Setanytime Call ndt.AdjustYear(1) Call ndt.AdjustDay(-1) Call xAssignerDate(nd_CSCo, "CSCo_DateFin", ndt.lslocaltime)
'Call nd_CSCo.ComputeWithForm(False, False)
' Assigner le no de contrat v_AnneeEntVig = Year(xVar(nd_CSCo, "CSCo_DateDebut", Today)) v_NoContratSeq = SDSCSCo_CreerNoContrat(v_AnneeEntVig) nd_CSCo.CSCo_NoContrat = v_NoContratSeq nd_CSCo.CSCo_NoRevision = "000" nd_CSCo.CSCo_NoContratFmt = v_NoContratSeq + "-000" nd_CSCo.CSCo_NoContratInit = v_NoContratSeq + "-000"
nd_CSCo.HistoDC = Now nd_CSCo.HistoUC = ns.commonusername Call nd_CSCo.Save(True, False)
v_ConsSeulement = "1"
' Créer les produits Do If xVar(nd_ICS, "ICS_ConsSeulement", "") <> "1" Then ' Ajouter le produit au contrat de service v_Resultat = VICS_AjouterProduitCS(nd_ICS, nd_CSCo) If v_Resultat = 1 Then v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 Call SIGE_AjouterLog(" OK " & v_ClientNoFmt & " " & xVar(nd_ICS, "ICS_CleICS", "") & " " & xVar(nd_ICS, "ICS_CodeProduit", ""), 0, 0, False) ElseIf v_Resultat < 0 Then nd_ICS.ICS_ErreurNo = v_Resultat VICS_CreerContratService = v_Resultat Call SIGE_AjouterLog(" Erreur PR " & v_ClientNoFmt & " " & xVar(nd_ICS, "ICS_CleICS", "") & " " & xVar(nd_ICS, "ICS_CodeProduit", ""), 1, 0, False) End If
v_ConsSeulement = "" End If
Set nd_ICS = pndc_ICS.GetNextDocument(nd_ICS) Loop Until nd_ICS Is Nothing
nd_CSCo.CSCo_NoProduitSeq = v_NbMaj nd_CSCo.CSCo_ConsSeulement = v_ConsSeulement Call nd_CSCo.Save(True, False)
If VICS_CreerContratService = 0 Then VICS_CreerContratService = v_NbMaj End If
If VICS_CreerContratService >= 0 Then ' Des produits ont été ajoutés au CS v_StatutICS = "90" Call SIGE_AjouterLog(" OK " & v_ClientNoFmt, 0, 0, False) Else ' Erreur v_StatutICS = "80" v_Commentaire = CStr(VICS_CreerContratService) Call SIGE_AjouterLog(" Erreur CS " & v_ClientNoFmt & " " & CStr(VICS_CreerContratService), 1, 0, False) End If
' Maj le statut des documents Set nd_ICS = pndc_ICS.GetFirstDocument Do Until nd_ICS Is Nothing ' Maj le statut de la consommation Call VICS_AssignerStatut(nd_ICS, v_StatutICS, v_Commentaire) ' Terminé
Set nd_ICS = pndc_ICS.GetNextDocument(nd_ICS) Loop Exit Function
GererErreur: VICS_CreerContratService = -9 Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VICS, gc_Element_VICS, GetThreadInfo(1), v_ClientNoFmt, False) Exit Function End Function

Sub VICS_ValiderImportations(pndc As NotesDocumentCollection) On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument
Dim v_NbDoc As Long Dim v_NbLus As Long Dim v_NbMaj As Long
v_NbDoc = pndc.Count
Set nd_Suivant = pndc.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = pndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant) v_NbLus = v_NbLus + 1
If VICS_ValiderImportation(nd) = 1 Then v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 End If
If (v_NbLus Mod 100) = 0 Then Print "Validation - " & CStr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & CStr(v_NbLus) & "/" & CStr(v_NbDoc) End If Loop
Call gnuiws_VICS.ViewRefresh Print "Fin validation - " & CStr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & CStr(v_NbLus) Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VICS, gc_Element_VICS, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function VICS_ImporterFichier(ByVal p_Categorie As String) As Integer '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Le script permet d'importer les données d'un fichier MS Excel. '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_Importation As String Dim a_Fichiers As Variant Dim v_Fichier As String
VICS_ImporterFichier = False Call SIIm_Initialisations g_DocumentImportationOuvert_SIIm = False
' Sélectionner l'importation à effectuer ' ---------------------------------------------------------- v_Importation = "ICS" ' v_Importation = SIIm_SelectionnerImportation(p_Categorie) If v_Importation = "" Then Exit Function End If
' Sélectionner le fichier Excel à importer ' -------------------------------------------------- a_Fichiers = gnuiws_VICS.OpenFileDialog(False, "Sélectionner un fichier Excel", "Fichiers Excel|*.xlsx", "", "") If IsEmpty(a_Fichiers) Then Exit Function End If v_Fichier = a_Fichiers(0)
' Ouvrir le fichier Excel à importer ' -------------------------------------------------- If VICS_OuvrirDocumentImportation(v_Importation, v_Fichier) Then
' Importation des documents ' ------------------------------------------- VICS_ImporterFichier = SIIm_ImporterDocuments(v_Importation) End If
' Fermer Excel ' --------------------- Call SIMX_FermerExcel(False)
If VICS_ImporterFichier Then Print "Importation terminée. " & CStr(g_NbDocumentsImportes_SIEt) & " documents importés." Else Print "Importation annulée." End If g_DocumentImportationOuvert_SIIm = False Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIIm, gc_Element_SIIm, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Call SIMX_FermerExcel(False) Exit Function End Function

Sub VICS_acCreerContratsService(p_Selection As String) On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ns As New NotesSession Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim nv As NotesView Dim ndc_ICS As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim ndc_Client As NotesDocumentCollection Dim v_ClientNoFmt As String Dim v_ClientFactNoFmt As String Dim v_TypeInstallation As String Dim v_ClientNoFmt_Courant As String Dim v_ClientFactNoFmt_Courant As String Dim v_TypeInstallation_Courant As String Dim v_Resultat As Integer
Dim v_NbDoc As Long Dim v_NbLus As Long Dim v_NbMaj As Long Dim v_NbErr As Long
Call VICS_Initialisations Call SIGE_OuvrirLog(gc_TypeElement_VICS, gc_Element_VICS)
Set ndb = ns.Currentdatabase
If p_Selection = "S" Then End '************** Les documents doivent être traités dans l'ordre Set ndc_ICS = ndb.UnprocessedDocuments Else Set nv = ndb.GetView("V_ICS20") Call nv.Refresh Set ndc_ICS = ndb.CreateDocumentCollection Set nd = nv.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd Is Nothing Call ndc_ICS.AddDocument(nd)
Set nd = nv.Getnextdocument(nd) Loop End If v_NbDoc = ndc_ICS.Count
If v_NbDoc = 0 Then ' Aucun document sélectionné. MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 2, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub End If
' Demander une confirmation If gnuiws_VICS.Prompt(PROMPT_YESNO, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 98, "", CStr(v_NbDoc)), "Voulez-vous maj les contrats de service?") <> 1 Then Exit Sub End If Call gnuiws_VICS.CurrentView.DeselectAll
Set ndc_Client = ndb.CreateDocumentCollection Set nd_Suivant = ndc_ICS.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc_ICS.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant) v_NbLus = v_NbLus + 1 v_ClientNoFmt = xVar(nd, "ICS_ClientNoFmt", "") v_ClientFactNoFmt = xVar(nd, "ICS_ClientFactNoFmt", "") v_TypeInstallation = xVar(nd, "ICS_TypeInstallation", "")
If v_ClientNoFmt_Courant <> "" And (v_ClientNoFmt <> v_ClientNoFmt_Courant Or v_ClientFactNoFmt <> v_ClientFactNoFmt_Courant Or v_TypeInstallation <> v_TypeInstallation_Courant Or nd_Suivant Is Nothing) Then Call SIGE_AjouterLog("====== " & v_ClientNoFmt_Courant & " =======================================", 0, 0, False) v_Resultat = VICS_CreerContratService(ndc_Client) If v_Resultat < 0 Then v_NbErr = v_NbErr + 1 ElseIf v_Resultat > 0 Then v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + v_Resultat End If
v_ClientNoFmt_Courant = "" v_ClientFactNoFmt_Courant = "" v_TypeInstallation_Courant = "" Set ndc_Client = ndb.CreateDocumentCollection End If
If xVar(nd, "ICS_Statut", "00") = "10" Then v_ClientNoFmt_Courant = v_ClientNoFmt v_ClientFactNoFmt_Courant = v_ClientFactNoFmt v_TypeInstallation_Courant = v_TypeInstallation Call ndc_Client.AddDocument(nd) End If
If (v_NbLus Mod 100) = 0 Then Print "Maj: " & CStr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & CStr(v_NbLus) & "/" & CStr(v_NbDoc) End If Loop
If v_ClientNoFmt_Courant <> "" Then Call SIGE_AjouterLog("====== " & v_ClientNoFmt_Courant & " =======================================", 0, 0, False) v_Resultat = VICS_CreerContratService(ndc_Client) If v_Resultat < 0 Then v_NbErr = v_NbErr + 1 ElseIf v_Resultat > 0 Then v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + v_Resultat End If
v_ClientNoFmt_Courant = "" v_ClientFactNoFmt_Courant = "" v_TypeInstallation_Courant = "" Set ndc_Client = ndb.CreateDocumentCollection End If
Call gnuiws_VICS.ViewRefresh Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Fin " & CStr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & CStr(v_NbLus) & " Err.: " & CStr(v_NbErr), 0, 0, True)
EnregistrerLog: Call SIGE_EnregistrerLog Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VICS, gc_Element_VICS, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) GoTo EnregistrerLog End Sub

Sub VICS_acImporter() On Error GoTo GererErreur
Call VICS_Initialisations

Call gnuiws_VICS.ViewRefresh Exit Sub

code.lotusscript: Option Public Option Declare Use "SDSCS_Salesforce_V2" Use "SI_Agents"

Dim gns_A As NotesSession Dim gndb_A As NotesDatabase
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_A = "A" Const gc_Element_A = "A_SFDA"
'========================================================================================================================================== Class a_clSync Public cl_ConnexionAPI As SLSf_clConnexionAPI Public l_NoClients List As String Public NbClients As Integer End Class

Sub Initialize On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim cl_Sync As New a_clSync Dim v_NbLus As Long Dim v_NbMaj As Long Dim v_NbAss As Long Dim v_ClientNoFmt As String Dim v_Identifiant As String Dim v_Resultat As Integer
Print "Début" Call SIAg_DemarrerAgent(90, 0)
g_LogAPI_SLSf = 0 Call SIGE_OuvrirLog(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A) v_Resultat = a_Initialisations(cl_Sync) If v_Resultat < 0 Then Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Connexion à l'API Salesforce - ***** Erreur ***** " & CStr(v_Resultat), 1, 0, True) GoTo FinSub End If
' Extraire la liste des clients de Salesforce v_Resultat = A_ExtraireAccounts(cl_Sync) If v_Resultat > 0 Then
' Synchroniser les Assets If cl_Sync.NbClients > 0 then ForAll e_NoClient In cl_Sync.l_NoClients v_NbLus = v_NbLus + 1 v_ClientNoFmt = ListTag(e_NoClient) v_Identifiant = "Client " & v_ClientNoFmt & " Account " & e_NoClient If InStr(v_ClientNoFmt, "-") > 0 Then 'v_Resultat = SDSCSSf_DeleteAccountAssets(v_ClientNoFmt, cl_Sync.cl_ConnexionAPI) ' Delete all assets v_Resultat = SDSCSSf_DeleteDuplicateAssets(v_ClientNoFmt, cl_Sync.cl_ConnexionAPI) ' Delete duplicate assets If v_Resultat > 0 Then v_NbAss = v_NbAss + v_Resultat v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 If g_LogAPI_SLSf <> 0 Then Call SIGE_AjouterLog(v_Identifiant & " (" & CStr(v_NbLus) & ") - " & CStr(v_Resultat) & " assets supprimés.", 0, 0, False) End If ElseIf v_Resultat = 0 Then If g_LogAPI_SLSf = 1 then Call SIGE_AjouterLog(v_Identifiant & " - Aucun asset supprimé.", 0, 0, True) End If Else Call SIGE_AjouterLog(v_Identifiant & " - ***** Erreur ***** " & CStr(v_Resultat), 1, 0, False) End If ' Else ' Call SIGE_AjouterLog(v_Identifiant & " - ***** Erreur ***** No de client SERTI invalide.", 1, 0, False) End If
If SIAg_AgentExpire Then GoTo FinSub End If If (v_NbLus Mod 10) = 0 Then Print CStr(v_NbAss) & "/" & CStr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & CStr(v_NbLus) & "/" & CStr(cl_Sync.NbClients) End If End ForAll Else Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Aucun client à traiter.", 0, 0, True) End If End If
FinSub: Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Fin " & CStr(v_NbAss) & "/" & CStr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & CStr(v_NbLus) & "/" & CStr(cl_Sync.NbClients), 0, 0, True) Call SIGE_EnregistrerLog Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SLSf, gc_Element_SLSf, GetThreadInfo(1), v_Identifiant, False) Exit Sub End Sub

'========================================================================================================================================== Function A_Initialisations(pcl_Sync As a_clSync) As Integer On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_NomProfilAPI As String A_Initialisations = 0
Set gns_A = New NotesSession Set gndb_A = gns_A.CurrentDatabase
' Ouvrir la connexion Salesforce v_NomProfilAPI = xVarProf("Prof_NomProfilSalesforceAPI", "") If v_NomProfilAPI = "" Then A_Initialisations = -1 Exit Function End If Set pcl_Sync.cl_ConnexionAPI = New SLSf_clConnexionAPI(v_NomProfilAPI) If pcl_Sync.cl_ConnexionAPI.Resultat < 0 Then A_Initialisations = pcl_Sync.cl_ConnexionAPI.Resultat Exit Function End If
A_Initialisations = 1 Exit Function
GererErreur: A_Initialisations = -9 Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SLSf, gc_Element_SLSf, GetThreadInfo(1), v_NomProfilAPI, False) Exit Function End Function

'========================================================================================================================================== Function A_ExtraireAccounts(pcl_Sync As a_clSync) As Integer On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_URL As String Dim v_Resultat As Integer Dim v_ResultatJSON As String Dim jsr As JSONReader Dim l_ResultatParse As Variant Dim v_NbElem As Integer Dim l_Records As Variant Dim v_ClientNoFmt As String
Dim v_NbLus As Integer Dim v_NbMaj As Integer
A_ExtraireAccounts = 0
v_URL = pcl_Sync.cl_ConnexionAPI.URL_API & "query/?q=SELECT+Id,SERTI_ID__c+from+Account+WHERE+SERTI_ID__c+!=+null" v_Resultat = SLSf_ExecuteGET(v_URL, pcl_Sync.cl_ConnexionAPI.CleAcces, v_ResultatJSON) If v_Resultat < 0 Then A_ExtraireAccounts = v_Resultat Exit Function End If
v_ResultatJSON = Replace(Replace(Replace(v_ResultatJSON, Chr(13), ""), Chr(10), ""), |\"|, |'|)
' Extraire le nombre d'enfants Set jsr = New JSONReader Set l_ResultatParse = jsr.Parse(v_ResultatJSON)
v_NbElem = l_ResultatParse.GetItem("totalSize").Value If v_NbElem > 0 Then ' Construire la liste des enfants Set l_Records = l_ResultatParse.GetItem("records") ForAll o_Enfant In l_Records.jlist v_ClientNoFmt = o_Enfant.GetItem("SERTI_ID__c").Value If Not IsElement(pcl_Sync.l_NoClients(v_ClientNoFmt)) Then pcl_Sync.l_NoClients(v_ClientNoFmt) = o_Enfant.GetItem("Id").Value v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 End If
End ForAll End If
pcl_Sync.NbClients = pcl_Sync.NbClients + v_NbMaj A_ExtraireAccounts = v_NbMaj Call SIGE_AjouterLog("***** " & GetThreadInfo(1) & ": " & CStr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & CStr(v_NbLus), 0, 0, False) Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SLSf, gc_Element_SLSf, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function
Option Public Option Declare Use "SDSCS_Salesforce_V2" Use "SI_Agents"

Dim gns_A As NotesSession Dim gndb_A As NotesDatabase
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_A = "A" Const gc_Element_A = "A_SFSA"
'========================================================================================================================================== Class a_clSync Public cl_ConnexionAPI As SLSf_clConnexionAPI Public l_NoClients List As String Public NbClients As Integer End Class

Sub Initialize On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim cl_Sync As New a_clSync Dim v_NbLus As Long Dim v_ClientNoFmt As String Dim v_Identifiant As String Dim v_Resultat As Integer Dim l_NbMaj List As Integer Dim l_NbMaj_Total List As Integer Dim v_Print As String
Print "Début" Call SIAg_DemarrerAgent(90, 0)
g_LogAPI_SLSf = 0 Call SIGE_OuvrirLog(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A) v_Resultat = a_Initialisations(cl_Sync) If v_Resultat < 0 Then Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Connexion à l'API Salesforce - ***** Erreur ***** " & CStr(v_Resultat), 1, 0, True) GoTo FinSub End If
l_NbMaj_Total("CC") = 0 l_NbMaj_Total("MC") = 0 l_NbMaj_Total("DC") = 0 l_NbMaj_Total("CB") = 0 l_NbMaj_Total("MB") = 0 l_NbMaj_Total("DB") = 0 l_NbMaj_Total("DD") = 0
' Extraire la liste des clients de Salesforce v_Resultat = A_ExtraireAccounts(cl_Sync) If v_Resultat > 0 Then
' Synchroniser les Assets If cl_Sync.NbClients > 0 then ForAll e_NoClient In cl_Sync.l_NoClients v_NbLus = v_NbLus + 1 v_ClientNoFmt = ListTag(e_NoClient) v_Identifiant = "Client " & v_ClientNoFmt & " Account " & e_NoClient If InStr(v_ClientNoFmt, "-") > 0 Then v_Resultat = SDSCSSf_SyncAccountAssets(v_ClientNoFmt, cl_Sync.cl_ConnexionAPI, l_NbMaj) If v_Resultat > 0 Then Call SIGE_AjouterLog(v_Identifiant & " - " & CStr(v_Resultat) & " assets maj.", 0, 0, False) ForAll e_NbMaj In l_NbMaj Call SIGE_AjouterLog(ListTag(e_NbMaj) & " = " & CStr(e_NbMaj), 0, 0, False) l_NbMaj_Total(ListTag(e_NbMaj)) = l_NbMaj_Total(ListTag(e_NbMaj)) + e_NbMaj End ForAll ElseIf v_Resultat = 0 Then If g_LogAPI_SLSf = 1 then Call SIGE_AjouterLog(v_Identifiant & " - Aucun asset maj.", 0, 0, True) End If Else Call SIGE_AjouterLog(v_Identifiant & " - ***** Erreur ***** " & CStr(v_Resultat), 1, 0, False) End If ' Else ' Call SIGE_AjouterLog(v_Identifiant & " - ***** Erreur ***** No de client SERTI invalide.", 1, 0, False) End If
If SIAg_AgentExpire Then GoTo FinSub End If If (v_NbLus Mod 10) = 0 Then Print CStr(v_NbLus) & "/" & CStr(cl_Sync.NbClients) End If End ForAll Else Call SIGE_AjouterLog("Aucun client à synchroniser", 0, 0, True) End If End If
FinSub: Call SIGE_AjouterLog("=======================================================================================", 0, 0, False) ForAll e_NbMaj In l_NbMaj_Total Call SIGE_AjouterLog(ListTag(e_NbMaj) & " = " & CStr(e_NbMaj), 0, 0, False) v_Print = v_Print & CStr(e_NbMaj) & "/" End ForAll Print "Fin " & v_Print & CStr(v_NbLus) & "/" & CStr(cl_Sync.NbClients) Call SIGE_EnregistrerLog Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SLSf, gc_Element_SLSf, GetThreadInfo(1), v_Identifiant, False) Exit Sub End Sub

' Traitement des erreurs ' ----------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_wsc = "SL" Const gc_Element_wsc = "wsc_LSCSD"
' ======================================================================================================= Public Class PortTypeBase
Private Service As NotesWebServiceEngine Private NoFault As WS_FAULT
Public Sub New() Set Service = New NotesWebServiceEngine Set NoFault = New WS_FAULT End Sub
Public Sub SetEndpoint(url As String) Call Service.SetEndpoint(url) End Sub
Public Function GetEndpoint() As String GetEndpoint = Service.GetEndpoint() End Function
Public Function GetLastFault() As WS_FAULT Set GetLastFault = Service.GetLastFault If (GetLastFault Is Nothing) Then Set GetLastFault = NoFault End If End Function
Public Sub SetTimeout(ms As Long) Call Service.SetTimeout(ms) End Sub
Public Function GetTimeout() As Long GetTimeout = Service.GetTimeout() End Function
Public Sub SetCredentials(username As String, password As String) Call Service.SetCredentials(username, password) End Sub
Public Sub SetSSLOptions(Opt As Long) Call Service.SetSSLOptions(Opt) End Sub
Public Function GetSSLOptions() As Long GetSSLOptions = Service.GetSSLOptions() End Function
End Class ' ======================================================================================================= Class wsc_clConnexion Public Utilisateur As String Public MotDePasse As String Public URL As String Public Resultat As Integer
Sub New(p_CodeMotDePasse As String, p_NomDB As String, p_NomWSP As String) On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ns As NotesSession Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim v_Serveur As String Dim v_Fichier As String
Me.Resultat = 0
If p_NomDB = "" Then Set ns = New NotesSession Set ndb = ns.CurrentDatabase Else Set ndb = xGDK_xndbNDB(p_NomDB) End If
If ndb Is Nothing Then Me.Resultat = -1 ' Base de documents introuvable Else Me.Utilisateur = xGDK_xVarPass(p_CodeMotDePasse, "Pass_Utilisateur", "", True) Me.MotDePasse = xGDK_xVarPass(p_CodeMotDePasse, "Pass_MotDePasse", "", True) v_Serveur = StrLeft(ndb.Server, "/") v_Fichier = Replace(ndb.FilePath, "\", "/") Me.URL = |https://| & v_Serveur & |.serti.com:443/| & v_Fichier & |/| & p_NomWSP & |?OpenWebService| Me.Resultat = 1 End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Me.Resultat = -9 Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_wsc, gc_Element_wsc, GetThreadInfo(1), p_NomDB, False) Exit Sub End Sub End Class

Function A_MajTraitementCommande(pnd_CSFa As NotesDocument) As Integer On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_DateFacturation_Cible As Variant Dim v_DateDerniereFacture As Variant Dim v_PeriodeFacturation As String Dim nd_CEnt As NotesDocument Dim v_NoContratFmt As String Dim v_DateFactureJusquau_Old As Variant Dim v_DateFactureJusquau As Variant Dim v_DateFin As Variant Dim v_DateFacturation As Variant Dim v_DateFacturation_Old As Variant Dim v_NoCommande As String Dim v_DateCommande As Variant Dim v_MontantFinancement As Double Dim nd_CSCo As NotesDocument Dim ndt As New NotesDateTime("") Dim v_osIndic As String Dim s As String
A_MajTraitementCommande = 0 v_osIndic = "OS_CDF - " & Format(Today, "YYYYMM") v_NoContratFmt = xVar(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_NoContratFmt" , "")
v_DateFacturation_Cible = DateNumber(2026, 02, 01) '*************************************************************** v_DateDerniereFacture = xVar(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_DateDerniereFacture", Today) If v_DateDerniereFacture <> v_DateFacturation_Cible Then Exit Function End If
v_PeriodeFacturation = xVar(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_PeriodeFacturation", "") If v_PeriodeFacturation <> "01" Then Exit Function End If
v_DateFactureJusquau_Old = xVar(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_DateFactureJusquau", Today)
' Extraire dernière commande Call xSIFc_Initialisations If gnv_CEnt60_A Is Nothing then Set gnv_CEnt60_A = gndb_xSIFc.GetView("V_CEnt60") Call gnv_CEnt60_A.Refresh End If Set nd_CEnt = gnv_CEnt60_A.GetDocumentByKey("SDSCS;" & xVar(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_NoContrat" , ""), True) If nd_CEnt Is Nothing Then Call SIGE_AjouterLog("A_TraiterFacturations - Contrat " & v_NoContratFmt & " Erreur commande manquante", 1, 0, True) Exit Function ElseIf xVar(nd_CEnt, "CEnt_Statut", "") <> "99" Then Call SIGE_AjouterLog("A_TraiterFacturations - Contrat " & v_NoContratFmt & " Erreur commande statut", 1, 0, True) Exit Function Else v_DateFacturation_Old = xVar(nd_CEnt, "CEnt_DateFacturation", Today) If v_DateFacturation_Old = "" Or v_DateFacturation_Old < v_DateDerniereFacture Then Exit Function End If End If
v_NoCommande = xVar(nd_CEnt, "CEnt_NoCommande" , "")
' Calculer date facturé jusqu'au ndt.LSLocalTime = v_DateFacturation_Cible Call ndt.SetAnyTime 'Call ndt.AdjustMonth(1) Call ndt.AdjustDay(-1) v_DateFactureJusquau = ndt.LSLocalTime v_DateFin = xVar(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_DateFin" , "") If v_DateFin < v_DateFactureJusquau Then v_DateFactureJusquau = v_DateFin End If If v_DateFactureJusquau >= v_DateFactureJusquau_Old Then Exit Function End If
' Calculer date facturation ndt.LSLocalTime = v_DateFacturation_Old Call ndt.SetAnyTime Call ndt.AdjustMonth(-1) v_DateFacturation = ndt.LSLocalTime
' ---------------------- Début de la maj 'Call SDSCSFa_MAJChampsRenversement(pnd_CSFa) Call A_MAJChampsFactureJusquau(pnd_CSFa, v_NoCommande, v_DateFactureJusquau, v_MontantFinancement)
If xVar(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_DatePremiereFacture", "") = "" Then Call xAssignerDate(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_DatePremiereFacture", Today) End If
pnd_CSFa.CSFa_NoCommande = v_NoCommande Call xAssignerDate(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_DateDerniereFacture", v_DateFacturation) v_DateCommande = v_DateFacturation - 1 'xVar(nd_CEnt, "CEnt_DateCommande", "") Call xAssignerDate(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_DateDerniereCommande", v_DateCommande) Call xAssignerDate(pnd_CSFa, "CSFa_DateFactureJusquau", v_DateFactureJusquau)
Call SDSCSFa_MajDatesProchaine(pnd_CSFa, False) Call SDSCSFa_ValidationFacturationTerminee(pnd_CSFa)
Set nd_CSCo = xSDSCS_xndCSCo(v_NoContratFmt, True ) If Not nd_CSCo Is Nothing Then Call xAssignerDate(nd_CSCo, "CSCo_DateDerniereCommande", v_DateCommande) Call nd_CSCo.Save(True,False) End If
pnd_CSFa.OS_CDF = v_osIndic If SDSCSFa_AssignerStatutFacturation(pnd_CSFa , "50", v_osIndic) = False Then Call pnd_CSFa.Save(True, False) End If
If v_MontantFinancement <> 0 Then Call A_MAJFinancement(pnd_CSFa, v_NoCommande, v_MontantFinancement) Call SIGE_AjouterLog("A_TraiterFacturations - Contrat " & v_NoContratFmt & " maj + financement.", 0, 0, True) Else Call SIGE_AjouterLog("A_TraiterFacturations - Contrat " & v_NoContratFmt & " maj.", 0, 0, True) End If
A_MajTraitementCommande = 1 Exit Function
GererErreur: A_MajTraitementCommande = -1 Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCSFa, gc_Element_SDSCSFa, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

' Create a collection of ALL design elements
Set nc = db.CreateNoteCollection(False)
Call nc.SelectAllDesignElements(True) ' Grabs forms, views, agents, etc.
Call nc.BuildCollection
' Export the entire collection to the stream
Set exporter = session.CreateDXLExporter(nc, stream)
Call exporter.Process
Call stream.Close
End Sub
